dkar chagagleng brjod 1 bstod pa/nges pa don bstod/ 1bstod pa phan bde 'byung gnas/ 7 gegs sel chen mo/ 9dgongs gcig rtsa ba/ 11gzhung 'grel nyi ma'i snang ba/ 23spyi don dang po/ chos 'khor gyi tshoms/ 36spyi don gnyis pa/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs/ 112spyi don gsum pa/ 'dul ba so so ṛ thar pa'i tshoms/ 135 spyi don bzhi pa/ bslab pa byang chub sems kyi tshoms/ — laspyi don lnga pa/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i tshoms/ 242spyi don drug pa/ lta sgom spyod pa'i tshoms/ 34spyi don bdun pa/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi tshoms/ 3maspyi don brgyad pa/ lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa/ 31 9mjug byang/ 439

cha/nyam/ med 'bre gung ji 'i chornga/ ye /meng brjod/da༅༅/ /oṃ swasti/ /sems kyi rdo rje yan lag bdun ldan kun gas la ngogs/ /'gag med rang rtsal zung 'jug lnga ldan tsha zer can/ /bang 'dul ston mdzad sprul sku phrin las snang brgya 'gyed/ /sku gsum dbyer med 'dren mchog shākya'i tog der 'dud//gang gi lung rtogs bstan la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /skyes chen mkha' la rgyu ska/ra grangs ltar yang / /sbas pa'i dgongs don bange ṅga ba/ gsal mdzad pa/ /'jig rten gsum mgon bdag sog/sa 'gro rnams skyongs//de yang 'dren pa mnyam med thub dbang ra t+na shrī the/ ci rme/ ༷ ste 5gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu phrin las thams cad

—— —da wa da wa da wad wa ——da —po/cig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs mchog mtha' me/da kyi ma rgan sems can bzod med las nyon gyi duḥkhas mnar ba rnams la gzhom med kyis snying rjes ma bzod pas dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su sku skye ba bzhes//rtsod med kyi skyes chen du ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor bstan te mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i nying khu blo gros hub kyis bzhes nas lam tshul rim pa bzhin du bzhugs pas thub pa'i gsung rabs thams cad kyi bdag por gyur//dgung grangs so lngar/ zhag gsum dros bzhi'i nang pa na/ ci mi bo bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan gcig go/ /zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha phye/ /gnyis med 'od gsal chen po la/ /'a/nyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yi na nam snyam/ /zhes/ gsungs te mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba med pa chos sku rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal/sar snyegs//de nas bzung bgrang bya bzhi bcu ring lha klu mi sogs

—da da —'khor 'bum phrag du mar 'khor 'das kyi chos kun gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs te/ de yang mgon po klus/ rten cing 'brel ba 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod gcig gces pa zab mo ste//zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las brtsam ste zab rgyas kyi chos tshul dpag tu med pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba rnams phyi nang gi zab chos su bzhugs//de dag gi snying por gyur pa dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'am khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos zhes/ mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i lta sgom spyod gsum dang so byang sngags sogs kyi dka' gnad ches rtogs dka' ba rnams nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo bka' yi bsdu ba po grub chen brgyad cu'i spyi mes sa ra ha slar yang 'gro ba'i don du phebs pa spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyis rdo rje'i gsung brgya dang lnga bcu dang lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu lhag rnams tshoms brgyad du bsdu ba dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos che chung lnga tsam mdzad//rdo rje'i gsung zhes pa'i go don ni/ chos kun rten

spyo'abrel rang babs las mi phyed pas na rdo rje/ gshes de las gzhan du 'gyur du med pas na rdo rje/ rtog ge mkhan gyi blo yi spyod yul du gyur dka' bas na rdo rje/ de nyid rtogs na ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ste ma rig 'khrul pa'i ri bo chen po rtsad nas 'byin pas na rdo rje zhes so//de yang dper na/ sangs rgyas dge sdig byed po lta bu ma yin pa gang zag la ltos te so byang sngags kyi sdom pa gsum char sdig pa mi dge ba spong byed thabs su gyur pa gcig kho na las gzhan du ma bstan/ mdo sngags gang yang rung mi dge ba'i gshis mi dge ba las 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang / dge ba'i gshis dge ba las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bas rgyu 'bras kyi 'dug stangs bstan pa des na thar 'dod kyi skyes bu rnams blang dor gyi mig 'byed ched bstan bcos 'di nyid la mngon par byang chub dgos par de gal che ba mngon//de ltar bstan bcos chen po de nyid la snga bar phyi gsum la 'grel byed mang du byung yang 'dir kun mkhyen chos kyi grags pa

snyozhes sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba bcu phrag rig pa'i dbang phyug 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel ba dgongs gcig nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa rnams gsal zhing mang nyung ran pa blo ldan rnams 'jug ngogs shin tu bde ba mthong ste dwangs bas bskul nas deb gzugs su par bskun zhus pa dang bcas gleng bar brjod pa 'di yang bod yul kha ba can gyi ljongs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang tsā ri phag gdong nag po thugs kyi gnas mchog gi nye 'dabs su skyes pa mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis byang phyogs a ri'i yul me ri lanaḍa mnga' sde 'khri gung bka' brgyud kyi chos sder bod shing phag zla 3 tshes 19 dang / 1995 phyi zla potshes 18 nyin bris pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas su gyur cig/phyag dpe 'di nyid rig mdzod nang du blugs pa po/lugs gnyis mkhyen brgya'i snang ba phyogs med du rgyas pa nang srid drung chogazur pa 'jam dbyangs gling bkris stobs rgyal mchog gis

4 ni//mdzad brel bar skabs su gnang //par bskrun gyi mdzad 'khur/ lhag bsam rmad byung mdzangs shing gzhung pa yo red tshang brtson 'grus siṅgas gnang //par bskrun gyi 'gro song rnams a ri mnyam med 'khri gung bka' brgyud chos sdos zhus pa chos ldan gyi bya ba'i grogs su gyur pa legs byas 'dis mtshon bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis du gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga lam̐/

bstod pa/ gedamosku/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum mgon la nges pa don gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //dbe༅/ /oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dpal ldan rin po che/ /'khor 'das mnyam sbyor bde chen ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /'bri gung bzhugs pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po khyod ni snying po byang chub du/ /mi bzad nyon mongs bdud kyi sde bcom zhing / /gdod nas rnam grol ye shes sku brnyes pa/ /'jig rten rnam 'dren khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /mi phyed rdo rje gcig tu gyur pa'i sku/ /'phags pa rnams dang lhar bcas kyis mchod pa/ /chos rgyal bla med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni rab 'byams 'jig rten thams cad du//rnam 'phrul bsam yas mi zad 'khor lo yis/ /'gro kun rnam grol sa la 'god mdzad pa/ /phrin las mtha' yas khyod la phyag

mi dgongs gcig nyi na snang /'tshal lo/ /khyod ni skye rga na 'chi las grol zhing / /gtsang bdag bde rtag yon tan pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje rgyal po mya ngan mi 'da' ba / /dus gsum 'gyur med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni 'khor 'das bdag po chos kyi rje/ /dkon mchog gsum rgyun nam yang mi 'chad pas/ /las can 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs gyur kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las mtha' yas pas/ /'khrul pas bcings pa'i skye bo rnam mang po/ /nyes tshogs srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /dus kyi rgyal po me mo glang gi lo/ /dbyar zla ra ba mar gyi tshes bcu la/ /kun bzang nags khrod dpal gyi 'bri gung du/ /ye shes sprul pa'i sku yi dkyil 'khor de//rnam grol chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa bstan/ /de tshe tshu rol mthong ba'i skye bo rnams/ /kye ma de ring 'jig rten mgon med zhes//smre sngags 'o dod chen po'i sgra skad 'don/ /khyod ni mi rtag mya ngan 'das pa med/ /gang tshe khyod la bdag gis 'di skad du/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs tshe/ /rdo rje'i sku 'di rtag par bzhags

bstod pa/ 3nas kyang / /lus can 'gro ba smin par mdzad gsol zhes/ /zhu ba zhus par de tshe zhal snga nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par ma gyur tshe/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs pa nga nyid yin/ /bu cig mya ngan sdug bsngal ma byed cig /ci phyir zhe na bla ma dam pa'i sku/ /dri med rnam dag chos kyi sku yin te/ /gtsang bdag bde rtag yon tan mthar phyin pas/ /nga yi sku la log par ma lta gsung / /de lta na yang bdag la the tshom ste/ /mgon po khyod ni 'di nas gshegs nas kyang / /sangs rgyas zhing khams gang du bzhud par 'gyur/ /bdag cag thams cad gsol ba gang du gdab/ /de skad zhus pas nyid kyi zhal snga nas//sangs rgyas zhing khams 'di yin gang na yod/ /khyed kyi sems nyid sto rka / rgya chen po dang / /dbyer med gcig tu gyur par nga bzhugs te//rang sems sgom dang 'bral bar ma byed dang / /nga dang 'bral ba med pa de nyid yin/ /u rgyan dza lan d+ngha ra la sogs pa/ /gnas gcig bzhugs pa nga la gang la yod/ /de skad gsungs pas nan tan chen po yis/ /phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtsho ma lus dang / /rang gi

rgo dgongs gcig nyin snang /lus srog ltos med phul nas kyang / /chos rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las la/ /bdag cag kun gyis log par bltas pa dang / /'gro bas bgyis pa'i nongs pa thams cad kun/ /da ltar mgon po'i spyan sngar so sor bshags/ skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med par zhu/ de skad zhus pas chos rje'i zhal snga nas/ khyod kyis nga la mi mnyes ma byas te/ /zhabs 'bring zhabs tog kun gyis mnyes par byas/ /res 'ga' bkyon pa brtse bas phan du re/ /nga la mya ngan 'da' ba mi rimanga' ste/ /khyed dang rtag tu 'bral ba med pa yin/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bzhugs pa ma yin yang/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro ci lo phan byas pa/ /nga la mi che khyod la mi chung ste/ /mchur rmenyam zheng 4 ma nyam bang mnyam 'chongs par mnyam/ /mngon dga' la sogs 'a gro ba gzhan med de/ /sangs rgyas zhing yang 'di nyid kho na yin//dpa' chen khyod kyis de skad gsungs pas na/ /bde gshegs gnyis su gsung ba mi sred pas/ /ji srid 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe//mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par nges/ /rnam 'dren khyod kyis

bstod pa/ 5thog mar gang gsungs pa/ /bar du bka' stsal de nyid kho na ste/ /tha mar gdams pa 'di las gzhan med na/ /tha dad brjod pa 'khrul pa kho nar zad/ /de ltar mgon po khyod ni bzhugs gyur cing / /mya ngan mi 'da' gsung gis dbug sa phyung yang / /bdagacag phal pa'i mig gyis ma mthong ba/ /kye ma 'dir ni nges par mtshar cig byas/ /deng nas bzung ste 'khor ba ma stongs tshe/ /mnyam med bla ma rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs/ /mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas sgoge /skad cig /tsam yang 'bral ba med par shog/ /khyod kyis mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rten 'brel mngon 'gyur zhing/ lakhor 'das chos rnams sgrib pa med pa dang / /rnam 'phrul bkod pa mtha' yas mthong bar shog /khyod kyi zhabs kyi drung nas mi g.yo zhing / /phyogs bcu 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad du / /'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang po ji lta bar/ /dgongs pa ma lus thams cad bsgrub par ribalto///bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba thams cad kun/ /bsod nams rdo rje'i lhun po brtan pa dang / /shes rab rdo rjes nyes pa'i tshogs bcom
ste/ /bde chen ye shes rdo rje'i gnas thob shog/ zhes chos kyi rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po la nges pa don gyi bstod pa spyan dza shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'o/ dge'o//

bstod pa/ 7dmosku/ /bstod pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas byang chub rin po che bzhugs so//༈ /oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum byel ba sras bcas kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig bsdus spral pa'i sku/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po 'khri gung pa/ /rin sman dpal zhes grags pas dge legs stsol//mgon khyod gdod nas mngon par byang chub kyang / /srid pa ji srid ye shes thugs rjes 'phrul/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol pa yang ston pas/ /'gro kun skyob pa'i khar chen bsnams la 'dad/ /gangs can 4 4 nge sa )4 ༄ 4 snaljangs 'dar thag pa chan pa' tshul/ /bshad dang sgrub pa' sga nas gsal ma/ dzad pa'i/ /phrin las nyin byed 'dzam gling yongs la khyab//'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po khyod la 'dud/ /gang gis khyod la gus shing gsol 'debs na/ bslu med thugs rjes gzigs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ /snyegs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag rjes 'jug rnams/ /mgon po khyod las re ltos su la 'cha'/ /de phyir snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /sngon gyi dam bca' chen po ma bsnyel

8 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bar/ /bstan 'dzin 'phel zhing bstan pa rgyas pa yi/ /'dod don lhun gyis 'grub par gyin gyis rlobs/ /bskal ngan dus kyi rgyud pa zhi ba dang / /snod bcud dpal dang yon tan gong du 'phel/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /gnas 'dir 'du zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs pa'i mthil/ /nges don mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /phyogs dus kun tu darashing rgyas pa dang / bslab gsum yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i re 'bras rnams/ /yid bzhin 'dod dgur smin pa'i dge legs kyis/ /sa gsum bkra shis dpal dang ldan pa yi//ngo mtshar snang ba chen pos khyab gyur cig/ // ces pa'ang bslab gsum nor bu'i rgyan mnga' kun grags sprul pa'i sku dbon 'khor bcas bkas bskul pa ltar/ /tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis kyi grangs ldan 'di mi pham rnam par rgyal bas bka' brgyud thub bstan dar rgyas gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel/༈ /shes bya kun gzigs kun mkhyen chos kyi rje/ /rten 'brel gnad la dbang thob 'bri gung pa/ /rin chen dpal gyi bstan pa srid mtha'i bar/ /bshad bsgrub thos bsam bsgom pas 'dzin gyur cig/ // ces pa'ang mi pham pas so//

bstod pa/ 9da༅༅/ /gegs sel chen mo ston pa dar ma blo gros kyis zhus pa'o/༈ /pha chos kyi rgyal po rin po che/ /bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi//pha rje btsun de yi byi na rlabs kyis/ /rang blo la gdams ngag 'di tsho byung / /bu dmigs med kyi snying rje ma brtan tshe/ /smon lam gyi brtson 'grus ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan don gyi zhe 'dod ma che cig/ /rgyu med kyi 'bras bur 'gro nyen gda'o/ rang rdo rje 'chang du ma song tshe//brgyud pa gong ma ma gtogs pa/ /rang 'khor la sgom du ma 'jug / cig 'khrul pa la nying 'khrul snon nyen gda'o/ /tshad med thubs/ rje ma skyes tshe/ /tshe 'di log pa'i blo gros kyis/ /rtsa rlung gi gdams ngag ma sgom cig /rang gshed rang gis bskor nyen gda'o/ /gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa ma nub tshe/ /nga med kyi kha lta ma che cig /mi chos bla ma'i brdzun po yis/ /mnar med kyi phud shing byed nyen gda'o/ /tshe

40 dgongs gcig nyin snang /'di'i bsam pa ma thengs tshe/ /khe drags kyi ri khrod ma bsten cig/nyon mongs dug gi stobs 'phel nas/ —/rang nyid ngan sar lhung nyen gda'o/ /snang sems gcig tu ma 'dres tshe/ /rtsa ba sgom pa ma gtogs pa/ /mtho dman gyi las la ma 'dzug cig /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung nyen gda'o/ /'di gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te//rang gi shes pa bskul bar bas/ /dug gsum nyon mongs kyi g.yo med na/ /sgrib pa spangs pa'i kha tshon du/ /smon lam myur du 'grub pa 84skurdor// // gegs sel chen mo skyob pa rin po ches gsungs pa'o// mar+shar+shar+sha//

rtsa ba/ ga ༄༅༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i gzhung zhes bya ba bzhugs che| // dmo༅/ /rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /dre med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ji lta ba/ /thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje/ /mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo//rgyal ba mchog gi zhal nas gsungs pa yi/ /dam chos khyad 'phags thun mong ma yin pa/ /sngon du mdzad pa'i bzhed tshul dpag med kyang / /mongs pas dran pa cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /chos kun gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bsta na/ /chos phung brgyad khri sangs rgyas sgrub par gcig /lje snod rgyud sde lam gyi rim pa yin/ /chos 'khor rnam gsum 'khor gyi rtog pa'i khyad/ /'khor lo re re la yang gsum ga tshang / /phyi cha/'i sa bom snga ma snga mar gnas / /mdo don gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du nges/

2 dgongs gcig nyin snang //'du 04 ba'i sde snod bden bzhi'i chos 'khor te/ /theg pa sna tshogs nges don 'khor lo yin/ /mtha' drug dgongs pa nges don 'ba' zhig bzhed//sems tsam bka' yis mtha' bral dbu ma ston/ /log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus/ /ji snyed lam rnams sa bcus bgrod pa ste/ /de yang rim gyis 'jug pa kho nar nges/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa thog mar spong ba'ang yod/ /tshad ma sangs rgyas mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ /tshad ma'i 'bras bus zab mo stong nyid ston/ /grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud pa/ /mu stegs pa la'ang dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang / /phyi nang khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed pa ste/ /theg pa che chung khyad par sems bskyed yin//mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par dbang yin te/ /de gnyis gang med rdzogs byang thob mi srid/ /sdom gsum mi dge bcu spong gnad gcig la/ /bdag ko ṣ+pe/ 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong / /rang bzhin rnam dag bral 'bras 6den tan ldan/ /byang phyogs so bdun bde gshegs snying por yod/ /tshad rme /da rna dzom/ bzhi sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ /theg pa thams cad rig gcig theg pa ra po/ces/ /nyan rang log sred can yang rnam mkhyen 'gyur/ /chos 'khor gnad bsdus kyi skabs te dang po'o//

rtsa ba/ gci༈ /dge sdig gnyis las lung ma bstan gzhan med/ /rtog gnyis gcig car 'jug pa mi sred la/ /sems byung las kyang sem sa ni 'byung ba'ang yod/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lus nyid 'khor bar bzhed//rten 'brel bcu gnyis ma rig kho nas g.yos/ /bcu gnyis de yang ska da cig gcig la tshang / /sems ni tha dad dbang gi snang ba yang / /da lta nyid du gang bsgrub 'bras bur spyod/ /dus kyi 'phel 'grib da lta bya yod yin//tshe 'di rang la ma thong chos gtso bor 'byung / /mi chos bcu drug lha chos gnad gcig ste/ /gtso phal tsam las 'bras thob rgyun chad med/ /shes rab bslab pa thog mar 'gro ba'ang yod/ /lam rim thams cad thun gcig nyams len dgos/ /zhi nga gcig la yang sangs rgyas grangs med 'byon/ /rten 'brel gnad bsdus kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o/༈ /dam chos 'dul ba theg pa thun mong ste/ /lhag par theg pa chen por gsal bzhugs la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di nyid yin/ /bar chad ldan la'ang sdom pa skye nges te/ /ngo bo rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs/ /ltung ba mtha' dag la ni 'du shes gtso/ /yid kyi gsum gtso bor spong ba dgos/ /gtong ba'i rgyu yis mi gtong ba yang mod/

44 dgongs gcig nyin snang / /pham pa bzhi ni bu lon nor can bzhin/ /sna gcig bsrungs pas 'bras bu myang 'das 'thob/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho gcig /sdig ltung tha dad med cing gcig pa yin/ /bkag pa ye bkag gnang ba ye gnang la//chos kyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas/ /'gro ba gang gis 'das kyang nyes pa dang / /bsrungs pa'i phan yon yang ni kun la 'byung / /bstan la cho ga lhag par gal che la/ /mi shes gti mug nyes pa gzhan las lci/ /dud 'gro gti mug che bas dman pa yin/ /nyams las ma thob nyes pa che bar bzhed/ /so thar gnad bsdus kyi skabs te gsum pa'o/ ༈ /byang chub sems dang snying rje tha dad yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rten can bzhed/ /so so skye bo la yang 'jug sdom skye//ci rigs kyis kyang 'jug pa'i sdom par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs can min ltung ba mi srid cing / /nyes par mi 'gyur mi dge gnang ba med/ /thabs mkhas spyod la mi dge yod ma yin/ /rang gzhan brje ba nyes par 'gyur skabs yod/ /sems dpar gnod byas bde bar mi 'brel zhing / /dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu so sor 'byung / /byang chub sems ni brjed las 'chor mi srid/ /sgreb pa rnam gsum nyon mongs sgreb pa gcig /dzi sred

rtsa ba/ 45grub pa'i don dam bden pas bsgribs/ /nyan thos kyis kyang gnas lugs phyogs gcig mthong / /sa drug man chad nyan rang thun mong ste/ /sems tsa ma pa ni sa bdun mngon rtogs yin/ /chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad mngon du byas/ /rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod/ /sa thob yon tan 'byung tshul mu drug yod/ /gzhi lam 'bras bur tshogs gnyis zung 'jug nas/ /mtho dman kun tu zhing ne gdam pa zab/ /bdag tu bzang ste tshogs bsags thabs mkhas bzhed/ /'khor 'das kun gyis bsags yod dge ba bsngo/ /sangs rgyas bla ma la yang bsngo ba dgos/ /byang sems gnad bsdus kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o/༈ /gsang sngags bstan pa gzhan la'ang 'byungab yod//dbang don rgyu da la skyes nas thob par bzhed/ /lha ni phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur 'gro/ /rtogs pa ma skyes dpe don khong mi chud/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gdod nas yongs su grub/ /rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga dgos/ /lha rnams thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan ldan / /mdo rgyud las gsungs lha rnams gtso bor bya/ /dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa dgos/ /spros pa thams cad babs kyi rten 'brel yin/ /rdo rje'i lus

46 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ni zab mo'i 'khor lor bzhed/ /gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gis sbas/ /las dang 'dug tshul 'ga' zhig sman rgyud zab/ /gzhan gyi mi zab pa rnams 'dir zab ste/ /de med rtsa rlung gdams pas sangs mi rgya//bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyams myong log rtog yin/ /dgongs pa tham sa cad 'gal med shes par dgos/ /gdams ngag ltar min bka' ltar 'ong bar bzhed/ /skyon rme/da ting 'dzin khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /sku gsum re re la yang gzhan gnyis tshang / /gsang sngags la ni tshul khrims med ka med/ /'dod pas bar du gcod pa mdo sngags gcig /sngags kyi mi dge dge bar 'gyur skabs med/ /'dul bar mi dge sngags su'ang dger mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs dag 'bras bde bar gshegs pa nyid//mthu bstan tsam las mngon spyod gnang ba med/ /rdo rje dmyal ba mnar med la sogs yin/ /slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na myur du 'dren/ /gsang sngags gnad bsdus kyi skabs te lnga pa'o/༈ /dam pa'i chos gang brgyud par 'brel pa zab/ /'khor 'das chos kun rang gi sems snang tsam/ /rgyu 'bras skad cig bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin/ /gshes la mi gnas bltas pas 'gyur mi srid/

rtsa ba/ 17/mtshan nyid mi ldan yon tan skyed mi nus/ /rtogs pa skyed thabs mos gus kho nar nges/ /lta ba'i mchog gyur rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ /chen po gsum gyis ma reg rtogs pa'i mchog /thos bsam sgom pa'i stong nyid shor gol yin/ /rtogs pa goms par byed pa sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa blang dor bral ba tshul khrims bzhed/ /lta sgom spyod gsum tha dad med par gcig/ /phyag chen tshul khrims gnad gcig khyad par chos/ /phyag chen yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /mnyam par gzhag las yon tan thams cad 'byung / /rgyu ni ma bsgrubs yon tan 'byung mi srid/ /stong nyid rtogs na rgyu 'bras nyid du ldang / /rtogs ldan la yang thabs lam lhag par dgos//rigs spyod khyad du 'phags pa tshul khrims yin/ /chos gsum mi ldan nyan rang khyad par med/ /lta sgom spyod pa gnad bsdus kyi skabs te drug pa'o ༈ /sangs rgyas sa na bden gnyis rnam dbyer med//mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyi sa med mtha' dang bral/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag 'das/ /sangs rgyas dus rnams rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs//bral ba'i 'bras bus ye shes thugs can bzhed/ /chos sku yon tan

48 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mdzad pa phrin las bcas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas sa na'ang thugs bskyed yod/ /thugs ni rtag chad lta ba tshun la'ang 'byung / shes byar srid tshad sangs rgyas bya ba byed/ /chos dbyings kun tu 'tshang rgya dgos par bzhed//rgyu med sprul pa mi srid rang rgyud pa/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya rten cing 'brel 'byung sku/ /smon 'jug longs sprul rgyu ru bzhes pa'ang yod/ /sku gsum tha dad med cing bzhugs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas tham sa cad sems can rgyud la bzhugs/ /'bras bu gnad bsdus kyi skabs te bdun pa'o/༈ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'di na pha yi bu/ /longs spyod phal pa'i 'byor ba ldan gyur kyang / /pha yi khyad nor gzhan la med pa dag /ma thos mi 'dzin de ni smad pa ltar/ /de bzhin mtshungs med 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /mngon du mdzad pa'i khyad par chos 'di dang / /sngon chad ma grags phyi dus 'jig rten 'dir/ /rjes 'brang sras kyis mi 'dzin de dang mtshungs/ /de phyir rigs ldan pha yi gdung 'tshobs pa/ /rigs 'tshol gzhan la smod par mi byed cing / /grags ldan de yi bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs rnams/ /nan tan chen pos 'dzin pa ngo mtshar che//bstan 'dzin chos mdzad skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /bu stong nang du 'khor lke

rtsa ba/ 49lo sa sgyur rgyal gyi/ / mtshan ldan sras ni khyad par 'phags pa bzhin//bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kun gyi nang na mdzes/ /thun mong ma yin dam pa'i snying po dang / /rab 'byams thub pa'i bka' la ma mongs pas/ /phyi rol rgol ba ngan pa'i wa tshogs kyis/ /gangs can seng ge lta bur nyam nga med//rigs mthun 'khor dang sna tshogs gdul bya la/ /ma 'dres chos kyi khyad par legs bstan pa/ /dman dang mchog gi bye brag rab phye ste/ /snyan pa'i sgra chen 'brug sgra phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /de ltar zab cing rgya che bla med pa'i//dgongs pa rgya mtsho che ltar yangs pa las/ /skra rtse'i chu thig tsam zhig smras pa 'di/ /ban ldom shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris/ /rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba 'dis/ /rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / 'dzig rten mi shes gti mug rnam bral zhing / /mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog ces pa 'di ni spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung de nyid sor bzhag la/ rang gzhan 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du rdo rje'i gsung rnams tshigs bcad du bsdebs te chos kyi rje skyob pa yab sras kyi bstan pa la dad pa'i blo can dkon mchog rin chen 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ khyi lo hor zla dang po'i nyer gsum la khams kyi be ri thang gi sgar thog tu bris pa'o// //༈ 'di yi lhan thabs/ lji na mo gu ru/ byang chub snying po

20 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rdul bral zhing khams su/ /rang byung rgyal ba yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas//mtshungs med chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /thub dbang 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa ma chog de'i zhal gyi pad+mo nas/ /legs 'ong thun mong ma yin rdo rje'i gsung / /lhan thabs bzhi bcu'i rtsa ba bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'dod ldan rnams bde yid dga'i dpal du byin/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa gcig /theg dang grub mtha' thams cad rten 'brel yin/ /chos phung brgyad khri nyon mongs gnyen por gsungs/ /re re la yang gsung rab bcu gnyis tshang / /de bzhin sde snod gcig la'ang gsum ka 'dus/ /'khor 'das thams cad phun tshogs lnga yis bsdus//thun mong thun mong ma yin mngon pa'i sde/ /mu stegs bon gyis bden pa mthong skabs med/ /thar pa cha mthun 'ga' zhig yod kyang rung / /sdom dang snying rje phyi rol pa la'ang yod/ /mtshan nyid theg pas tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya/ /chos dang nyams len 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig /sdom gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro/ /mthar thug sa tshun tshogs lam ngo bos bgrod/ /rgyu dang ldan phyir nyan rang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /spros pa bral phyir 'khor ba mtha' med bzhed/ /chos kun so thar sdom gsum re rer

rtsa ba/ 2 'du/ /sde pa kun gyi rtsa ba lung sde bzhi/ /rmi lam du ni nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung / /dag pa'i sa thob ngan 'gror song ba'ang yod/ /rgyu spyad gyur na sa bcu pa yang ltung / /nyams len mad byung rnal 'byor nang gi tshogs/ /ting 'dzin mtha' dag rdo rje lta bu ste/ /sde snod gsum mam de yi snyeng po sngags//rtogs kyang brgyud pa zab phyir cho ga dgos/ /lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad 'grub/ /lha kun mtshan ni lhag pa'i lha yis bzung / /dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang skabs med/ /lha la cig car 'jug pa zab mo'i gnad/ /rten 'brel 'tshogs las grub par shes pa dgos/ /tha mal lus su btags phyir dka' thub smad/ /drang nges med par cho ga rgyas par dgos/ /de yis 'dul na bsdus pa yang ni bzhed/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rmad byung byang chub sems/ /rtsa rlung gdams pa 'dul ba lhag par dgos/ /byin mthus kun gzhi dus gzhan du yang mthong / /rtsa rlung thig le snyigs ma dug bcas zab/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim bslab pa gsum/ /phar phyin drug ni theg pa gsum ga'i lam/ dpon slob phan tshun dam tshig mnyam par gcig /dge ba'i ngo bos phyag chen sgrib mi srid//bral ba'i 'bras bu thams cad rgyu dang bcas/ /nam mkha' gnyis 'dres

22 dgongs gcig nyin snang /nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs/ /rlung mi 'dzin pa lhugs par 'jog par zab//rnam shes bla ma 'od gsal 'pho ba'i mchog /byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs sangs rgyas yin/ /de ltar gang gi dgongs pa kun gsal mtha'//dbang thobe rnams kyis dpag pa sla mi yang / /'dab ldan mkha' lding dbang po spyan snga ba'i/ /mkhyen spyod gshog yangs rlabs kyis bgrod pa gang //sngon byon rnams kyis gsal bar byas mod kyang / /blo dman rnams la phan phyir lhan thabs rnams/ /tshigs su bcad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng / /dpyod ldan dga' ba'i do shal 'di star bas/ /legs byas dge ba stong phrag 'bar ba'i gzisang/ /skye 'gro'i sgrib mun cig car drung phyung nas//lung dang rtogs pa'i tshogs gnyis pad mo'i tshal/ /rgyas pa'i bcud la rol pa'i dpal thob shog ces rna dajig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa'i dam pa'i chos dgongs ba gcig pa'i lhan thabs/ tshigs su bcad pa'adi slob dpon rdzogs chen tshang sogs mos ldan rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor 7rje bla ma dharma surus rtsal ba'o// //

gzha 'gral/ 23༄༅༅/ paramasudharma0hrīXyikasabibhāṣaṇaṅgārgamotsikaraswār+yasaṅgāXnāmabihārasraswabhāṣaṇa0ste/ //༄༅༅/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//legs par bshad par yod/ /

24 dgongasagaciganyenasnang/ da wa da༅༅/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed nyi ma'i snang ba zhes (1 ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub mkha' bzhin 'dus ma byas/ /rji lta dzi snyed ye shes phul byung gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rnam mi rtog /tshogs gnyis goms pas rang don mthar son smon lam stobs kyis 'gro rnams sgrol/ /rnam grol rnam pa kun ldan thub rnams rnam pa kun tu phyag gi gnas/ 1 /rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'o mtsho las thon smon lam dag pa'i 'od dkar can/ /rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe yon tan kun gyi ri dwags lang tsho rnam bkra zhing / /rgyal kun mdzad phrin gcig tu bsdus pa'i bstan pa'i snying po bsil phreng can//rgyal ba 'khri gung pa zhes yongs grags 'gro blo'i ku mud bsrung der 'dud/ 3 /dzi lta dzi snyed shes rab mchog mnga' rgya la kun bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gtso/ /blo gros rdo rje'i shes rab mtshon gyis log smra'i ro 'dzin rtsad nas gcod/ /legs bshad rin chen chu gter che las byang chub mchog gi snying po spyon/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin 'khrul med

— rngan(༷/ngange (rwardoXgre()// shāt+na//tre 'doms mdzad dge ba'i bshes rnams bdag gis bstod/ 3 /gang 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa zhes grags rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang gzugs snang ba 'dul mngon byang sems rdo rje'i theg /nges don lta ba rtogs par ldan pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas mngon byed pa/ /rdo rje'i gsung zhes sa gsum srid par nyi ma'i 'od ltar ches gsal mod/ 4 /de dag dgongs pa'i snying po mchog rnams zab cing rgya che gting mtha' bral/ /ches brling rtogs dka'i gnas su gyur tshe blo dman bdag 'dra'i spyod yul du/ /rnam pa kun du ma gyur na yang 'grel byed mkhan po 'ga' zhig gis/ /'khrul pa'i lam du drangs pa'i nyes bshad bod yul 'di na rlung ltar grags/ nga/dus 'dir rdo rje'i gsung zhes smra ba mkha' la skar ma'i tshogs pa ltar/ /nyes bshad legs bshad chol por smra zhing dgongs pa'i don la tshom por gcod/ /zhib mor dris na chu shing bzhin du yid brten snying pos dben kho na/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rna ma par nyams pa ma bzod de/ dze /nges pa'i don gyi dgongs pa mthar thug

26 tsho dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ da wa gsal por smra ba'i mthu thob cing / /rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun kyang skal bzang lam du dkri ba dang / /shes ldan lam 'dir mos pa kun gyis rnam dag grub mtha'i tshul rtogs phyir/ /gang yin dgongs pa gsal por bshad 'di gzur gnas rnams kyis gus pas longs/ 7 /bdag gis nga rgyal shes rlom dag dang gzhan la phrag dog rnyed brtsod dang / /khengs grags spyi brtol mkhas 'dod phyir min dam pa 'i gsung gi gsang ba'i gnad/ /ches cher zab pa rtogs par dka' phyir skal ldan rnams kyis go sla'i phyir/ /lhag bsam zla tshes sar ba ltar dkar blo gros pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ 8/legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston spel gyi nga rgyal chang gis rab myos shing / /rig rus dpal 'byor 'khor tshogs kyis dregs yin rlom bsgyings 'gros nga ro can/ /phrag dog bum pa spyi bor bcangs nas nyes bshad ro 'dzin cher bskyod de/ /chags sdang sug pa'i gar gyis 'joms 'dod gnyis 'thung tshogs rnams ring spangs nas/ 9 /blo gsal skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs rnams gsong po'i mchu yis legs

tha/sdo/(nge(reX/95/ laXsgru myong na/ /blo gros kun dga' rgya cher spel ba'i gtam gyi dga' ston 'dir mchis kyi/ /blo ldan dga' ba'i gshog sgra'i glu dbyangs sa gsum / skye dgu'i bcud len te/ /blo mun sel byed nyi ma'i snang ba rbeshe dhegs mun pa 'joms phyir smra/ 10 /gang gi rdo rje'i gsung rnams gsal byed lung rig 'od brgya'i gzi 'bar ba/ /legs bshad rji snyed gti ma'i 'jing las rnam dpyod gar gyis bsrubs ba'i dpyid/ /blo gros rta bdun stobs kyis nyer drangs skal bzang phrag par deng shar gyi/ /dad ldan slob ma'i mig yid blo gros kun dga' brtas pa'i snang ba spel/ 11/'dir yang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ ston pa nyid kyis zhi/nga dag par bsngags shing lung bstan pa mgon po klu sgrub cerngan shing rta'i srol 'byed chen por byon pa bang de nyid/ slar yang gangs/ rikhyi khrod 'dir mgomyo po 'bri gung pa chen po rat+na shrī zhes mtshan 'dzin pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol mas kha che'i paṇ+ḍita chen po shākya shrī bha dra la dngor ga su gsungs pa rlung ltar grags pa dang / /gzhan yang mdo rgyud du 5ga 6nas/ yang dang yang du lung bstan pa dang / siṅgha gleng gi dgra bcom/ pa chen

28 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pos kyang me tog pad+ma dkar po'i skyes su bskur te bsngags pa sogs bsam las 'das pa'i phyir/ tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bu blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams ni yid ches pa'i gnas kho nar gyur la/ de las gzhan pa'i skal ngan rnams ni rnam pa kun du ma rig pa'i ling tog gis blo gros kyi mig bsgribs pas tshad ma'i yul ma mthong ba'i phyir bas pa nyid du zad de/ mngon rtog rgyan las/ /lha yi dbang pos char phab kyang / /sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang / /skal ba med pas bzang mi myong / /zhes so/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che des ni gdul bya'i snod dang 'tshams par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo dzi snyed cig bskor ba dang / gzhan yang snod ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la chos kyi gtam ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas nyid kyi sa legs par 'doms par mdzad pa la rdo rje'i gsung ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ de dag gi nang nas rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu dang lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcur bsdus te phyi

gzhung 'grel/ 29rabs kyi gang zag rnams 'dzin bde bar mdzad pa 'di rnams 'chad par bya'o/ /'cha da lugs rji lta bu zhe na/ 'grel byed rdo rje shes rab dang rin byang ma sogs ltar spyi bzhed dang rang bzhed sogs so sorabakod cing lung dang rigs pa'i tshogs du ma sbyar na go bde zhing legs bshad kyi phul chen por 'gyur na'ang / slob ma blo dman rnams kyi go yul du chud pa dang / rang nyid kyang yi ge'i ngal bas 'jigs te/ des na rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'khrul pa'i dre ma dang bral ba la lung gi rgyab brten dang bcas bshad pas spyi bzhed rnams rang shugs kyis rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / khrus kyi 'grel ba mkhan po 'ga' zhig gis tshig don bsdus pas don ma khrol ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis rang gi zhe 'dod dang ma 'grigs pas rdo rje'i gsung 'ga' zhig slar bcos nas rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon shing la 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lta bu dang / 'ga' zhig gis spyan snga sher 'byung sogs 'grel byed snga ma gsum la 'khrul par mthong zhing / rang 'dod rtsa ba dang bsres pas tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar gyur pa sogs 'khrul pa'i

30 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lam du drangs pa 'ga' mthong bas de lta bu rnams rnam par spangs te/rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa rang gis rtogs pa dang / 'grel ba snga ma rnams kyi legs pa'i cha rnams bsdus shing / mdo sngags kyi lung gis tshad mar bsgrubs teng mgon po 'bro gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad dang dbyer med cing /bod rgan spyi brtol rnams kyi man ngag phyogs re la zab mor bsngags te brjod pa las dgar ba'i mdo rgyud kun gyi lam rim man ngag thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i tshul du brjod par bya'o/ /de la gnyis/ spyir bstan bcos kyi lus rnam par gzhag pas mdor bsdu ba dang / bye brag so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa'o/ //dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad babs kyi gnas lugs bstan bya ba 'di'i khongs su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos dang chos nyid thams cad 'du na bstan bcos 'di'i lus thams cad kyang 'di nyid kho nar 'du ste/ de yang 'khor ba'i rang

gzhung 'grel/ cigabazhin thams cad kyang rang rang gi gshis sam babs ni kun gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las gang du yang ma 'das te/ rgyud bla ma las/ /thog 54 dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med / /gnyis med ga sum bral dre med rnam rtog med //chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sems can gyi gshis sam babs rang bzhin stong pa de nyid kyi snang ngo ri smon lam dag pa'i chos gsung pa yang / sangs rgyas de nyid kyi sgrogashis sam babs ni smon lam rnam par dag pa'i stobs las byang chub mchog gi rang gzugs su grub pa'i rang rtsal 'gag med du shar ba na/ des gsungs pa'i chos rnams kyi babs rang bzhin gyis gnas lugs gcig po de nyid bstan pa ma gtogs/ la lar drang don/ la lar nges don la sogs pa gsungs pa med mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyis babs kyi chos rnam pa gcig nyid gsungs pa na sems can rnams rang rang gi gshis babs gang yin gyis go lugs so sor byung bas na

32 dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ don yang so sor 'gal ba ltar snang ba bstan bcos mkhan pos mi 'gal ba'i phyir mtha' drug tshul bzhi sogs su bshad pa ste/ don du gshis sam babs de nyid las gzhan du gyur pa med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ /ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi/ /rnga sgra rang gi las las byung / /de bzhin 'jig rten thub pa'i chosang/ /gsung ba rang gi las las byung//zhes dang / de nyid las/ /ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang //yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las thon pa/ /sa la ba tshwa la sogs gonas dbye bas/ /shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad cu'i char/ /rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las thon te/ /'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye ba las/ /rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /des na sangs rgyas rang gi sngon gyi smon lam dang tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i stobs kyis gshis babs las byung ba'i chos kyi tshul rnam pa gcig las ma g.yos par gsungs pa yang rtogs pa med par nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar spros pa/ sems can rnams kyi gshis babs so sor yod pa yang /

gzhung 'grel/ 33 mgon po 'bri gung pas sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad du gsungs ltar go lugs so sor byung ba las don gcig po las ma 'das pa ni/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gsung gcig nyid du gsungs pa yang / /du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes so/ /'khor 'das kun gyi sems la gshis sam rang bzhin zhes brjod pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyud bla ma las/ /sems ni rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod//de ni glo bur dri mas ma rungs byas/ chos nyid sems las gzhan pa sems gzhan ni/ /'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin la brjod do/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i gshis babs de nyid kyang ngo bo dge ba'i rang gshis la bde ba dang / /mi dge ba'i babs las sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur du mi btub par de'i gshis babs rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung zhes pa mtha' gcig po 'di nyid gsung pa ste/mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das/ /mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' ba//las kyi rnam smin 'bras bu kho na gsungs/ /lta ba'i mun bral khyod la

3 4 dgongs gcig nyin snang /phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /des na 'khor 'das gnyis kyang dge sdig gi rang gzugs nyid de/ rang gzugs ni gshis babs las gzhan med pa yang / rdo rje gur las/ /rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i//sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /gnas pa'i don dang rnam shes dag /phyir rol gyur pa 'ga' yang med/ /ces so/ /tshul de 'dra ba des bskal gcig nyid bskal pa grangs med par ston pa dang / zhing khams mtha' yas pa rdul phra ra ba gcig gi nang du 'dzud pa sogs kyang mi shes pa'i snang ngor 'gal ba ltar snang yang don gyi ngo bo rang babs las gzhan du ma 'das pa nyid la chos kyi dbyings sam gshis babs zhes bya ste/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ chos kyi dbyings ni ma gtogs par/ /'di ltar chos yod ma yin te/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang dam chos pad+ma dkar por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar bskal lnga bcur byang sems shes rab brtsegs sogs du ma'i don mdzad pa gleng 'di'i snga dro gcig las ma song ba sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di go na

gzhung 'grel/ 35sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ 'di ni bstan bcos 'di'i don phyogs gcig tu drel ba lus rnam par gzhag pa'i tshul du bstan cing / rdo rje'i gsung gzhan rnams 'di'i 'phros don lta bur yang 'gyur bas na 'di ni shin tu gal che ba ste/ dpal ldan ngad phu bas/ 'am bu ni gsung 'di gcig pu'i phyir yang 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs drung du gtugs rin chog pa yin gsung ngo / /rnam gzhag spros pa de tsam gyis chog go / gnyis pa bye brag rgyas par bshad pa la spyi don brgyad de/ /tshoms bdun dang lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa rnams so/ —

36 dgongs gcig nyin snang /7 /spyi don dang po chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung sum cu mchis pa las /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad babs kyi gnas lug sa bstan bya ba 'di la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas/ 1 phyu dang dbang phyug ltar byed po'i che ba ma yin pa dang / 3 chos thams cad kyi gshis babs de brtse ba chen pos ston pa dang / nya gshes de sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur du med pa dkar nag zang thal rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pa dang / 4 rgyu 'bras mtho dman gang du'ang mi bslu ba dang / ngaganas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste/ gtan tshigs de lngas grub pa ni gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs de/ dbang bcu mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag pa ni mtha' gcig las

gzhung 'grel/ 37mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ rji skad du/ gnyis med gnyis su med par ston//zhes so/ /gshis babs ni sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar sems can gyi khams rgyud kyi chos kyi dbyings kho na las gzhan med de/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ /stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdus na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ sangang rgyas kyi chos thams cad sems can gyi bsam pa'i babs kyi gnas lugs don dam pa nyid bstan pa ni lung rig du mas grub pa yin no/ //gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs su gcig bya ba ni/ sermis can rnams kyi khams rgyud la nyon mongs pa dug gsum mam ma rig pa kho na las byung ba'i nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang / sems can gcig gi gshis thog tu 'bab cing nyams su blang bya'i chos yin pa las gzhan pa'i cho sa phung re re las gzhan mi dgos pa ma yin te/ sems can gyi khams

38 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rgyud la nyon mongs phra rags thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid lwa gtogs/ sems can la lar gti mug la lar 'dod chags sogs re re las gzhan med pa ma yin te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad/ /rgyun du 'brel bas lus zungs khyab par gyur/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir nyon mongs thams cad kyi gnyen por chos phung thams cad kyang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs su gcig pa ni chos kyi phung po thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i thabs yin la/ 4bdag med banyis po ni nyon mongs pa ma rig pa gti mug gi gnyen po yin pas na dper na nad gtso bo rlung la bad mkhris tsha ba ldan par byung na sman yang thams cad tshogs dgos pa dang 'dra ste/ sna gcig ma tshang yang de'i ngo skal gyi spang bya spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na nyon mongs re re las gzhan med pa ni mi srid pas/ chos kyang thams cad nyams su blang bya ma gtogs dor bya ye med pa yin te/ de yang chos thams cad rtsa ba phyag rgya chen po'i steng du 'bab pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi

—— gzhung 'grel/ 39stong gsungs pa gang yin pa/ /chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab//ces sogs gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang mdo sde bskal ba bzang po dang / glog thob kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos phung de rnams kyang pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du dbye ste bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin gzungs spobs sogs grangs de snyed bdag don du brnyes nas gzhan don du gdul bya la chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ston par 'gyur la/ de bsdu na phar phyin drug tu 'dus/ de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'dus/ des na phar phyin brgyad khri bzhi stong bsdus pa'i drug po 'di dgos 'di mi dgos med par drug car nyams su blangs pas so so'i yon tan skye dgos te/ 'phags pa bsdud pa las/ /sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed// khrims kyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang / / mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te/ /gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas blta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur// ye shes mtha'

40 dgongs gcig nyin snang /yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad la 'dor/ /rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub/ /shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ khams gsum ma lus pa las myur du 'da' bar 'gyur/ /mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang ma do sde'i sde snod rnams nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe sogs sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams 'grub pa'i rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung so sor gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i phyir don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong nyams su blangs dgos pa kho na las spang blang gcig kyang byar med/dbye na 'dod chags nyi khri chig stong gi gnyen por 'dul ba nyi khri chig stong / de bzhin du zhe sdang la mdo sde/ gti mug la mngon pa/ de gsum cha mnyam la sde snod gsum cha mnyam/ de bsdu na 'dod chags zhe sdang

gzhung 'grel/ 4 gti mug gsum la 'dul mdo mngon gsum/ de yang bsdu na gti mug gi gnyen por shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ des na chos kyi phung po thams cad kyang rang rgyud 'dul bar mi dgos ka med du go bar bya dgos so/ / /gsum pa ni/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam skye ba'i rim pa bya ba 'di la/ rin byang mar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa zhes dang / rdor she mar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes cung zad mi mthun pa ltar snang yang / 'dir rdor gsung gi 'dod tshul dang 'grel ba rnams kyi 'thad mi 'thad dpyad pa'i skabs ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag nas rdo rje'i gsung dngos kyi dgongs pa 'chad par bya'o/ /de la sdo snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad kyang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir lam dang sa'i yo/na tan rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su gcig par bzhed de/ mdo sde rgyan lasakyi : mdo dang chos mngon 'dul ba dag /mdor na don ni rnam bzhir

42 dgongs gcig nyin snang / 'dod/ /blo dang ldan pas de shes nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyed nyid 'thob/ /ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya//de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /ces pa nas /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kye'i rdo rje brtsam/ /zhes so/ /'di dag kyang so skye nas sdom gsum rgyud ldan man chud la khyad par ma mchis te /'dul ba las bsnyen par rdzogs pa thob zin nas thob pa rgyu mtshan du byas te 'dul ba dang ma mo dang mdo sdo sogs sde snod thams cad la bslab phar gsungs pa dang / byang sems la ni zhi ba lhas/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ sngags la ni/ pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pas sdom gsum re re nas bzung gsum ga rgyud ldan can nam/ so skye yang rung rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi blo can la mdo sngags gnyis lam rgyud la skye bar yang gcig la de gnyis ka med mi rung du bshad mod/ de'i tshul lung rig mang du yod na yang grags che bas de tsam gyis chog la/

gzhung 'grel/ 43 mdor na mtshan nyid phar phyir theg pa'i chos nyams su blangs pa dang / sngags bla med kyi lam bskyed pa dang rjogs pa'i rim pa sogs nyams su blangs pa'i 'thob bya ni stong pa nyid dam pa'i don rtogs pa las gzhan med pas na gcig ste/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye/ /mi dmigs pa la brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa nyid rab tu skye/ /zhes rnam gzhag du ma'i sgo nas gsungs so/ / /bzhi pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo gsum 'khor gyi rtog pa'i khyad par bstan pa yin par bzhed do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'khor gyi rnam par rtog pa'i dbang gis go tshul tha dad du 'byung ba ni sngar rgyud bla ma'i lung gis nam mkha'i khams char la khyad med kyang 'bab gnas kyi dbang gis so sor 'gyur ba de kho nas kyang 'grub la/ bye brag tu ston pas 'khor lo rim gsum du gsungs pa ni 'khor rnams rim gyis dkri ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ston pas lnga sde sogs la/ dge slong dag 'di ni thog mtha' bcir

4 4 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gsum du mi dge bas spang bar bya ba yin no/ /'di ni thog mtha' bar gsam du dge bas bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /zhes dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa ston pa bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo lan gsum du bzlas pas rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor bas nyan thos de dag gi dgra bcom ma thag ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes pa 'phags pa kauṇ+ḍi n+ya la sogs pa lta bu ste/ de ltar smin par mdzad pa'i rjes la chos dang chos nyid thams cad med pa'i tshul gyis gtan la phab pa 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa bskor te/ gong gi ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang lhag mthong gi rishes rab kyis gtan la phab ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la/ nga yang dgra bcom pa yin la khyed rnams kyang dgra bco ma pa yin zhes gsungs pa na/ 'khor rnams kyis bsam pa/ dgra bcom mnyam pa la yon tan mi mnyam pa ci yin snyam ste 'phreg tshud pa ra gyur te/ de ltar lhag mthong gi shes rab rtogs pas 'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad do/ /de nas chos thams cad med pa stong nyid dgag pa dang / 'khor rnams la/ khyed rnams dgra bcom

nganasdo/ngange 9)༷/95/ 2 (5pa ma yin no zhes sogs kyis theg pa 'og ma sun phyung nas/ mthar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rnams kyi rgyu la 'jug pa'i phyir gnas lugs yang dag mngon sum sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gtan la phab pa 'khor lo tha ma nges don rna ma par phye ba gsungs shing / shatsang / bdag bde ba/— rtag pa'i pha rol tu son par mdzad nas/ 'khor de rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad pa ste/ de ni 'khor lo gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin par mdzad ces pa ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ 'khor lo dang pos smin par mdzad nas kyangab/ /'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad/ /gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin mdzad pas/ /thub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du snang / /zhes dme / ji skad du/ mdo sde'i sde snod rnams nas/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor 4lo bskor ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis/ kye ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo dang po ba skor ro// de bzhin du gnyis pa bskor ro/ /gsum pa bskor ro/ /zhese pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor

46 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rnams thog mar bden pa bzhis blo bsgyur/ de ltar rtag par rlom pa 'khor lo bar pa med dgag gis sun phyung / de nyid mchad lta'i mtha' 'gog pa'i phyir 'khor lo tha ma 'tha' bral zung 'jug gsal stong gi lta bas gtan la phab pa nyid du —nges te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/myang 'das dngos pa'i blo can rgye/ /'dzin pa zlog par bya ba'i phyir//don dam mkhyen pas don dam pa/ /stong pa nyid ni bstan par mdzad//ces 'khor lo dang por dngos po'i blo can gyi 'dzin pa zlog par bya ba'i phyir 'khor lo bar pa gsungs shing / dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /de lta bas na thams cad bshad//yod pas med pas yod pas na/ /de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes 'khor lo bar pa stong pa med dgag gi blo can zlog pa'i phyir mtha' bral zung 'jug tu bshad pas/ des na 'khor lo rim pa gsum po lnga sde la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyis gong nas gong du 'khrid par mdzad nas mthar thug theg pa mchog gcig po bstan pa'i gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du mi 'ong ka med pa

gzhung 'grel/ 47yin no/ / —/lnga pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo re re la yang gsum ga tshang bar bzhed pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsume po'i dang po bden bzhi la yang bar pa dang tha ma'i rnam gzhag ches mang zhig de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la yang shes shing rtogs par bya ba ste/ 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi la/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung / myang 'das rgyu 'bras 'gog pa dang lam ston pa dang / bar pa mtshan nyid med par/ kun 'byung mal gang zag dang chos gnyis te/ rang rgyud yon tan gyis dregs shing gzhan nyams su mi len pa la brnyas pa gang zag gi kun 'byung / tshul khrims bsrung ba sogs tshe 'dir bde skyid dang phyi mar mtho ris gyi yon tan bdun sogs grub 'dod chos kyi bdag dang 'dra ba chos kyi kun 'byung / 'khor 'das gnyis med chos thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang nas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du 'byung ba dang/tha ma nges don gyi skabs dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis kun 'a byung spangs shing lam bden gnyis zung 'jug bsgoms pas

48 dgongs gcig nyin snang /dkon mchog gsum rtag brtan zhi ba them pa gcig tu grub cing 'bras bu sku dang ye shes yon tan tshad med 'grub pa'o// mtshon byed tshig gis kyang 'khor lo re re la gsum ga tshang ste/ dang po'i skabs bden bzhi rtogs pas bdag gis bya ba byas so sogs gsungs pa dang /sdug bsnga/la spang du med sogs rnam thar gsum gyi mtshan ma med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul yid mgyogs dang stobs bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bstan pa rnams nges don/ bar pa'i skabs 'dod pa rnams dug gi lo ma lta bu zhes sogs dang / gzugs mi rtag pa yid la bya'o sogs dang / sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu shes par bya sogs sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang / sbyin pa dge'o sogs dang / sbyin pas rgyal rigs mtho zhing mthong thob sogs dang / byang phyo gas so bdun bshad pa lam bden/ byang sems zhugs 'bras brgyad kyi 'gog bden gsungs shing / gzhan jigang rang sems mi dge bar skye ba kun 'byung / de'i 'bras bu rigs drug tu sdug bsngal myong ba sdug bsngal/ yang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyis sems dge bar skye ba las dang

gzhung 'grel/ 49bcas pa lam bden/ de'i 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba lam bden las 'bras bu 'gog bden 'byung ba sogs 'khor lo dang po'i brjod bya/rgyu 'bras de nyid kyi gshis gdod nas spros bral mtha' bral stong nyid du bstan pa 'khor lo bar pa'i brjod bya la stong nyid de'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi shī dang ye shes bral 'bras kyi yon tan gtsang bdag bde ba rtag par gsungs pa nges don gyi brjod bya/ de la mtho dman gang du bstan kyang rgyu 'bras gtso bor ston pa zhig 'dug na dang po'i brjod bya/ chos dbyings stong nyid rnam thar sgo gsum gtso bor ston pa gang du 'dug kyang bar pa'i brjod bya/ 'bras bu sku gsum rtag pa'i 'khor lo gtso bor ston pa nges don gyi brjod bya/ yang sbyang gzhi sgo lnga'i rnam shes gang na 'dug pa dang po/ yid shes gtsor ston gang du 'dug pa bar pa/ sbyang gzhi nyon yid dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes ston pa gang 'dug nges don/ yang nyan rang gi lam gtsor ston dang po/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid gtsor ston bar pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bral 'bras kyi yon tan gtsor ston tha ma/ de ltar na 'khor lo gsum po re re la

50 dgongs gcig nyin snang /brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ku'i cha nas 'khor lo gcig tu nges la/ de yang ston pa sangs rgyas ma thag zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos ni bdag gis thob/ ces 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya bstan pa ste/ mdor dril na/ 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi/ bar pa mtshan med/ tha ma nges don zhes dang / 'dul mdo mngon gsum sogs rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya don gyi ngo bo rnams ni re re la gsum ga tshang zhing gsum ga yang brjod bya gcig las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba las/ sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ma yin par gsungs pa dang / ji skad du/ 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed/ /ces dang / so thar las/ sems rta kha glan dka' ba la/ /mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi/ /srab 'di so sor thar pa yin/ /zhes so/ /mdo sdud pa las/ gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya/ /byis pa rnams kyis de brtag yod dang med par byed //yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te/ /byeng chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung / /zhes sogs dang / mdor

gzhung 'grel/ bya na 'khor lo rnam gsum sogs chos thams cad kyang rnam pa gcig gi ngo bor tshul mtshungs shing 'gres can kho nar gzhugs te/ ji skad du/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes bya ba 'di'i khongs su 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gyi brjod bya thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir tshul de lta bu sogs lung rig du ma'i gtan tshigs dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ //drug pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma phyi ma'i sa bon snga ma snga ma la gnas zhes bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i phyir des ni chos cithams cad gcig las gzhan mi gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya'i gtso bo bshad ma thag pa'i zab zhi spros bral las gzhan med pa yang thog ma nyid nas gsungs pa ni 'khor lo gsum ga'i sa bon nam rtsa bar byung la/ gzhan yang 'khor lo dang po'i skabs bden pa bzhi gsum du bzlas pa'i tha ma'i skabs/ sdug bsngal shes par byar med/ kun 'byung spang du

dgongs gcig nyin snang /med/ (regog pa mngon du byar med/ lam rgyud la bsten du med/ ces 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i sa bon bzhag 'khor lo bar pa'i skabs tha ma nges don gyi sa bon ni/ 'phags pa bsdud pa las/gang la sems dang yid dang rnam shes mthong med pa/ /de ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /zhes tha ma nges don rnam par nges pa'i rtsa ba bstan/ tha ma'i skabs lang kur gshegs pa las/ blo gros chen po sa mthar phyin// chos kyi dbang ni bskur nas su//'og min stug po nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ zhes sngags kyi ston pa dang / rji skad du/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu'i chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sngags kyi theg pa'i sa bon nam rtsa ba yang gsungs pa lta bu ste des na 'khor lo phyi ma'i sa bon snga mar gsungs pa shin tu mang ngo ///bdun pa ni/ mdo dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum

gzhung 'grel/ 53du nges zhes gsungs pa ni/ chos kyi phung po rnams la phyogs ris dang sde tshan du dbye ba med mod/ 'on kyang 'dzin bde ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum zhes grags pa ni gnas dang dus dang 'khor so gas kyis dbye ba ma yin te/ dang po'i gnas wā ra ṭ+wāṃ sir rdo rje mchu dang dpal lha mo lung bstan pa'i mdo sogs theg chen dang gsang sngags kyi chos 'ga' zhig gsungs pa dang / bar pa'iganas bya rgod phung rir/ theg pa chung ngu dang / 'khor lo tha ma'i gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo dngang/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i mdo sogs mang du gsungs/ tha ma'i gnas rtswa can la sogs par/ 'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo sogs theg pa chung ngu dang / khye'u bzhis zhus pa sogs mtshan nyid med pa'i chos mang du gsungs la/ dus kyang sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag dang po nas lnga pa'i bar la rdo rje rnam 'joms dngang/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo dang / sangs rgyas phal poche la sogs pa gsang sngags dang theg chen mang du'ang gsungs/ bar du nor bzang

'i dgongasagacig nyin snang /gi rnam thar sdong po brgyan pa dang / dran pa nyer gzhag sogs bden cibazhi'i rtog pa mang du gsungs/ tha ma'i dus su/ bden bzhi'i tshul mang po dang / mya ngan las 'da' khar lung zhu ba dang phran tshegs kyi khongs su gtogs pa mang du gsungs/ 'khor yang 'khor lo dang po'i skabs lnga sde rkyang par ma zad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa yod la/ bar pa'i skabs su nyan thos kyi 'khor theg dman kyang bsam las 'das pa'i phyir/des na 'khor lo gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni mdo'i don dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du bzhag ste/ bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ ji skad du/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis mgron gcig tu/ e ma sngon chad 'jig rten du dge sbyong ngam bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bcom ldan 'das kyis bskor ro zhes bsgrags pas dang por gzhag go/ /zhes dang / mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 4dus su ni/ yum rgya sa pa las/ rab

gzhung 'grel/ 55'byor gyis de bzhin nyid kyi le'u bstan pa'i tshe/ gtsang ma ris kyi lha rnams nam mkha' la 'khod nas lha'i gos dang me tog 'thor zhing /ltung lhung ldeg gi sgra phyung nas/ e ma 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor ba mthong ngo / /zhes bsgrags pas gnyis par gzhag bo/ /nges don chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus na/ mdo pre dgongs/ pa nges 'grel la sa/ byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon yul wā rā 〉sir drang srong ltung ba ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa la rmeng dag par zhugs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bstan pas chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar rmad da byang ba sngon chad 'jig rten da lhar gyar 4 ༄ ༄ lnge ba shepa'am/ mar gyur pa'am sus kyang chas dang mthun par ma bskar ba rab tu bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i tshig dze+e r+shaganas su gyur pa lags so/ /lan gnyis su bcom ldan 'das

56 dgongs gcig nyin snang / kyis theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la chos kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsams shing / skye ba ma mchis pa dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / gdod ma nas zhi ba/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams te spros pa'i rnam pas chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor lo de yang bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/rtsod pa'i tshig gi gnas su gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsum du theg pa thams cad la zhugs pa rnams la chos kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsams shing / skye ba ma mchis pa/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa/ gdod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams te shin tu rnam par dbye ba'i bye brag gis ha cang yang ngo mtshar la/ ha cang yang rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di ni bla na ma mchis par/ skabs ma mchis pa/nges pa'i don/ rtsod pa'i gnas su ma gyur pa lags so/ /zhes gsums pas gsum du nges so/ /de ltar na chos 'khor gsum po

gzhung 'grel/ 57mthar thug gi 'thob bya dang / 'bras bur khyad med na'ang gnas skabs su brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed tshig la mtho dman yod pa ltar ched du brjod mkhan yang dang po tshangs ris man chadang gnyis pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams/ gsum pa byang sems don dam yang dag 'phags sogs sa bcu la gnas pas brjod par zad do/ /don gyi gnad kyang rnam grangs gsum du nges te/ rgyu chebras stong nyid du 'jug pa 'khor lo dang po'i don/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung ba 'khor lo bar pa'i don/ de gnyis gnyis med du gnas pa ni 'khor lo gsum pa'i don yin te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med pa snyed// mkhas pas stong pa nyid ces bsnyad/ /stong nyid de yang stong nyid kyi/ /ngo bos stong par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas legs par grub bo/ //brgyad pa ni/ 'dul ba'i sde snod ni bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bya ba 'di la/ lung sde bzhi'i brjod bya dgag bcas dang sgrub bcas gnyis su 'du bas/ rnam 'byed dgag bcas te ltung ba sde lnga po

58 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ston pa dang / sgrub bcas gzhi bcu bdun bshad pa lung gzhi dpo / phran tshegs de gnyis kyi lhan thabs dang / de la the tshom gcod pa zhu ba rnams kyis bden pa bzhi rgyas par 'chad pa yin la/ sems can rnams kyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bde bar rlom pa la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal der gzigs pas sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa/ sems can rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung la sdug bsngal 'ong ba ma shes shing / de mkhyen pas kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa/ kun 'byung de spangs na 'bras bu 'gog pa 'ong bar sems can rnams kyis ma shes shing / 'phags pas de mkhyen pas 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa/ kun 'byung spong ba'i gnyen po lam brgyad nyams su len pa sems can rnams kyis ma shes pa/ 'phags pas mkhyen pas lam 'phags pa'i bden pa yin la/ de dag ni brjod bya rjong byed gnyis ka 'dul ba'i sde snod 'ba' zhig tu nges te/ chos kyi /'ekhor lo'i mdo dang / 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ dge slong dag nga dang khyed cag kho na las/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag ji lta ba bzhin

gzhung 'grel/ 59ma mthong bas// yun ring lam du 'khor bar 'gyur/ /bden pa de dag mthong nas ni/ /srid pa'i srid pa rab bcad de/ / skye ba'i 'okhor lo zad pa na/ da ni srid pa gzhan med de/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pa'i mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa las/ ka shi ka yi wā ra ṇa sī ru/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol rmad byung bas/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam par gcod mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mchod rten bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// tri/dgu pa ni/ theg pa sna tshogs ston pa nyid nges don chos kyi 'khor lo bya ba 'di la/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos thams cad mnyam pa chen po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad kyi gshes babs stong nyid rgyu 'bras su gsungs pa nyid yin la/ bye brag tu chos 'khor bar pa nges don dang tha ma theg pa sna tshogs su bzhed pa rnams ni rnam par ma brtags pa ste/ gong du byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis zhus pa'i mdo'i lung drangs pas kyang 'khor lo bar pā tematshan nyid med pa rtsod

60 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pa'i gzhir gyur pa dang / tha ma nges pa'i don rtsod pa'i gzhir ma gyu ra par grub la/ de tsam du ma zad don gyi cha nas 'khor lo gsum ga nges pa'i don gcig pu las gzhan pa'i rnam grangs ma gsungs te/ci'i phyir na sangs rgyas mtha' gnyis su mi gsung ba'i phyir myang 'das dngos po'i blo can zlog pa'i phyir stong nyid gsungs te/ dbu ma la 'ju ga pa las/ /myang 'das dngos po'i blo can gyi/ /'dzin pa zlog par bya ba'i phyir/ /don dam mkhyen pas don dam pang/ /stong pa nyid ni ston par mdzad/ ces stong nyid gsungs pa 'khorda lo bar pa'i dgongs pa yin la stong pa de yang gshis babs las gzhan pa'i med dgag sogs gangs can pa phyi ma 'ga' zhig gis lta ba 'di 'dra ba la dgongs nas/ ji skad du/ stong pa nyid la lha nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnam sa phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes rtag chad kyi lta ba gnyis dug can du ba'ag nas 'khor lo tha mar mtha' bral zung 'jug stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du gsungs te/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang

64 gzhung 'grel/ dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam rma ra grol/ zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs shing / ting 'dzin rgyal po dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i snge snod sogs las gsungs pa rnams kyang 'di kho na'i nges pa nyid du zad do/ //bcu pa/ mtha' drug tu gsungs pa thams cad nges don 'ba' zhig tu bzhed pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam nyid zhi ba chen po las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos rnams kyang rnam pa gcig las gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing / la lar drang don/ la lar nges don sogs mtha' drug gi bden rdzun mang du gsungs pa mi srid de/ zla ba sgron ma las/ gzhon nu khyod la bsgo zhing bstan par bya/ /dad par bgyis shig nga la mi bden med/ /bde gshegs rdzun gyi tshig ni mi smra ste/ /thugs rjes rgyal ba rtag tu bden par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bden par gsung pa/ rigs par gsung pa/ tshad mar gsung pa/ nges par gsung pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad rlabs po che gsung pa'i dus su pha

62 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rol po'i log rtog bsal ba'i phyir/ ljags la dpang po mdzad nas/ljags yangs shing srab la dmar bas/ zhing khams mtha' yas pa'am/mi mdzad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams sam/ 'khor 'dus pa de'am/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la khyab par mdzad nas/ kun dga' bo gang sems can rdzun du smra ba dag la ljags kyi dbang po 'di lta bu yod dam/ ljags kyi dbang po 'di lta bu dang ldan pas log par smra'am/gzhan du smra bar 'gyur ram/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad nges don 'ba' zhig las gzhan med la/ sngags kyi rgyud rnams nas kyang brda dang rtags kyi sgo nas gsungs pa rnams la deng sang dgongs pa can dang dgongs min sogs kyi bshad pa byed pa mtha' yas mod de yang rnam par 'khyams te/ sngags gsar ma'i zhing bcu rlung dang rtog par gsungs pa sogs dang / mchod rten la phyag mi bya ba dang / sring mo las rgyar bsten pa sogs gsungs pa yang / theg dman la phyag mi bya ba dang /shes rab kyi phyag rgya dang mi 'bral ba sogs brda'i sgo nas gsungs

gzhung 'grel/ 63la/ sngags rnying mar/ dbus kyi ka ba bsgyel na brtan/ shar gyi skar khung dgag na gsal/ drin can pha ma bsad na dge sogs gsungs pa yang las rlung rtsa dbu mar bcings pas ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le ye shes su bsgyur ba dang / mthong ba'i yul yul can tha mi dad du bsgoms pas rang snang gi ye shes rgyud la skye ba dang / khams nyi zla'i 'gros rba rlabs kyis bcad pas thabs shes zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'am/ yang na zhe sdang dang 'dod chags bse 'phos gnad du bsnun pas grol ba sogs la dgongs shing brda mdzad pa ni gsang sgrogs la dgongs kyi/ de las gzhan du tshul mang pos gsungs par sems pa rnams ni log pa'i rtog pa nyid du bas pas/ des na 'di ni drang don lde ma dgongs/ dgongs pa can/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa rdzun ma lta bu ste spang dgos/ 'di ni nges don dgongs min/ sgra ji bzhin pa bden pa ste blang ngo zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung la bden rdzun gyi phyogs ris su bcad nas spang blang bya ba ni rnam pa kun tu mi zad pa sdig pa'i las rngam po che ste/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal las

64 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas//de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkru ga/thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal bas rnam pa gcig po nyid du gsungs pa la phyi rabs pas mtha' drug sogs kyi bshad pa nges don du nyams su blangs nas spang blang byed cing drang nges dang mtha' drug zer ba'i rjod byed mtshor chas su byas nas/ brjod bya rgyal ba'i bka' la bden rdzun gyi stangs gcod byed pa ni thar pa med pa'i las kho na te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //bcu gcig pa ni/ sems tsam ston pa'i bka' nyid dbu ma ston zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyu mtshan gsum gyis bshad de/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang / de'i dgongs 'grel mkhan po dang / mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung dang gsum gyis gtan la phab snye/ dang po lang yar

gzhung 'grel/ 65gshegs pa las/ sems tsam du ni rtogs pa dang / /dngos po thams cad rnam bsal bas/ /phyi rol rtog pa rnam bzlog ste/ /lam de nyid ni dbu ma'o/ /zhes gsung sa shing / 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyang thog mar sems tsam du go zhing / sems kyang ngo bo ngos bzung du ma grub la/ de yang yod pa dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis las 'das shing rnam kun mchog ldan gyi chos kyi dbyings dbu ma chen po mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ dper na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang bco lnga'i zla ba gnyis yongs su rdzogs ma rdzogs las zla bar mtshungs pa dang / myu gu las 'bras bu 'byung phyir mtshungs pa lta bu ste/ mgon po byams pas /sems las gzhan med pa ni blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs/ /blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas/ /de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes gsungs so/ gnyis pa ni/slob dpon klu sgub dbu ma'i srol 'byed yin pa dbu ma'i bka' sher phyin sogs nas lung ma bstan par/ sprin chen po dang / rnga bo che dang /lang gshegs sogs nas lung bstan la/ dbu ma rtsa she lang gshegs

dgongs gcig nyin snang / la brten nas rab byed nyer bdun pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas phal chen gyi snying po sa bcu pa'i mdo slob dpon zla grags kyis dbu ma 'jug pa'i gzhung du bsdus pa'i phyir dang / gsum pa ni/ rdor she mar mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung gis zla shod sman pa'i da li bdun pa'i dpe ltar gsungs pa sogs kyis bston med du grub pa yin no/ //bcu gnyis pa ni/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus par bzhed pa ni/ 'dir don byed ces pa las bzang ngan gyi mtha' gcig tu ma bzhag pas/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyis bzang ngan gnyis kya'i don byed nus pa 'ba' zhig ste/ bzang po ni chu nang du shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas btsun mo ri dwags ma'i bu lnga brgyas byang chub thob pa dang / bram ze chen po sa ra has thod chang gi nang du ldum ra'i rtsi shing sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba mthong ba la brten nas gnas lugs gdod ma'i ngo bo nyid rtogs pa dang /sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma'i rnam rol mthong ba la brten nas skye bo mang po byang chub thob pa sogs dpag tu med pa bshad la/ ngan pa'i don byed

gzhung 'grel/ 67ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ khron pa'i nang byudu zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba spre'u lnga brgyas mthong bas de 'don pa'i ched du gcig la/ gcig 'khrus te 'don par brtsams pas spre'u thams cad tshe'i dus byas pa sogs gsung rab rnams nas gleng gzhi mang du gsungs pas kyang shes la/ yang dag dang log pa'i khyad par ni/ rgyu nam mkha'i zla ba rkyen sa༄ gzhi'i khron pa/ rten 'brel gyi babs mi rnams kyi mthong yul du snang ba sogs gang gi cha nas kyang mi phyed la/ de dag ni rgyu dus dang de dus kyi kun slong gnyis ka dge bas kun nas bslangs shing pyid na rnam smin dge ba nyid 'byung ba yang dag pa'i kun rdzob ste/ slob spyodapon legs ldan 'byed kyis/ yang dag kun rdzob rnams kyi skas/ /med par don dam khang chen gyi/ /steng du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni// mkhas la rung ba ma yin no/ /zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni//thub pas shes rab don du gsungs/ /zhes so/ byedon gyi ngo bor chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'am/ ma byung pa'am yod ma myong pa'i phyir 'khor 'das thams cad kyang —kan rdzob 'ba' zhig las don

68 dgongs gcig nyin snang /dam du yod par khas mi len cing / kun rdzob des don dam rtogs pa'i rgyu byed/ byams pas/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung / /zhes sogs gsungs pas mthar thug kun rdzob las gzhan pa'i chos med pa'i phyir ro/ /de la yang dbye na kun rdzob la gnyis su dbye ba ltar/ don dam la yang rnam grangs sto nga nyid bco brgyad sogs brjod byar bzhag pa rnams dang / rnam grangs ma yin pa skye med phyag rgya chen po brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa nyid yin no/ jo bo rjes/ chu zla dang grub mtha' ngan pa'i rtog par gsungs pa ni 'khrul pa las nying 'khrul du 'gyur ba la dgongs kyi/ don byed mi nus pa la ma dgongs par dgongs pa 'di dang mi 'gal lo/ //bcu gsum pa ni/ lam thams cad sa bcus bgrod bya ba ni/ mdo sngags gnyis gas sangs rgyas thob pa la lam sa bcus bgrod par marnya ngas te/ rgyu mtshan sa dang por cho sa nyid kyi bden pa

gzhung 'grel/ 69mthong nas/ sgom lam sa dgu bgrod cing sa bcu rgyun mtha' la shes sgrib spangs nas rdzogs byang thob dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang myur bul ni brtson pa che chung dang / snga ma'i las 'phro dang sbyang stobs sogs kyi dbye bas rnam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid kyi snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs las/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sa dang po'i tshe/ sa ngas rgyas 'od zer stong gi rgyal po yang dag par gnas pa las gzungs de thos pa'i mdo la sa brgyad pa thob par gyur pa dang //gsang chen thabs mkhas las/ byang sems dga' byed sa dang po'i dus su nyon mongs kyi ngo bo mthong bas sa brgyad pa thob par gsungs shing / sngags la rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti lta bu tshe gcig la dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod thob pa tsam gyis dngos grub mchog thob pa sogs myur bul ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ de'i dpe yang 'grel ba snga ma rnam sa su sugos bcu brtsegs te bltab par mda' 'phangs na shugs che bas skad cig la 'brib/sa shing chung bas rim par 'bigs kyang myur bul las don du rim gyis ma gtogs snga ma ma phug pa phyi ma 'bigs mi

70 dgongs gcig nyin snang /srid par bshad pa ltar dang 'dir ni yul 'di nas yul gzhan du 'gro bar mi'i rkang pas lam la phyin nas slebs pa dang / 'dab chags kyis nam mkhar 'phur te phyin pa gnyis/ mis lam bgrod pa dang 'dab chags nam mkhar 'phur nas lam la bgrod pa'i tha snyad 'dogs kyang / don du yul de gnyis kyi bar gyi mkha' la 'phur bas bgrod bya sa gzhi'i khyon de las gzhan med pa ltar mdo sngags dang /rim gyi sa gcig car ba sogs gang yang myur bul tsam las gzhan pa sa bcu ma bgrod pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te mtshan nyid theg par sa lam rim bgrod du mthun kyang sngags bla med kyis lam brtsi mi dgos par skad cig mar 'dod na/ sngags lam gyi rtsa ba smin grol las gzhan med la/ smin lam gyi skabs bum dbang nas bzhi pa'i bar las lam gyi mngon rtogs 'grub tshul dang / grol lam gyi bskyed rdzogs nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu sa dang po nas bcu pa'i steng du gsum bsnan pa thob tshul rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa la ci'i phyir bstonang/ 'on te phyag rdzogs pa rnams kyang rtogs pa

gzhung 'grel/ 74skad cig mas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yang sngar gyi dpe ltar myur bul las gzhan pa'i mdo sngags gnyis las tha dad pa'i lam zhig yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa'i lam du thal bas de 'dra ba'i lam gyi mdo ni blos gzhal bar dka'o/ /des na rdzogs byang thob pa ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthus grub pa'o/ /yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim ltar rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phos pa'am rtsal rdzogs pa'i tshe de dag gi la ma rtags sa bcu dang lam lnga bgrod pa'i dbang du byas te / 'di ni ming mang yang don mtshungs pa kho na ste dper na zan dang spag ces pa dang tshul mtshungs pas/ des na mdo sngagasamo gang la'ang lam thams cad sa bcus ma bgrod pa'i sangs rgyas mi srid de/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/dge ba'i rtsa ba ji srid yongs su ma rdzogs bar/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed/ /ces gsungs la stong nyid dam pa ni bka' brgyud rin po che 'di nyid kyi bzhed pas sgom med chen po'i rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhed pa dang don mthun pa'i phyir rnam par

72 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bshad pa dag go /'ga' zhig tshogs ma bsags kyi sangs rgyas zhes zur ngom dang dpa' gtam du byed pa ni tshogs ma bsags pa'i sangs rgyas ni rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu ste tshul de 'dra ba legs par da dung soms shig//bcu bzhi pa ni/ lam thams cad rim gyis 'jug bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa'i lam phar phyin drug sogs kyang rim gyis nyams su blangs dgos par dgongs nas/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ skye bo 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing / /mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ /longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas/ /thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do/ /ces sogs gsungs pa dang / sngags bla med la ni spyi dang bye brag gnyis te/spyir sems can rnams rdo rje theg pa'i sgor 'jug pa ni rim gyis ma gtogs cig car du 'jug pa ni ches smad cing bkag snye/ brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes sogs nas sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kye'i rdo rje brtsam/ /zhes pas dang po

gzhung 'grel/ 73nyid nas bstan pa la ma zhugs pa'i so skye la thog mar bsnyen gnas nas bzung grub mtha' rnams dbu ma'i bar du bshad nas/ sngags kyi rim pa zhes pa dbu ma'i rjes su bya spyod rnal 'byor rnams bshad pas rgyud sbyangs pa la kye rdo rje sogs bla med ston gyi thog ma nyid nas byung rgyal du mi ston la/ bye brag bstan pa la zhugs zin so thar ris brgyad gang rung dang byang sdom sogs ldan rung la dbang bskur yang /gsol gdab dang sdom bzung gnyis kur nan chags kyis/ thog mar skyabs 'gro so thar gyi sdom pa/ de rjes smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/khyad par sngags su sems bskyed pa zla rdor gyi rnam pa can/ de rjes rigs lnga spyi bye brag gi sdom bzung / de nas bum dbang nas bzhi pa'i bar rim gyis bskur zhing go don sprod pa lam rim go ma log pa dang /khyad par sngags la zhugs zin la yang smin lam ma bskur bar grol lam mi ston pa dang / rgyud kyi lung tsam gyi snga rol du yang dbang bskur ba sogs lam ri ma gyis pa la yang shin tu sgrigs chags dam par mdzad pa dang / phyag chen lta bu la yang cig car ba zhes pa rtogs pa skye

74 dgongs gcig nyin snang / shin tu sla ba la dgongs kyang / sbyangs pa sngon song can zhig ma gtogs las 'phro med pa la mi sred pa'i phyir sngon nas lam rim gyis bsag sbyangs byas pa zhig nges par dgos pa dang / de yang bram ze chen po sa ra ha cig car bar grags mod/ de yang sngon nas sbyangs pa'i 'phro sad pa dang / rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa yang rgyu med rkyen med ma yin par thod chang gi nang da rtsi ldam gyi gzags brnyan shar ba'i rkyen des ngo ra ༄ ༄0 'phrod pa yang rgyu rkyen de la ltos pas rim gyis pa kho na yin la/ cig car ba'i dpe lung pa khad dog gi nyi ma dang / rim gyis pa'i dpe lung pa khad yangs kyi nyi ma la sbyor ba ni dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams la rlung ltar grags mod/ de la dpyad na lung pa khad yangs kyi nyi ma ri rtse nas thon 'phral dro 'jam gyi nus pa mi 'byin la rim gyis grang ba skyob pa sogs byed sa rong gi nyi cha/ shar ma thag dro 'jam bsil skyob kyi bya ba byed pa ltar/ rim gyis pa'i rtogs pa gnas 'gyu nas sgom med kyi bar rim can du 'bad stsol la ltos shing yon tan skye dka' la/ cig car ba ngo 'phrod ma thag sems kyi rang ngo mthong zhing

gzhung 'grel/ 7 5yon tan skye ba la shugs che ba la dgongs mod/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar na rim gyis pa'i dpe la 'dod pa gcig kyang / cig cang ba'i don gyi go ba de la dpyad na dpe'i nyi ma de yang sa rong yin yang shar ri la 'dzegs pa sogs rim gyis 'char ba mi byed par skad cig de nyid la nam mkha'i dbus nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba zhig tu thal ba dang / skad cig dran rdzogs kyi dper chu las nya 'phar ba sogs bshad mod de yang zhib tu brtags na myur ba la skad cig ma'i brjod bya btags pa tsam las cung zad rim gyis ldang ba kho nar nges/la/ gzhan yang dpal phag mo gru pas/ cig car 'jug /pu'i gang zag de/ /tshogs bsags bsags pa yi gang zag yin/ /rgyud sbyangs sbyangs pa yi gang zag yin/ /blo btul btul ba yi gang zag yin/ /nya ṭ+wā/sa skyes skyes pa yi gang zag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ni skye ba 'di'i ri ma gyis pa yang ma zad bar skye ba mang po'i snga rol nas/ bas gas sbyang byas pa la dgongs pas tshe 'di'i rtogs pa skye myur gcig car ba ṭis bod pa de yang skye ba snga ma nas rim gyis sbyangs pa la dgongs so/ /
