76 dgongs gcig nyin snang //bco lnga pa ni/ shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong ba'ang yod ces bya ba 'di ni/ 'ang gi sgras sgrib gnyis byang nas rdzogs byang thob pa gang zhig shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong bas khyab ces mtha' gcig tu bzhag pa ma yin gyi/ sbyang bya sgrib pa gnyis shes sgrib rjes kho nar spong ba'i nges pa yang med pas sngon la spong ba'ang yod ces pa la dgongs kyi/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir sgrib pa gsum zhes bshad na'ang / nyon sgrib ni lhan skyes kyi sgrib pa yin la gzhan gnyis ni bsags pa'i sgrib pa ste des na gzhan gnyis la nyon sgreb kyis khyab cing rtsa ba lta bur 'dod la/nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mgon po byams pas/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /ces shes sgrib kyi khongs su las sgrib kyang bsdus pas sgrib pa gnyis zhes bshad la/ rje sgam po pa mi la'i drung du byon dus yab sras gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis dbus pa ston pa khyod kyis chos ci shes gsungs pa la/ sgam po pas/ bka'

gzhung 'grel/ 77gdam sa kyi blo sbyong sogs dang / gzhan yang tshogs lam la 'a9ga sgrib spong / sbyor lam la nyon sgrib spong / mthong lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar shes sgrib spong dgos tshul zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis nga ni shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong bar 'dod pa yin gsungs/ 'o na sgrib pa gnyis po ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ gnyis po sgrog rang brdal la 'gro gsungs pa dang / mgon po phag mo gru pas/ de yab sras gnyis ka bden zhes gsungs/ rje sgam po pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa la ko long ma sol na rtogs pa ma skye gsungs pas/ rtogs bya'am shes par bya rgyu'i sgrib par shes sgrib zer/ de ni 'khor gsum gyi dri bcas phra rags su gcig pa ni mgon po byams pa'i gsungs de ltar yin la/ des na 'ga' zhig ni gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar sgrib pa rags pa gnyis sngon la spong rjes la shes sgrib phra ba spong / 'ga' zhig thog mar mngon rtogs kyi khyad par gyis phra ba sngon la spong bas rags pa zhar byung du spong ba la dgongs/ de yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i skabs su gos btso glag mkhan gyi dri ma rags pa ni 'dag byed dang rtsol ba chung

78 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ngus 'dag la/ dre ma phra ba ni 'dag byed dang rtsol ba chen po dgos par gsungs pa dang 'dra bas/ shes sgrib 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma phra mo de 'bad rtsol che na pos thog mar spangs na ser sna sogs kyi rtog pa'i nyon sgrib dang des bsags pa'i las sgrib rnams rang shugs kyis 'dag pa kho nar nges la/ skabs 'dir mtshungs med nam blo ba'i mchan bur/ so sor rang rig gi lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i tshe sgrib pa mtha' dag rang dwangs su 'gyur bas shes sgrib sngon du spong bar grub bo zhes pa shin tu legs la/ des na gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pas sgrib pa gnyis dang / chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas shes sgrib spong dgos pa'i phyir gang zag gi bdag med kyis shes sgrib mi spong bas/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas shes sgrib dag pa'i tshe/ gang zag gi bdag rang shugs kyis rtogs shing sgrib pa gzhan gnyis mi spong ka med la dgongs/ 'ang gi sgras shes sgrib sngon la spong ba kho nar mtha' gcig tu ma bzhag la/ gang zag so so'i nyams len gyi 'gros kyis skabs so sor 'gyur ba la dgongs so/ /

gzhung 'grel/ 79/bcu drug pa ni/ tshad ma sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis tshad ma zhes pa/ rtog ge'i gnas su 'dod mod/ de ni don la 'khrul pa ste/ thal phyir tha snyad la zhen pa ni rtog ge'i gnas yin kyang / tshad ma zhes pa ni mi bslu zhing drang po'i don yin la de ni thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i spyod yul te/ tshad ma kun las btus par/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te/ /zhes tshad mar gyur pa ston pa kho nar nges pa dang / tshad ma rnam nges las/ phan pa dang mi phan pa thob pa dang spong ba ni nges par yang dag pa'i shes pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ de mi shes pa rnams kyi don du bdag gis 'di brtsams zhes 'byung ba dang / phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ mkhyen pas gzigs pa zhes sogs 'byung bas kyang grub la/ rig pa ni khyi mgo rdo ril dang ri bong rwa sogs mi srid pa'i dpe dang / ka bum sogs dngos po gzhal bya dang / kha dog

dgongs gcig nyin snang / dkar dmar sogs dkar po la nag po'am dmar po'i mdog med par ston pa sogs gnas skabs su thal phyir rtog brtags ltar snang yang / mthar thug gshes la med pa bltas pas mi 'gyur zhing gshis babs kyi gnas tshul kho na bstan pa nyid yin pas kyang tshad ma ni dpe don gnyis ma'i cha nas sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kho nar nges pa'i phyir lung rig mang du 'byung yang yi gis 'jigs pas de tsam du bzhag go/ / /bcu bdun pa ni/ tshad ma'i 'bras bu chos nyid stong pa nyid ston par bzhed pa ni/ rtog ge tshad ma la/ the tshom/ yid dpyod/log shes/ dpyad shes/ snang la ma nges pa ste tshad ma ma yin pa'i blo lpamangon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma ste blo rnam pa bdun du gsungs/ mngon sum la/ dbang po'i mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/rang rig mngon sum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum ste bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis yul drug mngon sum byed na'ang skye med kyi don la ltos na tshad ma mthar thug min te/ zla ba sgron ma'am ting 'dzin rgyal por/

gzhung 'grel/ 84mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min/ /lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min/ /gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na/ /'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pas snga ma gnyis kyis don spyi tsam las mi rtogs/ phyi ma gnyis kyis zhi lhag zung 'brel sgrub tshul kho na yod pas chos nyid rtogs pur+sha dbu ma sogs thams byed dang mthun no/ /rnal 'byo ra mngon sum de ni 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag yin pas/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras don rang gi khongs su chud cing / yid mngon gyi yul lnga mngon du ma gyur kyang sngar mngon du byas zin gyi yid chos gtan la 'bebs/ de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa'i sems dang sems kyi rang bzhin rang rig mngon sum gyis nges par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /yang na dbang po mngon sum gyis yul lnga yid chos rang rig gi tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms rnams gtan la 'bebs pas so/ /rjes dpag tshad ma la rgyu'i rtags/ 'bras bu'i rtags/ rang bzhin gyi rtags/ mi dmigs pa'i rtags te bzhi las/ rgyus 'bras bu dpog pa ma nges pa'i rtags/ 'bras bus rgyu dpog pa yang dag pa'i

82 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rtags/ yod pas yod pa sgrub pa rang bzhin gyi rtags/ med pas med pa sgrub pa mi dmigs pa'i rtags te bzhi'i nang nas yang dag gi rtags de sa chos thams cad rgyu 'bras rten 'brel don mthun rjes su dpag pas go bar 'gyur bas rgyu 'bras la mongs pa'i ma rig pa dang bral rgyu 'bras kyang rkyen bzhi la rag las pas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel kyi sgro 'dogs chod/ de yang skye med mngon sum tshad mas ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pas tshad ma'i 'bras bu stong pa nyid ston pa grub la/ gzhan yang rnam 'grel las/ rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam bsal zhing /zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas kyang bstan bcos 'di'i lus rnam gzhag zab mo stong pa nyid ston pa'i brjod bya yin la/ yang rnam 'grel las/ gang gi dngos po rnams dpyad na/ /de nyid du ni de dngos med/ /gang gi phyir na de dag la/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin med/ /ces gsungs shing rkang pa dang po'i dpyad na la 'gyur 'ga' zhig tu brtags na zhes 'byung ba don 'dra bas/ lung 'di yang nges don phyag rgya chen po dang

gzhung 'grel/ 83dbu ma'i don dpyis phyin pa'i lung yin pas na tshad ma'i 'bras bu stong nyid ston par nges shing / gzhan yang ji skad du/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mdor na tha snyad rig pa thams cad kyang chos nyid stong pa nyid kho na ston pa'i thabs su gsungs pa rnam grangs ches mang ngo //bco brgyad pa ni/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul du phyi nang gnyis las phyi pa'i lta grub ni brjod ma dgos la/ nang pa la yang rtag chad kyi mtha' la zhen pa'i ming grub mthar btags pas blo bsgyur ba'i gang zag so so rang rgyud la lta ba de 'dra ba bdag gir 'dzin pas rang rgyud pa zhes bya la/ de yang dper na dman pa 'jig rten pa la yang nga pha 'di'i bu rigs rgyud 'di lta bu zhes rtag lta dang cha mthun pa dang /las kyi dge sdig mthong tshe nyes pa de lta bu yod na gom pa 'dor mi nus/ chos bya thabs ci yod ces dang / phan yon mthong tshe phan yon

84 dgongs gcig nyin snang /'di 'dra yod na sangs rgyas sgrub pa re sla bsam pa'i rgyu 'bralas la yid mi ches pa chad lta dang cha mthun pa dang / bzang ngan gyi las thams cad phyus bskos gnam gyis byas zer ba sogs byed pa po yod pa'i lta ba dang cha 'dra ba dang / chos pa rnams kyang nyan thos grub mtha' smra ba gnyis nas theg chen dbu sems kyi bar du nga'i grub mtha' 'di lta bu zhes nga yir 'dzin cing bstod pa dang / kho'i grub mtha' 'di 'dra'o zhes smod cing gshe ba sogs rang rgyud gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrog tu chud pa bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rnam dag tu khas len pa dag rdzogs byang lta zhog 'khor bar 'khor ba'i las kyi gtso bo yang byed de//dbu ma 'jug par / dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gis 'di zhes dngos la chags gyur nas/ /zo chun 'phun ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces so//des na chos thams cad bdag med dam pa'i don stong nyid mtha' dang bral ba dgongs pa'i zhe phugs yin pa dang / gzung 'dzin bdag dang bdag gir gyi rtog pa 'joms pa'i gnyen po dpyis phyin pa yin

gzhung 'grel/ 85na/ gnyen po de nyid la 'dzin stangs grub mtha'i dngos por gzung bas sman dug tu song ba dang 'dra ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di ltar chos rnams thams cad ni// bdag med dam pa'i don du na/ /stong nyid bdag tu dmigs pa ni/ /nyes par bshad pa kho na'o/ /zhes so/ de ltar rang rang gi grub pa'i mtha' zhes nga yir 'dzen pa ni thar pa'i gegs la dmyal bar song ba las kyang ches dman te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo dang ldan pa dmyal bar gan sa pa dus kun tu/ /byang chub dri med yangs pa'i bar du gcod byed min/ /theg pa gzhan la rab bsil rnam rtog bdag phan pa/ /rab tu bde bar gnas kyang bar du gcod par byed/ /ces so/ der song gangs can 'dir bshad sgrub kyi bdag po 'ga' zhig don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyal sras su khas 'che zhing /grub mtha' dang bshad sgrub kyi phyogs 'dzin nga bdag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i rang gi grub mtha' la bstod cing gzhan la dngos brgyud kyis smod pa rlung ltar 'phyo ba 'di rnams ni rgyal sras lta zhog chos tshul tsam yang ma mthong bar nges te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sgyu ma'i

dgongs gcig nyin snang /rgyal pos sgyu ma yis/ /sgyu ma gzhan zhig pham pa ltar/ /gang dag gis ni chos mthong ba'i/ /rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med/ /ces bya ba la soms shig/ gzhan yang gleng gzhi ni moṅgal gyi bu'i las kyi rgyu ba bstan pa dang / dge slong nag po la bya rog zhar ma 'dra byas pa'i 'bras bu byung tshul dang / slob dpon chos mchog gi lo rgyus sogs rdor she mar drangs ba ltar rtogs par bya zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su/ 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa bye bar tshul khrims bsrungs byas shing / /yun ring dus su bsam gtan bsgom byas kyang //yang dag nyid mtha' 'di ni ma shes na/ /bstan pa 'di la de dag blo yod min/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas mdor na gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gi dug ni bdag med pa'i shes rab kyis 'joms dgos te/ mtshan brjod las/ bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan//mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs so //bcu dgu pa ni/ mu stegs pa la'ang gshes kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod par bzhed pa ni/ 'ang dang gshis skad kyis

gzhung 'grel/ 87mu stegs la bden pa mthong ba'i nges don mthar thug gi lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa med kyang gnas skabs su dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod pas kho rang rnams gnas skabs su bde skyid dang mngon mtho'i 'bras bu thob pa'ang dge ba'i 'bras bu yin la/ mdor na mi dge ba sdug bsngal nyes pa'i rgyu sa bcu pa'i rgyud la 'dug kyang spong zhing /dge ba bde 'bras ni mu stegs la 'dug kyang byang chub 'dod pas blang dgos te/ de ltar ma zad gshis kyi dge ba bde 'bras thob byed dud 'gro la 'dug kyang bsten dgos pas so/ /mu stegs kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya blang pa ni/ gzhi /gsum gyi cho ga nang pa la med cing phyi rol pa la yod pas/ phyi rol pas 'phya ba la brten/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mu stegs byed rnam sa kyis 'phya ba ni thog tu 'bab pa yin pas/ de lta bas na da phyin chad dbyar gnas gso sbyong dgag dbye 'di rnams bya'o/ /zhes bcas pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha was kyang mu stegs byed las bsrung ba dang bzlog pa'i skor sogs gnas skabs kyi

88 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bar chad sel byed mang po len par mdzad pa sogs sngags gsar rnying gi lo rgyus rnams kyis kyang grub la/ don des na rnam pa kun tu dge ba'i las lam dngos brgyud rgyu dang dus kyi kun slong la ma ltos pa gang 'dug kyang / mthar thug rgyu 'bras dang mthun na blang zhing /mthar thug de las ldog pa ni spang dgos la/ de yang mchog dman gang yin kyang brtags shing dpyad nas nyams su blang dgos te/ ji skad du /dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags nas nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nyes pa zhig 'dug na bla ma'am rang rgyud dam mchog dman su la 'dug kyang 'dor la/legs pa ni su la 'dug kyang blang / khyad par bla ma'i rgyud la ma legs pa 'dug kyang spong ba'i khar slar legs par bsgyur ba ni lhag par yang chos dang mthun te/ rngo bo chen pos gser gling pa'i thugs rgyud kyi lta ba dman pa dbu mar bsgyur ba lta bu yin no/ //nyi shu pa ni/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro bya ba ni/

gzhung 'grel/ 89'ga' zhig gis phyi nang khyad par snying rje dang bdag lta dang rtags phyag rgya bzhi yod med dang spyod pa sogs kyis dbye bar 'dod kyang don min te/ rgyu mtshan nang pa la phyi pa las kyang dman pa'i rtag chad kyi lta ba 'dzin pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ skyabs 'gros ni phyi nang gi dbye ba phyed pa tsam du'ang ma zad lta log dang theg dman sogs las skyob pa yang yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / /ngan song dang ni thabs min dang / /'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ zhes dang / mgon po phag mo gru pas/ de'i don 'grel pa mkhas pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍitas kyang skyabs su 'gro bar mi byed na nang pa sangs rgyas sar mi tshud la/ byed na blun po ba lang rdzi yi ge ka zhig mi shes pa'ang nang pa sangs rgyas par 'gyur bas/ de ltar na phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig yin zhes gsungs/ skabs 'di'i skyabs yul la theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags kyi dbye ba la mi ltos ston pa shāka thub thugs chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsung dang thugs la bzhugs pa'i gsung

90 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rab rnams chos/ sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa dge 'dun 'khor rnam bzhi chos de rnams nyams su len pa dge 'dun te/ de dag la skyabs su 'gro ba ni nang pa/ de tsam la skyabs su mi 'gro ba ni phyi pa zhes dgongs so/ //nyer gcig pa ni/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par sems bskyed bya ba ni/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par rgyu dang / lam dngu / 'bras bu dang / bdag med gnyis khas gang len sogs gang gis kyang mi phyed de/de'i dbye ba ni byang chub kyi sems gcig po yod med kyis 'byed pa yin la/ de yang theg pa chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyi da dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dngang/ /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs/ theg dman ning/ de nyid las/ ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang / /thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir/ /nyan thos kyi ni

gzhung 'grel/ 94theg pa 'di/ /theg pa chen po ga la yin/ /zhes theg pa chen po'i tshul ma tshang zhing gzhan phan gyi sems las 'gal ba sogs kyis nyan thos phyogs gcig pa theg dman du bzhag go /de lta bu'i dbye ba ni bshad ma thag pa'i lung ltar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon pa dang de la 'jug pa'i byang sems yod med kyi zlas phye ste/ jo bo rjes/ sems bskyed med na sngags bla med la zhugs kyang nyan rang gi byang chub las med cing sems bskyed dang ldan na 'tshang rgya ba la yun mi ring bar gsungs pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces dang / 'phags pa rdzud pa las/ gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro//reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par spyod gyur kyang / /dag bcom rang rgyal sems bral byang chub sems dga' na/ /dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam gzhag yin pa shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de tsam du ma zad byang chub kyi sems las nyams na dgra bcom dang nyan rang gi sdom pa rnam par dag kyang tshul khrims 'chal ba zhes brjod la/ 'dod yon

92 dgongs gcig nyin snang /la sred kyang mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing gzhan phan gyi ched du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi smon 'jug dang ldan na tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/ sdud pa las/ chos gang nges pa'i byang chub yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de ni yon tan chos ldan rnams kyi tshul khrims don//chos gang phan byed rnam/sa kyi byang chub yongs nyams pa/ /de ni tshul khrims 'chal ces rnam par 'dren pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul bakhrims pha rol phyin gams rig par bya/ /zhes so/ /nyan rad skreng dgra bcom rnams kyang byang chub chen po thob par 'dod na rang rang gi sdom pa las nyams kyang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ldan pas mchog thob ste/ sdud pa 0/sa / gal te rang rgyal dgra bcom byang chub reg 'dod na/ /tshul khrims 'chal cing mi mkhas de bzhin spyod pa nyams/ /ci ste byang chub zhi ba mchog tu yongs bsngo na/ /'dod yon brtson yang tshul khrims pha

gzhung 'grel/ 93rol phyin la gnas/ /zhes so/ /byang sems dang mi ldan pa'i nyan rang ni rdzogs byang thob pa'i gegs la dmyal ba las kyang ches lhag ste/ dzi skad du/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas pa'i/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi/ /sa ni gtan gyi gegs yin no//zhes dang dzi skad du/ rang gi bu la'ang ma chags pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams ni skar ba dman/ /sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i//skal bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gleng gzhi ni dkon brtse gas gsang chen thabs mkhas su dbang thob pa'i byang sems lta bu'o/ / /nyer gnyis pa ni/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par dbang bya ba ni/ spyir sngags lam gyi dngos gzhi smin grol las gzhan med pa ste/ji skad du/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan rma 'i mchog ces gsungs la/ mtshan nyid theg pa la ni de gnyis ka med pa'i phyir dang / smin grol gnyis kyang smin lam gtso che ba ni/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gang zhig dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar/

94 dgongs gcig nyin snang //rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang / /smig sgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs/ /zhes dngang/ sa ra has/dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim/ /shi ba ru ma gyis stongs pa ltar/ /de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni/ /ye shes kun gyis stongs pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na mdo sngags kyi khyad par dbang kho nar nges la/ de yang ji skad du/ don gcig na yang ma mongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dbang de yang sems bskyed gnyis sogs gzugs can du bkod pa sogs kyis thabs la ma mongs shing thabs mang ba dang / dam tshig las ma 'das na gzhan nyams len gang yang med na'ang skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'grub pas dka' ba med sdi dang / don gyi ye shes brjod yul las 'das kyang tshig gis ngo sprod pa dbang rnon gyi gzhal bya ste tshul de lta bu sngags lam gyi dbang las mtshan nyid theg pa la med pa sogs kyi khyad par dbang kho nas 'byed par dgongs so/ /

gzhung 'grel/ 95/nyer gsum pa ni/ sngags mtshan nyid gang med kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob par bzhed pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi dri ma ragasaḥpa rnams mtshan nyid theg pas spong / phra ba rnams sngags lam gyis sprong pa'am/ yang na sngags sdom gyi rten du so byang gnyis med mi rung du dgos par gsungs pa dang / jo bo rjes/ gsang sngags pha rol phyin pa la/ /brten nas byang chub sgrub par gsungs/ /zhes sogs dang mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog las/ ri mo lugs ma la sogs las/ /rnal 'byor 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /byang chub sems la rab brtson na//de nyid rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro// zhes dang sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur na/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de nyid dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs//zhes gsungs la/ rdor she mar mtshan nyid ral gri dang sngags de la ngar btags pa'i dpe gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang sgrib pa rags pa spong bar mtshan nyid med na rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti yang sangs mi rgyas/ phra ba spong bar sngags med na byang sems nor bzang la sogs pa'ang

96 dgongs gcig nyin snang /sangs mi rgya ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang jo bo rjes gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa'am/ dgongs 'dus nas thar pa nag po'am/ nyan thos sen+dha pa lta bu gsungs pa ste/ mdor na sngags pas thog mar phar phyin theg pa la zhugs nas sa brgyad pa man thob par byas te/ sa brgyad pa nas sngags la zhugs shing sgreb pa phra ba rnams spangs te rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang byed pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pas bskal ba mang por mgo dang yan lag sbyin par gtong ba nas brtsams mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i mthar 'og min du rdo rje 'chang las dbang mnos te rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du byas nas slar sprul pa rgyal bu don grub kyi lus rten la 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa yang / ji skad du/ 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar/ /gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs te/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang sdom pa gsum rim can du thob dgos pa'i phyir ro / //nyer bzhi pa ni/ sdom pa gsum spang bya mi dge ba bcu spong

gzhung 'grel/ 97bar gnad gcig bya ba ni/ go sla zhing grags che bas mdor bsdus na/sdom pa gsum ga la mi ngage ba gnang ba dang / dge ba bkag pa'i skabs mi srid cing gnad gcig tshul ni/ srog gcod la mtshon na mi bsad pa 'dul ba nas pham pa gsum par gsungs pa dang / byang sems la sdom pa nyi shu las/ gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi len par//khros nas gzhan la brdeg pa dang / /zhes dang / mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ sems can la gnod pa byed pa'o/ 'di dag ni rang bzhin gyi nyon mongs pa can te/ slar gsor mi rung ba'o zhes gsod pa bas brdeg pa yang rtsa ltung du bzhag pa dang / sngags la mi bsad pa'am brdeg pa sogs 'tshe ba byas na sdom pa 'og ma gnyis las bkag pa'i phyir rtsa ltung gnyis pa dang / bde gshegs snying po nang gi mched la 'tshe bas rtsa ltung gsum pa dang / sems can la byams pa spangs pas bzhi pa yang 'byung ba sogs shin tu nges pa'i phyir go sla'o/ //nyer lnga pa/ bdag po 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong bya ba ni/ spang bya blang bya 'thob bya so sor yod pas gsum du nges zer ba

9skye dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ — don min la/ rdor she mar g.yu rdog rgyal blon 'bangs gsum gyi bdag po'i khyad par gyis g.yu gcig kyang rgyan gsum gyi ming du 'pho bar bshad pa ltar dang / de bzhin du kha zas la yang sbyar la mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba sgrub par gcig mod/ rten gyi gang zag so so'i dbye bas phye ba dngos bstan du byung bas de'i shugs kyis rjod byed sdom pa gsum so sor byung yang brjod bya dge sgrub sdig spong du gcig la/ de'i bslab bya rtsa ba dang yan lag tu 'jog lugs grangs mang nyung dang / sdom pa'i ngo bo dman 'bring / mchog gi go rim dang / cho ga'i byed tshul gnas dus dpon slob kyi khyad par dang / sdom pa'i skye tshul sogs la ltos nas ming ldom pa gsum du bzhag pa ni rlung ltar grags mod/ don du gnad gcig pa'i phyir ro/ //nyer drug pa ni/ khams rang bzhin gyi rnam dag bral 'bras yon tan dang ldan par bzhed pa ni / khams zhes pa ṅgātu'i sgras rgyu'am/dbyings sam/ khams sogs la 'jug pa yin la/ khams 'di ni gdod ma nas bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan thams cad

gzhung 'grel/ — 99dang dbyer med du gnas pa nyid glo bur gyi nyes pas bsgribs la/nyes pa des kyang rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te/ de ni theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i rdo rje'i gnas bzhi par dpe don rgyas bshad kyis gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang//de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kunang/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes so/ /de yang glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i khyad par ni/ ji skad du/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes dang ji skad du/ ngo bo nyid la sogs pa yi/ /'di drug gis ni bsdus pa yi/ /khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /ming gsum gyis ni bstan pa yin//zhes so/ khams de ni skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba ste/ ji skad du/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' yi/ /khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /tshogs pa med cing skye ba dang / 'jig dang gnas pa'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /glo bur gyi dri mas kyang ngo bo la mi sgribs te/

00 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ji skad du/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa/ /de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de/ /yang dag min rtog las byung 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes so//gnas skabs su sgrib tshul rji lta bu zhe na/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chung dang / /gos trul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar/ /sems can rnams la bde gshegs khams 'di gnas/ /zhes so/ /dri ma de da lta spong mi nus pa ci yin zhe na/ ji skad du/ des na sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi thob ste//'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni/ /nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po 'di/ /rnam gzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ /nyon mongs sbubs nang gnas pa de/ /dpe dag gis ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ rim pa ji lta bur bsgribs na/ ji skad du/ dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang / /dgra bcom slob pa blo ldan rnams/ /rim bzhin bzhi dang

gzhung 'grel/ ga0gagacig dang ni/ /gnyis dang gnyis kyi ma dag nyid/ /ces so/ /glo bur zhes pa thog ma nyid nas bsgribs pa min nam zhe na min te/ ji skad du/sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs/ /ma 'brel thog ma med pa na//sems kyi rang bzhin dre med ni/ /thog ma med pa yin par brjod//ces so/ /de yang rnam dbyer bcas pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma ni rang ki ngo bos stong la/ rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can khams rang bzhin snying po ni ngo bos mi stong ste/ /ji skad du/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gis/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir lung 'di rnams la go ba'i 'phros don byas na/mtha' las 'das pa zhig mchis kyang yi ges 'jigs pas/ blo ldan rnams kyis lung la brtags shing dpyad pas don go bar 'gyur la/gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdor/ nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs nang na/ /zag pa med pa'i ye shes rin po che//sangs rgyas chos kyis gang zhing mdzes par 'dug /ces dang /lha mo

402 dgongs gcig nyin snang /dpal phreng seng ge'i sgra las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni rnam par dbyer yod pa/ shes pa glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag gis stong pa/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bral mi shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o//zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas phal po cher stong gsum gyi tshad dbyibs dar yug la bres pa rdul phra mo'i sbubs su bcug pa sus kyang ma mthong ba phye ba ltar/ snying po yon tan de bzhin gshegs pas gsal bar mdzad pa'i dpe dang / gzungs dbang rgyal pos zhus par/nor bu rin po che bkru ba dang phyi ba'i dpes rgyas par bstan pa yin la/ khams de ni gdod ma nas bsal gzhag med pa de mngon du gyur pa na/ lta ba med pa'i mig gis mthong ba med pa'i don gzhi dus kyi ngo bo de nyid mthong ba las gzhan med de/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med sogs dang / de nyid las/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang / /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /ces dang bram ze

gzhung 'grel/ 403chen pos/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la/ /de ring dpa'/ ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs/ zhes sogs bka' brgyud rin po che 'di'i grub thob chen po rnams kyis rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas gsungs la/ de dag gi don bshad na dbu ma chen po'i rang gzhan gyi stong pa'i bzhed lugs dang / gangs can 'di na bod rgan spyi pa'i grub mtha' rnam grangs mang zhing don ma mthong ba mang po'i tshul yang zhar byung du smra bar sems kyang yi ges ngal bas skabs don de tsam gyis go bar zad do/ //nyer bdurne pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por yod ces gsungs pa ni/bshad ma thag pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad tshang bar yod de/ dri bcas kyi lam la'ang sangs rgyas kyi chos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa sngar drangs ma thag pa ltar yod par gsungs na/ byang phyogs so bdun tshang ba lta ci smos/ lam bzhi por spyi bzhed dang mthun par so bdun

dgongs gcig nyin snang /tshang bar mdo sngags du ma nas bshad cing/ 'bras bu'i skabs byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phyug pa zhes sogs nges pas lam gyi yon tan mthar thug pa rnams mnga' ba mngon rtogs rgyan sogs las bshang pa ltar go bar bya zhing mdo sde gtan la dbab par de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de thams cad tshang bar gsungs pa yod kyang gzhan la gsang ba yin zhes grags chung la/ nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun/ /chos kyi rnam par dag par yin/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo sngags gnyis kur chos de lta bu yod pa yang phar phyin theg pa'i tshul go sla zhing / sngags su dpyid thig gi 'grel bar/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa ba rlung rgyu ba dang / rnam shes drug la dga' ba gzhis phye ba nyer bzhi dang / de 'khor lo bzhi por 'jug gnas ldang gsum po dga' bzhi'i zlas phye bas bcu gnyis te so drugayan lag thams cad tshim pa dang so bdun byang chub kyi phyogs chos dang sbyar ba rgyu'i skabs dang / lam dus lha so bdun/ 'bras dus rnam par dgarme pa'i ye shes dpal he ru ku'i ngor gsungs pa dang / mdor

gzhung 'grel/ 405na 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems las ma 'das na byang phyogs so bdun ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por med par grub lte /rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /gnas pa'i don dang rnam shes dag/phyi rol gyur pa 'ga' yang med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / /nyer brgyad pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi de bzhin gsheb/sa pa'i snying po dang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid rtsa ba 'di ni/ gzhi khams bde gshegs snying po la tshad med pa bzhi tshang bar yon tan gaṅgā'i rlu nga gi bye ma snyed dang ldan par gsungs pas kyang grub la/ mgon po pha ga mo tshigapas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun rdzob kyi cha nas ngos 'dzin na/khra dang spyang ki khu/ sogs gcan gzan dag kyang rang gi bu smad la/ byam sa snying rje skye ba de yin zhes gsungs/ /gzhi khams rang bzhin rnam dag la yod pa lam du byas nas nyams su blang ba snga/gas mtshan nyid gnyis kur gsungs la/ 'dir sngags la mtshon na/ dpal bde mchog 'byung ba las/ gzhan la phan pa'i sems ni byams pa ste/

106 dgongs gcig nyin snang //gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms byed snying rje yin/ /gzhan gyi bde bas tshi ma byed dga' ba ste/ /sems can kun snyoms btang snyoms rnam par bsam/ zhes lam dus su nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras dus su sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na'ang tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor 'tshang rgya snye/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gang gi don du stobs bcu po / /sems can rnams la byams pa bsgom/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis rgya la gyur pa/ /ngas ni bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'thungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi dus kyang tshad me da bzhi ldan rung / lam dus su nyams su blang bya'i snying po/ 'bras dus su bdud kyi sde 'joms pa dang / 'khor rnams smin grol la 'khod pa sogs tshangs gnas bzhi po 'di kho nas mdzad pa yin te/mdo sde rgyan las/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// zhes sogs tshangs gnas bzhi po chos sku'i yon tan du sbyar nas bstod pa yang don 'di'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no/ //nyer dgu pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rigs gcig theg pa gcig bya ba ni spyir sems can gyi rigs la gsung rab rnams su

gzhung 'grel/ 07gsum du 'dus par gsungs te/ yang dag par nges pa dang / log par nges pa dang / ma nges pa'i phung po gsum du gsungs pa sogs dang / rgyud bla mar gnas pa dang sgrub pa'i rigs gnyis su gsungs pa sogs skabs do na tsam la dgongs kyi/ yang dag par rigs gcig las gzhan pa med de khams bde gshegs snying po la mi 'dra ba med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ 'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid/ /da ltar de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid//chos kyi de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med/ /ces dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin//zhes so/ de ltar khams rigs gcig nyid la theg pa yang chen po 'ba' zhig las gzhan med de/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul phyi thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dren pa sems can rnams la mnyam pa'i thugs/ /nga la tha dad 'du shes nam yang med/ /theg pa dman pa gzhan la ngas bstan na/ /de la nga ni ser sna'i

408 dgongs gcig nyin snang /skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ nga yi mya ngan 'das gcig thig pa ba/cig /nga yi theg pa tha dad med pa ste/ /yang dag tu ni theg pa bcig tu bstan/ /de ni thabs kyi yul du shes par bgyis/ /zhes dang /dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ shu ri'i bu/ ngas kyang theg pa gcig las brtsams te sems can rnams la chos bstan pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ theg pa gnyis sam gsum zhes bya ba gang yang med do/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na'ang chos nyid ni 'di'o/ /'di ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na'ang theg pa gnyis su gdags pa'ang med na gsum du lta ga la yod/ /ces dang mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel las/the ga pa che dang theg pa dman pa las/ /rang bzhin sna tshogs chos 8 mas/ gang bstan pa/ /de dag nyid ni tshul gcig yang bstan te/ /de phyir theg pa sna tshogs nga mi smra/ /zhes dang 'phags pa rnam par thar pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ ngas 'di ni nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'am theg pa chen

gzhung 'grel/ ga09po dang ldan par chos tha dad par bstan pa gang yang med na/ mi blun po de dag dam pa'i chos 'di la 'di ni nyan thos rnams la bshad pa/ 'di ni rang sangs rgyas rnams la bshad pa'o/ /zhes tha dad du 'byed de/ de tha dad pa'i 'du shes kyis dam pa'i chos spong ba'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / dam chos pad dkar nas phyis ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas 'brog dgon par grong khyer sprul pa'i dpes bstan pa sogs dang / mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi ya gyal gcig 'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga' ba yin pa'i phyir des na theg pa tha mas cad rigs gcig theg pa gcig tu nges so //sum cu pa ni/ log sred can dang nyan thos kyang mthar byang chub chen po ra 'gyur zhes gsungs pa ni/ log sred can bdud dang legs skar lta bu dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal phyogs gcig pa sangs rgyas pa'i gegs su gsungs pa dang / rgyud bla mar chos la sdang ba la thar pa med par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rigs chad pa sogs

ga 0 da gongs gcig nyin snang / kyang byang chub tu mi 'gyur ba sogs gsungs pa rnams ni/ de rnams dus ma 'ongs pa ring po zhig gi bar du byang chub snying por mi 'gyur ba la dgongs kyi/ rtsa ba nas byang chub gtan mi thob pa ni ma yin te bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i phyir dang / bskal pa shin tu mang po'i grangs 'dren pa'i tshe grangs med ces bod pa dang 'dra bas/ nyan rang sogs lhag med du zhugs pa rnams kyang rgyal ba'i 'od zer gyis bskul nas byang chub kyi lam la bslabs te 'tshang rgya ba dang / bdud dang legs skar sogs log sred can rnams kyang las kyi 'phro de zad nas rigs khams bde gshegs snyeng po de rnams la yod pas theg pa chen po la zhugs nas 'tshang rgya bar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi yul las rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ dper na me stag chung ngu 'phel gyur na/ /me lce chen po 'bar zhing mched pa ltar/ /nyan thos ye shes me yi me stag kyang / /de nyid sangs rgyas yon tan me lce skye/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pas/ nyan thos de dag ji srid du/ /sangs rgyas rnams

gzhung 'grel/ gag kyis ma bskul tshe/ /de nyid ye shes lus gcig gis /ting 'dzin dregs pas myos te gnas/ /bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni//sems can don la mngon dga' zhing / /sangs rgyas byang chub thob 'gyur te/ /byang chub bar du nying mtshams sbyor/ zhes so/ /de ltar nyan rang gi theg pa yang ngal gso'i theg pa lta bu yin te/ ji skad du/ ngal gso'i don du theg pa cher/ /'byung ba ye shes gnyis po yang//gsungs pa yin gyi don dam min/ /zhes so/ /des na bdud dang legs skar yang byang chub snying por ston pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i phyir don 'dis sems can thams cad sangs mi rgya ba mi srid la sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa'i dus mi srid pa sogs chos skad rnying pa rnams kyang 'byung ngo / /zhes chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don dang po'o//

dz+ra /spyi don gnyis pa kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga mchos pa las//dang po ni/ dge mi dge gnyis su thag bcad nas lung ma bstan med bya ba ni/ sems can nyon mongs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i las thams cad ni mi dge ba ste dug gsum gyi 'dres yod tshad mi dge ba'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro bas so/ /slob dpon 'phags pas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ 'o na mdo sde rnams su/ gcig tu dkar ba la 'bras bu bde ba/ gcig tu nag pa la 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ 'dres ma'i las la 'bras bu yang 'dres mar gsungs pa yang 'gal lo zhe na/ de yang mi

gzhung 'grel/ nagaci'agal te 'dres ma zhes pa dper na zhing gcig la nas sran bsres te btab na zhing 'dir nas sran 'dres ma zhes tha snyad 'dogs kyang ngo bo nas la nas dang / sran ma la sran ma las gzhan mi smin te 'bras bu 'dres ma mi srid pas grub la/ chos mngon pa kun btus las lung ma bstan gyi dbye ba bcu gsum gsungs pa yang rtsa ba las 'byin pa'i las la dge sdig gnyis las lung ma bstan med kyi las mi 'byin pa rnams ma smos pa'i phyir dang / las 'byin pa'i lung ma bstan bshad kyang dge sdig gnyis las gzhan pa'i las med cing / 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis las gzhan 'byung rgyu med pa'i phyir dang /dper na khyo shug gnyis la bu mo gcig yod na nang tshang du bgrangs na gsum yod kyang pho mor bgrangs na gnyis las med pa lta bu sogs lung rig rnam dag mang pos grub pa 'dis dkar nag zang thal gyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yang ston pa nyid de/ 'ga' zhig gis/ las dkar rnam smin nag pa dang / /las nag rnam smin dkar ba dang //zhes kha mkhas kyi bshad rtsod lung rnam dag 'khyogs po'i don gyis

gag dgongs gcig nyin snang /rgyab tu drangs pa mang mod/ de lta na rgyu 'bras mi bden par khas len nam/ khyod 'dod pa de tshul ci 'dra/ sngar khyod kyis log pa'i grub mtha' mang po rlung ltar bsgrags zin mod/ da dung tshul de 'dra ba rnams la soms shig/ //gnyis pa ni/ rtog gnyis cig car du mi 'jug cingasems 'grogs par mi skye zhes pa ni/ gang zag gcig la shes rgyud gnyis med pa dang / chos thams cad skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir yud tsam re la'ang spang gnyen gyi tshogs mang po skye 'gag byed pa da ga snga ma snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma phyi ma skye ba ste/ tsha reg gam grang reg gam nyi ma dang mun pa ltar spang gnyen lhan cig tu mi gnas/ dge sdig gi rtog pa'ang lhan cig tu mi skye ste/ lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig ma/ /mi dge'i sems kyang skad cig ma/zhes dang / yum rgyas pa las/ sems kyis sems mi mthong zhing sems gnyis 'grogs par mi skye zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir go sla'o/

gzhung 'grel/ 45/gsum pa ni/ sems las byung ba las kyang sems 'byung zhes bya ba ni/ gzhi skye ba med pa sems yin/ de la rtog dpyod byed pa sems byung yin/ sgro 'dogs chod pa de sems yin pa'i phyir sems byung las kyang sems 'byung ba ste/ laṅkar gshegs pa las sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ /ngar 'dzin nyon mongs yid yin zhing / /gang zhig yul la 'dzin byed pa/ /de la rnam par shes zhes brjod/ /ces so/de'i dpe yang sa bon du nas btab par rgyu rkyen mang du 'du byas pas slar 'bras bur nas nyid yong ba dang mtshungs so/ de yang gzhi ma rig pa sems yin la/ de la brten nas sems byung 'du byed rnam sa 'byung / 'du byed las kyang rnam shes 'byung ste/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad par sems las byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //bzhi pa ni/ 'khor bar lus 'khor bya ba ni/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ de ring khong gis 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa klog pa kho bos gsan pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho lus 'di

ga bya dgongs gcig nyin snang /yin gsungs nas gda'/ de ji ltar yin snyam du dgongs pas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po srog chags du ma'i gzhir gyur pa ltar/ lus 'di 'khor ba'i gzhi dang rtsa ba ste thog ma med pa'i bag chags yul rkyen da nga 'phrad pas rnam rtog bzang ngan sna tshogs skye/ de bsags pa'i las kyis lus de dang rjes mthun grub pas 'khor bar lus 'khor ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ yid ni lus can ma yin pas/ /sus kyang gang du'ang gzhom mi nus/ /lus la mngon par zhen pas na/ /lus ni sdug bsngal dag gis gnod/ /ces so/ /khams gsum rigs drug tu 'khor ba yang lus yin la/ 'bras bu rdzogs byang thob nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sprul sku yang lus yin pas las bzang ngan gang smin yang lus la brten dgos te/ ji skad du/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'/ /zhes so/ bar dor lus med dam snyam na der yang bag chags kyi lus shig nges par yod de //mngon pa mdzod dang rje phag mo gru pas/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can/ /dbang po kun tshang thog med rgyu/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/

cigazhunga'agrel/ ga 7/gzhan yang rig pa drug cu pa las/ gal te phung po ma 'gags na //nyon mongs zad kyang 'das mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe de'ang 'gags rgyud pa//de yi tshe na grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ //lnga pa ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad ma rig pa/tī g.yos bya ba ni/ /myo 0rig pa yod na rga shi'i bar yod la/ ma ri'i /— dzo/ 'gags na rga shi'i bar 'gags pas grub ste/ 'phags pa sdud pa 95sa/sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun myo/ rig/ las byang bde bar gshegs pas gsangs/ /zhes gsangs la/ ri 9 rig/ dpa ring ring de ni dran med du brgyal ba'am mig gis mi mthong ba lta bu la mi bzhed de/ de kho na nyid kyi don la bsgribs pa'i gti mug mtshan 'dzan dug lnga'i rtsa bar gyur pa de nyid ma rig pa yin/ gzhan du na don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sogs las sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' la sogs pa mi she sa pa la ma rig par bshad modang/ de chi snga ma las gzhan du gzung bya med pas so/ //drug pa ni/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis skad cig ma gcig

ga bya dgongs gcig nyin snang /la'ang tshang bar bzhed de/ slob dpon dbyig gnyin gyis/ lug gcig gsod pa'i bar la'ang rten 'brel bcu gnyis tshang bar gsungs pa dang / de bas kyang dus nye ba klu dge tshul dang / bshud dge'i slob ma klur skyes pa dang / sbyor ba mgo rtsom pa nyon mongs pa'i dum bu/ dngos gzhi longs spyod pa las kyi dum bu/ rjes thim pa sdug bsngal gyi dum bu ste dum bu gsum sbyor dngos rjes gsum du 'ong / de ltar na rtog pa skad cig ma se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam la'ang rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad tshang ba yin/ 'di go na skyon spong ba dang yon tan sgrub pa thams cad dus ring po la ltos mi dgos/ skad cig ma'i 'khor lo'i tshul gyis bsgrub chog par gsungs te gnad zab kyang go sla'o/ //bdun pa ni/ sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad ces gsungs pa ni/ dper na chos mngon pa/ dus 'khor/ phal po che/ 'dul ba/ 'jig rten gdags gzhag sogs nas gling bzhi ri rab kyi tshad dbyibs sogs gsungs pa 'gal ba ltar go ba dang / de

gzhung 'grol/ ga byabazhin du mchog dmaṅge bar ma 'gro drug gang gi yang rang gi go tsho da snang tshod de ltar yin no/ /bden no/ gzhan rnams kyi tshul de 'dra ba min no zhes bden zhen gyis rgyal ba'i bka' la nang 'gal dang ris su gcod pa ni rnam par ma dag pa kho na ste/ dper na ngo bo chu gcig po la lhas bdud rtsi/ mis chu/ yi dwags kyis rnag khrag tu mthong ba ltar dang / don dam stong pa bden grub kyi dbang du gang yang ma grub kyang / kun rdzob bden pa'i 'khrul ngor rang rang gi las/ dang khams dang mos pa dang bsam pa'i dbang gis tha dad par snang ba nyid yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ yul dang dbang po'i bye brag rnams/ /rnam pa tha dad ma mchis te/ /gzugs sogs snang bar gyur pa ni/ /rang sems kho na snang ba'o/ /zhes dang rje phag mo gru pas/ dmyal ba dang ni sangs rgyas bar/ /spros bral sems kyi snang ba ste/ /stong nyid yin pa'i gnad ka des/ /cir yang bsgyur du btub pa yin/ /zhes so/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems las gzhan du grub pa med de/ rdo rje gur las/ gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes dang / /'du

ga20 dgongs gcig nyin snang / byed dang ni rnam shes nyid/ /thams cad sems 'di'i dngos po las//thub pas gzhan du ma gsungs so/ /zhes so/ de ltar thams cad sems su gcig par rtogs na 'khor 'das zhes pa'i ming tsam yang stong pa ste / dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud las/ 'khor bar 'khor bar mi 'gyur te/ /mya ngan 'da' bar yongs mi 'gyur/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa ni/ /chu zla bzhin du bden pas stong / /zhes so/ /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i snang ngor tha dad du snang ste/ ji skad du/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /mo tshogs 'di dag gang nas byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang / /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / mgon po phag mo gru pas/ res 'ga' ni ngam shod kyi klung 'di 'og min gyi gnas yin/ res 'ga' ni lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi yin zhes gsung pa yang don 'di la dgongs/ de ltar na bsod nams bsags pa rab 'bring tha ma'i sna nga ngor tha dad du snang ba yin gyi don du ngo bo ma grub pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gur nas rgyas par gsungs pa dang /phug khru bco brgyad pa'i nang du 'khor los sgyur ba bu dang btsun mo

gzhunga'agrel/ tsho24dpung bcas shong ba'i dpe dang / 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod las byams pas khri bshams pa'i tshad skedang / sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdor bya rgod phung ri'i yon tan gsungs pa rnams da lta bya rgod phu nga ri la med pa yang sems tha dad pa'i snang tshul tha dad pa yin/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / mngon pa'i gzhung nas gsungs pa yi/ /gangs ri gser gyi bya skyobs dngang /'dzam bu'i shing dang sa srungs bu/ /zhes pa nas de ltar min pa'i gang zag gis/ /yul der 'gro ba brgyud las bkag /ces rgyu mtshan du mas bkag mod/ dbya da nas bshad kyi/ dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ btsun pa ciX ri'i bus smras pa/ bdag gis sa chen po (redis mtho dman dang g.yang sa dang ljan ljin gyis gang bar mthong ngo / /khyes zer ro/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i zhing nas 'ongs pa'i tshangan / pa ral ba can gyis smras pa/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub rma 'i zhing 'di nyid gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i gnas kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bzhin du dag par mthong ngo zhes zer ro/ /de nas

122 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'a di'i rang bzhin ston par mdzad pas thams cad kyis shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin po che'i rgyan bkod pa'i zhing khams bzhin zhigongs su dag par mthong bar gyur pas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ni rtag tu 'di 'dra ste khyed rnams kyis mi mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ma dros pa dang ti se dang / tsā ri sogs kyang sngon gyi bshad tshod dang da lta mi mtshungs pa yang tshul de lta bu kho nar nges so/ /yang kho na re/ de la kha cig 'di skad du/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang / /dkon brtse gas bzhin du da lta med/ /dus kyi stobs kyis yul kun kyang / /rnam par 'gyur bar snang zhes zer/ /'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes pa nas/thams cad 'khrul pa ga la srid/ /ces pa'i bar gyi snyan ngag gi bstode pa dang gnas lugs brjod pa sogs gtan tshigs su byas mod kyi de yang lung des rnam par nyams par byas so/ /yang kho na re/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /mngon pa'i gzhung nas gsungs pa yi/

gzhung 'grel/ 123/zhes khris mod/ dus 'khor dang mngon pa'i gnas kyi rnam bshad mtshungs par 'dren pa yang rnam par 'khyams so/ /rtogs ldan du khas blangs pa 'ga' zhig rnam rtog khyim pa tha ma las rags pa'i rung can rnams dang / mkhas par khas len pa'i phyogs gcig bden 'dzin 'khrul zhen can rgyal ba'i bka' la ltang gcod byed pa dag yod mod/ rang gi gnas tshul de 'dra ba la soms la gcom bskyung nas kha rog 'dug cig / /brgyad pa ni/ da lta nyid du gang bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la longs spyod par bzhed pa ni/ sngon gyi las kho nar yang nges pa ma yin te/ da lta nyid du bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la long spyod pa 'di yang yod de/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo las/ chos thams cad ni rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba/ rkyen la rag las pa/ srid nga/'i rtsa ba can/ smon lam gyis thog drangs pa'o/ /zhes dang ji mad du//rgyu gcig gis ni kun grub pa'i/ /'bras bu gang zhigang yod min t+t+waṃ sgyu/ /lha rnams kyis ni byas pa yang / /rgyu rkyen gzhan la ltos dgos so/

124 dgongs gcig nyin snang /zhes dang / rje btsun mi las/ brkos par gyur na sa las chu yang thon //bsrubs par gyur na shing las me yang 'bar/ /mis ni brtson 'grus dang 'bad byas gyur na/ /mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med par gsungs/zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'drel thams cad ji ltar bsgregs pa ltar da lta nyid du 'byung ba mgon po 'bre gung pa chen po lta bu dang / dper na zhing la so nams mkhan gyis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu lta bu ste rtogs sla'o/ //dgu pa ne/ dus kyi 'phel 'grob da ltar yang byar yod/ces gsungs pa ni/ 'phel 'grib byed pa'i rgyu dge ba dang mi dge ba yin te/ byed pa pos byas pa dang / rang bzhin gyis byung ba dang / dus kyis/ byas pa ma yin te/ sngon bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gyi dus 'od gsal gyi lha babs ma thag pa'i bcud sogs dpal yon du mas longs spyod pa yang nyon mongs 'phel bas tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'grib la/ bcu pa'i dus rgyal ba mi pham pa'i sprul pas dge bcu'i khrims bcas pa bsrungs bas brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel bar bshad

gzhung 'grel/ 425pa dang / snying rje pad dkar las/ sngon 'jig rten gyi khams yang dag 'dren du skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri las 'greb nas brgyad cu pa'i nang du bdag cag gi ston pa 'di byang chub sems dpa'i che gdol ba stobs chen du 'khrungs shing / des stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis skye dgu mi chos bcu drug dang ldan par bkod pa'i mthus tshe lo lnga brgya bar 'phel bar gsungs pa lta bu yin pas/ da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dir yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam chos kyi rgyal po phyogs lhung dang bral ba dag gis skye dgu rnams rnam par dag pa'i mi chos bcu drug la bkod na tshe bsod longs spyod thams cad yar ldan du 'byung ba dang / de lta ma byung yang yul gru'am/ khyim gang ngam/ rang rgyud gcig po tsam yang mi chos bcu drug la bkol na de'i rngo skal nas rdzogs ldan ltar 'byung ba sngon gyi gleng gzhis grub pas de ltar 'byung mod/ rang 'dod dang rnyed brtsod khengs grags gtam don byus no ra la dmigs nas dge ba'i las lam du bdag gzhan bkol yang ne tso kha'i chos bshad dang mtshungs pas snying pos dben mod/ 'ga' zhig gis de ltar byas ma byas med ces blo bsad nas sdod pa la ni chusna rnams rgya mtshor 'du ba

426 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lta ra mi mthun pa thams cad sdig can de'i phyogs sam grong ngam khyim der 'ong ba chos nyid yin pas/ des na dus kyi 'phel 'grib dge sdig gi 'dor len gyis da lta kho nar 'byung ngo / //bcu pa ni/ tshe 'di rang du mthong chos gtso bor 'byung bya ba ni/ 'dul ba lung dbyen gzhi bam/ po brgya rtsa bdun pa las/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po ma skyes dgras mthong chos gang yin zhus pa'i lan du/ khyod kyi 'bangs go re long zhig nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas dge slong tshul khrims sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan par gyur na/phyis khyod kyis de la g.yog 'chol lam zhes dris pas ma skyes dgras de lta ci smos bdag gis phyag dang bkur bsti'i gnas su 'gyur ro zhes gsol ba la de mthong chos kyi 'bras bur gsungs pa dang / spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'os/ zhes dang dang bskur ba'i 'bras bur yang / ji skad du/ de ring khyod rnams bde ba ra gnas/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs la/ mthong

gzhung 'grel/ ga27chos da ltar yang 'byung ba dpal phag mo gru pas/ tha na 'jig rten mi chos gcig gis gcig la khyod mda' tsha zhes smras na nga bas kyang khyod tsha zhes zer la/ pha rol por smad na tshur yang smod par 'gyur/mthong chos de nyid kho na yin gsung ba ltar go bar sla'o/ //bcu gcig pa ni/ mi chos bcu drug la sogs pa dang lha chos gnad gcig bya ba ni/ srog gcod ma byin len 'dod log ji na myos 'gyur sogs spong bar bsngags pa dang / sgrub par smod pa dang pha ma dge slong slob dpon sogs la rim gro bya ba dang / phar phyin drug sogs spyod pa la bsngags pa dang / mi spyod pa la slod pa sogs kyi cha/dor na mi chos bcu drug lha chos dang gnad gcig pa a cang che ste/mi chos ni lha chos rtsa ba rmang rdo lta bu yin pa yang / slob dpon 'phags pa'i shes rab brgya par/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na//lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug ces dang bzhi brgya pa las/ yang dag kun rdzob rnams kyi skas/ /med par don dam khang chen gyi/ /steng du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni/ /mkhas la rung ba ma yin no/ zhes gsungs so/ /

ga28 dgongs gcig nyin snang //bcu gnyis pa ni/ phal che chung las 'bras bu thob pa rgyun sgru/ 'chad pa 'byung bya ba ni/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir brtson 'gru sa byas kyang 'tshang mi rgya zer ba rnam par ma dag pa ste/ phar phyin la yang dkon mchog gsum rtag pa'i gnad kyis nyams su gang blangs la 'bras bu 'byung bas dus kyi dbye ba mi rigs te/ zla ba snying por balhan pa nub khar dag bcom pa des pa 'byung bar gsungs la/tshe lo brte pa nas yar 'phel te drug brgya pa'i dus kyi bar du bstan pa 'di gnas shing gnas brtan chen po bcu drug byon nas gsung rab bsdus pa'i mchod rten byas te mya ngan las 'da' bar dgra bcom pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las gsungs pa sogs kyi phal che chung gis 'bras bu dang / bsgrub pa/ lung gi dus so sor bstan gyi/ bsgrubs shing nyams su blangs na 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'i 'phros ni/ sid+dha gling gi dgra bcom pa la zhus dus 'khor dang bstun pa'i kha che paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis las bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bshad pa la/ rje 'jig rten mgon po shin tu mnyes nas bstan pa gnas pa la bsngags shing / lnga brgya'i tha mar sher phyin gyis sangs

gzhung 'grel/ 429rgyas kyi bya ba byed par gsungs pa sogs spyi bzhed las bye brag gi bzhed par bstan la/ khyad par gsang sngags ni rdzogs ldan las rtsod dus 'dir shin tu bsngags pa'i phyir 'bras bu 'byung bar myur ba ste/ji skad da/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dus mthar dngos grub mi thob ste/ /chos 'di de ltar shes nas su/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ zhes sogs gsungs la lung 'di'i phyi mar dngos grub mi 'byung zhes pa ni snyegs ma'i dus phar phyin theg pa'i chos nyon mongs pa spang byar byed pa sgrub mkhan dkon gyi/ gsang sngags nyon mongs lam byed sgrub pa mang bas de'i phyir dgongs so/ /des na phal che chung la dgongs 'bras bu'i dus gong du bzhag gi phyis mi thob pa ma yin te/ma sgrubs na 'bras bu'i dus su'ang 'bras bu thob pa mi srid pa'i phyir dang / 'bras bu'i dus bsgrub pa'i dus lung gi dus rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus te bzhir bzhag pa ni shas che chung la dgongs pas de ltar go dgos so/ //bcu gsum pa ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro ba'ang yod bya ba ni/ bslab gsum rim can du bshad mod/ 'ang gi

30 dgongs gcig nyin snang /sgras kho nar yang ma nges te/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan la man ngag bstan pas de'i rgyud la mngon rtogs skyes pa lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ de'i rgyun skyong ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ rtogs pa mthar phyin nas stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ldang ba tshu la khrims kyi bslab pa yin te/ dper na rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / lnga sdo bzang po ye shes khong du chud nas dge slong gi bslab bya blangs pa dang / rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khyim pa'i cha lugs kyis dgra bcom pa thob rjes rab byung gi rtags dang bslab pa blangs pa lta bu dang / deng sang yang khyim pas bsam gtan bsgom nas ye shes mthong rjes gzod so thar gyi sdom pa nod pa lta bu yin la/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste/ /tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bslab pa gsum la go rim gcig kho nar yang ma nges so zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o/ //bcu bzhi pa ni/ lam rim thams cad thun gcig gi nang du nyams su blang bya ba ni/ nyin mtshan gyi cha thun drug bzhi gnyis gang

gzhung 'grel/ gcigaltar byed kyang thun khong re rer lam rim thams cad tshang bar nyams su blang dgos par dgongs/ de'i tshul ni thun gyi mgor 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang / rgyu 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi phar phyin theg pa la bdag med gnyis kyi don bsgom/gsang sngags pas lam rim gnyis bsgom pa la spyir dgongs/ bye brag thugs kyi bzhed pa ni thun gcig la yang mdo sngags gnyis ku'i lam gyi snyeng por drel ba mgon po phag mo gru pa'i thugs kyi gnag pa phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan du dril nas nyams su blang / der ma zad nyon mongs kyi rtog pa phra ba re re spong ba dang / dkar po'i chos phra mo re re bsgrabs kyang lam lnga ldan gyi skya bar nas 'don pa ni mgon po 'bri gung pag chen po'i zab chos kyi nying khu yin pas tshul de lta bu la dgongs shing /gzhan yang ji skad du/ rtag tu 'chi bsam las su bsags pa bgrang //dkon mchog gsum mchod ngo bo gnyis med bsgom/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas kyang grub la/ tshul 'di rnams ni jo bo rje bod du byon phyin dzad byung zer mod/ de ni min te/ rje btsun mar rngog sogs

432 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bka' brgyud rin po che 'di nyid spyi sgos kyi nyams len byed tshul mtha' dag kyang 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing de rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud kyang 'di kho na yin pas so/ / /bco lnga pa ni/ sangs rgyas mang po zhing gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bya ba ni/ tshogs gnyis goms pa'i phul gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni sems can gyi khams dang mnyam la/ sems can gyi khams 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ni mtha' las 'das te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'/ /de dag med pas 'khor ba ni/ /thog ma tha ma med par brjod/ ces gsungs pas sems can re re'i snang ngor sangs rgyas re re snang bar mdzad de/ mgon po byams pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad la/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa gcig car 'char/ zhes so/ des na 'jig rten gyi khams re rer sems can de snyed kyi grangs kyi sangs rgyas byon yang gcig gi go gcig gis 'gags par 'gyur ba med pa'i dper/ ston pas 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gsungs pa'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs

gzhung 'grel/ 433rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khor bcas byon pa dang / dam byedros pad dkar gsungs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas rin chen mang sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams til gyi gong bur ltar gang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das dbang po'i phug gu dbyar gnas pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'jug sred rgyal po'i zhing du sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa tshogs nas chos bgro ba mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten kun tu 'od du phyogs brgyas 'dus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba'i mdo gsungs pa sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs la/ 'gran zla med pa'i las bsags pa stunali don zhing der rtag tu bzhugs 9pa'i sangs rgyas de gtsor rgyur gyi don yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams la chags dang sdang ba cimi rgedza' bcas sangs rgyas gzhan rnams ni sangs rgyas de'i yab yum sras rim gro ba sogs dang / tha na mu stegs kyi tshul bzung nas che ba 'don pa dang / phrin las kyi grogs mdzad pa sogs kyang lung gis gas la la /dgongs 'dus le'u gsum pa'i lung 'jig rten gcig gam glid gcig tu sogs gsungs pa ni rdo rje gdan du 'tsha nga rgya ba sogs

434 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i ston pa mchog gi sprul sku gnyis mi 'byung ba la dgongs la/ yongs grags sogs bon 'bum gyi lung ni rang re'i lung du mi 'gro bas bzhag yang na zhing gcig tu dus rtag tu bzhugs nas bslab gzhi bca' ba'i sangs rgyas ni gcig las gnyis dus mtshungs su mi 'byung bar yang 'gal ba med la/ rdo rje'i gsung 'di ni gong gi rgyud bla'i lung gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no/ /zhes kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don gnyis pa'o//

gzhung 'bral/ ga35tsho/ spyi don gsum pa 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la/ rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu mchis pa las dbye bsdu'i dbang gis bco brgyad du mdzad pa las/ /dang po ni/ 'dul ba theg pa thun mong yin bya ba ni/theg chung gnas skabs kyi zhi bde byis pa 'brid pa'i bde skyid kyang so thar la brten nas 'byung ste/ dkon mchog seng ges zhus pa las/tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gror 'gro /zhes so// 'bring nyan rang gi theg pa yang so thar la brten te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhes so//mchog rdzogs byang gi 'bras bu yang so thar la brten te/ lung rnam 'byed las/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rang rgyal rnams gyis kyang //byang chub gang brnyes thugs slob rnam dag pa/ /sems can dag

36 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bcom yon tan ldan pa rnams/ /de'i yang rgyu ni 'dul ba yin par gsung / /zhes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi yang rtsa ba lta bu so thar 'ong ste/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i so thar gyi 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa las/ so sor thar pa zhes bya ba ni dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa so sor ma 'dres par nyams su blangs pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon du byed pa'i phyir so sor thar pa zhes bya'o/ gal te de ltar ma yin na byang chub sems dpa'i sde sdod las byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i gzhung de dag dang 'gal zhes dang / 'dul ba gtan la phab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa zhes sogs gsungs so/ gsang sngags la yang so thar gyi bslab bya thun mong du yod pa/ srog gcod ma byin len jin 'dod log rnams kyang phal cher 'dra la/ ngan song sbyong ba las/ chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs/mdo sder yang dga' ba can gyi mdo las/ chang gi nyes pa sum cu so

gzhung 'grel/ 437drug dang / byang sems kyi sde snod na nyes pa so lnga gsungs pa sogs nas so thar theg pa thun mong yin la/ thun mong gis mi tshad sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ ji ltar 'di na shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ /rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin kun gyi gzhi/ /de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams kun gyi yang / /gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /theg pa de rnams kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa myur bul yang brtson 'grus che chung yin te/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ bdag cag gi ston pa bas mgon po byams6 pa sems bskyed pa bskal pa bye ba phrag bzhi bcus snga na yang bdag cag gi ston pa brtson 'grus che bas sngon nu / sangs rgyas par gsungs pa lta bu yin/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas las ldog pa yang sdom pa gsum ga 'dra ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas so thar theg pa thun mong du nges pa'i phyir bod rgan spyi'i rjes su mi 'brang gsungs so// /gnyis pa ni/ lhag par theg pa chen por bzhugs pa

38 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gsal zhes gsung sa pa ni/ snga ma'i 'dul ba theg pa thun mong du gsungs pa tsam yang gzhan dag dkri bldi ched du re zhig gsung mod/bzhed pa'i snying po theg pa chen por bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i tshul yang 'dul ba nas gsungs te/ lung sman gyi gzhi las/ bdag cag gi ston pa sngon rgyal po 'od ldan du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / lung de nyid las/ rdza mkhan yangs pa'i 'od du gyur ba'i tshe shākya thub pa chen po la bsod snyoms phul nas sems bskyed pa sogs lung mang pos grub/ bar du lam phar phyin drug rdzogs tshul yang 'du la bar gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs lnga brgyar gsungs pa dang / /khyad par dmigs bsal du skyes rabs bcu gsal bar phar phyin drug rdzogs par mdzad tshul rgyal po 'od ldan gyi gleng gzhi sogs gsungs pas theg chen gyi bsngo ba'ang ches gsal/ so thar mdo'i zhabs su'ang /so sor thar pa ston pa yi/ /bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa/ /des

gaX/nga'agre95/ —— tshoni 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog/ ces sogs theg chen gyi bsngo ba ches mang / mthar byang chub thob tshul yang / lung dbyen gyi gzhi las mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / lung phran tshegs las mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa sogs ches mang ngo //'grel pa mkhan pos theg chen du bkral ba yang / slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsar lnga phrugs nyer gcig gi skabs su/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang / lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / lhag pa'i shes rab slob tu 'jug pa nyid ces sogs gsungs/ theg chen ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gis 'khur nus pa/ bdag dge gzhan la gtong ba la zer na/ 'dul ba'i sgor zhugs nas sbyangs pa'i yon tam bcu gnyis la gnas pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de mchog tu gsungs pa dge slong mi 'khrugs pa'i sems bskyed dam bca' lta bu'o/ /lha mo dpal phreng gi mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das so sor thar pa dang 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i chos 'di gnyis ni don gcig snye yig 'phru ni tha dad pa lags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste bde

shesna (kyi dgongarngan gcig nyin snang /bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi slad du rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na 'dir 'dul ba zhes bgyi ba dang nga ba tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni theg pa chen po'i cho ga'i chu ra khrims lags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /theg chung zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ nyan thos theg pa de la ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang // spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes dang /mdo sde rgyan las/ ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang / thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir// nyan thos kyi ni theg pa 'di/ /theg chen chos zhes bya ba min/ /zhes gsungs shing so sor thar pa ni de rnams las yog pas theg pa chen por bzhugs la/ theg chen zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs kre che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg

gzhung 'grel/ ga4gachen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di rnams so thar la dpyis phyin pa bzhugs pas theg chen du nges la/ theg pa che chung gi rgyu mtshan mi shes par ming la 'khrul pa 'di rnams ni ches blun pa'o// 'ga' zhig na re/ nyan thos kyi ni theg pa la/ /theg pa chen por 'chos pa dang / /nge bzhi na theg chen nyan thos su/ /'chos pa tshul khrims ma dag pa/ /zhes smras mod soms dang /'dul ba theg chen du bzhed pa ni/ lha mo dpal phreng gi mdos dngos su bshad mod/ de tshul khrims ma dag na mtshar che/ ston pa sangs rgyas tshul khrims rnam par ma dag na gzhan dag gi tshul khrims ci 'dra na ya cha'o/ /yang khyod kyis/ rang nyid tshul khrims bsrung na yang / /tshul khrims la ni mchog 'dzin cing / /gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa ni/ /ma dag pa yi tshul khrims yin/ /zhes smras shing bris mod/shin tu bden ches te / rang gis tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs kyang /gzhan la khyad du gsod pa ni ma dag pa'i tshul khrims yin par ston pas kyang yang yang gsungs pa dang / byang sems la bdag bstod

442 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gzhan smod rtsa ltung du gsungs pa dang / gsang sngags la khyad du gsod pa yan lag gi ltung ba bdun par gsungs pa sogs ches shin tu mang mod/ de'i phyir khyod rang gi bstan bcos na rang nyid nas tshul khrims yin gyi bar dang / des dngos dang shugs kyis bstan pa'i ltung ba de rnams khyed rang gis bdag gir mdzod cig ci'i phyir na khyed rang gi bstan bcos de'i mgo nas mjug gi bar gyi tshig cidon rnams kyi go don dang bsam sbyor la yang dag par soms shig//gsum pa ni/ tshul khrims rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin bya ba ni/ 'dul ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin te sa bcu'i dbong phyug rnams kyis kyang chos 'dul ba'i bslab gzhi bca' bar mi nus na de man chad kyi byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos rnams kyis lta ci smos/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji lta ba 'khor 'das kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa/ ji snyed mkhyen pa ni de'i ngang las rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad so sor ma 'dres par mkhyen pa/ yang na stobs bcu'i ji lta ba mkhyen

gzhung 'grel/ ge43pa'i ye shes zag pa zad pa'i stobs yin/ lhag ma dgu ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin pas/ de ltar stobs bcu'am dgus dgag sgrub kyi bslab tshul gsungs la/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas kyang mthar thug stobs bcu mnga' bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ tshul khrims la ni gnas na ting nge 'dzin rnams 'thob/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas na shes rab shin tu bsgom/ shes rab kyis rmi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa thob/ ye shes rnam par dag na tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ zhes so/ /don de la dgongs nas lo tsā ba chen po rnams gyis kyang 'dal ba'i glegs bam gyi 'gyar phyag ta/ thams cad sa ༄ 4 4 ༄ 4༄ 4mkhun pa la phyag 'tshal la/ /zhes smas pa dang / stan pa yangs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe kun dga' bo la bka' stsal ba/ nga 'das nas ston pa so sor thar pa la tshol zhes gsungs pa dang / so so ra thar mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par/ /nan tan dge 'dun tshogs mngon bstod/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir legs

444 dgongs gcig nyin snang / par grub pa'o///bzhi pa ni/ skye ba'i bar chad thams cad 'bras bu thob pa'i bar chad yin gsung pa ni/ sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad/ skyes pa gnas pa'i bar chad/ khyad par yon tan thob pa'i bar chad/ gzhan du mdzes pa'i bar chad de bzhi las/ dang po skye ba'i bar chad ces pa ni sdom pa mi skye bar gzhag pa min gyi/ de las 'bras bu mi 'byung bar bzhag pa yin te/ mtshams med kyi las pha dang ma bsad par 'gyod de rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum shes par gyur kyang / ston pas mtshams med byas pa de mi skye ba'i chos can du bka' stsal nas bskrad pas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin nas gtsug lag khang byas te slob ma byung bar chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob/ kho rang tshe 'phos nas dmyal bar skyes kyang bsro khang tshogi 'du shes skyes pas dmyal srung gi tho bas bsnun nas bsad pa rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lhar skyes pa ston pa'i spyan sngar slar bden pa mthong ba de mtshams med byas pa'i lus des dgra bcom sogs/ 'bras bu ma thob pa dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan

gzhung 'grel/ ga45pa rnams kyang tshe de la sdom pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin yang tshe 'phos nas thob pa dang / klu bye tshan gyi 'jigs pas rab tu byung ba gnyid log pa'i tshe rang gzugs sprul du snang ba/ ston pas khyod kyi lus 'di la brten nas yon tan gang yang mi thob pas dge slong rnams la ma 'tshe bar song zhig gsungs pas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du song bstan pa gnas kyi bar du dkon mchog la zhebs tog byed par dam bcas pa lta bu ste/ de ltar na lus rten de rnams la sdome pa phogs kyang lus de ma 'phos bar du dgra bcom sogs 'bras ༷bu mi thob pa'i phyir skye ba'i bar chad nyid dang 'bras bu skye ba'i byā sno chad du 'gyur ba kho na ste/ rje rin po ches/ gling gsum dag tu skyes pa yi/ /skyes pa bud med ma gtogs pa'i/ /gzhan gyi rten la 'dod pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/ /seng ge glang chen ru ru dang / /lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs la/ /so sor thar pa'i rten du gsungs//zhes kyang gsung ngo// ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal bar ma bsad pa'i mi rab tu byung ba dgra bcom thob par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe

446 dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ na mi 'gal te de ni sprul pa yin par mdo las gsal bar gsungs so /lnga pa ni/ sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bya ba ni/ kha che bye brag smra bas gzugs dang / sems dang / sems byung dang / mi ldan pa'i 'du byed dang 'dus ma byas te shes bya'i gzhi lnga'i gzugs la/ rgyu'i gzugs 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras gzugs yul lga dbang po lnga rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te bcu gcig gi phyi ma la'ang / sdom pa/ sdom min/ bar ma'i dbye bas rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te/ mdzod las/ rnam rig byed min gsum zhes bya/ /sdom dang sdom pa ma yin gzhanang/ /sdom pa so sor thar zhes bya/ /de bzhin bsam gtan zag med skyes/ /so thar zhes bya rnam pa brgyad/ /rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir/ /tha dad de dag 'gal ba med/ /spang bya lnga brgyad bcu dang ni/ /thams cad spong ba nod pa la/ /dge bsnyen dang ni bsnyen gnas dang / /dge tshul ched dang dge slong nyid/ /ces

gzhung 'grel/ 447pa'i sdom pa de rnams mngon gyur bcu sogs tshogs pa'i rkyen gyis dge slong sogs su gyur to snyam pa'i shes pa de rnams bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ chos khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa rnams rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs zhes sam/ bsam pa'i rang bzugs zhes btags so/ /rnam rig min pa'i gzugs de la rkyen mi dge bas zhig par rung bas mthun phyogs kyi darge ba nyams su blang / mi mthun phyogs kyi mi dge ba spong dgos zhes pa ni don dril ba mdor bsdus pa'i ngo bong/gzhan yang mdzod 'grel du/ sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa'i rig byed dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang po dag ni so sor thar pa zhes bya ste/ des sdig pa las so sor thar pa'i phyir te spangs pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ skad cig ma gnyis pa la sogs pa la ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa kho na yin gyi/so sor thar pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes sdom pa len pa rnam par rig byed/ sdom pa nyid rnam rig min pa/ yang na brje ba gsum las/ bsam

448 dgongs gcig nyin snang / pa brje ba rnam rig min pa/ rtags dang cha lugs brje zhing ming spo ba rnam rig sogs su dbye ba'ang zhar gyi 'phros so/ /'ga' zhig gis/nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min/ /zhes smra ba ni ha cang thal ches te /rgyu mtshan nyan thos shes pa sde pa bco brgyad spyi ming du btags pas bco brgyad po thams cad 'dod mthun du sdom pa rnam rig min par khas blangs pa khyod kyis mthong ngam thos/ 'di yod smra'i nang nas kha che bye brag smra ba'i lugs yin mod/ gzhan rnams kyis de ltar khas mi len no///drug pa ni/ ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso bya ba ni/yul bud med la spyad pa'i rjes su yul nor bar shes pa dang /gser brku bsam g.yu dang nor ba lta bu'i 'du shes ma yin gyi/'dir kun slong gnyis 'du shes yin pas de gtso bar bzhed/ rgyu mtshan mdo rtsa las/ smyo ba dang sems 'khrugs pa la ltung ba med do/zhes dang de nyid las/ shes gtso 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa nyid na'o//zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pa'i bshes spring las/ khyod kyis

gzhung 'gre// 449thugs 'dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ zhes so/ /gzhan yang dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed las/ ser sku'i bu mo bzang mo la rgyal po ma skyes dgas 'dod pa spyad par reg pa bdag gir ma byas pas ltung med du gnang ba dang / lung rnam 'byed las/ dge slong dgon pa ba gnyid log par tshogs can mas bkab pa dge slong gis bde ba bdag gir ma byas pa dang / g.yen ba na ba'i dge slong lci thun mas bkab pa bde bsabadag gir ma byas par ltung med du gnang ba sogs lung dang sleng gzhi mang pos yang dag par grub bo/ /gzhan yang dge sdig gang yin kyang sems gtso ba tshong dpon spob pa'i blo gros gyi gleng gzhi la rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i khye'u gnyis kyi gtam rgyud dang / lha'i bu la lham krad phul ba dang bsal ba gnyis ka rang sangs rgyas thob pa lta bu sogs ches mang la/ 'dir byas la ma bsags pa'i las sogs mu bzhi'i rgyas bshad 'byung yang rtsa ba'i dgongs pa lung rig de tsam gyis 'grub pa dang yi ges 'jigs pas bzhag la/ spro na rdor she mar

450 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rtogs par bya'o///bdun pa ni/ gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong gsu nga pa ni/so sor thar pa'i spang bya'i gtso bo brnab sems 'dod chags gnod sems zhe sdang log lta gti mug ste/ 'di gsum gtso bor spong dgos pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bzang byin dang mdzes dga' la bka' stsal pa/ ngas 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang/ /gti mug la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos bstan na/ci'i phyir khyod kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu byed/ ces bka' stsal ba dang / so thar mdo las/ sems rta kha glan dka' ba la/ mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi/ srab 'di so sor thar pa yin/ /zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa//brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i rigs kyi khye'u zas thob ma thob kyi dad pa dang /sems 'khrugs pa'i ngag gi 'bras bu 'phral du smin pa dang / dge

gzhung 'grel/ 454 tshul klu la sems khros nas log par smon pas lus de nyid du klur gyur pa'i dpes/ las dge sdig thams cad la yid gtso che ba kho nar nges te/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo las/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin //zhes so/ /mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad yid kyi cho 'phrul las byung ba ste/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces so / 'ga' zhig gis/ nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min/ /lus ngalha/ kailas ni skye bar 'dod/ /ces yid kyi brjod bya med la de yid gtso bo gzhir bzhag nas ma smos par lus ngag de'i yan lag tu bsams te smos srid/ de lta na 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gtso bo mi smos pa mi srid/ des na lus ngag las skye yid las mi skye zhe na/ yid dang bral ba'i bem po la sdom pa skye ba khyod kyi khyad chos srid mtha'i bar du mtshar che/ 'on te slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsa bar/shes gtso/ zhes sogs gsungs pa la cis bston/ rtsa ba yid dor

452 dgongs gcig nyin snang /nas yan lag lus ngag smos pa dper na zhing sa med pa'i myu gu dang 'bras bu lta bu ches ngo mtshar/ yid dang bral ba'i sdom pa len pa'i gang zag des/ las chog gi skabs da res 'dir bsam pa rab bskyed de sogs dang / brjod pa tha ma'i dus thob pas thob bsam pa'i bsam pa skyed cig zer ba sogs go don lus bem po dang ngag brag cha lta bu des 'dun pa de 'dra bsam shes pa mkhan po slob ma 'dul ba gsum gyi mdo ches ngo mtshar ro//brgyad pa ni/ gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong pa yang yod gsung pa ni/ mdzod las/ bslab pa phul sogs rgyu dgur gsungs pa spyir bstan nas/ bye brag tu gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba yang yod de/ lung rnam 'byed las/ bslab pa phul la ma nyams pa/ nyams la ma phul ba/ phul yang ma phul nyams kyang ma nyams pa/ phul yang phul nyams kyang nyams pa ste mu bzhi las/ tha mas gtong gzhan gsum gyis mi gtong la shi 'phos nas kyang mi gtong ba 'di la/ 'bri gung ba chen po'i dgongs pas/ tshul khrims

gzhung 'grel/ 63kyis yid kyi nyon mongs pa bsdams pas dbang po yul rjes su mi 'brang bas gang zag de'i tshul khrims kyi bag chags 'dris pa bar do dang skye ba phyi ma tshun chad du yang mi gtong ste/ rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdo las/ bzang skyong / rnam par shes pa'i khams 'di ni lus yongs su gtong nas dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rjes su 'jug ste/de'ang ji ltar zhe na rnam par shes pa'i khams gzugs can ma yin pa 'dis lus 'di bor nas sngar gyi bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dag yongs su 'dzin to/ /zhes dang/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dbang po rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur pa na/ /dpal ldan mi yi 'dzig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye bar 'gyur//sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / phal chen dang skyes rabs las/ dge dang mi dge'i las rnams goms byas na/ /mi rnams la ni 'dres pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de lta bu dag ched du ma bsgrubs kyang /

454 dgongs gcig nyin snang //srid pa gzhan la rmi lam lta bur spyod/ /ces sogs dus 'khor dang /mdo 'di'i lung gis kyang bag chags gang 'dris ba de la phyi mar yang spyod par gsungs pa dang / snying rje pad dkar las/ zhing khams dri sngo snang ba rdul bral dang / bde ba can du pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas bya ma bum dang lhang bzed snam sbyar sogs rang chas su 'ong bar gsungs pa dang / khri rkang gi gleng gzhi las/ dge slong khri la bsam gtan bsgom pa gnyid bro ba phyogs gzhan du khrus la song ba'i skabs dug sgrul tshad pas gdung ba khri'i 'og tu bsil brlan la 'khor ba ma shes nas khri'i steng du 'dug pa na dug sprul gnan pa ltar song nas khrornga/ te dge slong gi smin mtshams su so btab nas shi ba sum cu rtsa po/sdom pa'i lhar skyes pa'i tshe lha'i 'dod yon la ma chags par dge slong gi dran pa ma nyams par bshad pa sogs ma nga du gsungs so// 9)dre/ la ba snga ma rnams su dbang po rab kyis mi gtong bar bshad blo/4 da / lung don 'di rnams la dpyad na dbang po 'bring dang tha mas kyang mi gtong ba ches gsal te dbang po'i bye brag kha gsal du ma phye
