gzhung 'grel/ 455ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dag sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir/ /shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong / /zhes pa ni mdzod kyi lung de'i rjes su 'brangs mod/ 'di la dpyad de sdom pa thob kyang bsrung sems med pa dag la bag chags med pas gtong bar bden du chug bsrung sems can ni bag chags des bar dor yang dge slong gi dngos po las gzhan du mi 'gyur la/ min na bar dor bag chags kyis kha bsgyur bar bshad pa mi 'thad/ bar dor bag chags gzhan 'ong so thar gyi bag chags kho na mi 'ong ba ni mi srid pa'i phyir bshad pa de 'dra ba ni lung gi rjes kho na mtha' cig tu 'brangs nas bar dor sogs kyi nyams/ len la 'dres goms til 'bru tsam zhig kyang med par thal la/ tshe 'phos pas mi gtong ba'i gnad zab mo zab lam na rdo'i tshos drug gi bar do'i mngal dgag pa la yod mod/ ma mthong zhing nyams su ma blang ba la cha ci yod yid kyi las gsum spong bas kyang mi gtong ngo / 'di las 'phros pa paṇa chen zi lung pa'i gser thur la/ kurma pa mi bskyod zhabs kyis gnas brtan bcu drug

456 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe yang de rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi sdom pa gtong bar thal bas/ gnas brtan bcu drug sdom pa gtong ba'i tshe rgan po shākya ba yang 'khar ba 'khur nas yongs shog gsung ba yang shin tu thugs mad do// gzhan yang skabs 'dir rje lo chen gyi mchan bur/ pham pa gcig byung yang lhag ma gsum mi gtong ste/gal te gcig nyams pas gsum po gtong na bzhir phye ste gsungs pa la dgos pa med cing / gleng gzhi dga' ba can la pham pa dang po byung jigang dge slong du bzhag pa dgra bcom thob nas sor chud pas kyang shes shing / mngon pa mdzod dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur las/ kha che dag ni byung ba la/ /bu lon nor can bzhin du 'dod/ /ces so//des na mdzod lung gtong byed kyi rgyu dgu po bzhis nges par gtong /shi 'phos chos nub mtshan 'das gsum gyis phyed gtong/ bslab pa phul pa/ rtsa ltung byung bas bzhi cha re gtong / gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong ba 'di gal che'o/ /rdo rje'i gsung pham pa bzhi bu lon nor can dang 'dra zhes gsungs pa yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bshad zin pas go

gzhung 'grel/ ga57bar byos shig //dgu pa ni/ sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bus mya ngan las 'da'/ zhes pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/dge 'dun la lam grogs kyi dang ba'i sems dang ma bral na rdzogs/ byang thob pa thag mi ring / 'dun pa de nyid kho nas kyang byang chub thob na/ de'i steng du bslab gzhi'i nang tshan las sna gang rung zhig bsrung na ci'i phyir 'tshang mi rgya/ sngon 'od srung gi bstan pa la byung ba'i dge slong bslab pa nyams pa 'ga' zhig bdag cag gi ston pa'i dus rgyun zhugs nas dag bcom gyi bar thob pa las brgya pa sogs lasagasungs pa dang / snying rje pad dkar las/ nga'i bstan pa la bslab pa lhod pa chang ma'i khyim du bu'i lag pa nas bzung ste 'jug pa'ang sangs rgyas stong gi phyi ma rnams tshun la myang 'das su lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /des na mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i zhal nas/ ston pa'i ma 'dres dam pa'i chos/ dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa la/ sna gcig tsam zhig bsrungs na yang / /mya ngan 'da'

458 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bas nga re skyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dge bsnyen la/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa sogs 'dul ba'i brjod bya la rlung ltar grags so//bcu pa ni/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gcig pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir mi dge ba'i las kyi ngo bo nyid ni rang bzhin gyis bcas pa la khyab/ bcas pas rang bzhin la khyab/ dper na kham bu'i sdong po gnyis gcig bdag pos bsrungs gcig ma bsrungs kyang / ngo bo de nyid kham bu las dbye ba med pa lta bu/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa myo khyen pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel bslu med du gzigs chos thams cad kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas/ phyu dang dbang phyug byed pa po ma yin/sems can thams cad la thugs snyoms pa'i brtse ba rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / bar du brtson pa mi 'dor zhing phan bde'i lam la sbyor ba ste rgyu mtshan bzhi pos kyang gcig dge ba'i gshis kyi 'bras bu bde ba/ mi dge ba'i gshis kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal las go log mi

gzhung 'grel/ 459'byung bas kyang mi gcig ka med pa yin/ don gyi ngo bo mi dge ba bcu la rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba zer/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba mi dge ba bcu las logs su med cing rnam grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum so/gas ni lci yang dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi zlas phye ba'i phyir ngo bo mtshungs la/ lkugs 'phye'i 'khor lnga brgya dang / sangs rgyas pa'i 'khor lnga brgyas lhag pa'i yo byad bcangs pa'i gleng gzhi sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pas go sla'o//bcu gcig pa ni/ khams gsum gyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas bya ba ni/ bcas rang bzhin gcig na 'khor gyi nyan thos las 'gro ba gzhan la ma bcas so zer na min te/ ston pa la nye ring mi mnga' bas bcas pa'i tshogs thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa kho na yin te/ ston pas dang po thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ tha mar sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan las 'da' ba phan chad sems can thams cad kyi don du mdzad pa las 'khor gyi nyan thos dge slong dge tshul sogs bslab gzhi

ga60 dgongs gcig nyin snang /bcas pa de rnams kyi don kho na min te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ kun tu rgyu nyer 'tsho la/ nga ni wā ra ṭ+wāṃ ser 'gro/ grong khyer gas go ldan der song nas/ /long ba lta bu'i sems can la/ /mtshungs ji/ med pa'i 'od bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / tha na gang zag re re lung ston na yang / zhal gyi sgo nas 'od spros pas 'og min gyi bar snang bar byas nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad pa sogs ches mang la/ bcas pa bsrungs pa/'i phan yon dang 'das pa'i nyes pa ni mtho dman kun la khyad med de/ gleng gzhi me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i dpe da nga / gzhon nu ku sha dang / gzhon nu lkugs 'phye dang /legs 'ongs sogs lta bu dang / gsog 'jog la mtshon na gzhon nu chu skyes lta bu yin/ sor phreng la gdams pa'i mdo las/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'dul ba bsdus te bstan pa yin/ /zhes 'dul ba'i rtsa ba dge sgrub sdig spong las med pas na bcas pa thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa nyid do//

gzhung 'grel/ 464/bcu gnyis pa ni/ sdig pa dang ltung ba tha dad med cing gcig pa yin bya ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gcig pa'i phyir dang / bcas pa thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sdig ltung tha dad med cing gcig pa nyid grub ste/ so skyes sdig pa byas pa ngan song du 'gro/ sdom ldan gyis bslab pa nyams na dmyal bar 'gro bas khyad med de/ lung rnam 'byed du/ ltung ba re re'i mjug tu ngan song gsum du lhang zhes gsungs pas kyang 'dra/ sdom pa ma thob pas sdig pa zhes dang / thob pas ltung ba zhes ming tha dad mod/ ngo bo la khyad par dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ nyes pa che chung dang gnyen po stobs che chung sogs kyis mtshams med kyi las la'ang lci yang 'byung ba dang / ltung ba la yang yan lag rdzogs ma rdzogs kyis lci yang du bzhag pas khyad par med cing 'di go sla bas rnam bshad de tsam las ma dgos so//bcu gsum pa ni/ spyir bkag pa thams cad ye bkag gnang ba thams cad ye gnang yin gsung pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa

462 dgongs gcig nyin snang /chos thams cad kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas shing gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa shes bya'i gshis las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa des thog mar bkag pa mthar gnang / thog mar gnang ba mthar 'gog pa sogs gang zag blun po 'i spyod pa ltar mi mdzad pa nyid yin la/ dper na 'khrid mkhan gyis yang dag gi lam la sbyor ba shā ri'i bus khyi rkun rkang chag la lhag ma byin pa sems dga' ba'i mod shi ba mir skyes pa la chos bshad pas dgra bcom pa lta bu yin zhing / phyi dro'i zas bkag pa nad pa la yang zas la sred pas za na bkag la nad 'tsho sman gyi 'du shes la gnang ba yang / sred pa'i zas ni rnam pa kun tu bkag la/ca nad 'tsho'i zas ni rnam pa kun tu gnang ba'i phyir dang / shā ri'i bus btsun mo dpal ldan ma la nyi ma nub par chos bstan pa ltung med ni/ gnyis ku'i sems la chos ldan las nyon mongs med pa dang / las chos bstan pa dang / mthar btsun mos bden pa mthong ba'i phyir/ de yang yul bud med la'ang nyon mongs med pas chos ston cing bden pa la 'khod pa ni thog

gzhung 'grel/ 463mtha' gang du'ang ma bkag la/ nyon yid kyis bud med dang lhan cig las gsog pa ni thog mtha' kun tu ma gnang ba'i phyir dang / yang bud med chus khyer ba la sa'am bong ba'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'don par gsungs pa ni/ bud med la chags sems kyis 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu bkag la/ bong ba dang sa la 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu gnang ba'i phyir dang / 'di ni gzhan don la 'gyur phyir bud med sa bong du bsgoms nas thabs mkhas des reg par nyis med mdzad pas thabs mang ba 'i sgos theg chen du shugs kyis grub la/ bud med la chags sems kyis 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu reg pa bas blta ba yang bkag nas/ chags sems med na sa bong du bsgom nas reg pas nyes med dang / chags sems med pa'i gzhan don lhag bsam gyis dus tshod las 'das pa'i chos bstan pa ltung med du bzhag pa sogs kyis ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'ang yang dag par grub bo// gzhan yang 'phags pa legs 'ongs la chang gi bcas pa dang mo'u ci'agal gyi bu dang ma 'gags pa sogs la bud med dang lhan

464 dgongs gcig nyin snang /cig gnas gcig tu nyal ba'i bcas pa mdzad pa la/ gong ma ni dud 'gro'i rgyud la yod kyang gnang la/ des na las dang po la bkag phyis gnang ba min te/ las kyi cho ga'i gdams ngag brjod pa'i skabs de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pas gang la bslabs pa de la bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pas kyang bslab par bya'o/ /bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pas gang la bslabs pa de la de ring bsnyen —par rdzogs pas kyang bslab par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /sems smyo ba dang 'khrug pa'i ltung ba nyes med du bzhag pa yang skabs gcig po der yin gyi rnam pa kun tu min no/ / skabs 'dir gzhan dag dkar nag zang thal zhes bya ba'i/ /chos skad ngo mtshar che bar grags/ /de dag gis ni drang don la/ /nges pa'i don du 'khrul par snang / /zhes pa la brtags na/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po ni/ rnam pa kun tu mi dge ba'i las 'bras sdug bsngal ba dang/ dge ba'i las 'bras bde 'gro'i go 'phang du 'gyur ba sogs las gzhan pa'i go log mi 'byung bar dgongs mod/ khong dag rgyu 'bras de 'dra ba drang don du

gzhung 'grel/ 465 bzhed na/ mi dge ba spyad na bde 'gro dang / dge bas ngan song du 'gro ba khong bas nges don gyi bzhed par yod pa khong rang gi tshig des gsal por grub pas mtshar che'o/ yang khong dag ded dpon snying rje chen po yis/ tshong dpon g.yon can bsad pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/des na dgongs pa shes dgos so/ /zhes rgyas bshad dang bcas gsungs mod/ 'di yang dpyad kyi/ ded dpon des tshong pa g.yon can bsad pa'i las mang po ded dpon gyis nyams su myong ba'i mthar sangs rgyas nas kyang seng sdeng tsher ma zug pa sogs ni gdul bya la tshul bstan yin gyi don dam min/ sangs rgyas ni stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i longs sku de yin/ shāka thub ni de'i sprul sku yin/ de rang rgyud min sprul sku yin pas tshul ston tsam las dngos su sangs rgyas kyis las de myong na longs skus myong dgos pas de mi srid/ sgyu ma'i sprul pas sdug bsngal myong ba ni sgyu ma mkhan gyis myong gi sprul pa la mi 'byung zhes 'dod mod/ de yang rnam par 'khyams te/ ji skad du/ skabs der ston pas/ gang du gnas kyang las kyis

66 dgongs gcig nyin snang / mi brdzi ba'i/ /sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /zhes sogs 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rgyu 'bras las gzhan bstan pre cici yod/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ston pa sprul sku la smin pa'i las de tshul ston drang don/ gzhan rnams gyis las myong ba nges don rtag brtan zhig tu 'gyur mod/ mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs//blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas/ /de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /zhes drang ba'i don du thams cad med bzhin du snang la/ nges pa'i don du chos thams cad ngo bo nyid spros pa'i mtha' las 'das par gsungs pa ma thos sam/ yang khong dag gis/ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun pa min//nyan thos dang ni theg chen gyi/ /gnang bkag thams cad gcig tu med/ /des na la lar gnang ba ni/ /la la'i bkag pa nyid du 'gyur //zer mod de/ dpyad kyi/ 'dul bar bkag pa byang sems su gnang ba med mod/ gnang na sdom pa gnyis 'gal khyab tu 'gyur te/

gzhung 'grel/ 467dper na rdo rje spun la khros na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung gsum pa dang /sems can la byams pa spangs pas bzhi pa/ byang sems kyi sems can la 'tshe ba dang / so thar gyi dge sbyong gi chos bzhi las nyams pa'i phyir dang / de'i steng du bde gshegs bka' 'das kyang 'byung ba'i dpes khyod kyi 'dod pa rnam par 'khyams so/ /yang khong dganyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la/ /'dul ba mi 'dra rnam bzhi yod/ /ces dang / de las gyes pa bco brgyad la/ 'dul ba'i dbye ba'ang bco brgyad yod/ ces pa nas/ mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan/ zhes bstan bcos mnas blus pa'i rgyas bshad dang bcas 'byung mod/rigs pa ma yin te/ skabs 'dir 'dul ba mi 'dra ba bzhi dang bco brgyad du khas blangs/ snga rol gyi bstan bcos gyi mgor/ nyan tho sa rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas/ /dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yin/ /shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong / /sdom pa rnams kyi 'bras bu sno/ /shi ba'i tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min/ /lus ngag las ni skye bar 'dod/ /sdom

ga68 dgongs gcig nyin snang / pa gzugs tsun yin pa'i phyir/ /shi rbe'i tshe na sdom pa gtong / /zhes nyan thos zhes spyi tshig dang / sdom pa rnams kyi zhes mang tshig sogs sbyar nas nyan thos so thar gyi sdom pa yin no cog skyabs 'gro nas dge slong gi bar ji srid 'tsho ba pa/ shi nas gtong ba/ 'bras bu shi nas gzod thob pa/ gzugs rnam rig min pa/ rten lus ngag las skye ba sogs thams cad mtshungs par khas blangs pa dang / skabs 'dir 'dul ba mi 'dra bco brgyad yod pa tha na byin len tshun mi 'dra ba so sor yod ces 'gal ba ltag sprod 'di yang mtshar che/yang khong gis/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ltung ba thams cad spyod phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar yang ye bkag ye gnang la rgol bar sems kyang lugs de ni ye bkag ye gnang gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa ste/ rgyu mtshan longs sku rnams dbu skra rgyan cha sogs dang / grub thob rnams kyi cha lugs dang / spos ngad ldan pa'i dge slong rgyan gos dkar po can la sogs ni ye nas de ltar gnang bas de ltar grub cing / bye smra ba'i 'dul ba la rtags cha

gzhung 'grel/ 469lugs sogs ye nas 'di ltar gnang bas kyang ye gnang / longs sku sogs theg chen gyi chos la de 'dra ba'i rtags cha lugs bkag pas ye bkag tu grub mod/ khyod kyis ye bkag sogs dgag pa ltar byas nas bsgrubs pa ni ngo mtshar ro/ /yang kho dag bu mo gser mchog 'od ldan gyis/ /blo gros chen po 'jam dpal la/ /rab tu byung bar zhus pa'i tshe/ /lus kyi rab byung bkag nas kyang // sems kyi rab byung thob par mdzad/ /ces bris/ sngar sdom pa lus ngag las skye yid mi gtso bar bshad mod/ 'di gnyis kyi 'gal ba gang gis bsdum/ sh+lau ka 'di ni 'bri gung pa chen po'i ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba dang / gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong dgos pa'i gsal byed rnam dag tu 'dug pas rjes su yi rang ngo / gzhan yang khong dag gi legs bshad du de 'dra ba'i 'gal ba ltag sprod dang / gzhan dgag pa'i tshig ltar bris na yang tshig don la dpyad tshe dgag bya de nyid bsgrub pa'i legs bshad dpyis phyin pa mgo skyes kyi grangs las kyang ches mang ba zhig 'dug na'ang / yi ges ngal ba'i khur ma theg

70 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pas re zhig spros pa de tsam gyis chog go///bcu bzhi pa ni/ 'gro drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon 'byung bya ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pas bcas pa'i bslab gzhi rnams 'gro ba rigs drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon 'byung ba ste/rdza mkhan dga' spyod rang gi lag gis sa brko ba spangs pa dang / kā shi'i nags su sems can chen po bzhis gtan khrims bsrungs pas kā shi'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la bde legs byung ba sogs ches mang zhing / mdor bsdu na/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar pa yang / tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus las/ /sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang / /lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya/ /de ltar sdig pa'i chos las rnam phrol khabs/ /bde bar gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos//dag cing grol ba dang ni ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes khyim pas kyang rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang las kyi cho ga dor nas khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrungs na phan yon ches che bar gsung mod/

gzhung 'grel/ 7 gzhan dag na re/ kha gcig rab tu byung ba la/ /ltung ba ji snyed 'byung ba de/ /khyim pa nas ni dmyal ba'i bar/ /zhes pa nas/ mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan/ /zhes pa'i bar rnams dpung bzang gi lung 'di dang ches 'gal lo// /bco lnga ba ni/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das kyang nyes pa 'byung bya ba ni/ rdor gsung snga ma de nyid kyi phyir/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das kyang nyes pa 'byung ste/ lung dang gzhag pa las/ bskal pa dang po la ma 31sa pa'i 'bras sā lu gsog 'jog gis 'grib pa dang phyi rol pa'i drang srong lnga brgyas yo byad lhag po bcangs pas mngon shes lnga ma thob pa dang / glang ri khu yur la mi snyan pa brjod pas khyim bdag gis rgyal shor ba sogs ches mang zhing / brjod ma thag pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi lung rig rnams kyis kyang 'di nyid grub pa'o//bcu drug pa ni/ bstan pa la cho ga lhag par gal che bar bzhed pa ni ltung ba la 'du shes gtso ba dang / yid kyi gsum spong

472 dgongs gcig nyin snang / ba dang / bcas rang bzhin gcig pa sogs kyis cho ga med par bsrungs kyang chog go snyam na chog mod/ 'on te bstan pa la 'jug na cho ga ches gal che ba yin te/ lung las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /mkhan po slob dpon bsnyen rdzogs 'dod/ /yo byad yongs su dag pa dang / /gsol dang las ni mngon sum mo/ /zhes mngon gyur bcu nges par dgos par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang cho ga yod med kyis bstan pa yod med du 'jog pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus par gsungs pa dang / lung las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas cho ga phun sum tshogs pa la brten par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang / cho ga'i phyag bzhes kyi blang dor shes pa dang / sku gzugs mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i mdun du khas blangs pas ngo tsha khrel yod shes pa sogs rgyu mtshan mang zhing bcom ldan 'das kyis ston pa so thar la chol paṃ/sungs pa dang / nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes/ /shes gsungs pa dang / rje ba rnam pa gsum sogs kyis

gzhung 'grel/ 173nan tan tu sdom pas bsam pa rnam dag bar/nga sems g.yel med du 'byung ba sogs dgos pa ches mang zhing / gzhan yang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bdud sdig can 'ching ba grol ba'i phyir sems bskyed tshul sogs gleng gzhis kyang gsal lo/ / don 'di lta bu gsal bar mgon po 'khri gung pa chen pos gsungs bzhin du/'dul 'dzin mkhan por rlom pa 'ga' zhig mngon gyur bcu la snang chung du 'jog cing dge 'dun yang bcu phrag sogs tshogs su ma long yang rang gis go chod po byed cing gsol bzhi'i las sogs so thar gyi lag len zhib tu mi byed par 'ol tshod spyi brtol gyi mkhan po gan sa brtan zhes pa'i ming thob pa gtso bor byed cing so thar gyi sdom pa sbyin no zhes pa'i —mkhan po dang /— de 'dra ba la sdom pa tho ba bo zhes bsrung mi dgos pa'i thob ming la sems pa'i mkhan bu rnams ni rnam par nyams so/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ mi shes pa gti mug lhag par nyis pa che bya ba ni/ spyir 'khor bar 'khor ba ni nyes pa ma rig pa kho na

74 dgongs gcig nyin snang /yin la ma rig pa ni dngos po sogs ma mthong ba la mi zer/ gti mug pa la zer ba yin/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams ma rig pa las skye ba yin/ des na 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa ma rig pa yin te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig la sa byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes so/ gzhan yang nye bar 'khor la/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags ni nyis pa chung la 'bral dka'/ zhe sdang ni nyes pa che la 'bral sla/ gti mug ni nyes pa'ang che la 'bral yang dka'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di'i khongs su rdo rje'i gsung / dud 'gro gti mug che bas lhag par dman bya ba yang 'du ste/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi sems can rnams ni shes pa shin tu gsal bas snga ma'i las gang gis 'di 'dra bar skyes snyam pa'i 'gyod pa dang sdug bsngal 'byung zhing phyis mi byed snyam pa'i dran shes kyang 'byung ba la de 'dra ba'i 'gyod pa dang dran shes ni stobs bzhi'i ya gyal gnyis po yin pas sdig pa 'dag pa'i thabs

gzhunga'agrel/ 475 khyad par can yin la/ dud 'gro ni de 'dra bar skyes kyang glen rmugs kyis slar gcig la gcig za ba sogs nag po'i phyogs 'ba' zhig byed cing / de la der 'du mi shes pa sogs kyis shin tu dman te/mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal bar skyes pa ni bla'i/du 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas dmyal ba dang yi dwags ni de nas 'phos te bde 'gro'am las de sdag bsngal che bas zad mur bas mtho ris su skye la/ dad 'gro ni ༄ ༄ 7 sdulus des bsags pa slar ngan 'gra gzhan gnyis su 'ga'am dud 'gror slar skye ba sogs 'bras bu myong dgos pas shin tu sdug bsngal yun ring ngo //bco brgyad pa ni/ nyams pa'i nyes pa bas ma thob pa nyes pa lci zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngar thob nas nyams kyang 'gyod sems kyang 'byung bas yang la thob pa'i dus dang dzi tsam bsrungs pa'i phan yon chud mi za ba yin la/ ma thob pas ni nyes pa la nyes par ma mthong ba'i steng / nga dgo slong lta bu ni min pas 'di lta bu spyad

476 dgongs gcig nyin snang / byar 'os so snyam pa'i 'dun pa dran shes dang bcas spyad pas sdig pa ches ma thob pa lci ste/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ mi shes sdig pa byas pa shin tu lci/ /mkhas pas sdig pa byas pa yang bar 'gyur/ lcags kyi gong bu chung yang gting du 'gro/ de nyid snod byas che yang kha la 'phyo//zhes gsungs shing gzhan yang gcung mdzes dga' bo/ sor phreng can /ma skyes dgra bde byed sogs lta bu dang / pha ma bsad pa'i dge slong lta bu 'byung ba ni sngon gyi gleng gzhis kyang shes la/ bshes spring las/gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa na/ /zla ba sgren bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes dang / rab tu byung ba'i gzhi las/ gang zhig snga nas bag med pa/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan gyur na//nyi zla sprin nas byung chib ltar/ /'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur//zhes dang / sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo la sa/ me tog tsam pa ka ni rnyings gyur kyang / /me tog phal pa gzhan gyi do zla min/ /dge slong tshul khrims nyams shing sdig spyod kyang / /mu stegs byed dag

gzhung 'grel/ 77gzhan gyis do zla min/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ tshangs pa chen po de ltar tshul khrims nyams shing sdig pa byed pa'i dge slong de ngas bstan pa'i 'dul ba la mi ro lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngar rab tu byung ba dang tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i yon tan lhag pa'i mthu yod do/ /dper na khyu mchog dang gla ba lta bu shi ste rnam par shes pa dang bral na byol song gi nang na ro yin mod kyi/ khyu mchog la 'gi'u wam yod pa dang / gla ba la gla rtsi yod pa des sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don chen por 'gyur ba bzhin tu/ tshul khrims nyams pa'i dge slong ro lta bu yin kyang /dper na rab tu byung ba dang tshul khrims kyi yon tan lhag pa'i mthus rang dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang gnas pa'i grong gi bshan pa dang smad 'tshong mas yan lag brgyad pa dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs te mtshan mo dang nyin mo re mos kyi bsrungs pas de'i 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal res 'jog tu smin par gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi lung

178 dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ gzhi na bshad pa lta bu ches mang ngo / /'phags pa gager 'od dam pa las/ gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig bgyis pa/ /lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na 'di rnams mdor bsdu na phyogs lngar yang 'du ste/ 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa dang / bcas rang bzhin gcig sdig ltung gcig pa rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi la khyab phyogs/ 'gro drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon 'byung la/gang gis nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung ba dang / ye bkag ye gnang rnams/ blangs dang ma blangs 'bras bu mnyam phyogs/ gang gis 'das kyang nyes pa che ba sogs bslab pa bral ba nyes pa che phyogs/sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu myang 'das thob pa sogs lan gcig blangs pa phan yon che phyogs/ nyams las ma thob nyes pa che ba dang / mi shes pa gti mug nyes pa che ba sogs nyams las ma thob nyes pa che phyogs te phyogs lngar 'du/ rdor gsung gzhan rnams ni de rnams kyi gsal byed du 'gyur bas phyogs lngar 'dus pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang mu bzhi sogs kyi rnam par bshad pa mtha' yas pa skabs thob so sor spro na yang mang bas 'jigs te de tsam gyis chog par zad do/ /zhes 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don gsum pa'o//

480 dgongs gcig nyin snang / 4 /spyi don bzhi pa bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung nyer bzhi mchis pa las//dang po ni/ snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems tha dad pa yin zhes gsung pa ni/ snying rje zhes pa pha rol po ma nus pa sogs la rang bzhin gyis snying brtse ba'i sems dung ba de la zer/ byang chub sems zhes pa ni rgyu tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po gnyis las skyes pa ste/ de yang rnam shes byang ba dang ye shes chub pa zhes pa 'i go don thob ste/ rgyu mtshan byang bya rnam shes kyang / rnam byang dang po'i skabs su dbang shes lnga/ gnyis pa'i skabs su drug yid/ gsum par nyon yid/ bzhi par kun gzhi rnam smin gyi cha/ lnga par kun gzhi sa bon gyi cha yin la/ chub bya ye shes la yang lam dang 'bras bu gnyis su dbyer rigs te/ lam gyi ye shes slob pa'i skabs su rjes mthun

tha/༷kying9)grekhag/ 1(30/—dang / mi slob pa'i skabs su mtshan nyid pa yin la/ 'bras bu'i ye shes mthar thug pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sogs lnga me+e na no/snying rje la gnyis gang la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i yul gang zag dri lta bu zhe na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rtag tu sems can phan par sems//chos la mos dang de bzhin de'i/ /ye shes 'tshol bar 0migs pa'o //zhes so / /gang zag la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i yul gang zag dzi lta ngu/ zhe na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song / / sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs/ /bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs/ /'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan// zas can dug dang 'dre sa la zhen/ /lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa/ /lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i/ /sems can rnams la snying rje'o/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang / /log par mngon par zhen pa snying rje'o/ zhes gsungs so/ de 'dra ba'i sems can la snying brtse ba ni gang zag la dmigs pa dang /

na82 dgongs gcig nyin snang /de rnams kyi las dge sdig gi blang dor la rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal ba bsam pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o/ de 'dra ba'i snying rje gnyis pos kun nas bslangs te gzhan don gyi sems bskyed rgya chen po dang ldan pa ni byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces so// byang sems skye ba'i rgyu dngos ni bzhi ste /skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa dang / tshad med bzhi la blo sbyangs pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang / rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang bzhi po yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen bkur byas/ /de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon byas pa/ /'di nyan pa yi snod yin no/ /zhes so// des na snying rje ni byang sems kyi rgyu yin la dngos min/ sngon mu stegs byed bcu ri bo gangs can du phyin pas dgu rlung gis shi/ gcig lus pa brgya byin

gzhung 'grel/ 483gyis bgam pa'i phyir/ dar gyi khri stan nang tshang can rlung gis grang ba las skyob pa'i steng du khyi rgan nyam chung zhig sprul/ brgya byin mir byas nas/ de la khyi de bor la khri'i steng du sdod dang mi 'chi'o byas pas bdag lhag pas shi ba ni bla'i/ khyi 'di shi ba ni de lta ma yin no/ zhes pa sogs mu stegs byed la'ang snying rje de 'dra ba yod pa dang / nang pa la'ang nyan rang la snying rje chen po yod kyang gzhan don gyi sems bskyed med pa'i phyir slar theg chen du sems bskyed dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces so ///de ltar na snying rje phyi nang dang theg pa che chung thams cad thun mong du yod la/ byang sems ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/snying rje byang sems kyi rgyu yin kyang dngos min/ de las de skye ba'i phyir myu gu dang 'bras bu bzhin no//gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa rten can du bzhed pa ni so thar gyi sdom pa gang rung ni byang sdom

484 dgongs gcig nyin snang /skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / bogs 'don pa'i rten yin te/ rgyu mtshan so thar casdom pa gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas las ldog pa dge sgrub sdig spong gi nyams len byed pa de ni smon pa byang sems kyi rten dang / 'jug sdom gyi ngo bo sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis mi dge ba spong /dge ba chos sdud kyis dge ba sgrub/ sems can don byed kyis gzhan don mthu ldan du 'gyur ro/ /des na sngags sdom skye ba dang gnas pa dang bogs 'don par yang 'gro/ so thar sdom pa'i rten gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med rab tu byung bar bshad mod/ 'gro ba gzhan la mi skye bar ma nges te/ mdzangs blun la ston pa gzi brjid yon tan gyi bstan pa la klu'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa ba srungs/ pa dang / 'dul lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis klu rgyal sog ma med btul ba'i tshe srog gcod ma gtogs gzhan gsum khas blangs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang grogs mkhar gnyis/ kyis skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi lnga blangs pa dang /rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin lnga la rang gi sha khrag byin

gzhung 'grel/ 485 nas/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phogs pa sogs mang du gsungs bas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so//gzhan dag na re/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ /dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes sogs nas 'bras nas kyi sa bon la dpe bzhag dbu ma'i sems bskyed kun la skye/ sems tsam su thod thod la mi skye ba sogs bshad mod/ rnam par 'khyams te/ de gnyis ka rten can yin/ rgyu mtshan skyabs 'gro sogs rgyu'i gtso bo bzhi po gnyis ka la tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ khyod ltar na sems tsam la rgyu bzhi po dgos/ dbu ma la gang yang med par sems bskyed pas chog par thal lo/ /jo bos/ so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi/ rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom/ pa yi/skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min/ zhes pa rdzo bo sems tsam pa yiyi ji pas de ltar gsungs so zer mod/ dbu ma la mi dgos snyam na/ daspru oṃ rtusems bskyed kyi sngon du skyabs 'gro dgos sam/ mi/ dgos// dadornga/ snya so thar sdom pa'i rtsa ba skyabs 'gro las ci yod/ mi dgos na skyabs

—186 dgongs gcig nyin snang /su ma song ba'i sems bskyed de ya mtshan no/ /yang gzhan dag don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi//cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di 'dra cir 'gyur brtags dgos so/ zhes pa'i bar rgyas par bshad mod/ dpyad nas smra'o/ /don dam sems bskyed ces pa khyod kyis gang du sems/cho ga dang dam bca' sogs kyi dbye ba'ang mang du bris snang ba sna ga shog gron no/ /zag med kyi sdom pa las gzhan pa'i don dam sems bskyed gang du yod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa'i dus tshig tsam gyis ngo sprod de khyod rang gi lam 'bras la yang med dam/ ye shes 'di ni sogs gang du 'jog sems bskyed pa'i tshe don dam cho gar ma zad gaXgs su ma bsgoms sam/ kun rdzob zla ba dang don dam rdo rje'i gzugs su bsgom pa khyod kyis dgyes rdor gyi dbang gi dus ma byas sam/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi khyad par ro zer na bden mod/ 'on kyang don dam byang sems la cho ga mi 'thad pa'o ska bas khyod rang gis mdo sngags kyi dbye ba zur tsam yang ma phyed mod/ yang khong dag

gzhung 'grel/ 8 7/mdor na sems kyi 'phen pa las/ /gzhan pa'i dge sdig yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'ang ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'i phyogs su ma thal lam/ yang khong dag rmi lam gyi ni rjes 'brangs nas/sems can kun la sems bskyed byed/ /ces pa nas/ lung de sangs rgyas bstan pa min/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / phyi nas phag mo'i byin rlabs dang / /sems bskyed rmi lam ma la sogs/ /yi dam bsgom pa dkrong bskyed dang / /dkar po chig thub la sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi/ /chos log du ma deng sang 'phel/ /zhes sogs rgyu dus kyi kun slong gnyis rdzogs pa'i log shes mang du ṣ+ṭṛ/sa mod/ brtags shing dpyad de gzhan rnams gsang sngags tshoms sogs skabs thob tu sun 'byin la/ 'dir rmi lam du byung ba zhes/ yang yang smra ba mgon po 'khri gung pa chen po'i thugs bskyed chen mor grags pa sogs 'ga' zhig la sdang ngo/ /de la 'di ltar yang kham / ñtsa /0pa dbu se kum po gnas su bsgom du bzhugs tshe dbus gtsang gi mi byung ba rnams la dbus gtsang dus e bde dris pas ma bde zer/ ci

488 dgongs gcig nyin snang /nyes dres pas/ 'bri gung pa dang / zhang tshal pa 'khrugs zer/ de gnyis sdum khong min pa gzhan gyis mi 'ong bar dgongs yar phebs myos thog mar bla ma zhang gi sar byon pas/ bla ma zhang gis dmag gi khrod dang / chos ra dang / gzims chung gsum du sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan/ thugs ches te 'khri gung du byon pa'i lam du 'jig rten bsum mgon gar bzhugs dris pas/ dbyar gnas la bzhugs zhes thos/ yar byon pas 'jig rten mgon pos tshogs kyi ser sgreng dang bcas dbu se bsur phebs pas ston pa sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi cho ga sa kyis bskor bar dbu ses gzigs/ slar yol ba 'gag tu spyan snga brgyad dang 'bri gung pa nyid ston pa nyan thos mchog brgyad kyis brdo ༷ra bar gzigs/ slar phebs pas nang du khri steng na 'jig rten mgan po pa/zhugs spyan snga grags 'byung dang / sher 'byung gnyis g.yas g.yon du sgreng ba ston pa dang shā ri'i bu mo'ugal bu gsum du gzigs/ bla cha/ 'di gnyis la log pa'i chos mi mnga' bar thag chod/ g.yul du shi ba rnams ci 'drar dgongs 'od gsal gyis

gzhung 'grel/ 489gzigs pas/ g.yul du dbugs dang bral ma thag bar do med par bde 'gror 'gro ba gzigs/ ya mtshan te de'i rgyu ci yin 'jig rten mgon po ya zhus pas/ nga'i sems bskyed yid bzhin nor bu 'di'i mthu yin gsung/ shin tu dad de zhus pes gnang / da lta rnam thar du dbu se dang nyag se zhes dbu se 'ong ba yang don de yin/ zhes pa ni mgom po 'bri gung pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar can gyi gtam so bdun zhes grags pa'i gcig 'di yin no/ des na chos la chos su mos pa rnams la sems bskyed 'di nyid ches ngo mtshar bar nyi zla ltar grags mod/ 'on kyang rtog ge tha snyad la goms pas don la gol ba rnams log par rtog pa ni ches blo med do/ /gsum pa ni/ so so skye bo la yang 'jug pa skye bar bzhed pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ji snyed pa rnams slob dpon thogs med kyis byang sar brdzus/ de zhi ba lhas bslab btus dang spyod 'jug tu bsdus/ bslab btus slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍa go mis sdom pa nyi shu par bsdus pa yin la/ de'i nang nas mjug sdom la bslab

490 dgongs gcig nyin snang / bya bzhi bcu rtsa drug tu byas pa rnams sa dang po thob nas 'byung ba mi srid pas/ mthong spang brgya bcu rtsa gnyis spangs bas 'jig tshogs su lta ba med pa'i phyir dang / nyes pa che chung gi sdom pa slar len pa dang bshags yul mang nyung bshad pa'ang so skye la dgongs/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ sor ma chud pa la'ang 'jug pa skye zhes gsungs/gzhan yang nam mkha'i snying po'i mdor byang sems kyi ltung ba rgyal blon 'bangs rnams la 'byung ba rten gyi sgo nas bco brgyad dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas bcu bzhir gsungs pa yang so skye la dgongs pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di go sla zhing deng sang mjug sdom so skye la mi skye ba khas len pa nyung bas de tsam gyis chog go//bzhi pa ni/ ci rigs kyis tshul khrims kyi sdom par 'gyur bya ba ni/ sdom gsum mtha' dag nyes med du rdzogs pa ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig spyod yul yin/ byang chub sems dpas kyang mi 'ong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma rnams sa bcu pa kho na yin kyang so so rang nyid kyis nyams su blangs tshul re re

gzhung 'grel/ 49gabastan nas gzhan rnams shes par nus re kun zhes gsungs/ rdor gsung 'dir tshul khrims kyis gsung pa gzhan du 'jug sdom du 'gyur zhes smos pa ste/ 'jug sems brtan po zhig yod na bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ste/ zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug tu/ gang nas brtsams te sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mi bzlog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur na/ /deng nas bzung ste gnyis log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung / /zhes dang / tshong dpon mes sbyin bu dang chung mar bcas pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob kyang srog gcod spong ba kho na khas blangs pa lta bu dang / dpal dbyig gis zhus pa las/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la sems bskyed pas mi dge ba bcu spong / de ma nus na bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bsrung / de ma nus na'ang gcig bsrung / de ma nus na'ang nam zhig na bsrung ngo snyam du dam bca'/ zhes so/ tha na phyag gcig 'tshal phyo'ang 'jug sdom gyi

492 dgongs gcig nyin snang /tshul khrims su 'gyur te/ dwangs ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba dge ba chos sdud/ phyag de gzhan don du 'tshal ba sems can don byed/phyag 'tshal bar le lo 'dor zhing lus ngag yid gsum bag dang bcas 'bad pas 'tshal ba sdom pa'i tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum ga nges par tshang ba yin/ de lta min pa'i dge ba'i las 'ga' zhig la tshang 'ga' zhig la ma tshang ba'i tshul khrims gsum zhig byung na ngo mi mtshar ro/ /gzhan yang gzhan don sogs dngos kyis mi nus kyang bsam pas bya ba ni byang sems dang / sngags su sbyin pa bzhi sbyin pa dngos kyi mthu med des na bsam pas bya ba dang 'dra bas de ltar mos na bsam pa rgya chen po de nar son nas yar ngo ltar dkar po'i chos thams cad rgyun shugs mi chad cing mthar dngos su 'grub ste/ ji skad du/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang //de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya/ /gang la de yi blo yod pa/ /de yi rgyu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //lnga pa ni/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i ltung ba med

gzhung 'grel/ 493par bzhed pa ni/ nyon mongs pa can gyi ltung ba dang / ltung ba med pa gnyis su thag bcad pas/ de gnyis kyi bar skabs su nyon mongs ma yin pa'i ltung ba bya ba mi srid/ 'khor 'das gnyis su thag bcad pas de gnyis kyi bar du chos gzhan med pa dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ltung ba ni pham pa nas nyes byas kyi bar nyon mongs pa can ma gtogs nyon mongs min pa mi srid la/ brjed ngas sogs kyang nye ba'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i rgyud las/ mi shes pa dang bag med pa/ /ma gus pa dang nyon mongs pa/ /brjod ngas dran pa mi gsal ba/ /'di drug dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /zhes so/brjed ngas kyis nyams pa ni ches lci ste/ ji skad du/ khams gsum sems can thams cad bsad pa bas/ dran pa nyams par gyur ba sdig pa che/ /brjod ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/brjod ngas blo la 'od dpag med la sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ /ces so/ /der ma zad ku re dang bzhad

194 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gad tsam gyis kyang nyams te/ 'dul ba las/ bzhad gad kyi dngos pos ni gang du'ang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ kha cig na re/ ltung ba'i rnam bzhag mu bzhir gsung / /ljung med ltung dang ltung ba yi//gzugs brnyan ltung ba med pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan zhes pa rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes pa nas/ dge sdig rnam gzhag de ltar gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar yang zhi ba lha'i lung dang bcas byung mod kyang / ltung med dang ltung ba gnyis mthun/ dge sems kyis bsad pa ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan dang / gzhan la gnod na rdzun min kyang ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan zhes pa'ang mkhas 'dod las 'bras bu med de/ dge sems kyis bsad pa kun slong dge ba/ sbyor ba mi dge ba/ gzhan la gnod pa mi dge ba/ rdzun min pa dge ba yin pas so sor bkral na snga ma'i khongs su 'dus/ zhi ba lha'i lung gi sems gtso ba ni ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'i dgongs pa yin pas de yang rnam par ma brtags pa'i legs bshad do/ //drug pa ni/ nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba gnang ba

gzhung 'grel/ 195med bya ba ni/ rgyu 'bras gshis sam babs kyi rten 'brel de lta bu nyes med du gnang ba ma yin/ byang sems rang bde dor nas gzhan don la sdig pa'i rnam smin sdug bsngal bzod nus pa'i ngor ma bkag pa ste/ de 'dra ba nyon mongs dug gsum gyi mi dge ba yin mod/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi thabs kyis zin mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba spyod pa ni nyes par mi 'gyur bas spyod pa yin la/ bdag nyid yal bar dor nas gzhan don la brtson pas las de'i 'bras bu nyams su myong yang bzod pa'i go cha dang ldan pa'ibyang sems spyad pa spyod nus la gnang gi byang sems sar bu la ma gnang ngo / /mgon po phag mo gru pas/ gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad pa la/ /sa dang lam la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po la/ /lus ngag mi dge bdun yang gnang/ /zhes de 'dra bzod nus pa'i byang sems sa lam thob pa la gnang ba dang / gsang chen thabs mkhas las/ byang chub sems dpa' tshogs chen rab mchog rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can

ga96 dgongs gcig nyin snang /gcig gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rnongs pa 'di lta bu 'byung zhing nongs pa byung ba des bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du sems can dmyal ba chen por gnas kyang bla'i/ sems can gcig pu de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gtong ba ni de lta ma lags so/ /zhes gsol bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la legs so zhes bka' stsal to/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang / gleng gzhi ded dpon snying rje chen pos srog bcad pas lo stong phrag mang por dmyal ba nyams su myong zhing / mthar yang seng ldeng gi tshal pa sogs mang du byung mod/ rgyal po gser mdog gis ni ma byin len du mi 'gro ste khong rang sa chen po skye dgu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bdag por smon lam gyis dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag por skyes pas thams cad mnyam skyong las rang gtsigs kyi zhe 'dod med pa'i phyir 'gro ba de rnams kyi don du bsdus pas gzhan don thabs mkhas pa'i spyod par yang 'gyur/bram ze'i khye'u skar ma ni lo bcu gnyis su bram ze mo la tshangs spyod gtang bas bskal pa nyi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil ba las/ las kyi 'bras

gzhung 'grel/ 197bu 'di ma byung na de'i sngon du khong lo khri nyis stong du tsha ngas spyod la gnas nas slar chu 'chun ma'i lo bcu gnyis gyi mdza' bo byed pa'i tshe bdag gi brtul zhugs 'di gshigs nas sems can dmyal bar song yang sdug bsngal de bzod kyi/ bud med de shi bar 'ong 'i bde bar bya'o snyam ste lo bcu gnyis 'grogs slar mngon par 5 nga ste tshangs gnas bzhi bskyed nas shi 'phos pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i mi ngage ba gnang ba min mod/ rang nyid la nyes pa byung yang bzod pa'i go bgos te gzhan de bde bar byas pa gleng gzhi'i tshig gis gsal mod/gzhan yang gleng gzhi 'di ni nyams las ma thob nyes pa che ba sogs 'dul ba'i rdor gsung 'ga' zhig gi gsal byed kyang dpyis phyin pa yin no/ //bdun pa ni/ thabs mkhas pa la mi dge ba 'ong na de'i 'bras bu 'byung bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i lam la goms shing spyod pa/ mi dge ba'i lam kun nas spongs cas/ nyid yin na

498 dgongs gcig nyin snang /de'i spyod pa thams cad thabs la mkhas pa kho nar zad kyi mi mkhas pa med la / de la mi dge ba'i sprod pa yod pa mi srid do/ /de yod na mi dge bas bdag gzhan gyi don mi nus te/ mun pas mun pa sel ba bzhin no/ /ded dpon snying rje chen pos ni rgyu dus kyi kun slong sems can de rnams kyi don yin kyang / de dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang ma bskyed na mdung bsnun mi phod pas zhe sdang bskyed pa'i rnam smin phyis byung ba de tsho yin mod/ 'dul ba las/ bram ze khye'u bla mas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la bsams nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung la/ dge sbyong mgo reg la byang chub ga la yod ces smras pas de'i 'bras bu byeng ba sogs gleng gzhi ches mang bas so/ /yum rgyas pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can dmyal ba nas bzung ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad shes par bya'o/zhes gsungs pa'i 'khor ba ni spang bya yin kyang thog mar shes nas spong dgos/ ma shes bar spang blang mi 'byung ste sman za zhing dug mi za

gzhung 'grel/ 99bar thog mar dug dang sman ngo shes dgos pa bzhin no/ ston r+yā la yang seng sdeng gi tshal pa zug pa dang / mu ge'i grong du gshegs pa dang /lhung ba zed stong pa dang / ra rod can du gzims pa sogs drang don yin pa la thams cad mthun mod/ 'on te drang don thams cad rdzu na par bltas na log lta kho na ste rgyu 'bras mi bden par don gyi /sgro/ra 'debs su 'gyur bas ha cang thal ches te gdags pa las/ med par lta ba mnar med ltung / zhes sogs gsungs pas so //brgyad pa ni/ rang gzhan brje bar nyis par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la zhugs khu / 'phags pas bdag gzhan brje ba bkag pa min mod/ skabs kyi sgras lam tshogs sbyor gnyis man chad du bsam pa'i stobs rgya chen po bskyed nas sbyor ba gzhan don gang nus spyad rang gces pa'i dus yin/mthong lam nas sa bdun pa man chad du bsam sbyor gnyis ka nar son pas bsam pa ches bskyed cing sbyor ba nus tshad spyad/ rang gzhan mnyam pa'i dus yin/ sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar du

200 dgongs gcig nyin snang / bsam sbyor gnyis ka stobs che bas gzhan don rgya chen po'ang 'grub/spyod pa rlabs che la'ang 'jug nus/ brtul zhugs kyang shin tu che/sdug bsngal bzod pa'i stobs chen po yang thob pas bsam sbyor gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu gtong ba chen po la 'jug dgos so/ rgyu mtshan shes rab chung zhing dad pa che bas bdag gzhan brjo ba'i 'dun pa 'phyes na gegs su 'gyur te/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i bsnyun nad lta bu yin/ des na sar bu rnams kyis shes rab lam gtong gi gdams pas gnad du bsnun pa gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ chos gos gsum ma gtogs pa sbyin/ /dam pa'i chos ni spyod pa'i lus/ /phran tshegs ched du gnod mi bya/ /de ltar byas na sems can gyi/ /bsam pa myur du rdzogs par 'gyur / /snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par / /lus 'di gtong bar mi bya ste/ /ci nas 'di dang gzhan du yang / /don chen sgrub pa'i rgyur gtong ngo / /zhes gsungs so//byang chub sems darnga/'a chen po rnams kyis ni/ snying rje pad dkar las/ bdag gi lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing shin tu phra ba snye/da 'byung zhing /

gzhung 'grel/ 204lus re re 'ang ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang mnyam pa'i che bar gyur nang) /lus de dag re res kyang sems can rnams kyi sdug bsnga sdo gyi tshor ba'i bye brag ji snyed pa de snyed myong bar gyur cig bdag gi dge ba'i chos ji snyed pa rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo t+pā/dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis sems can rnams ni sdug bsngal nam/ yang mi myong rtag tu bde bar gyur cig ces smon pa lta bu bya dgos rnyidaper na bdag cag gi ston pas byang chub sems dpa' sar bu'i tshe shākya thub pa chen po la 'jam gang phul nas sems bskyed la phyis stobs chen por gyur nas rgyal po zla 'od sogs dbu dang rkang lag/ btang ba yang grangs med pa de 'dra skabs thob mi shes par/ da lta bdag gzhan brjes pas nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod par gsungs pa la yang dgag la/ lag len du mgo lus lta zhog dngos po spus gtsang ba re yang ngo bsrung dang lan 'byung ba la ma gtogs/lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba gle sbyin par khab tsam yang gtong bar blo gyog gyog byed par la bltas na rdo rje'i gsung shin tu ya mtshan mod/

202 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gzhan yang sman shing skyes pa myu gu'i dus nas sems can gcig gi nad gso ba'i phyir bcad na rtsa ba med par 'gyur la/ de thabs mkhas kyis skyed bsrings na rgyas pa'i tshe sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu shun lpags sogs thams cad kyis sems can dpag tu med pa 'tsho ba'i sman du 'gyur ba ltar/ byang chub sems dpas kyang skabs thob shes shing thabs mkhas par bya dgos te nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar sman shing ljon pa lta sdug pa//rtsa ba la sogs sa bon spyad 'os rnams// byin yang dus min spyod las bsrung bya ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman shing de bzhin no//zhes so/ gleng gzhi yang sngon 'phags pa shā ri'i bu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa bskal pa mang po'i dus na/ skabs shig mi zhig gis khyod kyi mig ya gcig nga la byin zer bas mig ya gcig phyung nas mi de la byin pas/ mi des mig gi steng pū rkang pa bzhag nas bcar song ba la/ khyod de ltar byed pa ci yin dris pas/ car zer ba de la bltas pa yin zer bas/ shā —

gzhung 'grel/ 203ri'i bu yi mug ste sems can 'di rnams la'ang byed thabs mi/ 'dug snyam nas yid chad/ de dman pa'i bsam pa skyes pa'i dus su nyan thos su gyur pa lta bu yin no/ /gzhan yang byang chub sem sa dpa'i brtul zhugs chen po mi mnga' bzhin du lag len la mi kheb bar mgo lus sbyin par gtong ngo / lus mi gtsang ba 'di sbyin ji/'i bsod nams thob pa yin zer bad gam byed pa dag gis gyi/ bdab/ gzhan brje ba'i byang sems med pa'i khar sngags kyi rtsa ltung brgyad pa phog nye'o/ /yang gzhan dag na re/ kha cig brje ba'i byang chub sems//bsgom du mi rung zhes su smra/ /zhes pa nas/ des na 'di 'dra'i byang༄0chub sems/ /bsgoms pa de dag thabs mi mkhas/ nor ba chen po'i chos yin lo/ /zhes sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /chos gzhan gyi ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes pa'i bar rgya sa par bshad pas rdo rje'i gsung 'di sun 'byin par 'dod mod/mtshar che/ 'bri gung pa chen pos skabs shes dmigs phye nas gsung mod/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i chos nor ba chen po yin zhes ci ste

204 dgongs gcig nyin snang / gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa' chen pos byang chub sems kyi gnad ma go na byang chub sems dpa' ltar bcos pas gnad ci zhig rtogs/ byang sems sar bu nas chen po'i bar gyis bdag gzhan brje zhing srog gtong ba kho na lag tu blang gi bsam pas mi 'ong snyam na gong du drangs pa'i spyod 'jug dang —nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo sogs lung du ma dang gleng gzhi ches mang ba la cis bston/ yang khyod rang gis de ma thag 'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /khyad par 'ga' zhig ma gsungs pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya sa sgrub mi nus//de phyir thabs mkhas shes rab nyid/ /sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo yin/zhes smras mod/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa thabs mkhas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sar bu 'breng chen po'i bar du bsam sbyor 'dris goms dang stobs rgyas ma rgyas kyi bar du bdab gzhan brje ba yang bsam sbyor lag len rim gyis byed pas dgongs pas/ khyo da rang gi tshig des rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa de lung rig grangs med las kyang dga' bar 'grub pa ngo mtshar che'o/

ci gzhung 'gre la/ 205/de bas las dang po pas lam du gtong ba gnad che ste/ ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gleng gzhi 'dul ba lung nas gsungs pa lta bu yin no/ //dgu pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pas bde bar 'brel mi srid/ ces gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa dang / gnod pa byed pa la lhag par thugs brtso ba yin pas na/ spyod 'jug las/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten mgon pos/ phongs par gyur kyang shin tu mi gtong zhing / /gnod par gyur kyang thugs rjes bder 'brel ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ni gnod pa byas kyang brtse ba ches shin tu che bas phan 'dogs shing de'i sgrib pa sbyong ba gtso bor 'bad de mdzad pa dang / nyes byed de yang 'gyod de bshags pas bde ba'i 'bras bu smin pa yin te/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bkrongs kyang me tog zla mdzes la khro ba mi mnga' zhing /

206 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rgyal po 'gyod nas bshags shing gdung la mchod de gso sbyong blangs nas tshangs par spyad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' bkrongs pa'i rnam smin gyis dmyal bar skyes pa lta bu dang / spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i mgo la rdo brgyab pa lta bu yin/ gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /ngan sems cung zad bskyed par byed na yang / dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis / sbyin dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags pa skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir/ /mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas byang sems la gnod pa byas pas bde ba thob pa lta ci smos/ gnod pa byas pa stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa'i mthus rjes su bzung nas bde bar 'brel ba yin no///bcu pa ni/ dge mi dge'i 'bras bu so sor 'byung bya ba ni/ 'phen rdzogs la dgongs te/ 'phen byed kyang dge ba/ rdzogs

gzhung 'grel/ 207byed kyang dge ba/ dang po nas dkon mchog gsum la dad cing bar dang tha mar yang dad pa rgyal po gzugs can snying po lta bu'o/ 'phen rdzogs gnyis mi dge ba/ dkon mchog gsum la thog mtha' bar gsum du log par lta ba lhas sbyin lta bu yin/ 'phen rdzogs go log mi srid de legs skar dad nas rab tu byung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob par lung bstan/ log lta'i 'bras bu dmyal bar song ba grags che/ des mtshon nas ma skyes dgra dang / dpal sbas/dpa' bas byin sogs lta bu yang yin/ gzhan yang rab byung gi gzhi las/ rna ba bye ba ri dang / gnas pa'i grong gi bshan pa dang / smad 'tshong ma dang / sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dge 'dun lta bu yin pas 'phen rdzogs dang me chu go log mi srid pa'i lung ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par gzhag pa'i mdo sde thams cad du ches gsal la mang bar yod pas 'dir glo/ sa ma dgos la des na kun btus su yang /gnag la rnam smin gnag pa mi dge ba dang / dkar la rnam smin dkar ba khams gsum pa'i dge ba dang / dkar nag tu gyur la

208 dgongs gcig nyin snang / 'bras bu dkar nag tu gyur pa'i 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i 'dres ma ste/bsam pa nag la sbyor bas dkar ba dang / sbyor ba nag la bsam pas dkar ba dang / mi nag cing dkar la rnam smin du mi 'gyur zhing las zad par 'gyur ba sbyor ba dang / bar chad med pa'i lam rnams la zag pa med pa'i las su gsungs pa'i bsam sbyor dkar nag bstan pa 'dis kyang las dang rnam smin dkar nag 'chol ba bstan par mi snang mod/ 'ga' zhig na re/ gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs/ 'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las// de dag dbye ba mu bzhir yod/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed kyang ni de nyid dang / zhes pa nas/ gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar gyi 'phen rdzogs gnyis ka dge ba dang /gnyis ka mi dge bar las kyang bde sdug gnyis po 'byung bar mthun mod/ 'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed mi dge ba dang / 'phen byed mi dge la rdzogs byed dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin go log 'byung ba mi srid mod/ mdo mangs rnams nas gcig tu dkar ba la 'bras bu

gzhung 'grel/ 209bde ba/ gcig tu gnag pa la 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ 'dres ma'i las las 'bras bu yang 'dres mar 'byung zhes gsungs pa'i snga ma gnyis go sla/ phyi ma ni dkar pa'i las las 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang / nag po las bde ba 'byung bar dgongs pa min mod/ dge sdig 'dres mar bsags pa las 'bras bu yang bde sdug 'dre mar 'byung bar gsungs la/ de yang dpyad na dkar nag zang thal las gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ khyod 'dod pa'i las gnag rnam smin dkar ba sogs 'byung na/ sems can thams cad byang chub thob pa'i don du pha ma bsad na dge 'bras 'byung mi srid mod/ de bas chos lugs ya mtshan can de 'dra ba rnam par 'khyams so/ / /bcu gcig pa ni/ brjed pa'i rgyu las byang chub sems 'chor mi srid ces pa ni/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ li tsā bi dri ma med pa'i gzi brjod sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi bstan pa la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nag po'i chos slad pas bang chub kyi sems bskyed brjod kyang ston pas byang

240 dgongs gcig nyin snang /chub tu lung bstan pa dang / gzhan yang dkon brtsegs dang / sdong brgyan las kyang brjod pa'i rgyus byang chub sems mi 'chor bar mthun par gsungs te/ dmigs pa'i sangs rgyas de bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pa dang / sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa 'khor ba'i bde skyed kyis zad par mi nus pa dang / sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa'i chos can du yod pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya dge ba'i las ci rigs kyis kyang 'jug sdom du 'gyur ba ste/ gnad bzhi po 'dis kyang byang sems 'chor mi srid de/ rdo rje pha lam lta bu'i byang sems 'di lug rwa lta bu'i log rtog gos ma bcom na/ rdo rje pha lam de ltor song yang pho ba'i mes mi 'ju bar phyir myur du 'ong ba dang 'dra bar byang sems kyang brjod pa'i rgyu las rtsa ba gtong ba mi srid pa yin te/nag po'i chos bzhis ma gos pa bya gsung ba sogs go sla/ //bcu gnyis pa ni/ sgreb pa gsum nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bya ba ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang /

gzhung 'grel/ sprugag/de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang //de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i nyon mongs la rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis su dbye ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa gti mug pa/des bskyed pa'i ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa ji snyed par bshad/ 'khor gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa yang rtsa ba ma rig pa'i g.yos yin pas na sgrib pa thams ca da nyon mongs pa ma rig par gcig mod/ de dag bag la nyal dang bcas pa spangs pa na rdzogs byang thob ste/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gti mug 'byung ba 'dod dang khro/ /de dag zhagro ba'i dgra 'dra ste// chom po chas ni bzang ba 'dra/ /de dag ma lus 'dir ngas bshig /ces dang / de nyid las/ nyon mongs rtsa ba bag nyal bcas/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu 'byung de dag /ngas 'dir shes rab dam pa yi/ /mthong lcags kyis ni ma lus bton/ /zhes dang/dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na/ /'dod cha gas zhe sdang gti mug dang / /dri ma gzhan yang rnam mang po/ /khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs/ /zhese sogs gsungs pa'i phyir

242 dgongs gcig nyin snang / ma rig pa chos dbyings ye shes su rtogs dus sgrib pa gzhan rnamaṅge mi dag pa mi srid pa la dgongs/ shes sgrib kyang nyon sgrib kyi rgyur mtshungs te lus ngag la gnas pa'i sgrib pa spangs kyang / yid kyi nyon mongs phra mo ma spangs tshe sa bcu pa rgyal po nor bzang lha mo yid 'phrog ma la chags pa dang / gzhon nu chu skyes snga ma la nyon mongs drag po skyes pas rgyal srid chos min du bskyangs pa dang / dom byang chub sems dpa' dang / spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang / ri dwags ru ru sogs su skyes pa yang sngon gyi 'bras bus dud 'gror skyes pa yin te/ skyes rabs las/ las kyi rnam par smin pa shin tu 'jigs/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can dag dud 'gror skyes// de'ang chos kyi 'du shes myong bar gyur/ /las med na ni skye ba'i mtshams mi sbyor/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lung 'di ni/ gzhan dag shākya thub pa'i sku la seng phreng zug pa sogs las min tshul ston pa yin zer ba sogs kyang don gyis bkag par thal lo/ //bcu gsum pa ni/ bden pa ni grub pa'i mtha' ji snyed

gzhung 'grel/ 243pas sgribs bya ba ni/ don dam bden pa blo'i yul las 'das pa la/grub mtha' blos byas ngar 'dzin/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi rtog pa ma dag pa 'dis bsgribs pa yin te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gang zhig yod ji/ ma yi/na de ni med ces bya/ /byis pa rnams kyis nge brtags yod dang med par byed/ /yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung / /zhes dang / de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang / /da ltar byung ba mi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste/ /gang zag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spros med de //'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// /zhes dang / rtog ge 'bar ba las/ sgra dang gtan tshigs dang gso ba dang nang zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i gnas bzhi po dag la yongs su 'dris pa'i bdag nyid kyis thos pa las byung ba'i shes pa la yang mngon par brtson pa nyid du bya ste/ 'di ni de las gzhan pa bsam pa dang sgom pa las byung ba bla na med pa'i shes pa dag thob pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sems

2 4 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mnyam par gzhag pas de nyid rtogs par 'gyur gyi gzhan gyis ni ma yin no// /zhes dang / spyod 'jug ltas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ /ces dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ dri ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan//bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par bya bar gsungs/ /zhes dang / mgon po phag mo gru pas/ grub mtha' tha dad ma gyur kyang //rtog pa'i 'do da lugs ma gtogs pa/ /ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med//rtog pa chos skur rtogs tsam na/ grub mtha' zhen pa'i 'dod 'dun zhi/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten mgon pos/ grub mtha' blo yi mdud pa la/ /sangs rgyas dgongs par 'khrul pa rnams/ /de nyid rtogs par gyur nas kyang / /dran 'dzin rang sar dag mdzad rgesol/ /ces dang / 'bri gung gling pa sher 'byung gis/ bsam sgom rtog pa'i shor gol dang gcig /chen pos reg pa'i rtog pa dang gnyis/ /bden pas bsgrubs pa'i grub ma tha' dang gsum/ /'di stong nyid seng ge'i dag gsum yin/ /zhes so/ des na thog mar nga zhes pa'i ngar 'dzin dang /

gzhung 'grel/ 245des btags pa'i nga'i chos/ nga'i grub mtha'/ kho'i grub mtha' zhes nga dang gzhan du btags pas 'khor bar 'gyur te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gis 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed nas/ /zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces dang / rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / /de gnyis dang ni 'brel pa las//nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ //bcu bzhi pa ni/ nyan thos kyis kyang phyog gcig babs kyi gnas lugs mthong bya ba ni/ 'khor ba spong bar mngon rtogs dgos/mngon rtogs skye ba sangs rgyas kyi gsung la brten/ gsung bzhin nyams su blangs bas babs kyi gnas lugs mthong bas nyan thos kyis kyang phyi gzung yul rags pa ma grub pa rdul phran cha med dang /nang 'dzin sems mi rtag pa skad cig mar shes pa la brten nas chags med kyi ye shes kyis 'khor ba spong bas phyogs gnyis po de'i

246 dgongs gcig nyin snang /babs kyi gnas lugs de rtogs pas dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi dang rang rgyal rtogs pa dang / mthar thug bla med byang chub kyi rgyur yang 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ nyan thos rnams kyi chos dbyings dang / /nga yi chos dbyings mtshungs par gcig /nyan thos rnams kyi rnam grol dang //nga yi rnam par grol ba'ang gcig /ces dang / dbu ma rtsa bar/bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gang zhig /bslu ba de ni brdzun zhes gsungs/ /'du byed thams cad bslu ba'i chos/ /des na de dag brdzun pa yin/ /gal te bslu chos gang yin pus/ /de brdzun de la ci zhig bslu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gsungs pa/ /stong nyid yongs su bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng bar/ stong nyid sangs rgyas che bdag nyid/ /de ltar rigs pas rjes bltas na/ /theg chen gcig tsagos las gsungs snapa/ /mkhas pa rnams la ci mi mnyam//zhes sogs ga(nges la/ 'dir grub mtha' smra ba'i nyan thos ma gtogs rtogs pa dang ldan pa ni dgra bcom la sogs te/ de rnams kyi mngon rtogs kyi sa mtshams ni 'di las 'das pas 'og tu

sa/zhung 'grel/ 247'chad do/ / /bco lnga pa ni / sa drug man chad nyan rang dang mngon rtogs thun mong yin bya ba ni/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdor/ sa lnga pa bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs pa ra gsungs pa dang / nyan thos/ dag bcom gyis kyang de rtogs par mdo gzhan nas bshad la/ sa drug pa bas rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par bshad pa dang /gzhan du rang rgyal gyi sa de rtogs par byung bas rtogs pa mnyam/yang nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi'i rgyun zhugs kyi rtogs pa dang / byang sems sa dang po ba'i rtogs pa thun mong ste 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mtshungs par rtogs pas so/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i 'bras bu 'gog bden dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa de/ byang se mas sa lnga pa'i rtogs pa dang thun mong / rang sangs rgyas kyis mngon du byas pa'i rten 'brel lug ldog gi tshul gyis myang 'das/ thob pa'i rtogs pa dang thun mong yin/ de lta na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems des nyan rang zil gyis gnon par bshad pa dang mi 'gal

248 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lam zhe na mi 'gal te/ de'i dpe sa bcu pa'i mdor/ byang sems rnam grol zla bas dang po sa bslang bas/ byang sems rdo rje snying pos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la lhag par dmigs pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan rang gi spyod yul las 'das kyang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pas ma yin pa/ rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs zil gyis gnon yang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pa min la/ rgyal bu nam nar son pa na/ rang gi blo'i glebs bskyed pa blon po'i bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i dpes/ byang chub sems dpa' yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa che ba nyid kyis nyan rang thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pa ni ma yin no/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pas ni rang gi yul shes pa la gnas pas nyan rang thams cad kyi bya ba las shin tu 'das pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ rin chen phreng bar/ theg pa che las skye med bstan/khyed kyi zad pa stong pa nyid/ /zad dang mi skye'i don du ni/ /gcig pas

gzhung 'grel/ 249de phyir bzod par bgyi/ /zhes nyan thos kyi zad pa mi skye ba dang/ theg chen gyi skye med gcig par bshad pa dang / gzhan yang bu mo mya ngan med kyi gleng gzhi lta bu dang / yang brgyad stong 'grel bar/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthong lam du nyan rang gi rtogs pa rdzogs pas/mthong lam gyi dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ de dag gis spangs rtogs rjo gas par bshad pa de/ sa bcu pa'i mdor/ bsam pa dang dmigs pa'i che bas nyan rang zil gyis gnon par gsungs pa dang dgongs rtse gtad la// yang na mthong lam thob pa'i byang sems la byebyes thams cad mnyam/ par sangs rgyas pa zhes sangs rgyas su btags kyang sangs rgyas dngos ma yin gyi/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni rjes su rtogs pa la dgongs pa ltar zo/ /sa drug pa'i skabs su/ rin chen phreng bar/〉 de yi rnam par sminari pa ni/ /lha yi rgyal po rab 'phrul 'gyur/ nyan skos rnams kyis mi 'phrogs la/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal can zhi byed/ ce sa pa'ang sa drug pa rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs dang thun mong du 'gyur

220 dgongs gcig nyin snang / bas nyan thos dgra bcom las ches lhag pa 'grub pa'i phyir dang /bdun pa ring du song ba ste/ grangs ni ring du song ldan phyir/ zhes pa'i nges tshig dang yang legs par 'brel ba'o/ //bcu drug pa ni/ sems tsam ni sa bdun gyi mngon rtogs ring du song bya ba ni/ theg chen sems tsam gyi lta ba gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi don dam pa nyan rang gi spyod yul du ma gyur pas ring du song ba sngar smos pa bzhin te/ des na chos thams cad sems su rtogs na/ ded dpon snying rje chen po dang / bram ze'i khye'u skar ma nasags thabs la mkhas pas bskal pa du ma'i byerdogs bzlumangs/ nye ba lta bu yin te/ ye shes rgyas pa las/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkha na po dag /rang gis sprul pa'i sgyu ma la/ /dge dang mi dge'i 'du byed 'i// /nyes pa gang gis mi gos ltar/ /thabs la mkhas pas rnam par sprod/ /ces so/ de lta'i thabs mkhas ni/ sa bdun pa thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod yul yin te/ rang gis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni bzod bla'i/ rang mi nyam/sa par pha rol po las mi bzad

gzhung 'grel/ 22gapa la 'jug pa la/ snying rje chen po yal bar mi 'dor ba ni sa bdun gyi mngon rtogs sems tsam rtogs pa las 'byung ste/ lang ku rna gshegs pa'i mdo'i de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa dang mi rtag par 'gyur ba zhes pa'i le'u lnga pa las/ sems tsam la ni bdun pa ste//snang ba med par sa brgyad yin/ /sa gnyis dag ni gnas yin te//bcu pa ye shes chen po nyid/ /de ni nga yi sa yin no/ /zhes dang /phal chen las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ zhes gsungs pas na/ sems tsam gyi mngon rtogs sa bdun la 'ong ba sems tsam ston pa'i mdo rnams su gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin no // /bcu bdun pa ni/ chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad pa la mngon du byas zhes pa ni rgyas bshad ma dgos/ bsdus na/ gang zag gi bdag med pa dang po dang / chos kyi bdag med pa brgyad pa la mngon du byed de/ rgya cher rol pa las/ chos 'di thamase cad rang bzhin bdag med pa'i/ /bzod pa bdag gis thob pa de yi tshe//

222 dgongs gcig nyin snang /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bdag lung bstan/ /ces dang /gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs ba//chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ sa dang po la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i brjod bya ni dag pa'i sa gsum gyi dang po sa brgyad pa la dgongs pas so// gzhan dag sa dang po rab dga' la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo dang / mar me mdzad lung bstan pa'i mdo las kyang chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad pa la mngon du bya sa par gsungs so/ / /bco brgyad pa ni/ rtogs pa gcigasna gis sa lam ma lus bgrod par bzhed pa ni/ 'od gsal don dam bden pa de dag ma dag gi rim pa'am/ sa dang po'i ming mngon rtogs mthong lam gyi ye shes de sangs rgyas pa'i bar du bgrod pa yin la/ ting nge 'dzin

gzhung 'grel/ 223gyi ming rnams gtan la dbab pa las/ gcig la ming rnam grangs su bshad ces dang / brgyud pa 'di la rnal 'byor bzhi'i spros bral cung zad gsal ba la rtse gcig ngo bro mthong ba spros bral/ lus dang snang ba'am 'khor 'das thams cad de nyid du rtogs pa ro cig mnyam rjes sogs bral ba sgom med du gsungs pa lta bu ste/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ ji skad bshad pa'i mthong ba'i lam gyis mngon sum du byas pa'i dngos po las tha mi dad pa la dmigs pa'i phyir mthong ba dang bsgom pa dag tha dad du gyur pa med pas sgom pa'i lamamatshan nyid pa rnam par gzhag pa ni med ces dang / 'jug pa'i 'grel bar/ ye shes kyi cha la sar rberjod de/ zhes sogs rgyas par bshad pa dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud/ /rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na/ /thams cad cig car 'gul bar ltar/ skad cig ye shes de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gi bye brag gis/ /skad cig gcig la rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang / mgon po 'bri gung pas/ ji ltar smyug

224 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rngegs mang po la/ /bkas pa'i tshul gyis thams cad kyang / /gas pa gcig gis bkas pa ltar/ /de bzhin ye shes gcig nas gcig/ces dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po rat+na shrīs/ shukya'i rgyal po 'di nyid ma gtogs pa/ /grangs med gsum du nges pa ga na 'dug/ mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa tshogs lam ste/ /gdams ngag rjes dran thob pa sbyor lam yin/ /rang gi sems nyid mthong ba mthong lam yin/ /rgyun chad med par bsgom pa sgom lam yin/ /rang sems mngon du gyur pa bar chad rme da/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //bcu dgu pa ni/ sa'i yon tan 'byung ba mu drug tu bzhed pa ni/ sa thob nas yon tan de ma thag tu 'byung ba ma yin te/mngon rtogs de yod kyang yon tan sgrub dgos/ rtogs pa de'i cha na tshul khrims dang / bsam gtan dang / byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas sa'i yon tan ji snyed pa sgrub dgos/ de bsgrubs pas yon tan 'byung ba la mu drug ste/ rim gyis pa'i mu/ cig car ba'i mu/'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa'i mu/ yon tan gzhan gyis mi

— gzhunga'agrel/ 225mthong ba'i mu/ rnal 'byor ba'i nyams kyi snang ba'i mu/ lung gi mu dang drug yin/ dang po rim gyis pa ni bdag cag gi ston pa lta bu/gnyis pa cig car ba'i mu rje btsun spyan ras gzigs lta bu/ gsum pa 'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa byang chub sems dga' nor bzang gi bla ma bcu po lta bu/ bzhi pa yod kyang gzhan gyis mi rmethong ba slob dpon klu sgrub lta bu/ slob dpon 'di mdo rnga bo cher sa brgyad pa/sprin chen por sa bcu pa/ 'jam dpa/la rtsa rgyud du sa brgyad pa/laṅkar gshegs par sa dang por lung bstan pa sogs ches mang ngo //chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po spyan ras gzigs yin kyang dbu'i a mi de wa mthong mkhan nyung ba dang / slob dpon thogs med kyi phrag par byams mgon bzhugs pa dang / slob dpon zla grags kyi phrag la spyan ras gzigs bzhugs pa sogs snang ba dag pas kyang khyi ro tsam du mthong ba sogs lta bu/ lnga pa rnal 'byor pa'i nyams snang rje btsun mi la'i yon tan chu bar du bzhugs dus cho 'phrul bstan pa khong rang gis min pa ma gzigs/ khong gi yon tan 'ga' yang jo mo bkra shis

226 dgongs gcig nyin snang / tshe ring mas gzigs pa lta bu/ drug pa lung ni/ mthong lam thob pa dang yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba dus mnyam du ma gsungs pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni phal cher 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang por 'gyur zhing dbang phyug chen po la dbang du thob la/ zhes pa nas/'dod na brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnam pa ji lta bus khyim dang chung ma dang longs spyod thams cad spangs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ba dang / rab tu byung na sa kyang skad cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin brgya rab tu thob snyoms par yang 'jug pa dang /sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / de dag gi byin gyis rlabs kyang yang dag par shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang /zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed pa dang / sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang / lus re re yang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgya brgya dang ldan par kun tu ston pa'i brtson 'grus rnam pa de lta bu rtsom mo/ /zhes gsungs pa gsal

gzhung 'grel/ 227bas bston du med do / / /nyi shu pa ni/ rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsags bya ba ni/ rgyu'i skabs su tshogs gnyis zung 'jug sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po dri med dang rnam dbyer med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa la ngos bzung bas rtsol bas ma bsags gshes babs rang bsags su yod de /rgyud bla ma las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de/ /yang dag min rtogs las byung 'dod chags sogs/ /glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur //zhes dang / de nyid las/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes so/ /lam dus kyi tshogs gnyis ni thams cad dang mthun la/ 'bras dus su yang gzugs dang chos sku zung 'jug tu 'byung ba yang bsags pa'i 'bra sa bur babs kyis byung ba yin no/ /rgyu dus kyi bsags pa ni ldan pa'i

228 dgongs gcig nyin snang / ——don yin la/ 'bras dus kyi bsags pa'i sgra ni sam+bha ra'i sgras kyang tshogs pa dang dus la bab pa dang yang dag par 'dus shing tshogs pa zhes sogs su bsgyur dgos pas/ tshig don gnyis kya'i cha nas legs par 'grub la/ gzhan yang blo gros mi zad pa'i zhus pa'i mdor snag smyug sogs sbyin pa ye shes kyi tshogs su bshad pa sogs rgyas bshad mtha' yas so/ /— /nyer gcig pa ni/ mtho dman gang du yang khying yar gdams pa gnad zab par bzhed pa ni/ bsam pa dang dngos gnyis te/ zhing dman pa ni tshogs bsags pa'i yul min te bshes spring las/ gang zag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang / /thams cad rnam par smin pa mi bzad ldan/ /zhes so/ zhing dman pa las ma rnyed na bsam pas bsgyur btub ste/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' glang po cher gyur pa na ngon pas gos ngur smrig gyon nas mda' bsnun pas glang pos rngon pa'i gos rgyu mtshan du byas nas mche srog byin te rang sems dag pa'i snon lam yang / sbyin pa kha gcig len pa las

gzhung 'grel/ 229'dag cing / /de bzhin gzhan ni gtong ba po las 'dag /de yi phyir na 'dir ni rang sems las/ /yon gyi dam pa bskyed phyir yang dag 'bad/ /ces btang bas byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa lta bu dang / sngon dge bshes bsam yas pa/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo grur/ rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs dus khong gi ngan spyod la brten nas dge 'dun thams cad la bye bo yin snyam pa'i 'du shes 'khrungar pa bar chad du mkhyen nas/ dge 'dun rnams yi dam lhar mos pa'i spyi bor 'gro ba'i mgon po re re sgoms shingayan lag bdun pa 'bul bar dam bcas pas/ dang po tshul chos can zer/ mthar mos gus mthar thug ces zer ba byung tshul lta bu'o/ /dngos su gdams pa ni/ snying po mdor bsags las/ sangs rgyas zhing sogs zhing rnams la// khyad par du ni sbyin pa spyad/ /dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang //bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra/ /bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni//dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar// dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ /rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni /

230 dgongs gcig nyin snang //ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu sbyin/ /rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i chos las ni/ /zhing bzang po la sa bon 'debs/ ces so/ /'di'i slob dpon zhes pa ni/ nag po ba'i dgra nag 'grel pa lasang/ dam chos klog dang sbyin pa dang / /'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang / /dbang bskur ba dang dkyil 'khor las//slob 'dod rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /ces gcig ldan gnyis ldan gsum ldan sogs bshad pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon yin pa'i phyir/bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag bzhes la zhing thams cad kyi mchog dpa' ldan bla ma dam pa yin par bzhed pa ni phyag bzhes kyi snying po mchog ste mtshan de ltar gyis so/ / /nyer gnyis pa ni/ ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs bsags pa thabs mkhas bya ba ni/ bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba dang bdag med 'khor ba las sgrol byed yin mod/ bdag 'dzin spong ba la ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs gsog pa la thabs la

gzhung 'grel/ 234mkhas par 'gyur gyi/ de med na chos gang yang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i btang snyoms gti mug gi cha yin pas/ slar bdag 'dzin 'gal tshabs can dam du 'gro bas des na bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po lta ci smos/ bdag 'dzin med pa'i chu dang me tog sogs kyang bdag tu bzung nas 'bul dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog/ sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gtunas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rgyal po gsal rgyal dang mu to ba'i gtam rgyud lta bu'o/ /mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi ngang du bsdus nas 'bul dgos pa'i phyir ro/ //nyer gsum pa ni/ 'khor 'das tham/sa cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi dge ba dang / 'das pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis tshogs gnyis bsags

232 dgongs gcig nyin snang / pa'i dge ba rnams rang gi blos bsdus te gzhan don byang chub snying po'i rgyur bsngo ba yin te/ de'i bsngo rgyu'i rtsa ba ni 'khor 'das kyi byed po sems yin pas dang / 'khor 'das thams cad la de bzhin nyid dbyer med du bzhugs pa dang / sems bskyed 'khor 'das kyi bdag po yin pa dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thugs dang po bskyed pa nas dam pa'i chos ma nub kyi bar gyi dge rtsa rnams sems can kho na'i dom/ yi /na phyir de ltar bsngo dgos te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ rji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ni/ /sngon gyi bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor las byung dge ba bsngo/ /byang chub sems kyi mthu yis ni//rang gi sems kyang bsngo bar bya/ /rdo rje chen po mthar phyin byed//byang chub sems kyis bsgral bar bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po che//sems can thams cad dgos pa med/ /thams cad de bzhin gshegs snying po/ /nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos pa med/ /ces so/gzhan dag na re/ yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba/ /chos kyi dbyings la bsams nas ni/ /zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba dug dang bcas par

gzhung 'grel/ 233gsungs/ /zer mod dpyad nas lung gis/ sher phyin gyi mdor/rab 'byor/ yongs su bsngo ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings yongs su bsngo ba ste/ zhes dang /de nyid las/ sems gang gis sems bsngo ba'i chos nyid kyang de yin/ chos gang dag gis yongs su bsngo ba'i chos de dag gi chos nyid kyang de yin/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang / rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang / /bde gshegs snyi/nga po khams dge ba/ /zag med yon tan ldan pa de//bsngos na 'bras bu smin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba las/ 'gro kun dge ba rji snye/da sogs/ /yang de nyid las rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslab bya ste/ /ji snyed gang yod mtha' dag ma lus dang / khams rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdu byangan te//ci nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug pa sogs/ /zhes/ so/bas gsungs so/ /yang gzhan dag la la byams dang snyi/nga rje so gas /gshis kyi dge ba yin zhes zer// /zhes pa nas/ des na legs par

dzodutho/ dgongs gcig nyin snang /soms la smros/ /zhes pa'i bar rgyas par smras mod/ dpyad de/cho sa kyi dbyings la ji snyed kyi sgra mi thob pa yang min te/ rgyud bla ma las/ shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid yin/ /sems can thams cad la yod pa /mthong phyir ji sdo/da yod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ yod pa'i sgra chos dbyings las 'gal na med pa'i sgra yang 'gal te mtha' las 'das pa'i phyi ra ro/ /yang / bem po dang ni dngos med dang / 'phags pa'i chos kyang cis mi bsngo/ /zhes pa yang don las gol te 'khor 'das gnyis ka bsngo ba'i lung sngar bshad pas so/ /yang / chos dbyings dge par byas nas ni/ /de la bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa/ /bsngo bas 'gyu ra na 'dus byas 'gyur/ /mi 'gyu ra bsngo ba don med yin//zhes pa yang / rnam par ma brtags pa ste/ sa ri warti'i sgra don yongs su bsgyur ba yin pas bsngo rgyu 'dus byas las 'dus ma byas bkag pa ma yin pa lung mang pos grub pas khyod nongs la/ zag bcas zag med du bsgyur ba sogs don mang zhing / yang / sems

gzhung 'grel/ 235'dus ma byas bsgyur du mi btub par khyod bsams na min te/ rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ rnam rtog sna tshogs lcags zhes bya/ /nyernga4 pa gsum tshogs bdag nyid las/ /gsang sngags skyes bu'i sbyor ba yis/ /de ni mi mchog dag tu 'gyur/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa yis// lcags ni gser du byed pa yin/ /de bzhin sngags kyi de nyid kyis/ /mi ni bde gshegs byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /yang gzhan dgarigs pa yin na rnam shes kyi/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas gsung bzhin gas pas sgrubs/ /zhes pa'i bar yang rnam par 'khyams te/bde gshegs snying po sems las gzhan med pa lung gis grub kyang kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi gsal cha la dgongs sogs mgo 'khor ba'i tshig mang du smras mod/ ga sal cha sem sa byung yi na/ sems min/bde gshegs snying po min/ tshogs brgyad sems byung yin/ bde gshegs snying po 'dus ma byas yin pa des grub/ sems dang se/mas/ byung tsam dbye ba ma phyed pa'i sdom gsum gyi bstan pa'i gsa'i/ byed mtshar che / sems can thams cad la bde gshegs snyi/nga po yod pa
