236 dgongs gcig nyin sna nga /skyon lnga spong phyir gsungs pa la mthun mod kyang nges don du sems can gyi khams la bde gshegs snying po med na sems can ci'i phyir 'tshang rgya/ rgyu la med na 'bras bu ci las 'byung / ya/nga khong dgadangos med yin na don byed med/ ces sogs bsting tshig smras mod/rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ dngos med pa las yang dag skye//bsngags kyi skyes bu 'byung ba ste/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen po zhes/ /'gro ba'i don ni sgrub pa'o/ /zhes lung rnam dag gis grub mod/ ci zhig gis bsto na/ yang khong dag des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang //'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad/ /ces tha tshig dang bcas smras mod/ don la gol te khams rang bzhin rnam dag gi steng du rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis ka tshang bas 'khor 'das tshang ste rang bzhin shes ma shes yin par lung gis sngar mang du bsgrubs so/ yang khyod 'dod pa bde gshegs t+t+waṃ/nga ngo/ rang bzhin rnam dag ces bzang bzang mo ye shes lnga rjo gas pa/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes ngan ngan po zhig rnam pa

gzhung 'grel/ 237kun tu bsam mod/ 'di lta ste/ salha ṭi'i rgyud kyi rtag pa brgyad pa'i rab 'byed gnyis pa las/ kye bcom ldan 'das/ ye shes kyi khyad par gang dag lags/ bka' stsal pa/ ye shes rnam pa lngar gsu/ngas teng/ lha rnams ye shes gsal ba yin/ /lha min ye shes khro ba'o/ /yi dwags ye shes zhen pa ste/ /dmyal ba'i ye shes 'jigs pas non//byol song ye shes blun pa ste/ /brtan pa rnams ni sems med pa'o//lkugs shing glen pas bsgribs pa dang / /byas pa'i shes pas shes pa can/ /rnal 'byor lta chos khyad par gyi/ ye shes de nyid bye brag shes/zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ ye shes de nyid khyad par gyi/ /ye shes chen po yang dag nyid/ /kun tu sems kyi bye brag gi/ 'khor lo mnyam par bzhag par lta/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ye gdod ma'i shes pa la ye shes su btags/ de sems las gzhan med/ de nyid rtogs ma rtogs yin par lung gis gsal por grub pas bcom skyungs shig yang zhar la 'di lta ste/ khong na re/ la la zhi gnas cung zad dang / /snang stong rtog pa phra mo la// mthong lam yin zhes ngo sprod

238 dgongs gcig nyin p+ta nga /byed/ /ces pa nas/ 'od zer nang par 'byung ba mtshar// zhes smras mo da/ legs par soms dang / zhi gnas tsam dang snang stong tsam la mthong lam lta zhog sems ngo mthong tsam la yang bka' brgyud rin po che mi bzhed de/ de ni khyed rang gi lugs rnying pa yin mod/ sngon mgon po phag mo grwa par zhi gnas kyi cha tsam la rje sa chen gyis mthong lam du ngo sprad/ dga' nas mnyam med dwags po'i rtsa ra byon nas don de zhus pas zan rdog las lod par sun phyung nas/ slar de'u mgor bsgoms pas gnas lugs kyi don ngo 'phrod da lta'ang ngo mthong de'ur grags/ sngar gyi bla ma de rnams la thugs ma ches zhes da lta rlung ltar grags mod bston yang cung zad mchis so// yang khong gis/ tshe 'dir mthong lam skyes pa la/ /yon tan shi nas 'byung ba ni/ /blun po rnams kyi rdzun rib yin/ /mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun pas/ /'di 'dra'i chos lugs mkhas pas spangs/ /zhes pa la yang sa'i yon tan 'byung tshul mu drug dang / sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs/ kyis/ sngar gsal bar bshad pas lugs 'di nongs par byas mod sa

gzhung 'grel/ 239bcu pa'i mdo'i lugs sogs mkhas pas spang bya khyod kyi khyad chos su zad do// gzhan yang bde gshegs snying po bsngo bya don dam pa'i dge ba'i de bzhin nyid du chos mngon pa kun btus su/ shud+dha gha wa ti'i sgra don dang mtshungs par gsungs pa dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod kyi rang 'grel du/ mchog tu bde ba'i phyir don dam par dge ba ste nad med pa bzhin no/ zhes su kha wa ti'i sgra don don dam pa'i dge bar shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyang mtha' gcod du 'gyur ro/ //nyer bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma la'ang bsngo ba dgos bya ba ni/ phrin las rdzogs par 'gyur bas bsngo ba dgos par gsungs te/ lung dbyen gyi gzhi las/ dka' thub mdzad nas byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa'i tshe bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma gnyis kyis ba stong gi 'o ma lan bcu drug tu nying khur byas pa drangs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des byang chub se mas dpa'i brtul zhugs 'grub par gyur cig ces bsngos pa dang / lhas byin gyis

240 dgongs gcig nyin snang /sgrogs 'phangs pa'i tshe bden pa'i stobs brjod pas rma'i 'dzag pa chad pa sogs lta bu dang / bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba med par mi 'gro bar bsngo ba byas pas ches cher 'phel ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis sngon gyi dam bca' 'gro phan mdzad pa myur du rdzogs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i yang spang rtogs gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang /bla ma yang so skye yin na sa lam thob myur du rdzogs pa dang / sa lam la gnas pa yin na bgrod myur ba sogs 'byung bar dgongs nas/'dzig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ nga 'bu mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su'ang khyed shul du yod pa rnams kyis bsngo ba byed dgos pa yin zhes yang yang gsung ba yang don de lta bu la dgongs la/ gzhan yang 'phags pa sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis/ de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rangs nas/ /sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na/ /yongs su bsngo bas sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon//zhes sogs kyang gsungs la/ bsngo ba'i skabs 'dir 'khor gsum

gzhung 'grel/ 24g.yongs su dag tshul sogs mgon po 'khri gung pa'i bzhed dgongs dpyis phyin pa rnam par bshad pa lung rig gis gtan la phab na spro ba 'phel yang rtsa ba'i don rnams brda khrol tsam las yan lag gi rgyas bshad yi ges ngal zhing / gleg bam gyi bangs chung ba la bsams te de tsam du byas so/ /zhes bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshoms gsal ba ra byed pa ste spyi don bzhi pa'o/ /

242 dgongs gcig nyin snang /7 /spyi don lnga pa gsang sngags rig 'dzi na sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i ga sung nyer brgyad mchis pa las /dang po ni/ sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la'ang 'byung zhes gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams spang rtogs mnyam zhing rgyu'i dus su nyon mongs rags pa/ lam gyi dus rgyu'i theg pa dang phra ba 'bras bu'i theg pas spangs te 'og min du longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du sangs rgyas nas thugs rje phyogs ris su ma chad par sku dang ye shes mdzad pa phrin las sems stan gyi khams dang mnyam par 'jug pas/'dul byed de lta bus gdul bya gsang sngags la mos pa rnams la sngags kyi chos nges par ston pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas gzhan gyi bstan pa la gsang sngags mi 'byung ba min mod/ 'on kyang shas che chung dang /mngon mtshan che chung gi dbang gis de ltar grags pa ste/ des na 0

gzhung 'grel/ 243sangs rgyas thams cad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis sangs rgyas pa sha stag ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag lwa byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas//dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba yang gsang sngags yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /zhes dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam//sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs/ des na gsang sngags ni dus gsum gyi ba stan pa thams cad du 'byung ste/'jam dpa' rtsa rgyud las/ 'od srung zhes bya mngon byung ba/ /de dus de tshe sa steng 'dir/ /'byung po rnams la legs do/na du/ /sngags

244 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mchog 'di ni gsungs pa yin / /zhes dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsung pa gang / /zhes sogs gsung ba'i phyir /des na shas che chung ngam gtso che chung tsam las/ bstan pa gzhan la yang gsang sngags 'byung ba kho naste/ 'on kyang bdag ca ga gi ston pa'i bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags shas che bar byung ba yin no/ //gnyis pa ni/ dbang gi don rgyud la skyes na thob ces gsung pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rab dang 'bring la tshad bzung med/ tha mas cho ga'i rnam gzhag tsam bshad pas dbang thob par mi 'gro/dbang don skyed byed dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sta gon nas bzung /dngos gzhi rdzogs pa'i bar du slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan mi 'dra ba re re rim can du 'byung zhing / sgo gsum dang de gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas/ rdo rje bzhi bskyed cing bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i nus ldan du byed dgos pa'i phyir dbang don skye dgos te/ phyag

gzhung 'greng / 245rdor bstod 'grel las/ 'dir dbang bskur bar byed pa ni dbang swo / bde ba'i sems dang ldan par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rme/ /dab nga don gang zhe na/ phung khams skye mched rgyal ba lnga sogs su ngo 'phro da cing nges shes skyes/ na bum dbang thob/ de bzhin du rang bzhin brgya da cu'i rtogs pa dbyings su dag pa'i dga' ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes na gsang dbang / rang bzhin lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i rim pa kun rdzob zhu bde'i rkyen gyis 'od gsal nyams sngu/ myong na sher dbang / dbang gsum pa'i kun rdzob dpe'i ye shes de nyid tshig gis ngo sprad pas don de phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag bdun ldan rtogs na bzhi pa thob pa la dgongs la/ de yang gsum ste/ rab kyis dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad ma thag rtogs te grol ba rgyal po en+d+ra bhū ti lta bu/ 'bring de dang de dag gi don nyams su len pa'i gnad shes shing rtogs pas grol lam la ma ltos par nyams su myong ba/ tha mas kyang de'i tshig don la go ba bskyed cing mos pa yid la byed pa zhig byung na dbang thob pa zhes bya la/ dbang gi don tsam yang

246 dgongs gcig nyin snang / — yi/ da la mi byed na dbang bskur yang thob par mi 'gyur te/ sa rdo la bskur ba dang khyad med pa'i phyir ro/ des na skabs 'dir dbang don zhes pa dbaskre bzhi'i don phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes na thob la/ma skyes na mi thob pa la dgongs pa min gyi/ de ltar yin na deng sang dbang thob pa mi srid mod/ 'dir ni rje nā ro pas/ dbang bskur gyi dus su mthong lam skye zhing de skad cig de la 'gag par gsung mod /de ni dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam du btags kyi/ chos mchog gi rjes kyi mthong lam ni 'gag pa med par gsungs pa lta bu yin pas tshul de lta bu dang mtshungs so/ /'dir dpyad par bya ba 'di ltar yang mchis te/ gzhan dag gis/ sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa ni//grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed/ /ces pa nas/ yongs su bzung bar mi shes so/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi slob ma nyer lnga man chad nges can dang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid las/ de bas lhag pa'i slob ma la/ /cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ /zhes pa nas/ mchod nas bsheg sa su gsol bar shes/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mtshan

gzhung 'grel/ 247gcig la dbang mi tshar ba'i nyes pa yod par bshad cing / gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar mod/ de yang min te/ spyi rgyud ni bya rgyud kho na yin te/ rgyud de nyid rang nas/ 'jig rten dag la brtse phyir ngas/ /rnam par gnon pa la sogs pa// dkyil 'khor sum stong dag dang ni/ /lnga brgyar bshad pa gang yin pa/ /dkyil 'khor de dag rnams kyi spyi'i/ /cho ga 'di ni ngas bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pas bla med la grangs 'di dgos pa'i shes byed med la/ yang khong dag bla med la lugs 'di 'gebs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyud de nyid las/ gang du las ni yod gyur la/ /las kyi cho ga rnams med pa/ de ni spyi yi rgyud dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten/ /zhes dbang bskur ba'i las yod la dbang gi cho ga med pa la 'gebs par bshad mod /de lta na deng sang dgyes rdor kyi dbang bskur la ya nga grangs sogs byed pa khyod kyi lugs la snang mod/ dgyes rdor la dbang cho ga med na bden du chug rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i dbang chog ches mang ba yod bzhin du spyi rgyud kyi lugs ltar 'gebs pa khyod rang gi 'dod

248 dgongs gcig nyin snang / pa bstan bcos su bris pa dang lag len 'gal ba de yang ngo mtshar che'o// yang khong dag ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yangang /slob ma smin byed cho ga ru/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /ces bris mod/ dbang lha bskyed bstim sogs dbang gi bya ba mtha' dag ting nge 'dzin la brten bzhin du blab col 'di 'dra 'khri ba yang mtshar che la/ ji skad du/ mi bskyod bsam gtan gsum rdzogs pa/ /zhes sogs lung mang po la ci'i phyir rgol/ yang khong dag deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur bya bar gsung mod kyi/ gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag ces zer ba yang shin tu ma brtags pa ste/ gang zag rab 'breng tha gsum la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin mod/ med mi rung ba min te/ brtag gnyis dang dzā ya se na'i gsung las/ rdul tshon bri bar mi nus na// dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /nges par bcom ldan he ru ka/ phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas par khri/ /zhes dang / ra li sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud

pa 'grel/ 249las/ gdul bya dbang po 'i bye brag gis/ /ting 'dzin me tog rdul tshon rim/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang khong dag la la sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /dbang bskur thob kyang mi phan zer/ /gal lte sems nyid rtogs gyur na/ /dbang bskur bya yang mi dgos lo/ /zhes zer yang / dbang gi rtsa ba mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi nang nas kyang / dbang bzhi4 pa tshig dbang yin par mthun la/ de ni sems nyid rtogs pa'i thabs las gzhan pa med de/ brtag tshoganyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/sems nyid ma rtogs na dbang thob kyang phan yon che mod go' bsno mi 'gyar ba ni rgyal ba kun gyi chos lugs yin pas khyed ma 'dod ༄ pha ga kyang sha thang nga / /yang khong dag kha gcig cho ga med bzhin du/ /bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par len ces zer//'o na dge tshul dge slong yang / /bla ma'i sku las cis mi len//sems bskyed kyang ne bla ma yi/ /kri nyidakyilas ni thob pa'i phyir//sems bskyed cho ga ci zhig dgos/ /zhes zer ba yang don las gol

250 dgongs gcig nyin snang /te/ spyir bla ma'i skru las dbang bzhi len pa ni/ ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhu// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /cesagasungs la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe dbang bzhi len pa las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ de 'gog na khyed rang gi lam zab gang du 'jog yang bla ma'i sku la ldas dkyil bkod nas dbang zhu ba ni/ cho ga las bshad pa dril bu khrus dkyil dang dgyes rdor gyi lus dkyil pho brang lnga sogs las dbang len pa ni kun mthun la khyed rang yang byed mod/ cho ga med pa kun rig sogs kyi dbang bla ma'i sku las ni nged kyang mi len pas tshulanemathun/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dpe/ so thar dang byang sems la bkab pa de ni sdom pa gsum cho ga gcig tu bsgrub pa khyed kyi khyad chos rmad du byung bar mchis so/ rdor gsung 'di'i 'grel ba snga ma 'ga' zhig tu dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo spros bral dang skye med du mdzad pa ni/ nā ro me tri mar rngog yab sras kyi bzhed pa dang ma mthun pa ste/ 'jig rten mgon po'i gsung bgros gtsang ma

gzhung 'grel/ 254zhig cung zad ma 'khor bas/ sa skya ba khu dbon gyi bzhed pa dang cha mthun du thal bas cung zhig nongs so/ / /gsum pa ni/ lha phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur du 'gro zhes gsung pa ni/ slob ma'i rgyud la dbang bzhi bskur ba la dkyil 'khor gyi lha gdan gsum tshang ba zhig nges par dgos la/ / de yang dngos su ma tshang bas dbang gi go mi chod na 'jam rdor dang dus 'khor ma gtogs rgyud sde phal cher la dngos su ma tshang bas ha cang thal ches shing / gdan gsum dngos su tshang bar dgos ji/ khyed lung rnams su yang gsal por ma mthong bas/ des na gad na gsam don gyis tshang ba zhig yin lda/ don gyi gdan gsum ni lha dpa' tre gcig pa la yang tshang ste/ de yang dbang bskur gyi tshe dbang bskur mkhan slob dpon gyi lus/ bskur gzhi mdun bskyed kyi dkyil /kho ra/— skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor/ bskur bya slob ma'i lus / bskur rdzas bum rmye sogs te/ de rnams la gdan gsum des pa r+ha tshang zhing tshang ba dpon slob gnyis gas shes pa gzhig dgos la/ de la

252 dgongs gcig nyin snang /gdan gsum/ ma tshang sdo'i tshang bar ma shes na dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i phyir cho ga rnam par ma dag pa'o// gdan gsum ne sangs rgyas dang rig ma'i gdan/ byang sems dang lha mo'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan rnams so/ /de yang nam 4mkhar spyan drangs pa'i rgyal/ ba lngas dbang bskur ba'i ribya ba mdzad/ rig mas rdo rje'i blu len/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skyod pa sogs mdzad par bsams pa dang /slob dpon dang slob ma'i phung po lnga rgyal ba ya 'byung ba bzhi rig ma/mig sogs nang gi skye mched byang sems/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched lha mo/ tshigs chen brgyad khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa ni nges pa don gyi gdan gsum yin la/ mdun bskyed dang dbang rdzas kyi lha yang rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' gsang chen rigs gcig de las gsang ba rigs gsum/rgyal ba rigs lga dam pa rigs brgya'i bdag nyid can nam/ yang rgyal ba rigs lnga po re re yang rigs lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can yin

gzhung 'grel/ 253pas nyer lnga/ de nyid re re yang yum bzhi'i zlas phye bas rigs brgya'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir nges par gdan gsum tshang snye/'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin/ rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste/ chu yi khams ni mā ma ki/ dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya gang / me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba las/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa /yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gdan zhes pa ni ngo bo'am/ yang na zhes pa'i tshig ste sangs rgyas sogs gsum ngo 'dzoms pa'i don yin pas nges dgos so/ 'dir kha gcig gis/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam yin gyi/ 'tshang rgya ba yi chos gzhan zhig/ sgom rgyu logs na yod mod zhes/ blun po rnams kyis mos sgom byas/ zhes pa yang / snyad

254 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ri 'dogs klan ka tsam las gzhan pa'i dgos pa gyi na tsam yang med de/dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob pa'i bsgom bya bskyed rdzogs las gzhan med pa la/ de ni dbang gis rtogs pa nyid yin par kun mthun pa la de 'dra'i khyad gsad kyi ngag kyang ches blun no/ / /bzhi pa ni/ dpe don rtogs pa ma skyes na dpe don khong du mi chud ces pa ni/ dpe'i ye shes la brten nas don gyi snaye shes lhags dgos par bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ dpe ni 'dra bas 'dra ba mtshon pa ste/ don phyin ci me log pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes na dpe don gnyis kur kha tshon gcod mi thub ste/ dper na rnem mkha' ma mtho nga ba'i mi la bar snang bstan pa bzhin te/ nam mkha' yang stong gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i cha nas 'di dnga'adra'o zhes brjod kyang go yul yin rlom tsam las don dpyis phyin pa mi go ba dang 'dra la/des na dpe don rtogs pa zhes pa'i go ba gting tshunas pa ni 'di lta ste/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes gnas ska bas bzhi dang stong pa bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi sogs kyi bde

gzhung 'grel/ 255chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes yin zhes go yul du bzhag na don min pas/de'i rngo bo bde stong lhan skyes brjod du med pa'i bde ba chen po de nyid kyi don rtogs par byas la/ gzod dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad ma thag sngar gyi gsum pa'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skyes zin de nyid zu nga 'jug yan lag bdun ldan du yin pa la yin par ngo 'phrod pa'i nges shes thob pas dpe sher dbang gi ye shes dang / don rmo bzhi pa'i ye shes gnyis ku'i don rgyud la skyes pa zhig ma —byung na dbang don khong du mi chud pa la dgongs pas so/ /des na gsum pa dpe'i ye shes su bzhag pa la bzhi pa tshig gis ngo sprad pas rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes par dpe la don tshig bshad tsam gyis ngo sprad na nyems myong yang blos byas kyi rtog brtags las gzhan du ma gyur pas go rimi chod do/ /des nas dbang gsum pa'i ye shes de nyid don gyi bde chen du 'dod pas yang min te/ ye shes grub pa las/ dbang po gnyis sbyor bde ba ni/ /de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra/ /de ni bde —ba che yin zhes/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs so/ /zhes so/— /de yang cung

256 dgongs gcig nyin snang /zad dbye na/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ ra ri bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes pa gzhi dus kyi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid rtogs par bya ba'i slad du dbang gsum pa pho nya'i lam gyis bgrod pa la brten nas gzhi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes de nyid lam dus 'dir bde stong zung 'jug dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin du dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba 'pho med du bcings pa'i lam des rtogs par byed do/ /phyag chen thig le las/dga' ba zhes bya snang ba yin/ /snang ba med pa mchog tu dga'/ /khyad dga' nye bar thob pa ste// lhan cig skyes te 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes dga' ba bzhi snang mched thob pa 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin dpe'i ye shes rgyud la rtogs par byas pa'i tshe ye shes de nyid tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad de/ brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes dpe don sbyar te bshad cing / de'i don ni/ kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/

gzhung 'grel/ 257/gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltar gnas/ /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu nyid ni du ma'i brdar mdzad do —/zhes sogs gsungs pas 'di ni gzhi —la yod pa lam du byas pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa nyid yin gyi/ rgyu la 'bras bu re ba min te rgyu kho na las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i nges pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te rgyu la 'bras gnas na/ /zan za mi gtsang za bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 'ga' zhig gis/ la las dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod/ /dbang bskur byas kyang ma thob dang / /ma byas kyang ni thob pa dang / /byas na thob la ma byas na/ /mi thob pa dang rnam bzhir 'dod/ /ces bkag pa yang dpyad par bya ste/ cho ga nya mas pa dang /dpon slob mtshan nyid ma tshang ba dang / dbang don rgyud la ma skyes pa sogs ni dpon slob gnyis gas dbang bskur thob kyi ming la bdag gir byas kyang dbang mtshan nyid pa thob par mi 'gyur la/ slob dpon thugs rgyud grol bas slob ma dad ldan la tshig gcig tsam gyi sa brda sprad pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes pa'i tshe smin grol gyi lam

258 dgongs gcig nyin snang /thams cad skad cig la rdzogs pas dbang bskur cho ga dang rdzas la ma brten kyang don gyis thob pa/ til+li pas nā ro pa la mchil lhum gyis bsnun nas/ kye ho/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// sogs gsungs pa lta bu slob dpon mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan la dus deng sang lta bu sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa dzi lta bar bskur na thob la ma bskur na mi thob pa ste de lta bu'i mu bzhi brtsi ba ni gsang sngags pa thams cad kyi spyi lugs yin la/ gsang sngags kyi rigs pa so byang la sbyor ba ni ches mi 'thad do/ /mu bzhi dbang kho na la brtsi yi gzhan la mi brtsi ba ni chos 'di pa'i lugs te/ de yang gsang sngags la grags pa rnams chos gzhan kun la brtsi dgos pa'i shes byed med do//byas na thob pa'i gang zag la dbang byed pa ni deng sang khyed rang gi rjes 'brangs rnams kyis kyang dpon slob mtshan ldan gyis cho ga yan lag tshang bar dbang bskur ba byed bzhin pa nyid ma yin nam/ nad med sman spong la/ nad pas mi spong ba ni khyod kyis rig par drangs kyang / lugs 'di pa'i rig pa phul du phyin pa ste/ dbang bskur na

snyogazhunga'agrel / 259thob la ma bskur na mi thob pa'i dpe nad pa dang sman gyi rig pas grub bo/ /de 'dra ba bstan pa 'khrug pa'i snyad ka dang bdud kyi byin rlabs yin par khas len na rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud lung rnams de 'drar thal bas ha cang chos spong gi las log par lta ba ma mchis thagasmug /lnga pa ni/ bskyed rim ni yongs su grub pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pas rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched 'byung ba rnams ni gdod nas lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin da grab pa de nyid 'bras das kyi lha'i ngo bo las gzhan da ma rngo rngo 4 4 ba sa bgrub pa da nyad kya zhal phyag ga rnam pa lam du byas ta bsgams pas 'bras bu lha de'i ngo bo nyid du 'tshang rgya ba ni dper na zhing pas nas kyi sa bon btab pa las 'bras bu nas nyid 'byung ba lta bu yin la/de yang lus kyi lha rnams bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor khris 'bur lta bu ma yin par dper na 'khor lo sdom pa nas rtsa rnams dpa' mo/khams rnams dpa' bor gsungs pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa nas/

260 dgongs gcig nyin snang /phung po lnga rgyal ba ya 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa nyid yin/ gsang ba rgya mtsho las/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus 'di dag thams cad ni/ sku gsum yongs su grub pa gsang sngags theg pa ste/ sku gsum nyid la 'jug pa lam gyi theg pa yin/sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ 'di dag dbang gis sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /zla ba bcu yang sa rnams nyid/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go/ zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// ces dang / 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas la ni rnam par grags/ /zhes so/ /des na gzhi la yod pa lam du byas pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa gsang ba sngags kyi khyad chos yin gyi/ gdod nas med pa zhig btsal nas bsgoms pas 'bras bu logs shig thob pa min te/ bram ze chen pos/ theg pa chen po bla med snying po'i lam 'di ni/ 'bras bu lam du khyer nas gdod nas/ 'bras bur gnas/

gzhunga'agrel/ da dkro gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'bras bu'i tshogs yin te/ sbyangs pa'i gtso bor gyur pa bsags pa las ni 'byung / zhes gsu/ngas so/ gdod nas yong sa grub yin pa la yin pa'i dran shes kyis bskyed rim mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyis gsal btab pa yin gyi/ gzhan du rang la med pa zhig bsgom par sems/ na rtsa ba'i ltung ba brgyad pa dang dgu pa nyams su myong bar yang 'gyur nyen che la/ gzhan yang ji skad du/rgyu la 'bras bu rgyas gdab cing / /'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas gdab//sgom gyi gzan du btub par ni/ /bskal pa bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur//zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas bskyed rim gdod nas yongs su grub pa nyid do/ /'ga' zhig gis/ rgya la bskyed rim bsgom na yang //sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i/ /cho ga'i yan lag kun spangs nas/ /rang bzo'i dkrong bskyed bsgom par zad/ ces legs bshad du rlom mod/ dpyad nas bshad kyi/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams nas/ mngon byang lnga bskyed/ cho ga bzhi bskyed/ rdo rje gsum bskyed /skad cig dkrong bskyed sogs bskyed tshul mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs pa

262 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rnams las/ gtso che ba bsdus na/ skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba la bskyed tshul bzhi bshad pa'i/ dang po mngal skyes sbyong ba la mngon byang lngas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed pa rjes chags kyis 'od gsal du zhugs bzhu ba'i glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa ste/ ji skad du/ mngal skyes blu yi sbyor ba yis/ /bsgom pa rnams kyis yongs su brtag /ces so/ /sgong skyes sbyong ba ni mngon byang lngas rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa tha mi dad du bskyed pa ste/ ji skad du/ sgong skyes blu ni med pa ste/ /sgra dang sgra min spangs pa'o// zhes so/ /brdzus skyes sbyong ba ni nam mkha' la dar 'phyar ba'am/ chu las nya ldang ba lta bur skad cig gis bskyed pa ste/ ji skad du/ sems can brdzus te skye ba bzhin// sa bon med par rnam par bsgom/ /zhes so/ /dror gshed las skyes pa sbyong byed ni bskyed tshul de gsum gang rung gi khongs su ma 'thus par dgongs la/ des na bskyed tshul phyi ma ni bshad ma thag pa'i lung de nyid dang / gzhan yang rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i

gzhung 'grel/ 263byed pa po/ /ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa/ rdzogs pa'i rna/la 'byor zhes brjod do/ zhes sogs rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud mang po'i lung 'i /sa/ grub pa dang / de'i man ngag rgyal ba kun gyi yab cig dang/la he ru ku'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon a bā ya rka// ra gup+ta'i zhal snga nas kyi rnal 'byor rjo gas pa'i phreng bar/ lha thams cad ska da cig gis bskyed pa la btag pa ba'i rdzogs rim mam zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes bsngab /sa rnga dang bcas te gsungs pa'i lugs 'di da lta gangs can gyi ljongs sbi/ ༷te zla ltar grags pa 'di lta bu la yang ma sems par rang bzo zhes chig rlon dang bcas te smras pa de 'dra ba ni rtsa ltung gnyis pa sbyo ra dngos rjes gsum nyams su myong bar ma byas sam/ / /drug pa ni/ rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga gal che bar bzhed pa ni/ snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang byung du byung ba rnams la ni skyabs 'gro nas brtsams so thar byang sems sngags lam gyi smin grol rnams rim gyis bstan te nyams su

264 dgongs gcig nyin snang / /len du bcug na sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de nyid ches gong du 'phel ba sogs 'byung la/ de lta bu la 'jug chog ma byas na ting 'dzin mi brtan pa'am/ glo bur du bar chad lam log gol sogs 'byung ba'ang srid la/ de 'dra ba 'ga' zhig bdud kyi las kyang yin srid pas de ltar yin na sngar gyi log sgom de yal nas ting nge 'dzin mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skye ba sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos pa ches mang ba sogs go sla bas rgyas par ma spros so/ //bdun pa ni/ lha thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang ldan par bzhed pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs gnyis mthar phyin bral ba dang rnam smin gyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / khyad par sngags kyi lha rnams skyon spangs yon tan rdzogs pa'i rngo bo yin pas dang / bye brag tu rdo rje'i theg pa rten 'brel bye da byung gi bdag nying yin pas phyo /tshan ngape lto 'og phyag mtshan dang gdan sogs kyang re res yon tan re re bskyed dgos pa'i phyi ra dang /gzhi'i dus nas sems can sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bshad pas don gyi

gaX/nga 9)gre04/ 2/39)cha nas mtshan dpe rdzogs la/ lam dus su khams dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin zla nyi dbyangs gsal rnams mtshan dpe'i ngo bo yin ji/ra bsgom dgos pa'i phyir dang / 'bras dus su longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa thob pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa'i skru de ni nga yin no/ /zhes dang / sdom pa'i rgyud las/ btsun mo'i r+bha ga bde chen du/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /mnga' bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ btsun mo'i r+bha ga'i bde gnas su/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /ba/tso po dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// zhes dang / dam pa dang po las/ rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag ngo/ yi/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste/ /'di dag ma lus lus la ste/ khyab bdag mchog gi go 'phang ni/ /sngags pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya/ zhes so// des na gtso bo la lta ci smos/ /'khor rnams kyang mtshan dpe'i rnam pa can dang / 'khor mgo brnyan can rnams kyang mtshan dpe'i

tram̐ 66 dbo/ngas gcig nyin snang /yon tan dang ldan par bsgom dgos te/ 'khor rnams kyang gtso bo'i ye sherngago kyi rol ba las byung gi rgyud tha dad pa ma yin te/ brtag gnyis las / 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan rma nga sne/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga / /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nga / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyi ra/ de dag gzhan gyi lugs la'ang yod mod ce na/ yod de cho ga bshad byang tsam byung yang / don go yul du ma byung bas sngags kyi lha nems/ mtshan dpe ldan par bsgom mi dgos zer ba rnams la dgongs so/ / /brgyad pa ni/ lha la sogs pa mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa gtso bor byed dgos par bzhed pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma thob pa de srid du rang rgyud la las nyon gyi sgrib pa yod pa dang / 'du ba chem bzhi'i khams kyis 'dus pa'i khyad par gyi mthong snang sna tshogs 'byung ba ngang / mthong nyams tshad ma zhig yin kyang chos zab mos kha ma bsgyur na lung ma bstan yin pas gar 'gro mi shes pa dang /

gzhung 'grel/ 267rgyal ba'i bka' las 'gal ba rnams log shes yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan de bzhi po'i gnad kyis lha la sogs pa bri ba'am/ bsgom pa'am gang byed kyang mdo rgyud nas bshad pa nyid gtso bor bzung ginyams myong / mthong rmis sogs gtso bor mi 'dzin la/ mthong rmis sogs rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun na rung la/ mi mthun pa ni log shes yin par thag chod pa ste/ thams cad mkhyen pas lha thams cad kyi gshis babs rnam dag dzi lta ji snyed mkhyen pa dang / bsgrub pa'i thabs sems can rnams la phan phyir ji lta ba gzhin du bstan rma dang /bar gcod kyi chos bar gcod du gsungs pa de la bar gcod du me+e 'gyur bar gsungs pas sus kyang bsgom du med pa dang / sgrub par dam bcas/ pa sgrub pa la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs mi 'byung bar khas blang du med pa ste rgyu mtshan de bzhis kyang mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid gtso che ste/ mgon po byams pas/ dzi ltar sgron glog nyi zla nor bu la/ /brten nas mig dang ldan pa blta ba bzhin/ de bzhin don chen chos spong 'od byed pa/ /thub la brten nas 'di ni

268 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rab tu bshad/ ces dang / de nyid kyis/ gang zhig rgya la las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ lha la sogs pa thams cad mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid gtso che bar 'dzin dgos pas so/ /des na rgyud sde'i lha zhig 'bri na'ang / rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / sdom 'byung nas bshad pa lta bu'i thig tshad rgyan cha sogs rnam dag dang mthun par khri ba'am 'bur du 'chos na'ang de 'dra ba nyid las gzhan pa'i thig tshad dang rnam dag sogs 'di 'dre bshad kyang / de bas 'di ltar mdzes so//'thad do/ /zhes pa'i log shes mi rung la/ bla ma'i sku zhig 'khri na'ang / bla ma sku 'bras legs na de 'dra ba 'bri/ mi legs na rang gi zhe 'dod kyi 'dra skra yin/ mos gus kyi dran pa slong byed yin zer ba'i 'dra 'bag skyug bro zhing mgo lus mi mtshungs pa mi bya bar ngo bo bla cha/ la rnam pa mtshar zhing dang ba 'dren pa mtshan dpe shugs la rdzogs pa gdan khri bkod pa sogs kyang mtshan nyid tshang zhing phun

gzhung 'grel/ 269sum tshogs pa byed dgos kyi/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis/ bla ma'i 'dra 'bag dud 'gro'i mtshul pa lta bu dang / phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil bstan pa khyi rgan yong tshugs byas pa lta bu la ming khyad 'phags btags pa dang / bla ma dge slong yin na chos gos rnam gsum sogs rang gzhung dang mi mthun par zhwa gos sogs mdog dbyibs dkar nag khra bo rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / bla ma me rlung chu brag sprin shing sogs kyi dbus na dregs pa can gyi gzugs lta bu bris nas ming dang bshad pa ya mtshan can byed pa sogs ni rnam pa kun tu rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal ba'i log shes dbang yod spyi brtol rang bzo kho nar 'dug paṅge shes ldan rnams kyis yid brten ci'i phyir rung /chu shing bzhin du snying pos dben par zad do/ //dgu pa ni/ dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa thams cad lhag par dgos zhes pa ni dbang po 'bring dang tha mas cho ga rgyas pa blo yul du chud dka' zhing / dbang po rab ni cho ga rgyas pa nyid gal che ste/ rab stong nyid rgyu 'bras su rtogs na cho ga'i rten 'brel sna res

370 dgongs gcig nyin snang /kyang yon tan re re bskyed pa'i phyir/ lhag par rgyas pa nyid gtso che la/las dang po pa dbang po rab la yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sogs cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rgyas par byas pas/ de'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pas yon tan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa sogs dgos pa ches mang la/ 'di ni gsung bzhi bcu pa'i drang nge sa thams cad la cho ga rgyas pa dgos tshul dang don mthun zhing go sla bas spros pa de tsam gyis chog go/ //bcu pa ni/ spros pa thams cad babs kyi rten 'brel gyis 'byung bya ba ni/ dzi skad du/ phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin/zhes pas phyi 'jig rten gyi khams chags gnas 'dzig gsum dang /nang rdo rje lus kyi chags gnas 'jig gsum rnams gshis babs kyi rten 'brel las byung gi bcos pa las ma yin la/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed gnas sdud pa yang sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus kyi gshis babasru/ de la sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa gshis babs de 'dra ba bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'bras bu zung 'jug

gzhung 'grel/ 27g.yan lag bdun ldan thob pa yang gzhi de'i gshis babs mngon du byas pa yin la/ des na 'di ni sngar gyi gshis sam babs dang 'di nyid rang gi gdod nas yongs su grub sogs kyang 'di nyid kyis bshad pa ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pas// de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ zhes dang / rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud nyi ma'i 'odazer las/ bsod nams ye shes stobs las skyes/ /gnas skabs rgyu 'bras ltos pa'i chos/ /rgyu mthun rgyu las 'das pa'i 'bras/ /thams cad chos kyi de ba zhin nyid/ /rte na cing 'brel 'byung gnas pa'i chos/ rig pa'i ye shes gsal bar 'gyur/ /gang zag chos kyi phyogs mthun pas/ rgyu rkyen 'bras bu tshul mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rten dang brten pa'i tshogs thams cad spongs pa che chung ci 'dra yang de dag gdul bya'i khams kyi gshis babs la dgongs nas rten cing 'brel 'byung du gsungs pa gshis babs kyi gnas lugs yin pas rang rang gi gzhung ltar bya dgos so//

272 dgongs gcig nyin snang /'ga' zhig gis/ rgyas pa la bsdus pa/ bsdus pa khugo rgyas pa rnga|gas/rang gi zhe 'dod kyis bsre bslad byas pa la yid ches med cing 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo / //bcu gcig pa ni/ rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs ni zab mo'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje zhes bya ba mi shigs pang/ mi chod pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ gzhom gzhig dang bral bas te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ /gzhig cing gzhom du med pas na/ bsreg par byar med 'dzig pa med/ /stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer bshad/ /ces so/ /des na gsang sdigs rdo rje theg pa pa rnams chos thams cad rdo rje'i sgra las drangs te/ rdo rje'i slob dpon/ rdo rje'i slob ma/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i dam tshig rdo rje'i dmyal ba sogs rdo rje'i sgra sbyar ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i lung don ltar rdo rje ni zab mo stong pa nyid spros bral gyi ye shes chen po'i don yin la/ des na lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje las gang du yang mi 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa

gzhung 'grel/ 273dang / rdo rje zhes bya ba gnyis med zung 'jug chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyang yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ badzā zhes bya gnyis med snying po'i don/ /phyag na de yi rdo rje rab 'bar bas/ /nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang / /'khor ba'i nyis tshogs spongs pa'i ma/tshan ma kun/ /thams cad 'joms par byed pa rdo rje'i tshig /yang dang yang du nan tan bka' stsal gsungs/ /zhes so/ /des na rdo rje zhes pa zab mo gsang sngags kyi brda yin/ zab mo ni chos yin/ lus zhes bya ba zhe sa la sku yin pas/ rdo rje'i lus zhes bya ba chos sku yin/ 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni rtag pa rgyun gyi don yin pas chos kyi sku rtag pa zhi ba rmad byung yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa ste/ mgon po 'bre gung pa chen pos/ bakhro bakhro rdo rje ma go bas/ /phyogs gcig stong par rtogs pa'i blo mig gis/ /theg chen yangs pa'i gnad 'di ma mthong bas/ /rmyongs pa'i byis pas ga chad ngu bar byed/ /ces so/ /'di yang cung zad go bar sla'o///bcu gnyis pa ni / gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje

274 dgongs gcig nyin snang /'chang gis sbas par bzhed pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa nyams myong can gyis rtogs kyang 'ga' zhig rang gar 'jug pa spong zhing / /chos zab mo la lung dang man ngag brgyud pa slob dpon la ltos dgos pa'i ched du zab mo'i gnas lugs 'ga' zhig phyogs tsam bshad nas shas cher sbas pa mang ste/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi/ /mtshan gyi don rnams rgyud 'di ru/ /yang dag 'dus par ngas bshad de/ /gzhan du don 'di ma bsgrags pas/ /bla ma la ni gus pa yi/ /slob ma dag gis rtogs pa'i phyir/ /rgyud gzhan dag tu sbas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sbas pa de ji ltar rtogs she na/ slob dpon slob ma gang yin yang nyams myong can gyis nyams su blangs pa'i tshe don de rtogs par 'gyur te/'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos e chung ri khrod du lam ri ma pa gnyis la gnad du bsnun pa'i tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan rnams stan de nyid du lhongs te ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya'i chos ma lus pa thugs su chud de sbas don thams cad kyang mngon

gzhung 'grel/ 275sum du gsal bar mdzad pa ni/ rje nyid kyis/ zhag gsum nyi ma dros bzhi na/ /mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan ga cig go /zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha phye/ /gnyisari med 'od gsal chen po la/ /mnyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag/nga rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gcig yin nam snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste/ sbas don thams cad ni rtog ge tha snyad mkhan rnams kyi spyod yul las 'das shing / rnal 'byor pa nyams myong can ye shes khong du chud pa rnams kyis nye bar rtogs bya longs spyod pa'i 'os su gyur pa nyid yin no/ //bcu gsum pa ni/ 'dug tshul dang / las 'ga' zhig sman zab par gsungs pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sman yan lag brgyad par/ dang po lus chags pa'i dus nyon mongs pa dus gsum shas gang che ba la brten nas nad 'du ba rnam bzhi so sor 'byung ba/ de re re la'ang phye bas brgya rtsa rer 'gro/ de'i bye brag re re la'ang bcos thabs tha dad pa re res bcos dgos/

276 dgongs gcig nyen snang / 'chos pa la'ang gzhi lus de'i rtsa rlu nga thig le gsum gyi gnas lugs ji lta ba rtogs par byas nas 'chos tshul gzigs pas shin tu zab par dgongs te/ rji skad du/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad/ /rgyun du 'brel bas lus zungs khyab par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs la/ sngon sgom chen lkog gyur mthong ba zhig gis mi zhig gi rgyab na ba la bltas pas/ der chu rgyus dang mnyam pa'i srog chags yod pa mthong ste sman pa zhig la bsnyad pas/ sman pa des mi de'i rgyab kyi srog chags kyi lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du 'gro ba'i me btsa' re brgyabs pas nad las grol skad/ sman pa'i dpyad la 'chugs med pa de 'dra ba 'byung la/gzhan yang lus kyi rtsa che phra rnams dang / der rgyu ba'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung sogs dang / 'pho ba dang mi 'phro ba'i thig le la sogs pa rnams kyi gnas tshul nges par byas nas/ rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa tsha grang las gyur pa'i nad rnams lta reg gi dre bas ngos bzung / de'i steng du 'bab pa'i sman dpyad zas bcos bzhis gnad

gzhung 'grel/ 277du bsnun pas 'tsho ba'i srog ster ba la bltas na/ las dang 'dug tshul 'ga' zhig ni sman dpyad kyi lugs zab par nges la/ de yang sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa mnga' ba rnams dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang /slob dpon rta dbyangs sogs bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i gnad rnams khong du legs par chud pa rnams kyis gzhan don du dgongs te legs par bkral zhing bshad pa'i lag len kha gsal la don 'drol ba 'di tsam ne rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud rnams su yang ma gsungs pas sman zab pa la dgongs so/ / /bcu bzhi pa ni/ gzhan gyi zab pa mi zab la mi zab pa zab ces gsungs pa ni/ 'og ma'i rgyu ma bsgrubs na gong ma'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'byor pa mtha' yas pa de yang thog mar rgyal rigs su skyes nas lus dang blo stobs rim gyis rdzogs pa la ltos pa lta bu dang / gzhan gyi mi zab pa skyabs 'gro dang so byang gi sdom pa sogs med na gzhan gyi zab pa rdo

278 dgongs gcig nyin snang / rje theg pa'i lam smin grol gnyis la rten med pa dang / sngags sdom skye ba la sdom pa 'og ma gnyis med mi rung yin pa dang / dbang la yang gzhan rnams dbang gong ma gsum zab pa 'dod kyang / 'dir bum dbang rtsa ba dang dbang gong ma de yi yan lag yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ mchog dbang gong ma zab zer yang nga 'bu bum dbang la rtsi chod che / gzhi dang snod dang lus lta bu/ gzhan rnams de yi khyad par chos/ zhes so/ gzhan yang brtag gnyis las/dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ de rjes kye rdo rje brtsam/ zhes sogs gsungs la/ des na byis pa med par dar ma dang rgan po mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ gzhan gyi mi zab pa rnams zab pa gzhi rten yin pa la dgongs shing 'og khang med na steng khang mi 'byung ba bzhin no// /rbeco lnga pa ni/ mi zab pa'i gdams ngag med na zab mo rtsa rlung gis r+sā ngas mi rgya/ zhes pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i don la sa brtsams te mi zab pa'i gdams ngag pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg

da wa —da wa—da da gzhunga'agrel 2479 pa la sogs pa'am/ mdor na skyabs sems tsam yang med gi/ra c-i rlung kho na la gnad du bsnun pas kyang mu stegs ci rigs dang thun mong gi ji 'phrul tsam 'ong srid/ sangs/ rgya bar mi srid de/ 'chang rgya 0ba la bstan pa'i sgor 'jug dgos/ skyabs 'gro med na nang pa'i gral du mi tshud/ so thar sdom pa gang rung dang mi ldan na ston pa'i 'khor rnams bzhi'i grangs su mi 'gro/ sems bskyed rnam gnyis med na theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba mi tshugs/ dbang don rgyud khwa ma skyes na rang rgyud smin pa'i go mi chod/ gdod nas yongs grupa mo bskyed rim dang mi ldan na tha mal gyi snang zhen mi bzlog cing gzhi lam 'bras gsum tha dad du 'dzin/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim med na chad par gol/ mtshan med kyi rdzogs rimacho med na rtag par gol/ don des na chos ci 'dra zhig byed kyang sbyor dngos rjes gsum tsha nga ba lam gyi 'gros ma log pa zhig gal che ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha/ /bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang / /bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su blangs/ /zhes dang po

280 dgongs gcig nyin snang /theg pa dman pa las grol zhing thabs chen po byang sems ba sgom/byang sems de las skyes pa'i yi dam gyi lha gdod nas grub pa gsal btab/ de yang rang sems bla mar ma rtogs na mos gus kyi rten phur mi tshugs pas bla ma bsgom/ de'i ngang las 'khor 'das dbyer med phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par 'jog de lta'i dge ba thams cad khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas byang chub tu bsngo ba gnad zab kyi de 'dra ba'i lam rnams re med par bzhag nas/ rtsa rlung 'byongs so zhes pham pa dang po bag yangs su spyod cing 'jig rten thams cad ku cos 'gengs pa'i rtogs ldan sgab nag rus pa'i rgyan can rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa rnams 'tshang rgya ba ni mo sham gyi bu dang nam mkha'i pad+ma dang mtshungs te/ 'jig rten gsu/ma gyi mgon pos// chags pa spyod pa'i sbyor thabs sum brgya drug cu dag /rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad rnams zab pa ma yin te / de dag 'od gsal dbyings su dab / na thub pa'i chos/ /rgyal bas gsang sngags zab pa'i gnad du gsu ngas pa yin/ /gzhan du mu stegs

gzhunga'agrel/ rdzubya /'khor ba'i sgrub thabs su/ /nan tan chen pos bka' stsal yang ya(sdu gsungs/ /zhes so///bcu drug pa ni/ bka' dang 'gal ba'i myong rtogs ni log rtog yin bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis lam nyams su blangs pa'i tshe rang gi khams 'dus pa'i bye brag gis nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig la bdud kyis bar du ba ca ngan pa'i lung bstan dang dngos nyams smri lam sogs la byung ba la sogs pa rgyal ba'i bka' na mi bzhugs pa 'am/ bka' dang 'a gal ba dag la 'di 'dra ba bka' na mi bzhugs/ dgongs 'grel ma khan pos ma bkral/ sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi thugs nyams su e / —'khrungs kyis 'di 'dra ba nga rang gi dngos nyams rmi 'i/ma du byung ngo zhes rang blo 'khrul pa la tshad mar bzung nas rjes/ 'jug rnams / lam de 'drar 'khrid pa dang / gzhan yang mu stegs byed ma /ngon shes can gyis brtags pas 'das pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dran/ de pham 7 drar pas skye ba'i thog ma des byas so zhes sngon mtha' dag pa'i lta ba ngang /

payid dgongasagacig nyin snang / ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dran/ de phan ma dran pas des skye ba'i tha mar byas pa phyi mtha' dag pa'i lta ba dang / mu stegs kyi lta log dang grub mtha' nyams myong phal cher ni/ sngon nang pa'i sgom nyes byung ba rnams yi/na te/ de ltar sgom chen pa'i nyams myong go log tu song ba rnams ni bdud kyi las su/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi bdud kyi (pe'u dang / gtsug gtor bam po dgu pa dang / ye shes rgyas pa'i cha/do sde rin po che'i mtha' phyin par gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' da/nga / dgongs 'grel mkhan po'i bstan bcos kyi don rnams rang gi zhe 'dod dang ma 'grig pas 'di rnams drang don sdom dngo/ngang yin pas bsgyur dgos zhes log par 'chad pa yang bdud kyi khros te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yon min te/ /ma lus de nyid mabyedrog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas//de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo snge gang yin de mi dkrug/thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par

gzhung 'grel/ 283'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir go bar bya dgos so///bcu bdun pa ni/ bka'i dgongs pa thams cad dang 'gal med du 'gro dgos zhes pa ni thog ma nyid nas rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma zhig gi lam la zhugs na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni drang por gsung pa bden par gsung pa gsang bar gsung pa yin pas/gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pas de rnams nang 'gal bar mi srid la/ des na lam gyi gnad tshang la ma nor ba zhig nyams su len pa ni sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa'i sgo nas chos lnga lda/na gyis nyams su len pa 'di yin/ 'di ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu rtogs pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan chos tham/ru/ cad kyi rtsa ba nges don phyag rgya chen po las bsgom rgyu gzhan med de/zla ba sgron ma las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ngas ni cha/do sde gang bshad pa/ /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste/ /tshig gcig rnam par bsgoms pas na/ /de dag thams cad bsgom par 'gyur/ /zhes

284 dgongs gcig nyin snang /dang / jo bo chen pos/ chos kyi phung pe brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /gzhan yang chos kyi 'khor lo re re la gsum ga tshang ba dang / phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims gnad gcig pa dang /sngags la tshul khrims med ka med du dgos pa sogs kyi gnad kyis kyang don 'di kho nar grub bo/ //bco brgyad pa ni/ gdams ngag ltar mi 'ong bka' ltar 'ong zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur bas shes bya thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i phyir/ mkhyen pa'i ye sheng des dbang byas pa'i chos de la slob dpon gzhan gyi dpe mkhyud dang zer zlos la ltos mi dgos par 'gro ba thams cad kyi khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po dang bag la nyal ba mkhyen pas gang la gang 'dul gyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don lam gyi gnad thams cad ma bsgribs par gsungs pas na bka' kho na ltar 'ong gi/bshad ma thag pa ltar so skye'i bo yul dang nyams myong gdams ngag

gzhung 'grel/ 285phyogs re ba ltar mi 'ong ba yin te/ phyogs gcig la mtshon na/dkon brtsegs 'od zer bkye ba'i 'dus pa las/ ngas ni bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /dge ba'i las kyi rgyu rkyen gyis/ /rmyongs pa rnams kyis rab spangs pas/ /'od zer sna tshogs grub pa yin/ /zhes sogs mtshan re re 'grub byed la rgyu phun sum tshogs pa re re gsungs pas na de 'dra ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yu la las gzhan su la'ang med pa'i phyir/ mgon po byams pa'i gsung sngar bshad ma thag pa des kyang nges par gsal bar byas so/ / /bcu dgu pa ni/ skyon med kyi ting 'dzin gsum khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu zhes gsungs pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams skye na yang / bde nyams chags par ma song bas 'dod khams/ gsal nyams 'dzin par ma song bas gzugs khams/ mi rtog pa'i nyams blos byas su ma song bas gzugs med grub/ de lta min yang de gsum kho na yun bsrings nas bsgoms kyang khams gsum du skye ba

286 dgongs gcig nyin snang /las mas med/ yang de gsum la 'dzin pa zhugs na 'dod lha sogs su gol/ rgyu mtshan phyag rgya chen po spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ ma bcos bzo med rang babs su skyong ba la/ de gsum blos byas su song ba'i phyir ro/ yang las dang po ba la de gsum skye ba shas cher mang yang de'i yun bskyangs pas rtogs pa gsha' ma mi skye/ nyams de gsum dag nas gzod rtogs pa gsha' ma skye ba yin te/ dper na me phu ba'i tshe sngon du du ba 'byung ba chos nyid yin yang / du ba byung tshe me 'bar ro zhes bzhag na me 'chi ba las 'os med/ du ba la ma ltos pa phus bas gzod me 'bar ba yin te/ dzi skad du/ nyams na bun dang 'dra bas yal nas 'gro/zhes gsungs la/ mgon po phag mo gru pas kyang / bde gsal la chags pa spang byas te/ /sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa bsgoms par bya/ /zhes so/ /bla ma 'dis nyams de gsum zhen med du bskyangs na nyan rang thob srid ces gsungs pa ni myong stong rgod po'i blo brod yin gyi don min no/ nyams de gsum gyi don rang gi mtshan nyid

da wa dzo gzhunga'agrel/ 287 nyan rang yang mi thob na sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ nyams de gsum dag nas rtogs pa skye yi/ de las skye ba min te/ nyams kyis rtogs pa thob pa dang / rtogs pa nyams phyir shor ba'i khyad che bas shes dgos so/ 'ga' zhig gis/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgoms pas/ zhes pa nas/ bskal pa grangs med dgos par gsungs/ zhes pa'i bar yang mi 'thad de/ blun pos phyag chen bsgoms pas dud 'gro sogs gsum thob la/ shes ldan gyis bsgoms na de las gzhan thob pa'i lung rnam dag khyod la gang na yod/ blun po ba lang rdzi la chos bstan nas grol ba sngon gyi gtam rgyud na gsal la/ 'dir dud 'gro sogs gsum thob pa de gang zag de'i skyon yin na chos mdo sngags gang yin kyang 'dra/ lam 'bras kyis kyang 'bras bu de las mi 'byung / chos kyi skyon yin na blun po zer ci dgos/ shes ldan gyis bsgoms kyang lam log tu 'gro ba las 'os med/ thub pas gti mug gi 'bras bus dud 'gro dang / skyon can gyi bsam gtan gyis 'gog pa dang /stong lta had pos gzugs med du gol sdi rgyu 'bras kyi spyi lugs yin

288 dgongs gcig nyin snang / mod/ spros bral zung 'jug gi ye shes bsgoms pas dud 'gro sogs thob na rgyal ba'i gsung rab la bskur ba ma btab bam/ phyag rgya ba rnams stong nyid rtogs par tshogs gnyis rdzogs mi dgos pa'i bzhed pa gang du 'dug nged kyi phyag rgya chen po dbang las byung / rim gnyis las byung zer zhing / rang byung ye shes yin zer ba dngos 'gal/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po rang byung gi ye shes yin/ gzhan byung min/ dbang dang rim gnyis kyang de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs yin/bsgoms pas rtogs kyi/ kha bshad kyis mi rtogs/ dbang don rgyud la ma skyes pa'i khyod kyi dbang las byung ba'i ye shes de ya mtshan/rdzogs byang 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rim gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar dgos/ pa rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung thams cad nas ches nan tan du gsung mod/ khyod rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas rim gnyis kyi nyams len la bza' btung byed pa'i dus tshod ltar dus su bcad nas khral chos kha gsag re byas rjes rnam pa kun tu sgo gsum tha mal du 'jog pa'i gsang sngags pa 'di 'dra ya mtshan che'o/ /yang khong dag da

gzhung 'grel/ 289lta'i phyag rgya chen po dang / /zhes pa nas/ phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin/ /zhes zer mod/ 'di yang dpyad de/ rtogs pa skye ba myur bul gyis cig car ba dang rim gyis pa zhes tha snyad mdzad mod/don la mda' 'phangs pas gos rim pa mang po phyogs gcig tu phug ces zer yang / rim gyis bgrod dgos kyi de dag phyogs gcig tu phug pa mi srid pa ltar/ rtogs pa skad cig la skyes zhes zer yang myur ba tsam la dgongs pas/ don du cig car ba mi srid pas so /khyod 'dod pa rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen chos log tu smra na yang /de la skyabs sems yi dam phyag chen bsngo ba sogs theg pa chen po'i lam srol rmad du byung ba zhig 'dug na chos min par khas len nam/ de rnams las log pa zhig la chos rnam dag tu khas len/ khyod rang gis kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa 'khrul bar spyod pa la mi dad/ rnam dag la dad par khas ma blangs sam/ lam de lnga las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes gang la ngos 'dzin/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos rgyal po la ma 'ongs pa'i dus log chos 'byung bar lung

290 dgongs ba/cig nyi / sang /bstan pa phyag rgya chen po la ngos bzung ba 'di phyag rgya chen po zhes 'phags pa'i yul du do ha skor gsum dang yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor sogs nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos rgyal po la lung bstan pa ltar smra ba 'di snying phod ma ches sam/ yang khong dganā ro dang ni mi tre yi/ /phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa/ /zhes pa nas/gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do/ /zhes nā ro mi tris phyag chen zhes bzhed pa ni/ las/ chos/ dam tshig phyag chen bzhi po yin/ zhes smras mod/ de yo ga la grags kyi/ bla med la/ gtum mo rtag pa'i phyag rgya/ dman pa las kyi phyag rgya/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes grags kyi/ snga ma bzhi po ma grags mod/ yo ga dang bla med kyi sa mtshams mi phyed pa'i gzhan lugs sun 'byin 'dod pa sha thang ngo / slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i lung drangs nas smin grol rim can du dgos par 'dod pa de ni 'dir yang 'dod do/ khong dag gis snga ma rgya nag lugs kyi yas 'bab dang mas 'dzag gnyis ming bsgyur nas phyag rgya bas cig car ba dang rim gyis pa yin /

gzhung 'grel/ 294mkhan po zhi 'tshos lung bstan pa ltar log chos yin zhes khas blangs/de ma thag tu cig car ba'i lam ka ma la shī las sun phyung nas rim gyis pa dar bar mdzad/ slar rgyal khrims nub nas rgya nag gi gzhung lugs la brten nas cig car ba'i lam la dkar po chog thub ces btags nas dar ro zhes zer ba yang / khong rang gis snga ma cig car rim gyis gnyis ka bkag de ma thag rim gyis sa lam rnam dag tu khas blangs pas 'gal lo/ /yang khong dag deng sa nga 'ga' zhig bla ma yi/ /mos gus tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas/ /rtog pa cung zad 'gag pa la/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod byed/ /de 'dra bdud kyi yin pa'ang srid/ /yang na khams 'dus bkag la'ang 'byung / zhes pa'ang klan ka ste/ rtog pa 'gags pa la phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad na shi ba dang brgyal ba la bya yi/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ slob dpon tog tse bas/dub pa sems nyid kyi 'gron po dag/ spros dang bral bar ngal sos shig /so ma gnyug ma rang babs 'di/ /blo 'das phyag rgya chen po yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ngo sprod byed kyi/ rtog pa 'gag pa la phyag

292 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rgya chen por 'dod pa phyag rgya pa'i lugs la med do/ / /nyi shu pa ni/ sku gsum re re la'ang gsum ga'i bdag nyid ces pa la/ spyir btang du chos sku la/ stong pa'i cha nas chos sku/gsal ba'i cha nas sprul sku/ zung du 'jug pa longs sku/ longs sku la thugs spros bral chos sku/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pa longs sku/ 'gag med du snang ba casprul sku/ sprul sku la thugs spros bral zhi ba chos sku/gsal snang ma 'gags pa longs sku/ sku de nyid sprul sku zhes bya zhing /bye brag tu/— sgrub pa po'i lus la rten dang brten pa gdod nas grub pa phyi nang ga zhan gsu ma dbyer med kyi gnad kyis nyams su blangs pa 'i 'bras bu dag pa'i ngo bor gcig pa yin te/ ji skad du/ lus kyi 'khor lo nyams dga' ba/ /dri skad gsungs pa'i sgo bzhi ra ldan//rang gi yan lag las byung ba'i/tsho /ka ba brgyad kyis brten pa yin //dngos po kun tu mnyam pas na/ /gru bzhi bar ni rab tu grags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi tshul gyis ni/ /de nyid 'khor lo gsum du brjod//bla ma brgyud pa'i rim gyis ni/ /rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du

gzhung 'grel/ 293gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa lus dkyil la dgongs shing / lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yang sku gsum ga'i bdag nyid yin pa sngar longs sku'i skabs ltar dang / 'khor la'ang des 'gro ba'am/ yang na gtso bo'i thugs zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes de chos sku/ de las 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu bzhengs pa longs sku/ gtso bo'i rnam rol las 'khor rnams snang ba sprul sku yin la/ phyi dkyil la gzhal yas khang sprul sku'i yon tan/ brten pa lha gtso 'khor rnams longs sku/ des dag pa byang phyogs so bdun sogs chos sku yin par grub chen lu ā+o pa sogs bzhed/ de bzhin du rdzogs rim la yang skye 'chi bar do gsum la sku gsum lam khyer du bzhed pa dang / lha gtso 'khor dang zhal phyag mang yang rung nyung yang rung gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi dug gsum sbyong byed la dgongs pas/ sku mdog mthing nag sogs po/ti0mug gi gnyen po/ yab yub zhal sbyor 'dod chags/ mtshon cha bsnams pa zhe sdang gi gnyen po'am/ de dag dag pa'i rang bzhin la 'chad dgos pas/ skabs 'dir/ dkyil 'khor dbus 'gyur

shā34 dgongs gcig nyin snang / mtha' mi 'gyur gyi bshad pa gal mi che/ der ma zad gang zag gi rgyud la yang rnam shes dang ye shes kyi cha gnyis las/ stong pa chos sku/gsal ba sprul sku/ zung du 'jug pa longs sku'am/ sems skye 'gag dang bral ba chos sku/ sna tshogs su 'char ba longs sku/ 'gag med du snang ba sprul sku/ zhes pa don gyis thob pas go bar gal che'o/ //nyer gcig pa ni/ gsang sngags la tshul khrims med ka med du bzhed pa ni/ sdom pa rten can gyi dbang gis so byang sngags sdom rnam rim nos dgos pa dang / khyad par du sngags lam sbyin pa'i tshe na sdom pa gnyis dang ldan rung la yang skyabs sems kyi sdom pa bsdus pa 'bogs dgos pa dang / brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes pa nas/ de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam//zhes pa'i bar dang / dus 'khor dang rdo rje snying 'grel sogs su/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'bring tha ma/ dge slong dge tshul khyim pa gsum gyi zlas phye ba dang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ so sor thar dang byang chub sems//rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud

gzhung 'grel/ 295las/ tshul khrims 'chal pas sngags mi 'grub/ /ces sogs gsungs la/ bsrung rgyu yang / dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dang khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis rtags dang cho ga'i khyad tsam ma gtogs bslab par bya ba la khyad med de/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar pa yi/ /tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba'i bslab pa la/ /sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang / /lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro///nyer gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pas bar du gcod gsungs pa'i steng du gcig bya ba ni/ rdo rje'i gsung gong ma'i don mi go na yang /'dir yang ye bkag ye gnang gi dgongs pas/ 'dod pa bsod nams kyi mtha' spong ba'i phyir gyi na tsam las ma gnang la/ lhag par rnyed na zhen med du longs spyad pas chog par dgongs nas gang yang gnang ba la chog shes dgos par gsungs pa dang / lhag par du sngags su 'dod yon rnams zhen med du rim pa gnyis kyi ngang nas spyod pa ni/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched rnams lha mo'i rang bzhin

296 dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ du gsungs la/ de dag kyang lha mchod pa sogs dgos pa gal che na khyen med du spyad kyi/ 'dod pa la 'chums pas spyad bya min te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyis zhus pa/tsho bcom ldan 'das ma dag pa ni gang lags/ bka' stsal ba/ gzugs la sogs pa lnga'o/ /ci'i phyir zhus pa/ gzung ba 'dzin pa dngos po'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / yum rgyas pa las/ 'dod pas ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba la'ang bar du gcod na mya ngan las 'das pa la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs so/ /dgos pa gal po che gzhan don la 'gyur nges pa la ni theg pa gsum ga nas ma bkag ste/ dang po 'dul ba kā ri ka las/dge slong gang zhig gser dngul len byed pa/ /nyes byas 'gyur ro gos dang brgyags phyir dang / /chos ldan phyir ni rtag tu bslang bar bya//zhes so/ /byang sems kyi skabs su ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro/ /reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par spyod gyur kyang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal sems bral byang chub sems dga' na// dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam gzhag yin

gzhung 'grel/ 297par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na/ /mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ de ltar rig byas gzhan don la/ /rtag tu brtson par gnas par bya/ /thugs rje mnga' ba ring gzigs pas/ /bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang / /zhes so/kyisngags kyi skabs lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang sogs la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs/ /'dod yon lnga la spyod par bgyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor na chos ldan gyi bya ba'i bar chad du 'gro na ni sdom pa gsum ga/ra 'dod yon rnams ye nas bkag la/ chos ldan gyi bya ba'i grogs su 'gro na ni 'dod yon rnams ye nas gnang ba ste rgyal po in+d+ra lha ti r+sha/ bu sogs so/ /de yang yul dang gnyen po gnyis med du rtogs pa la ni spros med kyi spyod pa zhes gang yang gnang bkag gi skabs med pa ni

298 dgongs gcig nyin snang /grub pa'i mtha' mchog tu bzang ba yin la/ gong du bshad pa ni de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dbang du byas so / //nyer gsum pa ni / sngags kyis mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med bya ba ni/ da bzhed spe snga ma'i yan lag nyid de/gsang sngags 'bras bu lam byed gzhi sbyong ba'i lam pa ste/ rang nyid gdod nas lhar grub pe glo bur gyi dri mas gos pre sbyangs nas sangs ——rgyas su byed mod/ gzhi la med pa 'tshol ba'am bsgyur ba ni min te// rte des na gzhi sbyong ba'i chos nyid ma gtogs lhar bsgyur ba min pa ni phar phyin theg par rmeng mtshungs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum dar yug gi dpe mdzad nas thabs mkhas kyis sgrib pa sbyongs mitshul gsungs pa ltar yin la/ sngags kyi mi dge ba rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams gzhan don dge bar 'gyur ba'i phyir spyad pa'i skabs nam yang med pa dang / nyon mongs pa dug lnga gnas bsgyur ye shes lnga zhes pa yang snam bu dkar po tshos kyis bsgyur ba ltar min gyi/ rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa la brjod bya de ltar byas pa yin te/ ji skad du/

— ཿba/po///rngog (rwarngoX/()// shā/kyi/bya//byi/'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ gnyis su yod pa ma yin te/'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la/ /mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin//zhes gsungs so/ / /nyer bzhi pa ni/ 'dul ba dge ba de sngags su yang dge la mi dge ba de mi dge bar gsungs pa ni/ 'dul bar mi dge ba'i pham pa bzhi ni sngags su dge bar gsungs pa med la/ rtsa ba'i dam tshotshig bzhi po dgongs pa can gyi brjod bya sbas nas gsungs pa ni/bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ ma byin pa la byang chub se/mas//kun rdzob ston pa brdzun smra ba/ /phung po srog chags rgyur pa ste//tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bud med yin// dgongs pa yis ni bshad pa la/ /byis pa rnams ni yi ger rtog/ rdo rje theg par gnas 'dodang kyang / /chos nyid de yis mi shes so/ /zhes gsungs pa de rnams/ rmi 'dul bar yang ma bkag la/ 'dul bar chang bkag pa nyid — kar/༷su yang tha mal chang 'thung bkag pa ni/ bde mchog 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ o.ā:lha zhes bya sngags kyis// rtag tu byin gyis brlab par bya/

300 dgongs gcig nyin snang //zhes pa nas/ cho ga yang dag ldan pas spyad/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur nus na 'thung gi mi nus na dngos grub nyams shing bgegs skye ba sogs kyi nyes pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa lta bu dang / brtag gnyis las/ dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /zhes myos pa'i nus pa dang 'bral nus na btung byar gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang 'grel pa dri med 'od las/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ rnal 'byor bas grub pa thob pa'i spyod pa mi bya/grub pa thob pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ zhes gsungs so/ /brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag snang ba dbang bsgyur zhing 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs tshul du ma ston pa ni 'dul bar yang ma bkag ste/mgadha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod nas gsungs pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang grub pa thob na slob dpon iṇ+ḍa bhu ti dang / rdo rje drel bu pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed lta bu yang yin la/ gang zag gi rigs kyi 'dod yon gyis mi gnod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i nyan thos rnaXs kyis mi sdug pa bsgoms pa la brten nas rnam

gzhung 'gre(5/ 30gapar grol ba thob pa la/ dge slong seng ge ni sdug pas rnam rnga/ra grol ba thob bo zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so/ //nyer lnga pa ni/ nyon mongs dag pa'i 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ dug gsum dang dug lnga'i bral 'bras sku gsum dang lngar bzhed kyi/ nyon mongs nyid sku dang ye shes su mi bzhed pa ste/ gnad mi shes pa'i nyon mongs pa ni 'khor ba'i rgyu yin la/ gnad dang ldan pa nyon mongs pa nyid nyon mongs pa'i ga nyen po ste/ 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar grong khyer dbus kyi mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la phan par byed/ /ces so/ /nyon mongarngan de spangs pa min mod/de nyid sbyang gzhi la rigs dbang lnga sogs kyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras sku lnga 'grub pa ste/ dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ gti mug rnam dag bsgoms pa yis/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyid du 'gyur//zhe sdang rnam dag bsgoms pa yis/ /mi bskyod pa ni nyid du 'gyur/

302 dgongs gcig nyin snang / /'dod chags rnam dag bsgoms pa yis/ /snang ba mtha' yas nyid du 'gyur/ /phra ga dog rnam dag bsgoms pa yisang/ /dpa' bo don yod grub par 'gyur/ /nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yis/ /rin chen 'byung ldan nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mgon po 'bre gung pa chen pos/ dgra gnyen du chad pa'i dpa' bo dang / gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis/ sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la//dus rgyun chad med par skor ro ro/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ //nyer drug pa ni/ sngags kyi mthu bstan pa las mngon spyod gnang ba med par bzhed pa ni/ spyir btang du sman rdzas sngags ting 'dzin rigs sngags sogs kyis srog 'phrog pa ni bkag pa ste/kā ri ka las/ sman dang sngags dang rig pa dang / 'chi ba'i phyogs su gang btang ba/ /de btang sdom pa zhig par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ snying rje mchog ldan sangs rgyas dang //byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /sngags rnams mthu bstan don du ni/ /las rnams thams cad bstan pa yinang /zhes sogs

gzhung 'grel/ 303gsungs pa dang / dpal na' ro pa'i gtam rgyud du/ mngon spyod brtsams pa mkha' 'gro mas shol ba dang / yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa la brtan pa thob pas mngon spyod byas pa dmyal bar skyes pa'am/ yi dwags rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu dang / gshin rje'i gshed la bstan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa bram ze tsa na kya zhes pas rgyal po'i dgra la mngon spyod byas pas dmyal bar skyes pa lta bu yin pas drag po mngon spyod nikyi phrin las de shin tu sdig che ba yin pas bdag cag rnams las ci la thug kyang 'di mi bya/ khyed mthu che zer na dga' la/khyed la sdom pa med zer na mi dga'i las 'di spong dgos pa yin gsungs/ dmigs bsal ni drag po mngon spyod byed pa'i yul/ spyir zhing bcu tshang zhing bstan pa 'jig pa/ bye brag rdo rje theg pa la 'khu zhing rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra byed pa/ de nyid bsgral na phyis bde bar 'gro nges pa zhig bya dgos la/ bsgral mkhan ni bsad pa gso nus pa/ bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i lam la goms pa mthar phyin pa/yul de bsgral nas rnam par shes pa byang chub tu spar nus pa zhig gi

304 dgongs gcig nyin snang /spyod yul yin te/ phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu las/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /phung po rdo rjer bltams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes dang /gshin rje me ru rtse'i rgyud las/ rang rig gsal ba'i thugs rje yis//nyon mongs bsgral ba ma gtogs pa/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems kyis sgrol/ /mnar med dmyal bar skye ba len/ /zhes dang / spyod pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang / /dgon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /bzod par sgom pa mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ bslab pa kun las btus par thabs la mkhas par mdo'i lung drangs par/gal te rab tu byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ltung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi po thams cad zhig par gyur kyang thabs la mkhas pa 'dis sel bar byed pa lta na byang chub sems dpa' la ltung bar mi 'gyur bar nga smra'o/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog sprin las/ mtshams med byed par 'dod pa'i mi bsad pa gnang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzhi mdor sprul byas te//

gzhung 'grel/ 305skye bo phal cher mgo mang bye ba gcod byed pa/ri gsad bya de dag ci 'dra de ltar byang chub sems/ /'gro kun sprul 'drar rab shes de la nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yul yul can de 'dra bas mngon spyod ma byas na rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu par 'byung bar nges so //nyer bdun pa ni/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba ni mnar med pa yin bya ba ste/ 'di ni mnar med ces nyams su myong bya'i sdug bsngal de las che ba gzhan gang du'ang med pas mnar med ces grags la/ rdo rje'i sgra sbyor ba ni sngar bshad pa ltar gsang sngags pa rnams chos thams cad la rdo rje'i sgra sbyor ba thabs shes mnyam rol gyi don yin la/ der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i// dmyal bar bstan pa gang yin pa//slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni nges par gnas par bstan//zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ de tshe dbang bskur mchog thob pa'i/ /slob mas bla ma'i bka' 'das na/ /'dzig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal zhing // 'jig rten pha rol mnar med gnas/ /zhes dang / rdo

306 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ mdo sogs bstan pa'i dmyal ba ru//slob dpon smod par byed pa de/ /gnas par 'gyur ba nga yis bstan//zhes sogs gsungs la/ gsang sngags su ngu 'bod la rdo rje'i dmyal ba mnar med du bzhag pa yang yod de/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa dri med 'od las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ngu 'bod dang / de'i steng du mun pa chen po dang / de bzhin du me dkyil la me'i dmyal ba dang du ba mi bzad pa chu dkyil la 'dam gyi chu dang bye ma'i chu/ sa dkyil gyi phyed 'og ma la gseg ma'i dmyal ba ste/gnas bdun la tsha grang gi dmyal ba 'khor bcas 'du bar yang gsungs so/ //nyer brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na de nyid kyis 'dren bya ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon smin grol gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa zhig la/ blo ngan gyi slob ma dam las nyams na sngar ye shes phab pa'i tshe ye shes sems dpa' slob ma'i snying la bcug pa de nyid dam las ma 'das na de'i ye shes sems dpa' yin la/ dam

gzhung 'grel/ 307las 'das na de nyid dam nyams kyi gshed mar gyur nas de'i tshe bstungs te rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung la/ de nyid slob dpon des cis kyang 'dren pa ni sems can blos mi gtang ba yin pas gzhan pa'i dmyal ba'i tshe tshad las myur bar 'dren pa ni slob dpon de'i mthu yin te/ dan 'bag gis thar pa nag po dmyal ba nas drangs pa dang /legs skar dmyal bar song ba bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 'dren par gsungs pa dang / byang sems nyi ma'i snying pos gdul bya ngan song nas bton pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang dge pa'i bshes gnyen spo to bas sa la 'gyel ba sa la brten nas langs ba ltar/ yul dkon mchog gsum la nongs pa bgyis pa yul de nyid la brten nas bshags dgos par gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon ye shes ldan pa la dam nyams na de nyid kyis 'dren gyi/ gzhan gang gis kyang 'dren mi nus par dgongs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngags kyi dam tshig gi rnam bshad rnams su yang / slob dpon la dam nyams na de nyid la bshags nas gnang ba ma byin bar du bshags pa la 'bad/

308 dgongs gcig nyin snang /slob dpon sku gshegs nas mi bzhugs na/ de'i bu'am chung ma'am/de med na de'i 'dra 'bag dang de'i lhag pa'i lha'i drung du bshags dgos par bshad pa yang don 'di yin no/ /'di ni byang sems tshoms kyi/ byang sems la gnod pas bde bar 'brel mi srid pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/ 'dir yang gnod pa'i las kyis dmyal bar skye/ sngon bzang po'i 'brel pa smin grol gyi thob pa de nyid kyis drangs pa yin pas 'di ni dkar nag zang thal yang dpyis phyin pa yin la/ rgyu 'bras la mu bzhir 'ga' zhig gis brtsi ba de yang rnam par nyams par byas so/ /zhes gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don lnga pa'o/ /

gzhung 'grel/ 309kro /spyi don drug pa lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu mchis pa las/ /dang po ni/ brgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar ba yin zhes gsung pa ni/ rdol chos dpe dkar bu bzhi lā bu/ shi chos gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa ka ba'i nang nas byung ba lta bu dang / gnam chos tan+d+ra sde bco brgyad rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu babs pa lta bu/ de la sogs pa rnams ni tshig don phun sum tshogs kyang / bla ma brgyud pa med pas 'bras bu mi 'byin pa dang / gzhan yang brgyud pa yid ches shing dam nyams dang 'dre khyer la sogs pa mi bar khyis ma chod pa zhig dang / de dag kyang bshad pa'i chos yin na rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du nyan bshad kyi rgyun ma chad cing lung rig gi zam ma chad pa/ sgom sgrub kyi chos yin na dbang gi chu bo sdi nub/

3 0 dgongs gcig nyin snang / byin rlabs kyi dad pa ma yal/ nyams len kyi gnad ka ma log pa zhig dgos te/ de yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur yin na/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud/ smon lam dbang brgyud/ mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud/ shog ser tshig brgyud de brgyud pa drug dang ldan pa/ sngags gsar ma yin na rdo rje 'chang nas rtswa ba'i bla ma'i bar dang / phar phyin theg pa yin na ston pa sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du zhal dang rnyi/na du brgyud pa'i gdams pa de ni zab cing ngo mtshar bar bzhed de/ saphyu ṭi'i rgyud las/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang / bla ma med na srid mthar min/ /zhes dang / mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gzhon nu bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi kha la rags lus na/ ting nge 'dzin 'di lta ci smos/ zhes dang / mgon po phag mo grwa pas/ dang po nyams myo nga skyes na yang // mi rtag sprin dang glog dang mtshungs/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal skye ba'i lhas/ /gdams ngag la kha tsho che na yang / /brgyud pa med pa mu stegs lam/ /zhes gsungs so/

gaX/nga9)gre95/ ()4——/'ga' zhig na re/ gter nas byung ba'i gleg bam/ dang / /ga(7na bye gas brkus pa'i chos lugs dang // brtsams chos dang ni rmi lam chos /blos bzos pa yi chos lugs la/ /rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa bsnyeg /de la'ang gzhan dag lung yin pa/ /chos dang 'gal ba (lta ci smo sa/ /rang chig dang yang 'gal ba yin/ /zhes pa yang rnam par ma brtags pa ste/ gter nas byung ba'i gleg bam ni phal cher slo ba dpon pad+mas sbas par zad mod/ de rdo rje 'chang /ma brgyud pa mi bsnye/ga pa la rgyu mtshan med/ gter de rdo rje 'chang gi sngar dwo nas sbas na khyed bden du chug de dag phyis sbas pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa snyeg dgos pa las 'os mod/ gter gyi glegs bam rnams zog chos rdo rje 'chang las 'gal bar khas len na/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gter du bzhugs myong ba dang / dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud rnams mchod rten chos bzang sprin gyi yang rjong nas spyan drangs pa dang / bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung rnams mchod rten bde byed brtseg pa nas spyan drangs pas khyod kyi khas len

342 dgongs gcig nyen snang /de thal ches la/ brtsam chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas paṇa grub kyis brtsams pa rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa mi snyeg na/ ltam 'bras kyi brgyud pa ga nga la gtugs/ des 'gre med/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig go/ /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis byas/ thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs / zhes ma gsungs sam/ rmi lam gyi chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun na brgyud pa de nyid la snyeg pas las 'os ma mchis la/ brkus pa'i chos ni rnam par ma dag mod/ blos bzos pa'i chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas bco sa na rung la/ ma bcos na mi rung ba kun gyis 'dod des na de 'dra ba yang bris pa la dgos pa mi snang ngo / / /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyis brdzus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin bya ba ni/ lang kur gshegs pa las/rnam rtog bag chags 'khrul pa la/ /mi rnams la ni phyi rol snang //phyi rol snang ba yod med de/ /sems ni sna tshogs nying du snang /

— ba/༷/ngange 9)༷/khag/ ()ske()/zhes dang / de nyid las/ rkyen las skyes pa'i snang ba las/ /rtog pa rang gis rtogs byed pa/ /phyi rol don mthong log ci pa ste/ /don med sems ni 'ba' zhig go/ ci /zhe sa dang / slob da pon 'phags pa'i sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa lis / sems rtogs kres ni byang cachub ste //sermes ni 'gro ba lnga po yin/ ci/bde dang sdug ri sngal mtshan nyid dag/sems las ma gtogs cung zad med/ji /cerme sogs gsungs pas don 'dis snang ba rang sems go na sangase rgyas thob par byed sdi'i rgyu sa bon grung po byang chub kyi sems dgra gnyen phyogs ris su ma chad pa zhig 'byung ste/ mgon po byams pas/ bdag dang sem/sa ca na rīmatshungs sathong yang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir rdo/ / ci/gsum pa n+ḍi/ chose thams cad bsam pa skad cicig 7ri/'i rang cigazugs yin gsung pa ni/ chog nyid brasam pa'i rang skeg krubasi / dang / chochos can bsam pa'i rang gzugs gonyi sna las/ 5 snga ma re phya tso rgya chen po nyid yin/ phyi ma la gsum las/ da lta daskre —— 'a phos pa dang / rdo sna ci'aphos stang lus 'gyur ba dang gsum las / — dang po da mu

344 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lta bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs ni/ rang rgyud la dge mi da ge'i rtog pa gang rung re re skyes pa na de dang mthun pa zhig yid snang la rang gzugs su grub la/ des dge mi dge'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba/ bram ze to rgya'i ne tsho dang khyi dkar po dung lta bu ste/ rgyal rnya/sa zhi ba lhas/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ mo tshogs nge dag gang las byang / de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang / /sdig sems (min par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang lha bsgoms pas kyang de'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs su 'gyur ba'i dam pa ya so dang/tsa thu 'bag pa'i sngags lta bu yin no/ /gnyis pa tshe 'phos pa skad ci ga ma'i rang gzugs ni bzhi ste/ sngar gong dge ba'i las dpag tu re da rnga/ byas kyang 'chi khar mi dge bas mtshams sbyar na ngan song du 'gro ba cho sa rgyal myang ngan med lta bu yin/ gzhan yang deng sang bshad sgrub kyi chos lugs 'ga' zhig gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen las kyi mtha' log nas 'gong por skyes pa mang du mchis pa 'di rnams lta bu/ yang sngar gong sdig pa 'ba' zhig la spyad kyang 'chi khar

gzhung 'grel/ 345dge bas mtshams sbyar na bde 'gro thob pa yul 'phags rgyal gyi rngon pa lta bu dang / deng sang yang sdig can 'ga' zhig 'pho ba sogs kyis mtshams sbyar bas mi lus thob nas skye ba 'chad pa lta bu/ yang sngar gong dge sdig gi las cher bsags pa med kyang 'chi khar dge bas mtshams sbyar na bde 'gro thob pa yul ka shi ku'i rgyal po tshangs/ sbyin gyi bran mo lta bu/ yang sngar gong dge sdig cher ma bsags pa 'chi khar mi dge bas mtshams sbyar na ngan 'gro 'gro ba sogs lta bu ste/ tshul des na bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs yin te/'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed / /skad cig gcig la rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ zhes so/ /'di gzhi dang dal/ra nag zang thal 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/ 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor stobs che zhing 'phen pa drag pas mtshams sbyor de'i dge sdig bi las zang thal du lus rten phyi ma der byung la/ snga gong bsags pa'i las dkar nag gi 'bras bu chud mi za bar rim gyis zang thal du 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ gang du phyin kyang las kyis mi brji ba'i/ /sa phyogs
