346 dgongs gcig nyin snang /de ni yod pa ma yin te/ /zhes sogs gsungs so// gsum pa tshe ma 'phos kyang lus 'gyur ba bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs ni/dge tshul klur gyur pa dang / shud ke ban rgan rgya mtsho'i slob mas klu bsgrubs pas klur gyur pa lta bu yin no/ /de lta na sems dang / las dang / 'bras bu gsum gyis bsdus pa bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs yin te/ gsum tshogs kyi rten 'brel las 'byung ba dran pa nyer bzhag nas gsungs pa ri mo mkhan gyi dpar dang 'dra bar gsungs pa gnad zab pa yin/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos/ rje phag (mo gru pa'i snang ba rang sems kyi khrod nas nga 'bus bsam pa'i rang rnga/zugs 'di rnyed pa yin gsungs des na rgyu 'bras mthong chos su 'byung ba dang / skyes nas dang / lan grangs gzhan myong ma nges pa sogs h+pho / ba'i phan yon gsum gyis kyang bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs 'di nyid 'byung ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ji ltar skyes pa'i zo chun rgyud/ /rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na/ /thams cad cig car 'gul bar lta/ /skad cig ye shes de bzhin no/ /zhes

gzhung 'grel/ 347sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i gsung 'dis snang ba rang sems gsal por bstan pa yang yin no/ //bzhi pa ni/ gshes la mi gnas na bltas pas mi 'gyur bya ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang / rten 'brel rgyu 'bras shes bya'i gshis dang 'gal ba dang / dpal chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma rig pas kyang 'di mi 'grub pa dang / rang blo 'khrul pa la tshad mar byas pa log shes yin pa ste/ rgyu mtshan 'di bzhi pos gsung 'di grub pa yin la de yang chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa'i gshis mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dang / de'i gnad kyis rang sems kyi gshis babs las gzhan du ma gyur bas yod pa la med pa dang / med pa yod par bltas kyang mi 'grub/ me la brlan gsher dang / chu la tsha sreg gi gshis/ med pa dang / sa la g.yo ba dang / rlung la sre brtan gyi gshis med pas/ de rnams go zlog nas de ltar blta sa kyang don byed de mi 'grub/ mthong khung la kum bur bltas nas bsdad kyang gshis de med

348 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pas g.yang la rdeg 'chos pa las 'os med/ dug la sman du bltas nas zos kyang srog 'dor la/ dge bas bde ba dang / mi dge bas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba yang gshis yin/ de go log tu bltas kyang bsgyur du mi btub/ rgyu 'bras de ni mtho ba sa bcu pa sogs la yang bsla med da 'ong ste/ 'khor los bsgur rgyal nga la na lta bu yin/snab sa ༄ 4 da dro ༄ 4 4lag shas kyang ma 'grub pa lags skar gyas sangs rgyas 'gra ba mag skor mkhan du bltas kyang gshes la mi gnas pas der 'gyur mi srid kyang / kho rang log rtog des dmyal bar song ba yang de yin /yang grub pa thob pa rnams kyis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa rnams 'gal ba ltar snang ba zhe na/ de yang don dam du 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems las gzhan du med cing rang sems spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems la dbang bsgyur ba'i gshes kyis de ltar nus pa yin/ gshes de rgyu yin pas rgyu la 'bras bu bsgyur du mi btub pas/ 'dul ba lung las/ gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi byed kyis 'dod na rgya mtsho chen po sbrang rtsir bsgyur btub pa'ang rgyu

gzhung 'grel/ 349sngon song gi 'bras bu bsla med da 'byang ba rgya 'bras kyi gshis yin/ba sdu ga ༄ tremado sde las brgya pa las/ dge slang sgur chung gis thal skyag sbrang rtsir bsgyur ma btub pa rgyu sngon du ma song ba'i gshis yin/ des na gsung 'di ni chos 'khor tshoms kyi gshes sam babs kyi skabs dang /dkar nag zang thal gyi skabs sogs su lung rig mang du bshad zin pas 'dir dpe don tsam bstan pas go bar byos shig //lnga pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla mas yon tan bskyed par mi nus zhes pa ni/ slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan skye bar byed pa la rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa las 'byung gi/ rgyu'i gtso bo ni bla ma mtshan ldan dang slob ma dad ldan yin te/dus 'khor brdzus rgyud las/ nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ /slob mcho rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas las sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de nyid dmyal

320 dgongs gcig nyin snang /ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/ /zhes pas mtshan ldan las log pa'i bla ma ni bsten par bya ba smos ci dgos dmyal ba bzhin du spang byar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bla ma mtshan ldan min kyang sngar ma brtags par gdams pa zhus zin la log par bltas nas phyos bla ma mtshan ldan la gtugs nas mos gus sogs phun sum tshogs kyang sngar nyams pa'i nyes pas yon tan mi skye ba nag shod rgyal 'byung lta bu yin pas /des na chos kyis ma 'brel gong du dpon slob legs par brtags nas gzod 'brel par bya yi/ 'brel pa thogs zin nas spangs na mtshan ldan yin yang rung min yang rung rtsa ltung dang por 'gyur bas thog ma nyid nas brtag pa gal che ba ni mdo sngags kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no/ / /drug pa ni/ rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs mos gus kho nar nges bya ba ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan yang / slob ma'i rgyud la dad pa med na yon tan mi 'byung ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/

gzhung 'grel/ 324bskal pa dus gsum thams cad dung/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /srog chags bye ba'i tshe bskyabs pas/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi thob ste/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma la// dwangs ba'i yid kyis mnyes byas na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la nges par thob/ /ces dang / mgon po byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pa yis mthong ba med//ces dang / mgon po 'khri gung pa chen pos/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma yang / /chos sku'i 'du shes ma bskyed na/ /sems nyid rtogs pa'i kha lta yang / /rang dang gong mas khrel bar zad/ /ces dang/ til+li pas/mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga mnyes byas//zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo mos gus yin par bzhed do/ //bdun pa ni/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/grub mtha' lung rig bshad pas gtan la phab pa'i gnas lugs kyi

322 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lta ba ni go yul tsam yin la/ nyams su blangs pas rang rgyud la spros med mtha' bral gyi rtogs pa skyes pa ni lta ba mtshan nyid pa rtogs pa la dgongs te/ de yang rang re'i brgyud pa 'di lung rig gis gtan la phab pa'i ngo bo rang gzhan stong par khas blangs kyang / mtshan 'dzin bden zhen gyi sgrog gis bcings pa'i lta ba de 'dra ba mi bzhed de/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas//lta ba thams cad spong ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa/ /gau tam de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / rje mi la ras pa la lta ba gang yin zhus pas/ nga la lta ba med ces gsungs pa lta bu dang /yum las/ sems ni sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o/ zhes dang / mgon po phag mo gru pas/ lta ba'i mthar thug blta bya lta byed bral/ zhes gsungs pas/ rang re'i brgyud pa 'di ni lta ba zhes pa'i tha snyad spyir mri 'dogs la/ 'dogs na yang gnas lugs nges pa don gyi snying po 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug ye shes kyi rang ngo rtogs pa la lta ba tsam du ming 'dogs

/ri gzhung 'grel/ 323kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i mtha' bral mthar lhung gi lta ba de 'dra ba mi bzhed pa yin no/ / /brgyad pa ni/ chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa bya ba ni/ dang po dbu ma chen po'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba rang gzhan stong pa'i lugs 'di gnyis kyang sems kyi mngon rtogs la ma reg ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ yod dang med ces rgya ba mtha' yin te//de bzhin gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha'/ /de phyir mtha' 'di dag ni rnam spangs nas/ mkhas pan/ dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag rgya chen po chos thams cad dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs gsal stod du 'dod pa des kyang sems kyi mngo na rto gas la ma reg ste/ sdud pa las/ phung 'di stong zhes rtog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' de/ /mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad mi bya/ /zhes so/ /rdzogs pa chen po chos thams cad ma rdzogs pa med pa de las gong du yang 'gro rgyu med pa snang ba la bdag tu bzung ba des kyang sems kyi mngon rtogs la ma reg ste/ mgon po phag mo

324 dgongs gcig nyin snang /gru pas/ gsar ma'i rgyud bzhi rnying ma'i theg pa dgu/ /yang dag kun rdzob sa bcu'i rim pa ste/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i dpe ni khyung chen bzhin//phyag rgya chen po'i dpe ni mtshon du mde/ /dpe yis mtshon na 'dus byas rkyang pa yinang/ /zhes so/ /'o na de gsum las gzhan pa'i sems nyid mngon par rtogs pa 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa de gang yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snga ma de gsum ni blos byas las ma 'das pa dang chen po'i 'dzin stangs can dpe dang tshig gis gzhal bya blos byas kyi stong pa nyid yin pas sems kyi mngon rtogs la kha yang ma reg mod/ 'dir blos ma byas/ 'dzin stangs las bral/ dpe med tshig gi yul las 'das pa yin te/ slob dpon shān+ti de bas/don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin pa 'dod/ /ces blo las 'das pa de yang so ma ma bcos lhug pa gsum du gzhag pa ste/tog tse pas/ so ma gnyug ma rang babs 'di/ /blo 'das phyag rgya chen po yin/ /zhes dang / sa ra has/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad/ /tshor drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces dang / slob

gzhung 'grel/ 32 ṣadapon rat+naXn+tis sbyor ba bzhis lha la bstod pa las/ rmi/ bar / r+ya brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin / /ma skyes mi 'gag nam ma/ po'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ dus spro /sum rgya/wa jigaci yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes/ dang / rje sgam po pas/ rgya gar yang ma chad/ ris gar yang ma lhung / sgo gar yang ma 'apo/bas/ rten gar yang ma bcas/ phugs gar yang ma gtad / phyogs gar yang ma gtogs/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ brjod pa lha/nga gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ ming ji skad kyang thogs la thong / sgom byung gi shes pa zhig gtsigs su che/ zhes gsungs pa sogs lung rig du ma'i sgo nas gtan la phab ste/ don gyi cha nas chen po gsum yang mthon po'i 'dzin stangs dang ma bral bas bdag 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir 'ga' zhig gis/ la la grub thob ngan zhes zer//rtogs ldan bzang ba yin no lo/ /zhes pa nas/ nged kyi grub thob de 'dra min/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / rtogs ldan mtshan nyid 'di yin zhes/ /mdo rgyud kun las gsungs pa med/ /des na rtogs ldan blun

326 dgongasagaciganyinasna nga/ po la/ /gragaso kyi mkhas pa rnams la min/ /zhes pa nas/ mdo rgyud ༷na dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar rmi lam nges bstan gyi lung yin rgyu ṅge dang bcas bshad mod/ rnam par 'khyams te/ grub thob ces pa rtogs pa dang ldan pas grub pa thob pa yin mod/gtsang btsan dang pe har sogs 'gabre pa la grab thob mi zer/ grab 7 7 4 7 ༄ ༄4 4 bathab dang rtags ldan na phyags las rnam rgyal gya spyad pa la zhugs pa sogs gang du 'khor 'das phyag rgya chen por rtogs shing snang ba rang sems su rtogs pa la rtogs ldan zer/ des rtogs pa mthar phyin pas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang grub pas grub thob zer gyi/ deng sang ri khrod du sdod nus pa tsam dang / bya ba cung zad 'bad nas btang ba tsam dang / sems ngo 'phrod pa'i ming tsam gyi stong lta tad po'i rbad gam che ba dang / lha med 'dre med kyi spyod pa bya ba des 'gro ba rnams blo khrid pa sogs la grub chen pa zhes deng sang yon bdag rnams kyis blun dad kyis btags pa la yul de rang yang bdag gir 'dzin cing zog pori gya nom grub thob tu zhen pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can mang po

gzhung 'grel/ ri327'di ni kho bos kyang mig gis mthong zhing rna bas thos mod/ ('on te 'di rnams ni khyi rgan sog po la seng ge dkar mo zhes btags pa dang khyad par rdul tsam yang med do/ /rtogs ldan gyi mtshan nyid mdo rgyud nas ma gsungs na/ zla ba sgron mas zhus pa'i mdo las kyang gsungs shing / glang po rtsa gyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyange / 'jam dpal rtogs pa zhes bya ba ni skye ba med pa la bzod pa'i tshig bla dwags so/ /zhes so/ /khong dag go nyams rtogs gsum la ska da dod po sdoḥ zhes pa byung bas rab 'bring tha ma gsum du 'jog mo thub gsungs pa skad dod de bsams pa 'dra na yang / gzhan du na go ba'i skad dod po sdoḥ zhes go ba dang yod pa byang ba dang blo la chub pa sogs la de ltar yang bshad don skabs thob tu bsgyur ba dang /nyams la ras zhes pa gar gyi nyams la nirta ras zhes gar gyi nyams sam gar gyi ro zhes bsgyur ba dang / yang ga ti rtogs pa'i skad dod du snang ba sogs legs sbyar gyi skad la sgra gcig don mang dang / don gcig sgra mang sogs mtha' yas pa rnams lo tsā bas

328 dgongs gcig nyin snang /skabs thob tu gang babs bsgyur ba las 'khrul pa med de gsung rab rgya chen po la bltas pas shes pas 'gyur la/ mdo du mar yang byang sems kyi yon tan smos pa'i tshe dran pa dang ldan pa/ blo gros dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang /mdo sde rgyan du de rnams byang chub sems dpa'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad la/ bsgoms pa'i nyams myong zag bcas dang zag med du 'dod pa ni rgyud las kyang dpe don gyi ye shes su btags pa ltar yin la/ des na rtogs pa don gyi phyag rgya chen po de rgyud la ldan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de zag med kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir rtogs ldan zhes bzhed pa yin no/ yang khong dag gis/ rnal 'byor bzhis lam dang sbyor ba chos mthun tsam bshad na 'gal ba med/ don du mi 'thad ces rmi lam nges bstan gyi lung drangs pa de'i dpe la bshad pa yang ches mi 'thad de/ rnal 'byor bzhis lam dang sbyor tshul lung rig nyams myong du mas gtan la phab pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed srol mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams la bston du

gzhung 'grel/ 329med pa'i phyir 'dir yi ges ngal bas ma spros so/ / /dgu pa ni/ thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi stong nyid shor gol yin bya ba ni/ thos bsam bsgom pas gzhal ba'i sgom nyams su ji lta ba gnad ldan du ma lon pas shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum du song ba ches mang ste/ dang po shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa ba rnams/ /rig pa sems pa'i shes rab kyis// phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar rnams/ /gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs kyis/ mi/bshigs nas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur/ /stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang / /zhes pa'i don lta bsgoms pas gshis la shor ba dang / gsang sngags pa 'ga' zhig shu dzñā'i sngags kyis phyi nang rnams/ /stong nyid spros bral nam mkha' ltar/ /byas nas de la blo bzhag pas/ /zhes sogs brjod bya de'i yul bzung ba'i yul dang /'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa dang rnal 'byor pa rang nyid dang gsum blos stong bar byas nas gnyis med rdo rjes dag par byas pas bzung 'dzin yul yul can las ma 'das pas gshis la shor ba'o/

()(spre() darngo/ngarngotheg nga 4)tha /snizugashā/nga /— — gnyis pa/ rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ bka' gdamaṅge pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ dngos po rdzas kyi phung po lta bu zhig la/ dngos med de'i g.yogs lta bu zhig gis bkab pa dang 'dra bar/ 'di ni 'khor gsum yin pas dngos por byas na dngos med 'di 'dra zhig gi rgyas rtsa btab na mi 'ong snyam nas rgyas btab pas de yang dngos po dang dngos med gnyis su song zhing dngos po la dngos med kyi rgyas btab pas rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// gsum pa/ gnyen por shor ba ni/ bsam bsgom pa 'ga' zhig nyon mongs skyes dus slar de la brtags shing de spong byed kyi gnyen por slar stong nyid bsgoms pas gar song cha med du song ba la 'di lta ste/ rnam rtog skyes byung yang dran rtse gnyen po rgyabs pas rang grol du song zer ba sogs/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs kyi steng du gnyen po'i rnam rtog bsnan nas rtog pa'i rtsags cha/ brtsegs pas sgom spang gnyen gnyis med du ma song bar/ spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis su song bas sgom gnyen par shor ba'o/ /bzhi pa lam du shor ba ni/ lam dus su stong nyid bsgoms pas 'bras bu

— gzhuXkhaXgrel/ 33ga chos skye zer ba'i bzang po zhig logs nas thob tu re ba/ dper na yid bzhin gyi nor ba rin po che kur+sha pa ṇa dang bsdar ba lta ba phre/rang bzhu rangasgom lam 'bras dbyer med du ma song bar lam 'bras tha dad du bzung bas lam du shor ba zhes bya'o/ /gol sa dang po 'dod khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blangs pa'i tshe bde bas lus sems gang ba lta bu byung ba la zhen cing chags pas bskyangs pas 'dod khams su gol/ gnyis pa gzugs khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blangs pas gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu phyi nang zla ba shar ba lta bu/ mig phye btsums khyad med pa byung ba la zhen chags kyis bskyangs pas gzugs khams su gol/ gsum pa gzugs med khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blangs pa'i tshe phyi nang gang du bltas kyang rtog pa phra ba tsam yang med par rdul bral chos skur rtogs pa 'dra ba yang 'ong bas de 'dra ba la chags zhen gyis bskyangs pas gzugs med pa'i khams su gol/ gol sa can gyi rtogs pa de gsum la yun bskyangs nas bsgoms pas gol sa gsum du gol ba'i rjes su ngan song

332 dgongs gcig nyin snang /gsum sogs su skyes par gsungs la/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ mgon po phag mo gru pas zhen pa dang bral ba'i nyams gsum po bsgoms na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang thob srid bya ba srid mtha' ma bkag par gda' ste/ ngas logs su zhus pa la ni gtan mi srid gsung pas/ mdor na nyams byas pa'i chos yin mod/ nyan rang gi lam ni 'gog pa'i bden pa dang // rten 'brel lub/ru/ zlog yin pas de thob pa mi srid do/ /rgyas pa'ang srid ces pa de/ mdor na mi srid pa'i gsung du mchi'o/ /zhes gsungs pas thos pas stong nyid bco brgyad byang bar byas shing / de la bsam pas rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas stong tshul 'di 'dra'o snyam pa de nyid bsgoms pas rtogs bya dpyad bsgom las gzhan med pas de ni blos byas kyi bdag 'dzin las ma 9redas te/ slob dpon ye shes snyi/nga pos/sgye me0de ces dang stong zhes dang / /bdag med ces dang stong pa nyid/dman pa'i yid kyis gang bsgoms pa/ /de ni 'di na bdag bsgom pa'o/ /zhes so/ /zab mo phyag rgya chen po mtha' bral gyi bsgom ni de

gzhung 'grel/ 333'dra ba'i gzhal bya ma yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min teng/ /don dam phyir na bsam pas min/ /chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ /sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //bcu pa ni/ rtogs pa goms par byed pa sgom pa yin bya ba ni/ yon tan rgyud ldan gyi bla mas dad ldan gyi slob ma la nyams myong gi steng nas ngo sprad pa slob mas rtogs pa la rtogs pa zer/ gang rtogs na chen po gsum sogs mthon po'i 'dzin stang sa can gyi dri mas ma gos pa'i rang byung gi ye shes tha mal gyi shes pa de nyid yin te/ dzi skad du/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la/ de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs/ zhes gsungs pa'i don yin/de nyid rtogs na skyon med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum sogs shor gol du ma song bar gong du rtogs pa'i ye shes de nyid la goms shing 'dres par byas nas bzo med du skyong ba la bsgom zer ba ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ bsgom pa ma yin goms pa yin/ /goms pa

334 dgongs gcig nyi na snang / ri klong du gyur pa yin/ /goms de bdag la rag lus pas/ /rgyun chad med par mnyam par gzhag /ces so/ /de lta bu'i sgom de ni bzo bcos dang bral ba'i gnyug ma de nyid skyong ba ste/ de la rtse cig tu gnas na rnam par g.yeng ba'i dbus su dben pa la khyad med de/ lung phran chigs las 'phags pa gtu ya na lta bu dang / ma yengs par nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa ni sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa yin la/'di la gnas na gzhan gsum po 'di'i khongs su 'du'o/ /'di la nang du yang dag 'jog pa zhes pa ni/ bde mcho ga rtsa rgyud las/ yid ni nang du chud gyur pas/ /gang 'dod pa yi dngos grub thob/ /ces so/ /des na ma yengs pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la brten nas yang dag pa'i spong ba bzhi sogs rgyud la skye zhing des byang phyogs so bdun sogs ༷rkir po'i yon tan mtha' dag ting nge 'dzin 'dis bskyed pa yin te/mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lam de/ /dus rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir nag po'i phyogs 'joms shing spange ba dang / dkar po'i phyogs thoms cad 'phel ba dang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sdud par byed pa ni ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid las gzhan nyams su blang bya ci yang med de/ rje

———————— tshonaX/ngange 9)༷/95/ ()()(5 phag rme gru pas/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs 6pe/ /re 'dod spongs la sems la ltos/ /sems la lta dang ma bral na/ /stobs bcu ma 'dres bco brgyad dang / mi 'jigs bzhi la sogs pa yi//sangs rgyas yon tan ma lus pa/ /bar do dang por 'ong bar nges//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //bcu gcig pa ni/ spyod pa blang do ra dang bral ba tshul khrims rin po che yin bya ba ni/ chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa de'i spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba ni tshul khrims rin po che yin te/ sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad blang du med pa ye nas dgag bcas/ dge ba thams cad dor du med pa ye nas sneb bcas/ de 'dra ba'i tshul khrims ni chags sdang spangs pa spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba'am/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu kun 'byung mi len/ thar pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam bslab pa gsum mi 'dor ba dang / chags pa mi len sdang ba mi 'dor ba sogs kyi don yin pas na/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ blang dor med pa'i spyod pa de// chags sdang med pa'i

336 dgongs gcig nyin snang /lus ngag yin/ /go ba 'dzol na 'khor bar 'khyams/ /zhes so/blang dor zhes pa ni chags sdang dang bral ba la dgongs pa ste/ zas gcig pu la mtshon na/ nyan thos rnams kha zas 'tsho ba'i sman gyi ched du ste/ kyā ri ka las/ bru ba'i nad las ldog pa'i phyir/ /bza'o snyam pa'i sems kyis bza'/ /zhes chags sdang dang bral bar gsungs pa dang / byang sems kyi kha zas lus kyi srin bu stong phrag brgyad cu sogs la phan pa'i sems kyis bza' dgos par byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams nas gsungs la/ gsang sngags pas ni lus kyi lha gdan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams la nang gi sbyin bsreg tu 'bul te/ ji skad du/ bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba dang //ji ltar rnyed pa bsten par bya/ /yid 'ong ma 'ong rnam rtog phyir//zhes pa tsam du mi bya'o// zhes so/ /mdor dril na dge ba mi spang sdig pa mi 'dor zhes pa'i don min gyi/ mchog dman bar ma gang la yang dge ba la chags shing mi dge ba la sdang ba'i bsam pa med pa zhig yin la/ de yang lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa des bsgrubs pa'i

gzhung 'grel/ 337spyod pa ni don snying por gyur pa bslab pa rin po che gsum chags sdang med pa'i sgo nas spyod pa yin te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang zhig chos 'di thos nas chags byed cing / /chos ma yin pa mthong na khong khro skye/ /nga rgyal dregs pa bcom na legs pa ste/ /nga rgyal dbang gis sdug bsngal rjes su myong / /zhes gsungs pas mdor na zas spyod gnas mal nyams len gang la'ang dga' ba'i sgo nas chags pas blang ba dngab mi dga' ba'i sgo nas sdang zhing spang ba med par bya ba gang byed thams cad chos lnga'i skya bar nas bton te 'bad zhes 'chad pa ni dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no/ //bcu gnyis pa ni/ lta sgom spyod gsum gcig pa yon gsung pa ni/ lta ba mtha' bral rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa de goms par byed pa sgo ma pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba/ de dang mi 'gal zhing mthun par spyod pa ni gong du bshad ma thag pa'i spyod pa chags sdang gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba ste/ de gsum ngo bo dbyer med cing nyams su blang ba ni tshul khrims rin po che ches rmad du byung

338 dgongs gcig nyinasnang /ba yin te/ rje phag mo gru pas/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum/ /rtogs pa gcig la tshang gyur na/ /'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la thob/ zhes dang /mgon po 'bri gung pas/ lta ba dang sgom pa spyod ba gsum/ — /gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /zhes gsungs pas de gsum dbyer med bsal bzhag med pa ni lta sgom spyod pa gcig cing phyin ci ma log pa yin la/ lta ba mtha' bral du khas blangs kyang sgom pa gzung 'dzin las ma 'das pa/ spyod pa chags sdang gi dbang du song ba la ni rdzogs byang gi skal ba yod pa ri bong ri rwa dang mtshungs par dgongs so /bcu gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims gcig pa ni 'dzig rten mgon po'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin bya ba ni/ rgyu mtshan bzhi ste/ dang po mtshungs par gcig pa ni/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i don ma go bas 'khor bar 'khor bas de'i rang bzhin shes dgos pa dang / bdag 'dzin spang ba dang /chags sdang spong ba dang / lus ngag 〈da gsum ga'i sgo nas bsrung ba

cha gzhung 'grel/ 339sogs gcig par nges te/ dzi skad du/ lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste//ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste//thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /zhes gtso bor sems bsruX dgos ba'i lung rig mang la/ gnyis pa phan tshun 'brel bar gcig pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du // yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin par gsungs/ /zhes dang/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'di na shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ /rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin kun gyi gzhing/ /de bzhin chos rnams ma lus kun gyi yang //gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa/byed pa'i las gcig pa ni spyir dug gsum gyis kun slangs kyi mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba'i las lam thams cad sgrub par gcig la/khyad par stong nyid rtogs na rgyu 'bras su sdang ba'i gnad kus kyang gcig ste/ dzi skad du/ ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyis rab bsdam ste//lus kyis mi dge ba dag mi byed cing / /zhes sogs gsungs pas byed pa spang blang yang gcig bzhi pa gshis stong nyid du gcig pa ni so

340 dgongs gcig nyin snang /thar sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam rig min pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mtha' bral yang gshis stong pa nyid du chu dang chab rom ltar gcig ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ting 'dzin rgyal po stong pa 'di bsgoms pas//tshul khrims dag pa'i mgo la de 'dug ste/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong par mnyam gzhag nas/ /byas pa mi reg brtson pas mi shes so//zhes gsungs pas gcig par bzhed la/ tshul khrims de nyon mongs pa'i spros dang bral bas chos sku dang / nyon mongs pa stong pas stong pa/nyon mongs pa rnams dag pas rang bzhin rnam dag ces mdo sde rnams su gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa tha dad pa med pa nyid do/ / ri /bcu bzhi pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin bya ba ni/ gzhi dus su kham/sa rang bzhin rnam dag yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ lam dus su phar phyin lnga shes rab dang 'brel bas dge ba rgya chen po'i tshogs 'byung zhing mthong spang brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dang / sgom spang bzhi brgya bcu bzhi spong zhing / 'bras dus su kri gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid

gzhung 'grel/ 344'grub pa ste/ mgon po byams pas/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na/ /sdug la'ang skyo bar mi 'gyur zhingang/ /mya ngan 'das la 'dun pa dang / /don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las/ skye dang 'jig grol chos 'di thams cad las/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba gang na sgom byed pa/ /de dag 'chi med rgas nas na ba'ang med/ /ngan 'gro med cing mi sdug phrad pa'ang med//ces dang / de nyid las/ bdag po med cing byed pa med gyur pa//chos 'di thams cad stong par bsgoms nas su/ /smon pa spangs nas bla na med pa yi// byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin reg par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / —/bco lnga pa ni/ mnyam bzhag las yon tan thams cad 'byung bya ba ni/ sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pas/ de bla ma mtshan ldan gyi byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus kyi rten 'brel tshogs pas gdams pa'i gnad kyis spangs te/ de'i ngang la gnas pa la mnyam bzhag zer/ de las

342 dgongs gcig nyin snang /langs pa'i dus na nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skye ba rjes shes yin/mnyam gzhag de bskyangs pa'i yon tan ni mthar thug mthong lam thob nas yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs 'byung zhing / de las kyang mthar thug don gnyis 'grub pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa ste/ rje phag go gru pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu dag /sems skye med du gnas pa'i yon tan yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ //bcu drug pa ni/ rgyu ma bsgrubs na ni yon tan thams cad mi 'byung bya ba de sems ngo 'phrod tsam golta ci smos/ sa la gnas pa rnams kyis kyang sems can gyi don mdzad pa'am bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rnams bsgrub pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la sgrub dgos par gsungs la/ 'di dang mnyam gzhag kho na las yon tan thams cad 'byung ba 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'dir mnyam gzhag stong nyid dang rjes shes dngos 'dzin can du bsgrub pa ma yin gyi/ dper na nor bu rin po che la dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mthu yod kyang phyi ba gsum sogs byas te rgyal

gzhung 'grel/ 343mtshan gyi rtse mor btags te gsol ba 'debs dgos pa lta bu yin la/ rgyu bsgrubs na rjes shes su mi 'gyur ram rnyi/ma na mi 'gyur te/'phags pa sdud pa las/ bdag ni mnyam par gzhag ce'am langs zhe rlom sems 3/da/ /ces so/ /des na mnyam gzhag las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas sgrub dgos te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/nga la 'od zer yang yod de/ /de ming rnam dag mig ces bya/ /tshe dang longs spyod shes rab dang // nad dang khe nyan spang sems dang //sangs rgyas mar me mchod pas na/ /de phyir de las skyes pa yin//zhes gsungs pas/ mnyam gzhag las ma g.yos bzhin du tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs bya bar gnad zab par dgongs so/ //bcu bdun pa ni/ stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ldang bar bzhed pa ni/ stong nyid rtogs na chos thams cad kyi gshis babs rtogs pa yin/ chos thams cad kyi gshis babs ni dge ba'i gshes las bde ba dang / mi dge ba'i gshes las sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gnad kyis rgyu 'bras kho na'i spang blang du 'byung ste/

344 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rje mi las sgam po pa la 'gro chos su gsungs pa/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun mi bcad/ mar ngan song la dogs pa med kyang sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem/ zhes dang / yang rje btsun mi las/ stong nyid kyi bshad pa lung rig dang mthun mthun mo mang po byas rung stong nyid de bas kyang phra bas go ba dang yid ches pa dka'/ stong nyid la yid ches rting stong nyid rang rgyu 'bras su shar ba go nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len dge sgrub sdig spong la brtson du rang 'gro ba yin/ chos kun gyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa 'di yin pas sdig spong dge sgrub kyi phyag len la zhib pa dang brtson pa gal che/zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos nyid las kyi rnam smin med shes kyang / /dge dang mi dge'i las ni chud mi za// zhi bar gnas pa rang rgyal theg pa de/ /nyan thos rnam par grol ba'i sgra phyir 'brangs// zhes dang / rje phag mo gru pas/ kha lta rkyang par ma song zhing//snying nas rtsa ba chod gyur te// ro gcig gi ngang la 'byams gyur na //bu rgyu 'bras kun mngon du gyur pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i

gzhung 'grel/ 345phyir/ stong nyid rtogs na chos thams cad rgyu 'bras nyid du rtogs pa ni gshis sam babs so /bco brgyad pa ni/ rtogs ldan la thabs lam la sogs pa lhag par dgos zhes gsung pa ni/ rtogs ldan de mthong thos dran pas kyang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi zhing zhi lhag zung 'brel rgyud la skye nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul thams cad kyi rgyu bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi gtum mo bsgoms pas rtsa rlung thig le bsgom dgos par grub cing /sorges khongs kyi phar phyin bcus bsdus pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa shes rab chen po dang zung 'brel du nyams su blangs par stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi yon tan phrin las dbang bcu sogs 'byung ba'i phyir yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /zhes dang / rin chen them skas las/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ma thob par/ chos nyid rtogs kyang yon tan med/ /de bas gtum mo bsgom par bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag don du phyag

34ca dgongs gcig nyin snang / tshorgya chen po spros bral gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur kyang / gzhan don du yon tan dang phrin las tshad med pa 'byung ba'i phyir gtum mo sogs chos drug dang phar phyin bcu sogs la 'bad par bya dgos so/ //bcu dgu pa ni/ tshul khrims la gces spras su byed pa rig spyod khyad par du 'phags zhes gsung pa ni/ nyon mongs rnam rtog gi mtshan 'dzin brtul nas ye shes kyi stobs la zhugs pa la rig pa brtal zhags kyi spyod pa zhes bya la/ de ni brgyad pa 'di'i rnal ri7 ra ༷dri ra 'byar bzhi'i rtags pa gong na sa gong du na 'pho ba tshul khrims la bltos pa dang / sa bcu pa man chad la sgrib pa phra ba yod pa spong khyed du 'gyur ba dang / ngo tsha med pa tho co'i spyod rtsing ni bla'i/ dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa dka' bas khyad du 'phags pa dang / rgya gar gyi slob dpon klu sgrub sogs dang bod kyi rje sgam po pa sogs kyang rig spyod 'di mdzad pas phrin las che bar byung zhing / rdo rje 'dzin pa la yang dge slong dge tshul dge ba snyen gyi dbye bas rab 'bring tha mar 'gyur tshul ltar dang / mgon po 'bri gung pas/ nga 'bu rgya gar gyi grub thob

gzhung 'grel/ 347brgyad cu dang mnyam pa'i rtogs ldan 'di da lta rab tu byung ba'i tshul du byon pa nga 'bu pho rgod pa yin gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na nyams rtogs cher mnga' yang tshu la khrims dang lhan gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i rig spyod 'di bstan pa rnam dag gi nyams len du 'gyur gyi/deng sang 'ga' zhig brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa yin par khas 'che ba'i rus rgyan gyon/ khyi lugs dkres/ mtshon cha thogs nas rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod cing lus srog thed la 'bor ba'i rtogs ldan spyod pa lha klu thabs cad dkrugs shing phaṭa dang ku sgras lung pa 'gengs pa'i jo chol can byas pa don med khyi ltar 'khyams pa rnam/na/ kyi spyod pa brtul zhugs las ches 'phags pa'i phyir tshul de lta bur dgongs so/ //nyi shu pa ni/ /bhu su ku chos gsum med na zhi ba nyan rang yin bya ba ni/ bhu su ku zhes pa/ byuk+ta zas bza' ba/ susta gnyid log pa/ ku t+ta bshang ba 'dor ba steng/ de gsum las gzhan pa'i rnam g.yeng med par nyams len gyis dus 'da' ba'i rnal 'byor pa

348 dgongs gcig nyin snang / zhi ba'i lha dang / grub chen lu sī pa lta bu yin yang chos gsum po 'di dang mi ldan na zhi ba nyan rang dang 'dra la/ chos gsum ni/ dang po nyes pa'i spu ris mthong ba'i tshul khrims dgos la/ de med na yon tan mi thob bas slob dpon 'phags pa rdza bum la chags pa lta bu dang / slob dpon chos mchog gis phyag shing klad la bskor ba'i dpe lta bu yin pas tshul khrims gasrung dgos/ gnyis pa yon tan dgos par go ba'i bsgrub pa dgo/ pa ni/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis gdams ngag rjes su gnang ba thob nas gnas ri khrod sogs brten cing bsgrub pa'i brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa zhig dgos/ gsum pa tshad med snying rjes bskul ba'i gzhan phan ni gang la thug kyang sems can blos mi gtong zhing de'i don sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan pos gzhan don 'ba' zhig las bdag don spu rtse tsam yang lus ngag yid gsum la mi dran pa zhig dgos/ de gsum med na dzi ltar bzang yang zhi thab nyan rang dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos gsum ni sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu drung po med ka med kyi thabs yin pas cis

———— tshonapo//ngange (rwardo/nye/(ga / (3 44//byi kyang gal che/ de yang grub thob lu ā+o pa lta bu nges pa don gyi tshul khrims bsrung bya srung byed dang bral ba mngon du gyur cing stong nyid rgyu 'bras su mkhyen pa/ don sgrub pa'i spobs pa can stong nyid snying rjes gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ chos gsum nges pa don gyis tshang ba dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha ni chos de gsum ldan par khong rang gis brtsams chos de rnams kyis gsal ba yin la/ gzhan yang grub pa'i dbang sgyeg dam pa rnams ni chos de gsum ldan rung du yod pas don gnyis 'grub pa yin/ 'o cag rnams kyang phun sum tshogs pa ltar sems kyang chos de gsum dang mi ldan na don gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs go chod po mi 'ong bas de gsum cis kyang gal che ba la dgongs pa yin no// zhes/ khyad par lta bsgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don drug pa'o/ /

350 dgongs gcig nyin snang /7 /spyi don bdun pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga mchos pa las//dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bden pa gnyis su med bya ba ni/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems yin la sems ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nyid de/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'khor 'das kyi rang bzhin rtogs pas sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid mtha' bral zung 'jug de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas/ bden pa gnyis/ dbyings dang ye shes / chos dang chos can/ stong pa dang rten 'brel/ yod pa dang med pa sogs mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing /gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can yin te/ des na sangs rgyas kyi sar 'di ni kun rdzob bo/ /'di ni

gzhung 'grel/ 35gdon dam mo zhes rnam par dbye ba med de/ mtshan brjod las/gnyis med gnyis su med par ston/ /yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/ /zhes dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /rtog pa rgenyis dang yang dag bral/ gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa/ /de ni zung du 'jug par bshad/ /ces so/ /'ga' zhi ga gis/ chos thams cad kun rdzob tu yod don dam du med zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i khyad par las med de/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ gnyis 0su yod pa ma yin te/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa lang/ /mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes dang /rje phag mo gru pas/ e ma hoḥsems kyi rgyal po de/ /rtogs par gyur na mya ngan 'das/ /ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ste/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs ma lags pa/ /'bras bu thob dang mi thob med/ /ces gsungs so/ / /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho

352 dgongs gcig nyin snang /na zhes gsung pa ni/ chad pa lnga dang bral ba ste/ stong nyid dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i rgya chad/ nyan thos pa'i bcom chadang/ mu stegs chad lta ba'i shi chad/ blos byas kyi stong pa phyal chad/ rdzogs chen pa'i gdod nas ye chad/ de lnga po ma yin pa/ ye gdod ma'i shes pa de nyid rtogs pas mtha' gnyis dang bral ba/ bden don gnyis su med pa zab mo'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba ches phra ba gzhom gzhi ga dang bral ba mtha' dbus dang bral ba mtshan ma (was 'das pa mthar phyin pa ltar/ brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing sogs dang /mtshan brjod las/ gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang ba/ /rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pas/yod ces bya ba rtag par ltang/ /med ces bya ba chad par lta/ /de phyir yod dang med pa gnyis/ /mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang /ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te//de bzhin gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha'/ /de phyir mtha' 'di dag ni rnam spangs te/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o/

gzhung 'grel/ 353/zhes so/ ye shes de ni ngo bo mtha' bral zab gsal gnyis su med pa yin la/ de yang zung 'jug don dam pa'i phyag rgya chen po blo las 'das pa blos byas dang bral ba yin la/ gong du bshad pa'i lta ba lnga po ni blos gzhal ba'i chos las ma 'das te/ spyod 'jug las/don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni lakun rdzob yin par 'dod//ces sogs gsungs pa ni/ kho na zhes nges tshig kyang mdzad de don dam pa'i ye shes ni yod med sogs mtha' thams stad dang bral ba zab gsal gnyis med don dmu phyag rgya chen po blo las zhadas pa kho na yin gyi/ blos ni nam yang de'i phyogs yin pa mi srid do zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ / /gsum pa ni/ sgyi ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag par 'das zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ni spros pa'i mtha' thums cad dang bral ba'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de'i gnad kyis ye shes de yang sgyu ma zhes pa med bzhin du snang ba/ rnang ba ma nges pa'i nying 'khrul da lta nyid du 'jig pa'i chos can mi rtag pa yin la/ ye

354 dgongs gcig nyin snang /shes bden don blo 'das zab gsal phyag rgya chen po ni yul de lta bu las 'das pa 'khrul pa rtsad gcod/ 'jig bral rtag pa la sogs pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ye shes chen po yin te/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ chos kun sgyu mar thugs su chud/ /sgyu ma nyid kyang mchis ma lags/ /sgyu ma'i chos las rnam grol ba/ /mi rten khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas ye shes de ni sgyu ma lta bu sogs dpe thams cad kyis gzhal du med pa zhig go / /bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas dus rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dzi lta ji snyed kyi ye shes phul 'byung zhing / 'dus ma byas pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhan rkyen gyis mi rtog pa ste rang don du chos phun sum tshogs pa de gsum mnga' bas tshad mar gzhugs pa kho na las gzhan pa'i ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa sogs kyi phyir/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gang gsungs pa de bzhin te gzhan du mi 'gyur —

gzhung 'grel/ 355bas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi tsha da ma ste des ni mi bslu'o//zhes dang / phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ zhes dang / slob dpon phyogs glang gis/ tshad mar gyur pa 'asho la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi thugs skad cig ma gnyis pa tshun chad sgro 'dogs chod pa'i dpyad shes tshad mar mi dze'agyur zhes pa don min no/ / /lnga pa ni/ bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi thugs can bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid spang bya dang bral ba'i 'bras bu chos nyid ji lta ba dang / chos can dzi snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis brnyes pas rtag tu mnyam gzhag las ma g.yos shing rnam rtog mi mnga' la/ cir yang sa ler mkhyen pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing / rjes su 'jug pa thogs med du grub la/ bral 'bras kyi thugs la dre ma med

356 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pa'i sems su bzhag cing sems can chen po zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bgrang zhing / dri bcas rtog pa med pas sems med ces kyang btags te/ de 'dra ba'i thugs de nyid bral ba'i 'bras bu can te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral/ ting nge 'dzin kyang mi 'dod do/ /zhes so/ des na sangs rgas spyo thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes de la 'di dang 'dir rtog gi rnam rtog dang der 'dzin gyi shes pa med de/ rje phag mo gru pas/ terkang gnyis gtso bo snang ba med/ /ces so/ /rle na thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul gang la gang 'dul du ston pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/mgon po byams pas/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad la/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig car 'char/ /zhes gsungs so/ //drug pa ni/ chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas bya ba

gzhung 'grel/ 357ni/ spyir gzhi dur/ kyi ma rig pa nyid ngo bo chos sku'i byang chub las ma 'das te/ 'jam dpa' rnam rol las/ gzhi'i dus su ma rig pa nyid byang chub ste byang chub nyid ma rig pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ de 'dra ba'i rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku de sems can thams cad la yod pas sa bcu man chad du skyon spong zhing yon tan sgrub lugs mthun la/ sangs rgyas nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las 'byung tshul ni rnam pa thams cad du mi mthun te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos sku mthar thug brnyes pa'i tshe bral ba'i yon tan dang ldam pa las/ de'i rnam smin gyi yon tan longs sku dang / de'i phren las sprul pa'i sku yin/ chos sku de'i yon tan ni/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag las/ bsdus na drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / de yang bsdus na yon tan bzhi ldan du gsungs te/ mgon po byams pas/ thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi/ /rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas/ zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir/ /lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod/ /so so rang gi rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /zhes chos sku'i

358 dgongs gcig nyin snang /yon tan dang / ya/nga / de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen/ /lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba/ /nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro/ /zhes mdzad pa rnams gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo sogs nas chas par gsungs pa'i phyir chos sku zhes pa stong nyid ci med cang med du mi bzhed kyi/chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa skyabs kyi mthar thug pa ste/ mgon po byams pas/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste/ /thu ba pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ / /bdun pa ne/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na thugs bskyed yod bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la rang don du thugs bskyed pa ni thugs dang po bskyed pa nas tha ma'i bar du med la/ gzhan don du thugs bskyed pa ni 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du yod de/ yab sras mjal ba las// dpa' bo rnams ni thabs mkhas te/ /bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung chog

gzhung 'grel/ 359pa'i 'du shes bsal/ /dpa' bo chen po rnam par 'phrul/ /byang chub mchog tu thugs kyang 'jug /ces dang / mgon po byams pas /de yang sa gser zla ba me// zhes sems bskyed grogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba nyer gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma/ sgra brnyan chu bo sprin rnams so//zhes pa gsum sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed gsungs pa dang / yang mgon po byas pas/ sems bskyed sa mtshams kyis ba zhir dbye ba'i phyi ma/ de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes pang reng sangs rgyas ṣi sa'i thugs bskyed du gsungs pa dang / 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud gnyi ri med rnam rgyal las/ sems can sna tshogs 'dul don du/ /sangasargyas rnams ni yang dang yang / /sems bskyed 'gyur bas lam sbyong ste/mdzad pa du ma'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /rgyun mi chad par sems bskyed pa / /byang chub sems ni mi zad phyir/ /de phyir phrin las rgyun mi chad/ /ces sangs rgyas kyi sa'i thugs bskyed de ni phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i rgyur yang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ //brgyad pa ni/ thugs gcig pu'ang rtag chad kyi lta ba

360 dgongs gcig nyin snang / tshun chad du 'byung bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo brnyes pas sems can rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa dang yid kyi 'jug pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa de snyed du 'dul byed sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi 'jug pa yang sngon gyi smon lam rgya chen po'i mthus de snyed du 'byung ste/ mu stegs rtag pa dang chad pa'i lta bas 'dul ba la yang de dag gi sgor zhugs nas ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pas de dag dang mthun pa ltar mdzad nas/ gzod lam rnam dge tu dkri bar mdzad pa yin la/ de 'dra ba dri za rab dga' brtul ba'i gleng gzhis kyang shes shing / gzhan yang gsang bsam sogs las/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs sems kyi dmigs pa dang yang bral la/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa dang bsam pa'ang rab tu shes so//zhes dang / mya ngan 'das pa las/ long ba ma lags long ba ltar//zha bo ma lags zha bo ltar/ /byis pa ma lags byis tshul gyisang //sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams kyi

gzhung 'grel/ 36gdon mdzad kyang / /'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus// zhes gsungs shing / blo gros 'jug par rgyas par bshad pa bzhin gang la gang 'dul de la der ston gyi tshul gyis mu stegs byed kyi log lta la yang de 'dra bar bstan nas goms su bcug pa'i mthar sangs rgyas pa'i lam du gzhug pa'i blo gong nas gong du 'khrid par mdzad pa ni thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'o/ / /dgu pa ni/ shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed gsung pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pas gdul bya'i bsam pa dang khams dang dbang po dang bag la nyal mkhyen pas sems can phyi khams dang mnyam par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'ang de dang mnyam par ston cing / de yang so so'i las kyi bye brag gis sangs rgyas kho nar ston pa'i nges pa med pas gdul bya de nyid gdul ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ gdul bya dag pa la longs sku/ gzhan du mchog gi sprul sku/ dman pa rnams la bzo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku/ dman pa'i sprul pa/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/

362ja dgongasagacig nyin snang /tshajo sa pa/ brgya byin/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / gzhan yang dgongs par gyur na ngan song gsum dang sa chu rme/ rlung nam mkha' la sogs pa bem po'i rnam pas kyang de gdul ba sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad pa ni sngon gyi smon lam gang dzo'adul der ston gyi gshis babs yin la/ zas dang spos kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad pa dre ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo las// de bzhin gshegs pa spos mchog brtsegs kyi gleng gzhi lta bu ram̐ dang / gos kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa lta bu dang / 'dzig rten khams sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa dang ljon shing gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa chos kun bgro ba nas gsungs pa lta bu dang / 'dod chags kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa dge slong brtan pa'i blo gros dang / sprul pa'i bud med lta bu dang / zhe sdang gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad mthong na dga' ba mngon par 'phags pa brtson pa chen po zhes bya ba zhing der chos kyi 'khor

gzhunga'agrel/ /de lolo bskor bzhin pa nas sor phreng can du sprul pa lta bu dang / gti mug gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa 'od srung rdzogs byed lta bu dang /salha ṭa'i rgyud nas/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par gsungs pa dang / tha na rmye stegs byed rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang thabs la mkhas pa'i bya ba yin par byang sems spyod yul rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs shing / de ltar na sangs rgyas la don gyis 'gran pa'i gang zag 'byung mi srid de 'gran zla mi 'byung ba'i las bsags pa'i phyir dang /sangs rgyas dang das mnyam par byang ba'i ma stegs byed de rnamyog nga ga zhi༄ ༄ ༄ sangs rgyas nyid kyi thugs rjes de ltar snang tshul du bstan gyi/ don gyis mu stegs byed sangs rgyas dang dus mtshungs su 'byung mi srid de/mdo snga ma de nyid las/ gser gyi rgyal po yul gar byung gyur pa/ /de nas gyes pa'i phung po lcags mi 'byung / /gang du 'dren pa byang chub brnyes gyur pa/ /zhing der mu stegs can gyi tshogs mi 'byung / /yid bzhin nor bu rdo dang phrad gyur pa// bden pa'i tshul du nam yang

364 dgongs gcig nyin snang /'byung ba med/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen mu stegs can/ /zhing gcig tu ni nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir rdzogs byed sogs kyang snang tshul de 'dra na yang ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las tshul de 'dra bar bstan pa ste/ mdo de nyid las/ 'dim dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gzhan mu stegs can dang / spyod pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu gang dag snang ba 'di yang de bzhin ga shegs pa'i byin rlabs dang thabs la mkhas pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang gsal rgyal gyi bya ba rgan po 'dul ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyis bya ba gnyis pa mdzad nas btul ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing /'phags pa sdud pa las/ gang dag rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag chos ston dang // 'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang //mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ zhes dang / dkon mchog sgron ma las/ de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur/ sman dang

gzhung 'grel/ 365rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod sbyin snying po dang / /lam gol dong ba rnams la lam ston 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba dus la bab na byed par 'gyur la/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba zhes pa ni sems can la phan par mdzad pa yin la/ de yang grol ba chen po ye shes skad cig la 'char ba nas bsod nams cha mthun gyi las dang dge ba'i bsam pa cung zad bskyed pa yan chad sangs rgyas kyi bya ba yin par sdud pa'i lung gis grub pa ltar yin la/ des na shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'i gtam 'di la blor mi tshud pa'i na tsha mi dgos kyi/ don du shes bya la srid tshad sangs rgyas nyid las ma 'das te/ rgyud gsang ba'i snying po las/ srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas shing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi brnyes so// zhes pa'i gtam ngo mtshar che ba de ltar yang yod la/ de la yid dngangs par mi dgos

366 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pa'i sman ni 'di lta ste/ mdo las/ gang dri ma mtha' dag gi sbubs las ma grol ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la som nyi ma mchis pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku la som nyi ma mchis pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos kyi sku nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i rdul phra rab kyi bar ro nye ring med par khyab pa'i phyir/ sems can gyi khams rgyud la lta ci smos/ chos skus gar khyab der sems can gyi don dus las mi g.yel ba'i thugs rje chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bzhugs pas/ gdul bya dus la bab cing dgongs na sems ldan dang sems med dge ba'i bsam pa cung zad skyes pa yan chod yin la/ de skye ba'i rkyen du ma gyur ba'i shes bya ni gang yang med pa'i phyir dge sdig rnam pa gang gis kyang sems can sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad do zhes bya ba gtam snga ma de ga nyis thob pa'i tshe dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa'i sman a ka ra brgyad pa lta bu'o/ /de dag kyang dus la bab dgos pa ni/ chos kun bgro ba la sa/ 'di lta ste/ dpe ra na me ni shing thams cad la yod mod kyi /

gzhung 'grel/ 367rkyen dang rtsol ba ma tshang na ni 'bar zhing rang gi dgos pa rnams mi byed/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang shes bya thams cad la gnas mod kyi/ dad pa la sogs pa'i rkyen dang rtsol ba ma tshang na mi 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba rnams kyang mi mdzad do//zhes rgya cher gsungs pas so/ / /bcu pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sangs ma rgyas na sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi chos sku dang longs sku gnyis lta zhog mchog gi sprul sku thub dbang 'di nyid byang chub kyi snying por sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas klas pa'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas zhing gi rgyan ma lus pa bstan pa phyogs bcu'i sems can ma lus pas mthong bar mdo rgya cher rol par gsungs pa dang / phal po che dkas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul snyed la dbang bsgyur ba'i de'i bu grangs dzi snyed kyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs de dang mnyam pa la dbang byed pa'i so so'i 'khor

368 dgongs gcig nyin snang /tshogs grangs kyang de de tsam dang / 'khor re res 'dzig rten ri rab kyi rdul phra ba'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor de snyed dang mnyam pas bskor ba 'khor de dag re re stong gsum dang stong gnyis dang stong spyi phud dang / gling bzhi'i 'gyur tshad sngar ltar bgrangs nas rgyal po re re la 'khor de snyed/ 'khor re la mi'i 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu zhes sogs gsungs la/ de yang tshad dang ris su ma chad pa chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sangs rgyas par gsungs te/ mdo las/ tshangs pa ngas yongs su chad pa'i rnam pas tshad dang ldan par sangs rgyas pa ma yin gyi/ tshangs pa nga ni tshad med cing ris sum̐ mu chad pa'i rnam pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas de yang zhing 'dir 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa yin gyi/ nges pa don dam du sangs rgyas pa ni dus tshod 'di tsam zhes tshad gzung bar mi nus te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ bde bar gshegs pa ma lus phyogs zhing sangs rgyas yul rnams mtha' dag na/ /phra rab rdul gyi

gzhung 'grel/ 369rdul rnams bdog par gyur pa ji snyed pa/ /dpa' bo byang chub mchog rab dam par gshegs pa'i bskal pa de snyed de/ /'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni gzhan gyis bsnyad pa ma lags so/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ //bcu gcig pa ni/ rgyu med kyi sprul pa mi srid pas rang rgyud pa bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshe/ 'dul byed kyi rgyu ting nge 'dzin 'di zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugarag so zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/ yum rgyas par/ rab 'byor chos thams cad sprul pa ste kha cig nyon mongs pa dang / kha cig las dang / kha cig nyan rang dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul par gsungs te/ des na rgyu med pa'i sprul pa mi srid pa'i phyir rang rgyud par mi 'ong kha med la/rang rgyud pa zhes pa ni rgyu la ltos pa nyid du go bar bya yi/ tha mal pa'i rang rgyud pa dang 'di don mi gcig la/ rgyu zhes pa'ang rnam pa thams cad du 'gro 'ong dang bral ba'i byang chub chen po'i rang rtsal las gdul bya 'dul bar dgongs pa na de'i dbang po dang 'tshams

370 dgongs gcig nyin snang / pa'i 'dul byed kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'dir rgyu zhes btags pa ste/mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das/ /mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' zhing / /las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin kho na gsungs/ /lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba las/ chos thams cad ni rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba/ rkyen la rag las pa/ sred pa'i rtsa ba can/ smon lam gyis thog drangs pa'o/ /zhes so //'di dang spyod 'jug nas rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar mi rigs pa'i dpe zan dang mi gtsang ba la sbyar ba 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te 'di ni rnam pa kun tu dge sdig gi las su bzhed cing / cig shos ni rgyu de byed po gzhan gyis bsgyur bas rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba la dargongs pas so/ //bcu gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi sku yin bya ba ni/ chos sku rang bzhin gyis rnam dag brnyes pa dang / sngon thugs bskyed pa'i dam bca'i mthu dang / gdul bya dad pa can gyi snang ba ste/

gzhung 'grel/ 374mdor bsdu na rten 'brel de gsum mam/ rang don gsum gzhan don gsum brnyed pa'i rten 'brel las byung ba yin la/ rgyu snga ma gsum po tshogs pa'i rten 'brel med na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du bzhugs kyang mi mthong la/ de gsum tshogs na mthong ba lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las gleng gzhi gsungs pa lta bu yin te/mgon po byams pas/ ji ltar baiḍū'i sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char//zhes dang / yang de nyid kyis/ dag pa baiḍūr+ya 'dra yi/ /sems la sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu/ /de dag pa ni mi bzlog pa'i/ /dad pa'i dbang po brtas pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas ni tshogs pa de gsum gyi rten 'brel gyis mthong ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / gyi/bcu gsum pa ni/ smon pa las longs sku dang 'jug pa las sprul sku 'byung bya ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad blo'i khongs su chud pa'i smon sems rgya shin hūṃ che bas

372 dgongs gcig nyin snang / longs sku 'byung ba'i rgyu zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab cing sku la zhing khams thams cad snang ba nges pa lnga dang ldan pa de 'byung /sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du sgo gsum dge ba la bkol ba'i sems de las byung ba'i dge rtsa tha dad bsags pa las sprul sku tshad med pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan te/ bzang po spyod pa las/ nam mkha'i mtha ra thug gyur pa dzi tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /dzi tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes dang / sdong po brgyan spra las/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni sems can gcig gi phyir ni ma yin pa nas/ sems can brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i phyir ma yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du'o/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rdza mkhan yangs pa'i 'od kyis smon lam btab pa dang / rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis sangs rgyas mchod pa lta bu las sprul sku dang / 'jug pa'i dge tshogs kyis longs sku thob pa yang mi 'gal bas/ des na chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs dang / gzugs sku gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs

gzhang 'grel/ 373las 'byung ste/ chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs las 'byung bar klu sgrub kyis bzhed do// rdo rje'i gsung 'di dang / sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi sku bya ba dang / sprul pa thams cad rang rgyud pa bya ba dang / chos dbyings thams cad du sangs rgyas pa dang / 'di rnams gnad gcig pa phan tshul 'brel ba can yin la/ de yang rdza mkhan dang rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis sangs rgyas mchod pa sprul sku dang / 'jug pas/ longs sku thob pa'i spyi bzhed dang / de gcig pu yang ma nges pas smon pa las longs sku dang 'jug pas sprul sku thob pa bye brag khyad par gyi bzhed pa'o/ //bcu bzhi pa ni/ sku gsum tha dad med par bzhugs bya ba ni/ chos sku gtsang bdag bde ba rtag par mgon po byams pas gsungs pa dang / longs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa 'khor 'das kyi yon ta na thams cad dang ldan par gser 'od kyi sku gsum ston pa'i longs sku'i skabs dang mngon rtogs rgyan las bshad pa dang / de gnyis dbyer med kyi phrin las sprul pa'i skur ston pa yang mngon

374 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rtogs rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji sred bar/ /zhes sogs dang /sku gsum tha dad med pa ni/ mgon po byams pas/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyisang zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ ngo bo chos sku las rnam pa gzugs sku gnyis su snang ba'i phyir chos sku nyid las med pas/ des na nyon mongs dag pa'i rang gzugs chos sku/ de mtshan dpes brgyan pa longs sku/ gang la gang 'dul du snang ba sprul sku yin pas tha dad med pa nyid do/ //bco lnga pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad sems can gyi —khams rgyud la bzhugs bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang por sems bskyed pa nas bzung / byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad de ye shes brnyes shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / bstan pa gnas pa sogs thams cad sem sa can gyi don du mdzad pa las gzhan du med pas zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs pa mi srid la/ zhi ba'i dbyings las gzhan pa ni 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can gyi khams rgyud de/dkon mchog rjes su dran pa las/ mya ngan las 'da' ba la mi

gzhung 'grel/ 375gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa zhes so// de yang khab mig gi nam mkha' ltar tshad brtsi ba min gyi/ sems can re re'i rgyud la yang de bzhinag gshegs pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par tshul ji ltar bzhugs she na/ mgon po byams pas/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes dang /de'i snga 'grel las/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir/ /rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med phyir// sangs rgyas rigs la de 'bras nyer btags phyir/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas snyi/nga po can du gsungs/ ra/zhes dang / 'o na bzhugs tshul dzi lta bu snang tshul sngi lta bu zhe na/ dri skad du/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid//gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltar gnas/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ gcig pu rnams la du ma'i brdar mdzad do//zhes so/ de ni thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas rang gi khams rgyud la

3 6 — —————— ge ——— dgod dzi di caganyu na tram̐ zo bzhugs pa ya/nga ma dag pa med pa dag pa gnyis ldan du bzhugs te/mgon po byams pas/ sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs// ma 'brel thog ma med pa na/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med ni/ /thog ma rme/da par yin par brjod/ /ces so/ /de nyid las nyon shes sgrib kyis ba sgribs pas de nyid bsal bya ste/ /mgon po ma pham pas/sems can rnams ni sangs/ rgyas te// 'on kyang glo bur dre mas bsgribs/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas te/ /zhes so// sangs rgyas kyi ge thung ni sems can gyi kham/sa rgyud la dgongs kyi/ la la dag sangs rgyas/laspyan 'dren pa dang gshegs su gsol ba'i tshe bde ba can dang 'og min dang / mngon dga' sogs bzang po logs shig na spyan 'dren par sems mod/ de ni bdag gzhan tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dre ma las ma 'das modang dag pa'i khying dang dmyal ba la sogs pa dge sdig gi rang gzugs las gzhan logs su med pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/lcags sreg sa gzhi su yi byas/ mo/ tshogs de dag gang las/ byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang / /sdi ga sems yin par thub pas

gzhung 'grel/ 377gsungs/ /zhes pa dang / dre ma med par grags pa'i mdor/ zhing 'di shā ri'i bus mtho dman can sogs phal par mthong / sa ngas rgyas mya ngan med kyi zhing nas/ 'ongs pa'i tshangs pa ral pa can gyis gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gams kho na lta bur mthong ba la/ sangs rgyas kyis 'khor rnams la zhing 'di shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin po che'i rgyan bkod pa'i zhing dang 'dra bar bstan nas rnam ji/ kun tu dag pa'i ngor de ltar yod tshul gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ gzhan yang rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes bya ba sems can gyi khams rgyud yin te/ rgyu mtshan rang bzhin gyis zhes bya ba 'dus ma byas pa lhun gyis grub pa sogs kyi don yin la/ de sems can gyi khams bde gshegs snying po'i ming las gzhan min la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang sems can gyi khams rgyud de nyid la bzhugs pa ste/ mtshan brjod las//sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug/ sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs/ /sems can kun gyi dbang don shes/ sems can kun bh+ri yid 'phrog pa/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ sems can kun yid

378 dgongs gcig nyin snang /yul dang ldan// sems can kun gyi yid rig pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /de dag sems dang mthun par 'jug /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir mdor na nga dang gzhan du 'dzin pa'i dri ma med pa zhig dgos kyi/ gnyis 'dzin can rnams rdzogs byang thob pa mi sred do/ /zhes 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don bdun pa'o/ /

gzhung 'grel/ 379 7 /spyi don brgya da pa lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bzhi bcu rtsa bdun mchis pa las /dang po māṃ/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs bskyed ) pa nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar gzhan don kho na las gzhan gang du'ang mi 'da' ba'i gnad kyis yi ge dang / gsung dang / chos dang /sku mnyam zhing mtshungs pa kho na yin te/ laṅkar gshegs pa las blo gros chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni mtshungs pa rnam pa bzhi la dgongs nas 'khor gyi nang du gshegs nas 'di lta ste/ nga nyid de'i tshe de'i duse na log par dad sel dang / gser thub dang /'od srung du gyur to/ /zhes so/ /mtshungs pa bzhi ni/ yi ge mtshungs pa bud+dha zhes pa khong du chud pa dang sangs rgyas zhen sogs la 'jug

380 dgongasagaciganyinasnang/ da ——pa can/ gsung mtshungs pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ chos mtshungs pa byang chub kyi phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun/ sku mtshungs pa chos kyi sku las mi g.yo bar gzugs skus 'gro don mdzad pa/ des na chos thams cad kyi babs kyi gnas lugs stong nyid rten 'brel zung 'jug tu gcig pa'i phyir ro/ //gnyis pa ne/ theg pa dang grub mtha' thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel bya ba ni/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed la sogs pa thams ca da sangs rgyas tshogs gnyis goms pa phul du phyin pa'i rten 'brel kho na las ma 'das la/ de yang phyi nang gsang ba dang gang zag gi rten 'brel rnams yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan/'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad rten 'brel yin/ zhes dang / dzi skad du/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi//gsung gi mdzad kyi gces pa zab mo ste/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i

gzhung 'gral/ 384phyir ro/ //gsum pa ne/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gsungs bya ba ni/ chos kyi phung po'i rnam gzhag dang grangs nges ni gzhan gang gis kyang mi 'byed de/ nyon mongs pa'i grangs dang de'i gnyen por de'i gangs su gsungs te/rnam snang mngon byang las/ nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /zhes so/ des na spyir rags pa la nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa tsam byas kyi/ dbye na sems can gyi khams rgyud la nyon mongs phra rags grangs las 'das pa'i gnyen pos zhes phung yang gangs las 'das la/ des na nyon mongs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa'i gnyen por chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba spros bral phyag rgya chen po bstan te/ dzi skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa/ /chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab//ces gsungs so/ /

382 dgongs gcig nyin snang //bzhi pa ni/ gsung rab yan lag bcu banyis po /gcig gi nang du'ang bcu gnyis po thams cad ci rigs su tshang bya ba ni/dper na mdo sde lta bu'i nang du thog mar gleng gzhi gsungs pa dang /de nyid kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tshigs su bcad pa dang / de dbyangs kyis bsnyad cing/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang sems sogs lung ston pa dang /dag pa'i zhing gzhan dang de'i ston pa la ched du brjod pa'i tshul dang /bdag gzhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang / de 'dra ba gsungs pas de lta bu byung ba dang / rang dang gzhan gyi skyes rabs gsung pa dang / de nyid tshig don shin tu rgyas pa dang / don gtan la 'bebs pa dang /rmad du byung ba'i chig sogs chol por 'dres cane chadu tshang bas na ci rigs su tshang ba ste/ bskal pa bzang po sogs la yang don gyis ci snogs pa tshang ba'i phyir ro/ //lnga pa ni/ sdi snod re re bzhin du sde snod gsum char 'dus bya ba ni/ ston pas sde snod gsum 'dres can du gsungs kyang sdud pa pos rnyed sla ba sogs rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig la bsams nas

gzhung 'grel/ 383so sor bsdu bar mdzad kyang / 'dul ba'i nang du mdo sde dang mngon pa'i tshig don ches mang ba bzhugs la/ de bzhin du mdo mngon gnyis la yang 'dul ba sogs ci rigs pa 'dres can du yod de/rgyu mtshan 'khor lo gsum gyi tshig don 'dres can du gsungs pa sngar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dres can nyid du bzhugs pa go sla'o///drug pa ni/ bka' thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshang ba dang / /bdun pa ni/ 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lngas bsdus bya ba ni/ 'di la spyir 'khor 'das gnyis tha dad med par rtogs ma rtogs su bzhed pa dang / rdo rje gur las ye shes kyi bye brag 'gro ba rigs drug kur dngos bstan du gsungs pa dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba rnams 'gro ba rig drug so so'i gnas su ngo bo tha mi dad la snang tshul so sor snang ba'i thub pa drug tu sprul par gsungs pas thub pa drug dngos su gsungs rjes de dag gi chos 'khor dus gnas rnams shugs 'byung du gsal ba sogs rnam

384 dgongs gcig nyin snang /pa mang po'i sgo nas 'chad par spro na'ang yi ge'i ngal bas yan lag gi bshad pa'i spros pa rnams re zhig dor nas/ 'dir dgongs pa'i rtsa ba 'chad de/ 'khor ba 'gro ba rigs drug gam lnga dang / myang 'das byang chub gsum mam/ 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi la sogs pa thams cad mthar thug 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes phun tshogs lnga'i bdag nyid las gang du yang ma 'das pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan ston 'khor chos sogs gcig las du mar snang ba ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad med par brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga /sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su chos thams cad ye shes de'i ngo bor gdod nas grub pa/ kun rdzob tu las nyon kyis 'phags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal tsha grang bkres skom glen rmugs sogs myong ba phun tshogs lnga bsdus ma yin pa ltar snang yang / ye shes de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi jo bor gsungs pas sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yang rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa spros bral ye shes chen po las ma 'das pa don dam bden pa ste rnam

gzhung 'grel/ 385pa kun tu bden gnyis zung 'jug las 'da' ba med pa'i gnad dang / stong dang rten 'brel dbyer med la dgongs shing / gzhan yang 'khor 'das dbyer med ces pa dge ba'i rang gzugs kyis mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis dang / mi dge ba'i rang gzugs kyis 'gro ba rigs drug tu snang yang / snang cha de tsam las ngo bo de dang der 'dzin ltar ma grub pa thams cad chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa spros bral zhi ba chen po las ma 'das pa sngar lung mang du drangs pa ltar dang / sems can thams cad la kham sa bde bar gshegs pa'i dhi/nga po sgrib med du yod pa mgon po byams pas rnam pa kun tu gsungs mod/ bde gshegs snying po de ni yon tan phun tshogs lnga ldan las mi 'da' ste/ dper na sa bon du bzhag pa'i nas la yang btags na rtsam pa 'byung la/ sa bon btab pa'i nas su smin pa yang btags na rtsam pa 'byung ba dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir sogs lung rig du ma'i cha nas legs par grub bo/ da lta kun rdzob 'khrul/ ngor 'khor ba pa la phun tshogs lnga ldan mi 'dug pa 'dra ba 'di ni

386 dgongs gcig nyin snang /rang rang gi mi dge ba'i las kyi rang gzugs de rang gis mthong ba yin mod/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong yang / dung gi gshis dkar po kho na las mi 'da' zhing rang mkhris nad las grol na dung gi mdog dkar po nyid du mthong ba ltar/ khams rang bzhin rnam dag gi gshis bde gshegs snying po phun tshogs lnga ldan las ma 'das kyang mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bus ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong ba ltar snang mod/ las de dang bral nas mya ngan las 'das pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag nyid gdod nas yongs grub tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'khrul pa'i rang bzos ma slad pa yin la/ lung rigs ni sngar mang du bshad pa rnams 'dir sbyor bar rigs so/ /gzhan yang ji skad du/ dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs sa gzhi de/ /yang dag don gyi 'og min yin/ /zhes sogs kyang don 'di thog tu 'bab pas/ go bar bya dgos la/ rdor she ma sogs su/ ston pa a wa glang mgo 'khor dmyal ba'i sems can/chos tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ dus de ku'i tshe tshad/ gnas dmyal ba

gzhung 'grel/ 387sogs bshad pa yang gnas skabs su brjod bya rjod byed mi mdzes kyang shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'i dgongs pa dang / srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa'i lung dang / sangs rgyas dngos kyis chos gsung yang rgyu 'bras las gzhan med na dmyal bar rgyu 'bras dngos su gtan la phab pa chos rnam dag tu 'gyur ba sogs lung rig mang pos dpyad na bshad pa de 'dra ba don gyi cha nas legs par thob cing rmad du byung ba'i go bar zad do/ /bka' thams cad kyi gleng gzhi la chos phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang zer yang /'dir bka' thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa lnga nges par tshang bar bzhed pa rtsa bar rdor gsung gcig tu byas pa rje zhwa dmar pa bzhi pas kyang de ltar mdzad na'ang / rdor she mar 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i khongs su bsdus pas sa bcad drug pa dang / bdun pa gnyis gcig tu byas pas so/ //brgyad pa ni/ thun mong gi mdo dang sems tsam ston pa'i bka' ni mngon pa'i sde snod du bzhed pa ni/ 'dul ba ni spyi dang

388 dgongs gcig nyin snang /mthun/ mdo dang mngon pa thun mong du rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs dang / mngon pa gong ma sems tsam ston pa'i mdo phal po che dang / gtan la dbab pa/ lang gshegs/ rgyan stug po bzhi sogs nges don ston pa rnams so/ /mngon pa 'og ma sde bdun gyi phyogs su/'dul ba dang mngon pa 'og ma thun mong du 'ong ba'i mdo theg chung gi mdo rnams yin cing / mdo sde'i ngos 'dzin ma byung yang / de las gzhan pa'i drang nges 'dres par ston pa'i mdo rnams la dgongs zhes rje zhwa dmar pa bzhi pas gsungs pa don la gnas pas so/ //dkyi pa ni/ mu stegs dang bon gyi sgor zhugs pas bden pa mthong ba'i gnas med bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa lta ba mtha' bral du bzhed par/ mu stegs rnams rtag chad gang rung lta bar khas len cing dkon mchog gsum la log par lta ba dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang bral ba sogs kyi rang rgyud kyi lta ba de ma dor bar du sangs rgyas mi thob la/ bon ni sangs rgyas ma byung ba la sgro btags shing des bstan pa'i don zhes phyin ci log tu bsgyur bas

gzhung 'grel/ 389gnad 'chugs pa sogs log pa'i lam du zhugs pas chos de ma dor bar du 'tshang mi rgya ste/ mdo sde gtan la phab pa la sa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab log par bsgyur ba rnams bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /zhes dang / mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig yid ni r+shachos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /ces gsungs so/ //bcu pa ni/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni yod par mi 'gal bya ba/ snga ma'i 'phro bon dang mu stegs 'tshang rgya ba mi srid kyang thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig/ ni yod de/bsod nams cha mthun dge ba bcu spyod pa'i steng du thar pa zhes pa myang 'das yin pas/ de'i cha shas 'khor ba la yid skyo zhing myang 'das thob 'dod kyi bsam pa tsam yod mod/ 'on kyang 'tshang mi rgya ba ni theg chen gyi skyabs sems dang rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol sogs lam gyi gnad rnams med cing / yod pa yang phyin ci log tu song bas 'tshang mi rgya ba yin no//

30)wa dgongasagacig nyin snang //bcu gcig pa ni/ sdom pa bsrung ba dang snying rje phyi rol pa la'ang yod bya ba ni/ dge ba bcus mi dge ba bcu sdom pas sdom pa'i tha snyad tsam 'dogs rung bar rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pas phyi rol pa la dge bcu tsam yod pa dang / sdug bsngal can la snying brtse ba ni lhag par khong la yod pas sngar ti ser mu stegs pa bdun gnas skor la phyin tshe drug lhag pas shi/ gcig lus par/brgya byin gyis bgam pa'i dpe sngar bshad pa ltar dang / 'dod yon spong zhing dka' thub spyod pa sogs sangs rgyas pa las phyi rol pa ches 'bad brtson che ba yin na'ang / mdzod kyi rang 'grel las/ phyi rol pa rnam sa la yang dag par blangs pa'i tshul khrims yod dam zhe na/yod mod kyi/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni ma yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni srid pa la brten pa'i phyir sdig pa las so sor thar par byed pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas dbye ba phyed dgos so/ //bcu gnyis pa ni/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bar bzhed pa ni/ rang gi skal ba dang bsod

gzhung 'grel/ 394nams kyi mthu yod cing / bla ma mtshan ldan gyis bstan pa'i 'a/ma tshang la ma nor ba dang / rang gis nyams len brtson pa rmad du byung ba zhig ste/ rgyu tshogs de rnams 'dzoms na mtshan nyid theg pas kyang tshe gcig la yang 'tshang rgya ba 'ong la/ rgyu tshogs de rnams ma 'dzoms na sngags kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba mi 'grub la/ gtso bor rgyu tshogs de 'dra ba 'dzoms pa gal che ba ste zhib pa sngar sdom pa gsum 'chad pa'i skabs su bshad grub bo/ //bcu gsum pa ni/ chos dang nyams len gyi 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig bya ba ni/ skyabs yul de dag gi ngo bo la khyad med cing / sa'i grangs bcu gcig dang bcu gsum gnyis/ snga ma ni bcu gcig pas sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / phyi ma rtsa mdud grol ba dang las rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gags te bcu gsum pa sangs rgyas su bzhag pa ste/ de ni ngo bo sa bcur mthun zhing nang gses kyi dbye ba yin la/ chos thog mtha' bar gsum du dge zhing nyams len bslab pa gsum mam dge sgrub sdig spong du 'dra bas sangs rgyas ni de gnyis

392 dgongs gcig nyan snang /gang gis bsgrubs kyang thob zin pa mchog dman med par gcig go //bcu bzhi pa ni/ sdom pa gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro bya ba ni/ so thar sdom pa nyon mongs rags pa spong zhing khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum grangs kyang nyung la de nyid lus ngag yid gsum tha mal gyi ngang nas bsrung / byang sdom rnam pa thams cad du gzhan don kho na las mi 'da' zhing rtsa ltung yang so thar las grangs mang bas cung zad snga ma las dog sngags sdom ni sgo gsum ga'i nyon mongs shin tu phra ba yang spong zhing de yang tha mal gyi snang zhen spangs nas lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las mi 'da' bas snga ma gnyis ka las bsrung sdom dka' yang so thar la sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi rmang rdo mi dgos la/ byang sems la so thar gyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro sogs dgos shing / sngags sdom ni thog mar so thar ris bdun gang rung gi gzhi la/ theg chen sems bskyed dang ldan pa la gzod sngags sdom sbyin dgos pas ches dka'/ bsrung mtshams kyang jo bo chen po a ti shas/ kho bo la so thar gyi sdom pa la ni nyes ltung gtan

gzhung 'grel/ 393mi 'ong / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la tshoskabs skabs su tsag tsig tsam 'ong / gsang sngags kyi sdom pa la ni ltung ba char gcig nyar gcig tu 'ong / zhes gsungs pas kyang grub bo/ //bco lnga pa ni/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad tshogs lam gyi ngo bos bgrod bya ba ni/ tshogs lam chung ngur bsgom pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i ngo bos sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad bgrod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sar chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la dran pa yongs su nyams pa med par gsungs shing / skabs brgyad kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i skabs/ de la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dran pasabyu dbang bsgyur ba zhi ba'i rnam pa can zhes gsungs pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag gsum po'ang dran pa'i na rim pas 'phar nas/ dbang po stobs byang chub yan lag 'phags lam brgyad rnams su ngo bo dag cing yon tan 'phel ba'i mthar thag yin pa'i phyir dang / tshogs lam chang ngar ༄4 dbye ra bsgom pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag de nyid kyi ngo bo gong nas gong du na

3lo da wa —— dgongasagacig nyin snang / 'phar ba sangs rgyas kyis bgrod pa yin te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po ji (sta/ ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba de'i zhal snga nas/ das gsum sangs rgyas kyi gzhang lam de/ /das 8 4 ༄ 4 da ba sa da ba gyun chad mad pa' dran pa yan/ /dran pa yangs mad ma shas na//lus ngag tab tab kyi kha na med/ /ces gsungs so/ /dran pa nye bar ga zhag pa'i ngo bo na 'phar ba'i thabs khyad par can gyi theg chen se/mas bskyed dang ldan pa'i tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu rdzogs pa nyid zhin no/ //bcu drug pa ni/ nyan rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang ldan pas mtha/ra thug byang chub snying por 'gyur bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis/da/ri /ṭa/: bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas pa'i/ gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/nyan thos da nga ni rang rgyal gyi/ /sa ni gtan gyi gegs yin no/ /zhes pa'i tha mar gegs zhes bya ba la go don ma 'phrod pas sangs rgyas pa mi srid ces 'dod pa de 'gog pa ste/ nyan rang yang lam de las slar theg chen du sems bskyed pas 'tshang rgya ba yin la/ nyan rang de

gzhung 'grel/ 395yang smon lam gyi mthus theg chen du sems mi bskyed pa mi srid pa la dgongs te/ ji skad du/ dzi ltar mi dag ra ro pa/ /chang gos bral ba sad pa bzhin/ /de nas de dag nga yis kyang / /ye shes dam pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpal phreng gi mdo las/ me'i dpes nyan thos su gyur nas rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /phyis ni sangs rgyas su'ang 'gyur/ zhes sogs gsungs so/ / /bcu bdun pa ni/ 'khor ba mtha' med spros pa med bya ba ni/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbye ba las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' bar gsum 0che/da de de'i spros pa dang bral bas so// slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i dbu ma 'jug pa las/ thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'// de dab che/da pa co so 3'khor ba ni/ /thog ma tha ma med par brjod/ /'gro 'ong bral phyir rmi lam lta'i/ /srid 'di de yis dben nyid gang / /de ni thog ma dang tha ma/ / med pa stong pa nyid do zhes/ /bstan bcos las ni brnga par bsnyad/ /ces rgya cher gsungs so/ /

396 dgongs gcig nyin snang //bco brgyad pa ni/ chos kun so sor thar sdom re rer 'du bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sdom pa gsum gang rung re re la yang 'du ste/ 'dul ba la mtshon na yang / bsrung thabs kyi yan lag thams cad rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam rig min pa 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs yin la/ de bzhin du dze+e do sde'i nyams len byang sems rnam pa gnyis su 'dus pa dang /sngags su thabs shes gnyis su 'du ba sogs nas chos thams cad sdom gsu/ma re rer 'du ba yang bzhed de/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyi myong du 'dus par rig par bya'o zhes dang / gzhan yang chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral gyi steng du gzhol zhing 'bab pa dang yang mthun no/ //bcu dgu pa ni/ sde pa bzhi cha ra gyi rtsa ba lung sde bzhi 'di nyid kho na yin bya ba ni/ mdo las/ kun dga' bo nga 'das
